article.articleHeadline: 全国流感处于中流行水平 检测阳性率上升 中疾控发布提示
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nationwide influenza at a moderate level; positivity rate rising; China CDC issues a reminder.
article.articleSummary: As of November 27, 2026, China's CDC reports that for November 16–22, 2026, national sentinel surveillance shows influenza activity at a moderate (mid-season) level, with rising positivity in southern and northern provinces. Among laboratory-confirmed positives, influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 accounts for 65.0%, A(H3N2) 9.7%, and influenza B/Victoria lineage 25.3%. The 5–14 years age group shows higher positivity than other ages. The agency notes that most regions are in the peak season for respiratory infections and urges vaccination, alongside multi-disease protection. Public health advice includes covering mouth and nose with a tissue, scarf, or elbow when coughing or sneezing, practicing hand hygiene, avoiding touching eyes/nose/mouth with unclean hands, and wearing masks in crowded settings to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 全国のインフルエンザは中程度の流行レベル、陽性率上昇　中国疾病預防控制センターが注意喚起

triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(A/H1N1pdm09, A/H3N2, B/Victoria)の通常の定点サーベイランス報告。中国CDCによる例年の注意喚起であり、異常な重症化や拡大の兆候は記述なし。

article.articleHeadline: Veja por que os casos graves de Covid-19 voltam a aumentar no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: See why severe COVID-19 cases are rising again in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising in Brazil, potentially linked to the new PJ.2.1 variant, according to Fiocruz's Infogripe bulletin. Virologist Paola Cristina Resente from Instituto Oswaldo Cruz notes this trend across the Americas. The World Health Organization classifies PJ.2.1 as a 'variant under monitoring' due to mutations in the spike protein that may increase infectivity, though there is no evidence of greater disease severity. In Rio de Janeiro, genomic surveillance in partnership with the Municipal Health Secretariat found that 58% of analyzed samples belonged to PJ.2.1. Federal guidance emphasizes vaccination for priority groups, including the elderly and children under four, since vaccines provide protection against severe forms for circulating variants. Testing remains essential for controlling infections, conducted mainly in sentinel sites and hospitals. In addition to seniors and young children, immunocompromised or respiratory patients should keep their vaccination schedule up to date per the Health Ministry.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで新型コロナウイルスの重症例が再び増加している理由
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1の監視下にある症例増加が報告されているが、WHOも重症度増加の証拠はないとしており、現時点では通常のサーベイランス範囲内のため継続監視とする。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（リオデジャネイロ）における新変異株PJ.2.1の拡大に関するもの。WHOは当該変異株を『監視下の変異株』に分類しているが重症度増加の証拠はないとしている。スペイン・カナリア諸島への言及は地理的ノイズと判断し除外。

article.articleHeadline: Flu activity climbs to mid-high level as positive rate hits 24%
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in the Health Bureau area has risen to a mid-to-high level, with a weekly positive rate of 24.3% (Nov 15–21), well above the 15.2% threshold. Lab surveillance shows circulation of influenza B and A subtypes H3 and H1; activity was stable February–October before this surge. Children are hardest hit: emergency department visits for influenza-like illness rose 38% in four weeks (363→501), while adult visits remained stable. Clusters increased from four to 13 last week, mainly in kindergartens and schools, predominantly influenza A; a Santa Rosa de Lima Secondary School cluster involved four Form 5 girls with fever and cough starting Nov 22; three tested positive for influenza A; cases mild, no severe complications. Vaccination uptake is satisfactory: care homes >80%, schools ~70%; free vaccination extended to all residents since Nov 16, with about 141,000 doses this year (62,000 for 50+ and elderly). Unvaccinated residents, especially elderly, pregnant women, young children, and those with chronic illnesses, are urged to vaccinate before December travel; immunity takes 2–3 weeks.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ活動が中~高水準に上昇、陽性率24%に達する
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの流行であり、既知のウイルス型（A/H3, H1, B）による定例サーベイランス報告。重症例や異常事態の報告はなく、ワクチン接種率も良好で地域で管理されている。
triage.notes: 記事はマカオ（中国特別行政区）における季節性インフルエンザサーベイランス報告。学校・幼稚園でのクラスター増加はあるが、重症化例はなく、ワクチン接種率も高い。香港・マカオはChinaに含める方針に従いid 1814991を採用。

article.articleHeadline: Treated, cured, then sick again: Why tuberculosis keeps returning to haunt patients
article.articleSummary: Recurrent pulmonary TB haunts Indian TB patients, including Navjot Singh, 42, among those relapsing after treatment at NITRD in Mehrauli and Rajan Babu Institute in GTB Nagar. Over 22 years, TB struck thrice; relapse can occur when original bacteria survive, reinfection, dormant bacilli awaken, or treatment fails. Molecular testing and drug susceptibility help detect resistance. A 2024 NLM review of 75,224 patients found recurrent TB in 2.9%; a 2026 Lancet Global Health study of 1,076 survivors in Maharashtra found 7% redeveloped TB within 12 months. India accounts for about a quarter of global TB, with 2024 estimates of 27.1 lakh new cases and over 3 lakh deaths; worldwide 10.7 million cases and 1.23 million deaths (WHO 2025 report). Many patients abandon treatment, as with Abdesh Singh in Mangolpuri who stopped after 3-4 months; poverty, crowding, malnutrition, stigma drive relapse. HIV co-infection worsens risk and requires TB diagnosis and close follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: 治療・治癒後に再発：結核が患者を苦しめ続ける理由
triage.triage_reason: インドの結核再発に関する既知の疫学的・医療的課題を扱った解説記事であり、新規の異常事態や急性公衆衛生上の脅威ではないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれにも該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Hujan Mulai Rajin Turun, Ada Ancaman DBD yang Diam-Diam Mengintai Warga Kota Probolinggo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rain Is Starting to Fall More Regularly, There Is a Dengue Fever Threat Lurking Quietly Among Probolinggo City Residents.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever threat rises in Probolinggo City as the rainy season begins, with standing water around homes fostering Aedes aegypti breeding. Health official Intan Sudarmadi of Dinkes P2KB Kota Probolinggo urges 3M actions—drain, cover, and recycle—to prevent dengue, rather than relying on fogging alone. Regular draining of water-holding containers such as flower pots, storage tanks, unused ponds, and open rainwater jars is essential to kill larvae. Always seal water storage to prevent mosquito access. Fogging is not a standalone solution since it kills adults only and larvae persist in stagnant water; fogging may be deployed if dengue cases are detected, but must be paired with elimination of mosquito breeding sites for effective prevention. Early dengue symptoms include high fever, headache, nausea, vomiting, and loss of appetite. Statement dated November 26, 2026.

article.articleHeadline: Peringatan Dini Hujan Terbit Lagi, Kemenkes Ingatkan Leptospirosis dari Genangan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early Rain Warning Issued Again, Health Ministry Reminds of Leptospirosis from Standing Water
article.articleSummary: BMKG issued an early rain warning on 27 November 2026 for West Sumatra and the Riau Islands, with nowcasting forecasts for the next 0–6 hours at district level. The Indonesian Health Ministry warns of leptospirosis risk during the rainy season as floodwater and standing water can harbor Leptospira interrogans carried by animals such as rats, cattle, dogs, and pigs. Transmission occurs through skin contact with urine, contact with contaminated water or soil, or consumption of contaminated foods. The bacteria can live for years in animal kidneys without symptoms. Human incubation ranges from 2 days to 4 weeks; symptoms include nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, and red skin spots, with fever, headache, and chills after flood exposure. High-risk groups: outdoor workers, livestock handlers, sanitation workers, flood-prone residents, and recreational water users. Complications include GI bleeding, rhabdomyolysis, disseminated intravascular coagulation, and miscarriage. Seven preventive steps are outlined—protective clothing, wound care, avoiding contaminated water, drinking clean water, and handwashing.

article.articleHeadline: 질병청, 제주서 조류인플엔자 인체감염증 국내유입 대비 점검
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: KDCA to assess readiness in Jeju for the domestic introduction of human infections with avian influenza.
article.articleSummary: Domestic readiness for potential human infections with avian influenza (AI) in Korea centers on Jeju. KDCA Chief Im Seung-kwan visited Jeju Airport Branch to inspect quarantine systems as wild birds and poultry harbor high-pathogenic AI, and overseas AI human infections are reported. Jeju screens inbound flights from AI-affected regions; China and Cambodia are designated focused quarantine management areas. Arrivals from these areas must submit Q-CODE or a health questionnaire before entry; if symptoms such as fever arise after return, report to 1339 or local health centers. Community clinics maintain travel-history screening. As of late October, Jeju Airport processed 10,067 inbound flights and 1,722,434 entrants, with China-origin flights at 63.6% (6,401). Among entrants, 48 with fever underwent in-depth quarantine; no suspected AI cases were found. The health official urged reinforced on-site capabilities to rapidly respond to any suspected case given Jeju’s high share of China-bound traffic.

triage.notes: 記事の主題は韓国済州における検疫準備状況の点検であり、中国・カンボジアは『重点検疫管理地域』として言及されているのみで、具体的な感染事例の発生国として記述されていないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: DOH reports 40% increase in cholera cases, 2% rise in typhoid fever
article.articleSummary: Cholera cases rise 40% in October, with 28 cases recorded Oct 18–31, up from 20 in Oct 4–17, and Regions V and VII breaching epidemic thresholds as outbreaks persist. The cholera case fatality rate climbs to 23% this year, from 1.89% in 2025, while nationwide cholera totals reach 560 cases year-to-date, 61% lower than 1,430 in the same period of 2025. Typhoid fever shows a 2% uptick to 1,200 cases Oct 18–31 (1,180 prior), with 17,089 typhoid cases nationwide so far this year and 15,002 hospitalizations (88%). Cumulative typhoid cases are 26% below 2025’s 23,100. Typhoid CFR falls to 0.30% in 2026 from 0.36% in 2025. Fifteen provinces and urbanized areas across nine regions have breached epidemic thresholds amid El Niño–related water challenges; DOH urges safe drinking water and thoroughly cooked food.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン保健省、コレラ症例40%増加、腸チフス2%増加を報告
triage.triage_reason: コレラの致死率が1.89%から23%へ急上昇しており、異常かつ公衆衛生上深刻な影響が疑われるためIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: コレラの致死率上昇（1.89%→23%）は特に注目すべき異常値であり、データの正確性や死亡例の内訳（医療アクセス不足等）について続報の確認が必要。エルニーニョに伴う水供給問題が流行の背景とされる。

article.articleHeadline: Casos graves de Covid-19 continuam em alta no Brasil, aponta Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe COVID-19 cases remain high in Brazil, according to Fiocruz.
article.articleSummary: As of November 27, 2026, Fiocruz's InfoGripe bulletin shows a sustained rise in severe COVID-19 cases in Brazil, with SARS-CoV-2 lineage PJ.2.1 circulating in eight states and the Federal District; the World Health Organization classifies PJ.2.1 as a variant under monitoring. Rio de Janeiro state reports Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) activity at an alert level, with other respiratory viruses such as metapneumovirus and influenza A and B contributing to the trend. From November 15–21, increases in SRAG cases were recorded across Minas Gerais, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo, Paraná, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Bahia and the Federal District.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで新型コロナウイルスの重症例が引き続き増加、フィオクルスが指摘
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル複数州でCOVID-19重症例（SRAG）増加とWHO監視対象の新系統PJ.2.1の流行が報告されているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の明確な情報はなく、続報を注視すべき段階。
triage.notes: WHO監視対象のSARS-CoV-2系統PJ.2.1がブラジル8州と連邦直轄区で検出され、SRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）が複数州で増加。メタニューモウイルスやインフルエンザA/Bとの混合流行も報告されている。国際的拡大の証拠はまだ不明。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 덮친 치명률 50% 질병...6천 명 가까이 사망 [자막뉴스]
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A disease with a 50% fatality rate strikes the Democratic Republic of the Congo... Nearly 6,000 dead [Caption News].
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain). As of 24 November 2026, cumulative cases reach 12,021 with 5,904 deaths (case fatality rate 49.1%). Ongoing outbreak challenges include rebel clashes forcing evacuation of healthcare workers and wage arrears triggering strikes at treatment centers and checkpoints, delaying containment. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific therapy for this outbreak. WHO warns about two-thirds of deaths occurring outside treatment centers, underscoring gaps in access and care. Cross-border risk is shown by Kenya reporting 9 cases and 2 deaths. The response is hampered by fragile health systems and community mistrust; disputes over U.S.-backed isolation facilities add legal complexity. The article also depicts mortuary challenges and families searching for loved ones amid overwhelmed facilities.

triage.headline_ja: 致死率50%の疾病がコンゴ民主共和国を襲う…死者数6000人近くに[字幕ニュース]
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が流行し、致死率49.1%・死者5,904人に達し、ケニアへの越境拡大も報告されているためフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Vaccination urged for multi-strain flu season
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-27, flu season in China has begun, with three influenza strains circulating: H1N1 (56.2%), H3N2 (15.5%), and B Victoria lineage (28.3%) among positive samples. Southern provinces show declining flu activity while northern provinces rise, signaling a protracted season. Co-circulation raises short-term reinfection risk and could extend transmission. Lack of cross-protection means recovery from one strain does not prevent others. Vaccination is urged for at-risk groups, especially the elderly, children, and people with chronic diseases; students and medical workers are also prioritized. Protective antibodies take 2–4 weeks to develop, so early vaccination is advised before peak season. China has expanded immunization: free vaccines for those 65+, rural primary and junior middle school students, broader insurance coverage, and funds for workers in new forms of employment (couriers, ride-hailing drivers); weekends and targeted vaccination services are offered. Authorities warn of imported chikungunya and dengue and emphasize preventing norovirus outbreaks in high-risk facilities.

article.articleHeadline: 4个流感防控重点问题，权威解答→
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 4 Key Questions on Influenza Prevention and Control, Authoritative Answers →
article.articleSummary: China’s 2026–2027 influenza vaccines comprise both trivalent inactivated vaccines (split/subunit, intramuscular, for 6 months and older) and trivalent live attenuated vaccines (intranasal, for 3–17 years). The vaccines cover A/H1N1, A/H3N2, and B/Victoria lineage strains. Even if autumn infections occurred, reinfection in winter remains possible due to alternating dominant strains and limited cross-protection among lineages. Last year’s vaccine components have been updated for this year, so annual vaccination is still recommended as immunity wanes and the virus evolves. Antiviral options include neuraminidase inhibitors (oseltamivir, zanamivir, peramivir), polymerase inhibitors (baloxavir marboxil, favipiravir), and a hemagglutinin inhibitor (umifenovir/Arbidol). Antivirals do not replace vaccination; high-risk individuals should seek early medical care if symptoms arise. Published date: 2026-11-27.

article.articleHeadline: Casos de escabiose suspendem aulas em escola de Divinópolis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of Scabies Suspend Classes at a School in Divinópolis.
article.articleSummary: Twenty-one cases of scabies were confirmed at Cmei Isauro Silva in the Danilo Passos neighborhood of Divinópolis, prompting municipal authorities to suspend classes at the center on Friday, 27 November 2026, and cancel all municipal school activities scheduled for Saturday, 28 November 2026. In response, a general cleaning and disinfection campaign will be carried out across the municipal network over the weekend to halt transmission and safeguard students and staff. Parents are advised to monitor for intense itching and skin lesions, and, if suspected, to seek prompt clinical evaluation at the nearest health unit rather than sending the child to school. The actions follow the municipal health (Semusa) and education (Semed) protocols under Decree 17.696/2026, with daily monitoring by an intersectoral commission chaired by Mayor Janete Aparecida. Return to classes is anticipated on Monday, 30 November 2026.

article.articleHeadline: 天鹅到家居家保姆被曝梅毒甲肝阳性 平台体检漏洞引担忧
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swan to-Home in-home nanny found positive for syphilis and hepatitis A; platform health-check loopholes raise concerns.
article.articleSummary: Shenzhen-based Swan to Home in-home nanny tested positive for syphilis and hepatitis A, spotlighting platform health-check gaps. The caregiver, while applying facial moisturizer to a baby with a facial cut, bled from a finger; the mother reviewed the platform’s health report and found only hepatitis B was screened, with no tests for syphilis or hepatitis A. Hospital retests showed Treponemal antibody positivity for syphilis and hepatitis A total antibody positivity; the baby tested negative but remains in a window period and requires follow-up testing. Since 2020, regulators—Ministry of Commerce and National Health Commission—mandated domestic workers’ health checks for home services, including gonorrhea screening, external ophthalmic examination, and syphilis antibody testing, yet the platform says it had not been notified. This is not the first incident: prior cases in Dalian (2019) and Jiangxi (2020) also revealed gaps, and six years later full implementation remains incomplete.

triage.headline_ja: 「スワン・トゥ・ホーム」の家事代行ベビーシッターが梅毒・A型肝炎陽性と判明、プラットフォームの健康診断の抜け穴に懸念
triage.triage_reason: 個人の感染症検査結果に関する単発事例であり、公衆衛生上のアウトブレイクや集団発生を示す情報ではない。プラットフォームの健康診断制度の不備を指摘する社会的な記事であり、感染症シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は個人の家事代行ベビーシッターが梅毒・A型肝炎に感染していた事例を基に、プラットフォームの健康診断制度の不備（B型肝炎のみ検査し梅毒・A型肝炎を検査していなかった）を問題視する消費者保護・規制に関する社会的関心記事。感染症のアウトブレイクや集団感染事例ではないため、公衆衛生危機管理上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Bhopal reports 6,000 TB cases, highest treatment burden in MP
article.articleSummary: As of 27 November 2026, Bhopal in Madhya Pradesh reports 6,179 TB patients under treatment, the district’s share of MP’s 100,761 current cases at 6.1%. The numbers are attributed to improved case detection and patient inflow from other districts, not necessarily higher local transmission. State figures list MP’s other districts: Chhatarpur 5,877; Indore 4,764; Gwalior 4,135; Jabalpur 3,760. Diagnostic capacity in Bhopal includes six fixed testing machines and five handheld X-ray units, with Ni-kshay IDs used to track treatment and prevent dropouts. MDR-TB and XDR-TB are prioritized, with care at Gandhi Medical College TB Hospital. Nutritional support kits reach 13,531 TB patients, of whom 4,836 consented to assistance. MP faces TB specialist shortages: 64 sanctioned posts, 37 filled (57.8%), leaving 27 vacant (>42%).

triage.headline_ja: ボパールでTB患者6,000人を報告、MP州で最も治療負担が高い
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核サーベイランス報告であり、検出能力向上による数値であって異常な増加や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核専門医の不足(57.8%充足)は州レベルの医療資源問題として言及されているが、公衆衛生緊急事態には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: பூந்தமல்லி ஒன்றியத்திற்கு உட்பட்ட 28 கிராமங்களில் டெங்கு தடுப்பு பணிகள் தீவிரம் - Dinakaran - Dinakaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue prevention activities intensified in 28 villages under Poonthamalli Union.
article.articleSummary: On 27 November 2026, dengue prevention activities were intensified in 28 villages under Poonthamalli Union in Tamil Nadu. Led by District Health Officer Prabhakaran, with Deputy District Medical Officer Prithiba, District Malaria Officer Neelamogan, Junior Entomologist Anand, Regional Health Supervisor Vadivel, and Health Inspector Vijayakumar, health teams coordinated vector-control and community outreach, including a door-to-door dengue awareness drive in Sembaramakkam Panchayat. As monsoon rains heighten mosquito breeding, authorities identified and destroyed breeding sites, conducted surrounding cleanliness drives, and carried out insecticide spraying and fogging. Fever cases were identified; those with symptoms received medical guidance and, if needed, referrals to hospitals. Residents were urged to prevent water stagnation and fully cooperate with prevention measures to curb dengue and other vector-borne diseases.

triage.headline_ja: プーンタマッリ区管轄の28村でデング熱予防活動が強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節的なデング熱予防・媒介蚊対策活動であり、異常な発生や重症例の急増は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 地方行政・保健当局による定例的な季節性デング熱対策の報道であり、感染者数の急増や死亡例の報告はない。モンスーン期の媒介蚊対策として通常の公衆衛生活動の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: รัฐเพิ่มมาตรการคุมโรค! พิษสุนัขบ้าเข้มข้นขึ้น โปลิโอเป็นโรคติดต่ออันตราย เพิ่มด่าน 2 สนามบิน - สยามรัฐ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The government tightens disease-control measures! Rabies intensifies; Polio is a dangerous communicable disease; Two more checkpoints at airports.
article.articleSummary: Thailand tightens disease-control measures as rabies intensifies and polio is designated a dangerous communicable disease, with two new international airport checkpoints at Trat and Nakhon Si Thammarat. On 27 November 2026, the National Communicable Diseases Committee approved enhanced rabies surveillance after a six-year rise in deaths; 13 fatalities were recorded in 2026. Rabies transmission occurs mainly via dog bites or scratches, with most victims puppies or stray dogs lacking post-exposure vaccination. The Ministry of Public Health will fast-track diagnosis, treatment, and first-dose vaccination for exposed persons; the Department of Livestock will boost animal surveillance and vaccination; Local Administration will expand surveys of owned/stray animals; the National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation will monitor forest–community interfaces. Polio is elevated to a dangerous disease under the Disease Control Act BE 2558. Influenza: 613,292 cases, 134 deaths; RSV: 32,007 cases, 7 deaths; Monkeypox: 512 cases, 3 deaths; Dengue: 34,875 cases, 47 deaths, with southern outbreaks and predominance among school-age and working-age populations.

triage.headline_ja: タイ政府が感染症対策を強化！狂犬病対策を強化、ポリオを危険感染症に指定、空港2か所に新検疫所を設置
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病死亡数の6年連続増加とポリオの危険感染症指定など政策強化の動きは注視すべきだが、急性の国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限を示す具体的事象はなく、フルリスク評価には至らない。
triage.notes: 記事は複数疾患（狂犬病、ポリオ、インフルエンザ、RSV、Mpox、デング熱）の国内統計と政策強化策をまとめたタイ保健当局の定期的な公衆衛生報告であり、単一の急性アウトブレイクシグナルではない。狂犬病死亡数の増加傾向は継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: PAHO calls for stronger surveillance amid increase in mpox cases in the Americas
article.articleSummary: Mpox surge in the Americas prompts PAHO to strengthen surveillance and vaccination. In a 24 November 2026 Epidemiological Alert, cases have risen since epidemiological week 39 of 2026, led by Brazil, with 3,269 confirmed cases and four deaths across 13 countries from January to November 2026. Since 2022, the region has reported 76,084 cases and 202 deaths across 31 countries and territories; Brazil accounts for 1,325 cases in 2026, including one death, with increases since September. Mpox continues to disproportionately affect men who have sex with men; of 114 mpox deaths with known HIV status, 111 (97%) were among people with HIV. PAHO urges stronger epidemiological and genomic surveillance, timely detection and investigation, monitoring shifts in transmission, and expanded prevention and vaccination, especially for high-risk groups. Transmission occurs via close contact and contaminated materials; symptoms include fever, skin rash/lesions, headaches, muscle aches, fatigue, and swollen lymph nodes. Travelers should seek vaccination where available.

triage.headline_ja: PAHO、アメリカ大陸でのMpox症例増加を受けサーベイランス強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「国際的拡大」の2つ以上に該当し、PAHOが地域規模でのサーベイランス・ワクチン接種強化を要請していることから、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はPAHO（汎米保健機構）による地域全体（13カ国、2026年1月～11月で3,269例、4死亡）のMpox増加警告であり、ブラジルが最多症例国として特筆されている。スペイン領カナリア諸島は発生地域に含まれるが対象国リスト外であり、記事内でも主題として扱われていないため除外。HIV陽性者における死亡率の高さ（97%）は重症度・脆弱性の観点で特筆すべき情報。

article.articleHeadline: Bhiwandi shawarma poisoning: Number of affected people rises to 116, stall razed, owner absconding
article.articleSummary: Bhiwandi, Thane district, Maharashtra, reports a chicken shawarma–related outbreak linked to AK Shawarma at Vanjarpatti Naka. The number ill rose to 116 by 27 November 2026, up from 56 two days earlier. Of those affected, 56 men, 35 women and 25 children were hospitalised; four patients (two children, two women) were moved to Thane Civil Hospital as their condition deteriorated, while nine have recovered. Symptoms include vomiting, diarrhoea, abdominal pain and fever. The unauthorised stall has been demolished; the owner is untraceable, and an FIR under BNS sections 274–275 has been filed. FDA visited but could not collect samples; vomit and stool specimens were sent for testing. This is the second shawarma-linked outbreak in Bhiwandi; June 2026’s incident at Famous Shawarma in Khandupada involved Salmonella and E. coli, with the outlet sealed for licence expiry. BNMC has intensified crackdown on illegal vendors with inspections and licensing checks.

triage.headline_ja: ビワンディのシャワルマ食中毒：被害者数116人に増加、屋台は撤去、店主は逃走中
triage.triage_reason: 同一地域で2回目の食中毒アウトブレイクであり、116人発症・複数入院という規模の大きさとWPRO基準（異常性・重症度）該当、地元当局の対応（FDA・BNMC）による社会的関心の高まりが確認されるため、フルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: 原因病原体は検査中で未確定（疾患名はBluedotタグによる推定）。同地区で6月にもSalmonella/E. coli関連のシャワルマ食中毒事例があり、衛生管理の構造的課題が示唆される。死亡者報告はなく、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際拡大の懸念はない食品由来の局地的アウトブレイクである。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 확진 1만2000명 넘어...치명률 50% 육박
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 12,000, with case fatality rate nearing 50%.
article.articleSummary: Lab-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 12,021 as of 24 November local time, with 5,904 deaths (case fatality rate 49.1%). Recovered total 3,332; 1,092 are in treatment centers. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no approved vaccine or therapy exists; however the Ervebo vaccine (for Zaire ebolavirus) has been deployed since 26 August in the affected area for residents and healthcare workers, with animal data suggesting reduced progression to severe illness. The northeastern Ituri and North Kivu provinces are impeded by ongoing government–rebel fighting, hindering vaccination, surveillance, and control. A mining town about 25 km north of Bunia has seen clashes; WHO staff were evacuated after gunfire. Unpaid salaries for Ebola-treatment and checkpoint personnel further impede operations. WHO warns most deaths occur outside treatment centers, with late case confirmation and weak contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴのエボラ確定症例が1万2000人を超える…致死率50%に迫る
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、1万2000例超の大規模アウトブレイクであり、紛争地域での対応困難、承認ワクチン・治療薬の不在など公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルス種に対する承認ワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、Ervebo(Zaire種用)を状況対応的に使用している点、紛争による医療活動の妨げ、未払い給与によるオペレーション支障など、管理可能性に重大な懸念あり。続報と国際支援動向の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Over 10,000 chickens culled in Cuddalore, bird flu scare returns
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (H5N1) re-emerged in Cuddalore district, Tamil Nadu, with the culling of about 10,000 chickens at Nochikadu and Naduthittu after sudden deaths. Officials buried remaining poultry, deployed disinfectants, and reinforced biosecurity as part of containment. The outbreak follows earlier mass mortality across five farms around Kattiyankuppam, where over 40,000 birds died and 34,000 were culled after November 13 laboratory confirmation of highly pathogenic avian influenza by the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases in Bhopal; subsequent culls occurred within a one-kilometre radius of the infected Kattiyankuppam site. Current case samples were sent to Namakkal for confirmation. Health Minister KG Arunraj reports no human infections and ongoing monitoring in Cuddalore, while Chennai has reported H5N1 at Vandalur Zoo and heightened surveillance. Farm owners seek fair government compensation.

triage.headline_ja: クダロールで鶏1万羽超を殺処分、鳥インフルエンザの脅威が再燃
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州で高病原性鳥インフルエンザ(H5N1)による大規模な家禽死亡・殺処分が発生しているが、現時点で人への感染は報告されておらず、公衆衛生上の重大性は確認されていないため継続監視とする。
triage.notes: 人への感染報告はないが、複数農場・動物園での再発生と大量死・殺処分が続いており、動物衛生当局による監視が継続中。人獣共通感染症としてのリスクを注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Equateur Province: about 641,000 children expected for polio vaccination [Radio Okapi]
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination campaign planned in Equateur Province (DR Congo), targeting about 641,000 children for immunization, as reported by Radio Okapi on 2026-11-27. The article centers on a mass polio vaccination drive to boost protection against poliomyelitis among young children. No outbreak or case counts are presented in the available text; the posted body consists solely of a disclaimer about Africain.info and does not provide epidemiologic details. The report underscores immunization as a preventive measure to sustain polio-free status and avert reintroduction, with emphasis on child populations in Equateur Province and coordination with health authorities. The piece notes ongoing public health vaccination efforts in the province, reflecting broader polio eradication objectives.

triage.headline_ja: 赤道州:ポリオワクチン接種に約64万1000人の子どもが対象に見込まれる【ラジオ・オカピ】
triage.triage_reason: 予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンの告知であり、アウトブレイクや症例数の報告はなく、IHR基準・WPRO基準のいずれにも明確に該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: India should eliminate measles
article.articleSummary: India has not yet eliminated measles, despite progress and a goal to eradicate measles and rubella by achieving over 95% vaccination with two doses in every district. Measles remains highly contagious: an infected person can transmit to more than 15 susceptible people, and the virus can stay airborne up to two hours. NFHS-5 data from nearly 44,000 children aged 24-35 months show 11.5% zero-dose and 29.8% with only one of the two doses; eight northeastern states have higher zero-dose prevalence, and in 26 districts more than 30% received no measles vaccine. Socioeconomic disparities persist: zero-dose odds are 66% higher in the poorest households and 54% higher when mothers have no schooling. Campaigns help but require routine follow-up, outreach to migrant/remote communities, functioning primary health centres, and strong surveillance. Campaigns like Mission Indradhanush raised immunisation levels, signaling what sustained investment can achieve in India's public health.

triage.headline_ja: インドは麻疹を撲滅すべきだ
triage.triage_reason: 個別の急性アウトブレイク報告ではなく、麻疹排除に関する政策論評記事であるが、ワクチン未接種率の高さなど感染拡大しやすい状況が継続していることから経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的なアウトブレイク事例の報告ではなく、インドにおける麻疹・風疹排除政策に関する論説記事。ワクチン未接種率の高さや地域格差など構造的問題を指摘しており、将来的なアウトブレイクリスクの観点から継続的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: डेंग्यू, चिकुनगुनिया, झिकाचे निदान आता एकाच चाचणीत ; पुण्याच्या एनआयव्हीची महत्त्वपूर्ण कामगिरी ; उपचारांची दिशाही होणार स्पष्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue, chikungunya, Zika diagnosis now in a single test; Pune's NIV marks a significant achievement; The treatment directions will also become clear.
article.articleSummary: Dengue, chikungunya, and Zika can now be diagnosed from a single sample using a multiplex real-time RT-PCR test developed by NIV Pune under ICMR. The assay detects viral RNA with Beta-actin as an internal control to confirm extraction and assay validity. Validation used 257 dengue, 113 chikungunya, 4 Zika, and 220 non-infected samples, yielding dengue sensitivity 95.3% and chikungunya 98.2%, with 100% specificity for all three viruses; Zika sensitivity remains to be established, needing more positive samples. Quality-control samples from 2022–2025 (QCMD) confirmed consistent results across days, reagent lots, and different RT-PCR machines. Published in Archives of Virology, the test facilitates faster, more accurate diagnosis and supports public health tracking and treatment decisions. Dr. Rajesh Karyakte notes its potential to translate into a diagnostic kit for clinical use.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱、チクングニア熱、ジカ熱の診断が単一検査で可能に；プネーNIVが重要な成果を達成；治療方針も明確化へ
triage.triage_reason: 新規診断法の開発に関する科学・技術ニュースであり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクの発生を報じるものではないため、トリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 記事はNIV Pune（ICMR傘下）が開発した多重リアルタイムRT-PCR検査法の技術的成果を報じるもので、デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱の実際の症例報告やアウトブレイク情報は含まれていない。感染症イベントとしての発生報告ではないため、対象国（India含む）への発生確認は行わない。

article.articleHeadline: Biến thể Covid-19 mới xuất hiện ở nhiều quốc gia: Khả năng lây lan thế nào?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new COVID-19 variant has emerged in many countries: how transmissible is it?
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1, a SARS-CoV-2 variant descended from Omicron JN.1, has been detected in multiple countries across the Americas, Europe, and Asia and is classified by the WHO as a Variant Under Monitoring. It carries up to 24 spike-protein mutations. Lab data show stronger ACE2 binding, but there is no confirmed increase in real-world transmissibility. Early findings suggest limited immune escape relative to circulating variants. Symptoms are not markedly different from prior Omicron infections; common COVID-19 signs include fever, chills, sore throat, cough, nasal congestion, runny nose, headache, muscle aches, fatigue, and occasionally nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea. Global risk remains low for now; no clear evidence of increased hospitalizations or deaths. Vietnam’s Ministry of Health urges continued basic precautions, vaccination, masking in crowded or enclosed spaces, and medical attention if symptoms worsen, as of 27 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの新変異株が複数国で出現：どの程度拡散する可能性があるか？
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1がWHOの監視対象変異株に指定されたが、実世界での感染力増加や重症度上昇の確証はなく、現時点のリスクは低いとされているため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナム保健省の注意喚起を含む一般的な変異株解説記事であり、特定国での急激な感染拡大や重症化事例の報告はない。スペイン（カナリア諸島）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll nears 6,000 in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to exact a heavy toll. Government data list 5,904 deaths among 12,021 confirmed cases. The outbreak was declared mid-May in Ituri province and has since spread to eight of the DRC’s 26 provinces, underscoring sustained transmission across a broad geographic area. With the tally rising toward 6,000 deaths, the situation remains ongoing as of 2026-11-27. In response, Japan conducted the first Ebola response drill amid the Congo outbreak, reflecting international public health engagement. The report provides counts but does not specify infection sources or details on imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ死者数が6,000人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: 致死率が高く死者数が約6,000人に達し、26州中8州に拡大するなど持続的な人-人感染が続いており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 日本は対応訓練を実施したのみで発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。感染源や輸出入症例の詳細は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Chủ động kiểm soát sốt xuất huyết bằng công nghệ cảnh báo sớm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Proactive Dengue Fever Control Using Early Warning Technology.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Ho Chi Minh City (TP.HCM) and Ha Tinh province triggers proactive, technology-driven control. In TP.HCM, dengue accounts for about 30–40% of infectious diseases, averaging 50,000 cases annually (2015–2025) with 2025 incidence at 472 per 100,000. The epidemic peaks June–November, and over 8,000 larval-risk sites are monitored amid urbanization and climate-change pressures. In Ha Tinh, 731 dengue cases were recorded in 2026 across five outbreaks, two ongoing (Văn Miếu-Trung Thượng: 113 cases; Vĩnh Lộc: 91). Control measures include environmental management and insecticide spraying of 200 households around Ky Hoa and 899 households in Cam Trung. Ho Chi Minh City is developing an early warning system (2026–2028) integrating case data, vectors, serology, and climate to forecast 1–12 weeks ahead and guide targeted interventions; six localities are piloting, with expansion to 168 wards/communes planned; OUCRU collaboration; GIS-based management since 2017.

triage.headline_ja: 早期警報技術によるデング熱の能動的制御
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの既知の季節性デング熱流行であり、例年発生している疾患だが、症例数が多く監視技術導入の動きがあるため継続観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで季節性・地域流行性の既知疾患であり、本記事は主に監視技術（早期警報システム）導入に関する内容。重症度や死亡者数の情報は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Putusan Pengadilan Tinggi Kenya Soal Fasilitas Karantina Ebola Tanpa Konsultasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya High Court ruling on Ebola quarantine facilities without consultation
article.articleSummary: Kenya High Court ruled the government violated the constitution by authorizing the construction of an Ebola quarantine facility backed by the United States without public consultation. The 50-bed facility was built at Laikipia Air Base near Nanyuki and was intended to house people exposed to Ebola, including U.S. citizens. Archival footage from June showed protests in Nanyuki and Nairobi with demonstrators carrying posters and mock coffins, burning tires, and clashing with police who used tear gas. The court ordered the government to disclose project documents within 45 days, including the agreement with the United States, and barred any further construction or operation of the facility until compliance with applicable procedures. The ruling comes amid fears that Ebola could spread from the Democratic Republic of Congo and concerns about Kenyan health system capacity to handle an outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア高等裁判所、エボラ検疫施設建設を巡り協議なしの違憲判決
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はケニアにおけるエボラ検疫施設建設を巡る違憲判決・抗議活動に関する法的・政治的ニュースであり、実際の感染症発生や症例報告ではない。発生国ケニアは対象国リストに含まれず、DRCは懸念の背景として言及されるのみで実際の発生報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアの検疫施設建設を巡る司法判断・抗議活動が主題であり、実際のエボラ症例やDRCでの発生状況の詳細は含まれていない。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。DRCは『懸念』として言及されるのみで実発生報告ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola avanza en medio de conflictos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak advances amid conflicts.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 12,021 confirmed cases, according to government data from Bunia and the eastern region, as of Thursday. It is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history, with nearly half of those infected dying, per the Ministry of Health. It is the deadliest of the DRC’s 17 Ebola outbreaks and is on track to surpass the approximately 11,000 deaths of West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic. Ongoing clashes between rebels and the army are hampering surveillance, contact tracing, and containment efforts across the affected area. The rapid rise in cases highlights the difficulty of controlling Ebola in conflict-affected, hard-to-reach parts of the eastern Congo, where health authorities are intensifying efforts despite insecurity.

triage.headline_ja: 紛争の最中でエボラ出血熱の流行が拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で史上最速拡大のエボラ流行が12,021例を超え致死率約50%、紛争により対応が阻害されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部（ブニア含む）のエボラ流行に特化しており、Angolaは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事サマリーには言及がないため除外した。史上最速拡大・過去最多死亡者数更新の恐れがあり、紛争による対応阻害が深刻。

article.articleHeadline: सांस लेने में हो रही है परेशानी तो न करें नजरअंदाज, सर्दी के मौसम में हो सकता है निमोनिया का खतरा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: If you're having trouble breathing, don't ignore it—pneumonia risk may rise in the winter season.
article.articleSummary: Winter coughs, breathlessness, and fever may signal pneumonia, a lung infection. Dr. Ajay Kumar of Rajiv Gandhi Hospital and Dr. Ajit caution that while winter colds and flu are usually viral and improve in days, a cough that lingers with shortness of breath can indicate pneumonia. Pneumonia inflames the lung’s small air sacs, leading to breathing difficulty. Warning signs include fever that persists, shortness of breath, chest pain, a productive cough with yellow/green or blood-tinged sputum, marked weakness, fatigue, and loss of appetite. Children under five, adults over 65, and those with weak immunity are at higher risk; in children, fast breathing and inward chest movement are key signs. Seek medical care for cough with breathing trouble, chest pain, or high fever; emergency care is needed if lips or face turn blue, fainting, or confusion. Published 2026-11-27.

triage.headline_ja: 息苦しさを感じたら放置しないで―冬は肺炎のリスクが高まる可能性
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクではなく、冬季の肺炎に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 具体的な感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、医師による季節性の健康啓発・注意喚起記事である。特定地域の流行データも含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 질병청, 제주서 AI 인체감염증 국내유입 대비 검역체계 점검
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: KDCA Inspects Jeju Quarantine System in Preparation for Domestic Introduction of Avian Influenza Infections in Humans
article.articleSummary: High-pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) human infections abroad prompt Korea’s KDCA to inspect Jeju International Airport’s quarantine system. On 27 November 2026, KDCA Commissioner Lim Seung-kwan visited the Jeju Airport Station to validate procedures to block HPAI entry via travelers and goods. Following an October 13 risk alert, controls were issued to poultry farms and transport operators; HPAI antigens have been detected in wild birds and poultry domestically since a Suncheon Bay fecal sample in Jeollanam-do tested positive. China and Cambodia are designated focus regions; travellers from these areas must report health status via Q-CODE or a paper health form. A post-arrival dual surveillance system remains: symptomatic returnees should contact 1339 or local health centers, and clinicians can verify overseas travel history. From January–October, Jeju quarantines screened 10,067 flights and 1,722,434 entrants; 48 travellers underwent detailed investigations, all negative. Jeju uses a paperless, kiosk-based quarantine to speed entry and reduce contact.

triage.headline_ja: 疾病管理庁、済州でAI(鳥インフルエンザ)ヒト感染症の国内流入に備え検疫体制を点検
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は韓国済州空港における検疫体制の点検・強化を報じる内容であり、新規の感染発生事例の報告ではない。中国・カンボジアは渡航者の重点監視対象地域として言及されているに留まり、具体的な発生状況の記述はない。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国国内の検疫対応に関するもので、対象国リストに韓国は含まれない。中国・カンボジアは重点監視地域として言及されるのみで、具体的な発生事例の記述がないため verified_locations には含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Hati-Hati, di Balik Tren Memelihara Satwa Eksotis, Ada Risiko Penularan Penyakit Zoonosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be careful: Behind the trend of keeping exotic animals as pets, there is a risk of zoonotic disease transmission.
article.articleSummary: India's exotic-pet trade raises zoonotic risks amid weak One Health-integrated surveillance. In Mumbai, veterinary doctor Rina Dev, a bird and exotic-animal specialist, spent four days hospitalized for pneumonia linked to psittacosis (Chlamydia psittaci) after handling seized wildlife. A 2024 case described a man with fever, chills, shortness of breath, cough and joint pain who recovered after targeted psittacosis treatment, illustrating occupational risk. In Belgium, 15 customs officers were infected with psittacosis after exposure to infected parakeets. ICAR-Indian Veterinary Research Institute (2021) highlighted the zoonotic potential of psittacosis. A 2026 Humane World for Animals report warns India’s exotic-pet trade creates conditions favorable to cross-species transmission and notes the lack of an integrated disease-surveillance system. Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has 11,114 confirmed cases and 5,433 deaths as of 10 November 2026, with additional cases in Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria—the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record.

triage.headline_ja: 要注意：エキゾチックペット飼育トレンドの裏にある人獣共通感染症の伝播リスク
triage.triage_reason: 記事はインドのエキゾチックペット取引によるオウム病（人獣共通感染症）のリスクを主題としているが、併せてコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）における過去最速拡大とされるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（確定症例11,114例、死亡5,433例、複数国への拡大）が報告されており、国際的公衆衛生上の重大懸念としてフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事本体はインド・ムンバイでの獣医によるオウム病罹患例とエキゾチックペット取引のワンヘルス監視体制の弱さを主題とするが、文中にDRCのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（2026年11月10日時点で確定11,114例、死亡5,433例、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの拡大、史上最速拡大）という極めて重大な情報が含まれており、これを看過できないためPICKUPと判定した。ベルギー・ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Varningen: Mässling upptäck på flyg till Thailand
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: Measles detected on flight to Thailand.
article.articleSummary: Measles detected on a Bangkok–Stockholm flight prompts Swedish health alert. One measles case was identified in a traveler who arrived in Stockholm on 19 November, as reported by Aftonbladet, with authorities saying the suspected outbreak involves passengers onboard the Bangkok-to-Stockholm flight. Public Health Agency of Sweden warns that all on-board passengers may have been exposed and the affected region is conducting follow-up. Thai Airways informed travelers by email about the exposure. While population vaccination coverage is high—reducing the likelihood of a larger outbreak—health officials caution that additional isolated cases cannot be ruled out. The report emphasizes import risk from international travel and the need for vigilance among clinicians and travelers.

triage.headline_ja: 警告：タイ行きの機内で麻疹発見
triage.triage_reason: バンコク発ストックホルム行き便内での麻疹曝露が確認され、スウェーデン公衆衛生当局が警告を発出。国際便を介した輸入例であり拡散リスクと社会的関心が認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はスウェーデンで確認された麻疹の輸入例（バンコク発便搭乗者）についてのもので、タイ国内での麻疹発生そのものを報告しているわけではないため、対象国としてタイは含めない。感染源や発生国の特定情報は記事中に不明。

article.articleHeadline: У ДР Конго кількість випадків Еболи перевищила 12 тисяч
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the number of Ebola cases has surpassed 12,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo have surpassed 12,000, with 12,021 confirmed infections and about half of patients dying. Declared in May, the outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. It is the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in the country’s history and among its deadliest, with fatalities potentially surpassing West Africa’s 2014–2016 toll of about 11,000. Conflict, poor roads, and violence fueled by distrust and misinformation are hampering response. In Iga-Barrière, a mining town about 25 km north of Bunia, clashes between the army and the CRP rebel group triggered new displacement toward Bunia. WHO's incident manager Dr. Katherine Smolwood said clashes have blocked access to some settlements, interrupted monitoring of at-risk people, and reduced staff at treatment centers. Approximately ten people, including two WHO staff and Congolese health officials, were evacuated to Bunia after a siege at Akve.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例数が1万2000人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%、1万2000人超の感染という深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、紛争により対応が妨げられ国際的拡大・支援の必要性も高いため、フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAlaska、United States、Angolaが含まれるが、記事本文はDRC東部（イトゥリ州ブニア周辺）のアウトブレイクに特化しており、これらは誤付与と判断し除外した。バンディブギョウイルスによる史上最速拡大・最悪級の流行とされ、紛争による対応阻害も深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Varningen: Mässling upptäck på flyg till Thailand
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: Measles detected on a flight to Thailand.
article.articleSummary: Measles detected on a Bangkok–Stockholm flight prompts a warning from Sweden’s Public Health Agency. A measles case was identified in a traveler who flew into Stockholm on 19 November. The agency says all passengers aboard may have been exposed to the infection. Thai Airways notified travellers by email about the potential exposure. The affected region is following up the case, according to the Public Health Agency. The incident is described as a suspected measles outbreak on the aircraft, underscoring the exposure risk for passengers who may have developed symptoms. The report does not specify additional locations or confirmed secondary cases, and authorities continue to monitor the situation.

triage.headline_ja: 警告：タイ行きの便内ではしかを検出
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の麻疹ではあるが、国際線の多数の乗客が曝露した可能性があり、保健当局が警告を発するなど社会的・行政的関心が高いため、WPRO基準（流行しやすさ）該当と合わせてフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 麻疹感染者が確認されたのはスウェーデン（対象国外）であり、タイは便の出発地として言及されているのみで、タイ国内での発症・流行の確証はないため verified_locations には含めなかった。続報でタイ国内の二次感染例が確認された場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: US loses measles-free status after 26 years; India reports over 28,000 cases in 2026
article.articleSummary: United States loses measles elimination status after 12 consecutive months of endemic transmission, PAHO announced on November 17, 2026. As of November 24, 2026, US CDC records 6,039 confirmed measles cases, up from 2,289 in all of 2025. Mexico and Bolivia also lose elimination status; Canada had already done so in 2025. India reports 28,605 measles cases January–September 2026, up from 12,313 in the same period last year, with WHO classifying India as endemic. Losing elimination status means re-established endemic transmission, though occasional imported cases may occur if local spread is interrupted. Measles is highly contagious, airborne, and can infect up to 18 people; the virus can remain infectious for up to two hours. Symptoms include high fever, dry cough, runny nose, Koplik spots, and a rash; complications include pneumonia, encephalitis, severe diarrhea, ear infections, and potential blindness, with about 95,000 global deaths in 2024, mainly among unvaccinated children under five.

triage.headline_ja: 米国が26年ぶりに麻疹排除状態を喪失、インドでは2026年に28,000件以上の症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: インドで麻疹症例が前年同期比で倍増し（12,313→28,605件）、WHOがインドを麻疹流行国と分類。重症合併症（脳炎・肺炎・死亡）のリスクがあり、国際的な感染拡大の可能性も高いため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事は米国・メキシコ・ボリビア・カナダの麻疹排除状態喪失を主題としているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。インドのみ対象国として該当し、同国の症例急増とWHOによる流行国認定が主要な懸念点。

article.articleHeadline: Varningen: Mässling upptäckt på flyg från Thailand till Stockholm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: Measles detected on a flight from Thailand to Stockholm.
article.articleSummary: Sweden's Public Health Agency warns airline passengers after a suspected measles outbreak on a flight from Bangkok, Thailand to Stockholm, reported by Aftonbladet. The illness was detected in a traveler who arrived in Stockholm on 19 November. On 20 November, a measles-infected person sought care at the emergency department of Södersjukhuset, prompting extensive contact tracing. Thai Airways informed travelers that all on board may have been exposed. The affected region is following up the case. Authorities note that vaccination coverage in the population is high, making a larger outbreak unlikely, though isolated additional cases cannot be ruled out. No further details on laboratory confirmation or symptoms are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: 警告:タイからストックホルム行きの機内で麻疹感染者を検出
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹は感染力が非常に強く、機内での広範な接触者追跡が行われており、公衆衛生当局やメディアの関心も高いため、WPRO基準(epidemic_prone)に該当し社会的関心もあることからフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はスウェーデン国内で発生した輸入麻疹例の接触者追跡に関するもので、タイ国内での麻疹発生拡大を示す記述はないため、タイは地域検証から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: கிண்டி சிறுவர் பூங்காவில் பறவைகள் உயிரி*ப்பு: முன்னெச்சரிக்கை நடவடிக்கையாக பூங்கா மூடல்! - Dinakaran - Dinakaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird deaths at Kindi Children's Park: Park closed as a precautionary measure.
article.articleSummary: Bird deaths in the waterfowl enclosure at Kindi Children’s Park, Chennai, prompt precautionary closure from November 28 to 30, with the park remaining shut until further notice. The cause of death is not yet determined; samples have been sent to the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD) in Bhopal for testing. Avian influenza infection has not been detected to date. Following guidelines, the affected birds have been isolated, and the enclosure is being cleaned with disinfectants while the health status of other birds and animals is closely monitored. Full details will be released after laboratory results are available.

triage.headline_ja: キンディ児童公園で鳥の死亡:予防措置として公園を閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 鳥の死亡事例が発生し検査中だが、鳥インフルエンザ感染は現時点で未確認であり、ヒトへの影響も報告されていないため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 原因不明の鳥の死亡事例。検査結果（NIHSAD）待ちで、鳥インフルエンザは現時点で未検出。ヒト感染の報告なし。続報待ち。

article.articleHeadline: وفيات "إيبولا" في الكونغو تتجاوز 5900 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in Congo exceed 5,900 cases.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) linked to the Bundibugyo strain has reached 5,904 deaths from 12,021 confirmed cases. Declared in mid-May in Ituri province in the northeastern DRC, the outbreak has expanded to eight of the country’s 26 provinces, revealing persistent transmission across a broad region. As of November 27, 2026, government surveillance reports ongoing containment and response efforts across affected districts. The Bundibugyo variant is described as rare, with the reported totals derived from laboratory-confirmed diagnoses, highlighting sustained public health challenges in monitoring and interrupting transmission in multiple provinces. Authorities continue to monitor the situation and deploy resources to affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数が5,900人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）による大規模アウトブレイクで死者5,904人・感染確認12,021人、26州中8州に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株は稀少で、8州への拡大は持続的な人-人感染と地域的拡散のリスクを示唆する。致死率も高く、国際的な支援ニーズが高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola nel Congo orientale: oltre 12.000 casi, i combattimenti frenano la risposta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in eastern Congo: over 12,000 cases, fighting hampers the response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo virus has reached 12,021 confirmed cases and 5,904 deaths across eight provinces as of mid-November, according to ECDC. Nearly half of confirmed cases have died. In the three weeks before 17 November, 452 of 720 deaths occurred outside treatment centers, highlighting gaps in admission, hydration, electrolyte management, and complication care. In Ituri province, fighting impeded evacuation and access to care; at Akwe hospital, three days of fighting kept staff from leaving and hindered contact tracing. Bundibugyo is distinct from Ebola strains with vaccines or monoclonal antibodies; no licensed vaccine exists for Bundibugyo, though a trial called Tumaini began in Congo in October, and other vaccines are under study. The outbreak remains ongoing, with some cases outside Congo; EU/EEA risk is very low, but the public health emergency of international concern persists.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部でエボラ出血熱：症例数1万2千人超、戦闘が対応を妨げる
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが1万2千例・死亡6千人近くに達し、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）が継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ワクチン未承認株（ブンディブギョ）であり、治療施設外での死亡が多い点、紛争地域での対応困難が特に懸念される。EU/EEAへのリスクは低いとされるが、PHEICは継続中。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு தடுப்பு அதிரடி: கொசு ஒழிப்பை தீவிரப்படுத்திய தமிழ்நாடு அரசு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Prevention Drive: Tamil Nadu Government Steps Up Mosquito Control
article.articleSummary: As of 27 November 2026, Tamil Nadu's Public Health and Higher Education Departments issued a joint order amid the intensified northeast monsoon to make all educational institutions dengue-proof. A weekly, intensive anti-mosquito drive will cover all schools, colleges, universities, and hostels, with ongoing checks of classrooms, laboratories, restrooms, dormitories, kitchens, stairwells, and parking areas to prevent water stagnation. Water storage tanks, elevated tanks, and taps must be sealed to stop mosquito entry; discarded tyres, coconut husks, plastic bottles, plant pots, and construction debris should be removed daily to prevent rainwater collection, and gutters/drains must be kept clean. Hostels and surrounding grounds require special attention, with each institution appointing a Nodal Person and coordinating with local bodies for prevention. Awareness campaigns will educate students and staff on identifying breeding sources, and anyone with fever or dengue symptoms should seek immediate medical care at a government health facility.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱予防対策:タミル・ナードゥ州政府が蚊対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は当該地域で季節的に発生する既知の疾患であり、本記事は行政による通常の予防啓発策を報じるもので、異常性や深刻な公衆衛生上の影響は確認されない。
triage.notes: モンスーン季節に伴う定例的な蚊対策・予防啓発の報道であり、感染者数や重症例など具体的な疫学データは記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 임승관 질병관리청장, 제주공항 찾아 AI 인체감염증 검역 대응태세 점검
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Im Seung-kwan, KDCA Commissioner, visits Jeju International Airport to inspect AI-based human infectious disease quarantine readiness.
article.articleSummary: On November 27, 2026, KDCA Commissioner Im Seung-kwan visited the Jeju International Airport Quarantine Station to inspect AI-related human influenza entry readiness. With highly pathogenic avian influenza detected in wild birds and poultry domestically, and human infections reported abroad, the inspection targeted inbound flights from risk regions. As of the end of last month, the Jeju station processed 10,067 inbound flights and 1,722,434 entrants, including 48 symptomatic individuals. Chinese-origin routes accounted for 6,401 flights (63.6%). Korea designates China and Cambodia as priority inspection regions; arrivals from these areas must submit Q-CODE or a health status questionnaire. Post-arrival surveillance includes SMS alerts on prevention, guidance to contact 1339 or local health centers if fever or cough develops, and a linked system enabling clinicians to check travel history during the incubation period. Im underscored ongoing vigilance due to Jeju’s high proportion of China-bound flights.

triage.headline_ja: イム・スングァン疾病管理庁長、済州空港でAI人体感染症検疫対応体制を点検
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は韓国当局による検疫体制の視察・点検という行政活動の報告であり、新規の感染症発生や症例急増を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国国内の鳥類・家禽における高病原性鳥インフルエンザの存在、および海外でのヒト感染例を背景とした検疫強化の視察内容。具体的な発生国（中国・カンボジア）は入国審査の優先対象地域として言及されているのみで、記事の主題はあくまで韓国の検疫対応体制の点検であるため、対象国リストにおける発生国として確定できない。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola di Republik Demokratik Kongo Tembus 12.000 Kasus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo Tops 12,000 Cases
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have surpassed 12,000, with 12,021 cases and 5,904 deaths since the outbreak was declared in May, making it the country’s largest. As of 27 November, the outbreak has spread to eight provinces: Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, Tshopo, Ubangi South, and Ubangi North, with conflict and local resistance cited as fueling transmission. Ongoing security incidents around a hospital in Ituri disrupted response, prompting WHO personnel to be relocated from Mongbwalu after being stranded in a maternity ward for over 24 hours. This week, WHO and Africa CDC launched an updated continental readiness and response plan for Bundibugyo virus, running November 2026–May 2027, prioritizing community-centered detection, care, and mobilization of resources. The plan requires about $1.576 billion over six months; Tedros Ghebreyesus emphasizes urgent, coordinated action to end the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、感染者数が12,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%・感染者12,000人超・8州に拡大し、治安問題でWHO対応が妨げられるなど、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数に該当する深刻な公衆衛生イベント。
triage.notes: WHO・Africa CDCが16億ドル規模の大陸的対応計画を発表しており、国際支援の必要性が明確。治安悪化により対応が妨げられている点にも留意。

article.articleHeadline: 道内インフル、異例の長期流行に？　外国人観光客増が影響か　春まで続く恐れ：北海道新聞デジタル
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza in Hokkaido: An unusually long-lasting outbreak? Could the increase in foreign tourists be affecting it? There is concern that it will continue until spring — Hokkaido Shimbun Digital
article.articleSummary: Influenza continues to rise in Hokkaido, Japan, after an unusually protracted summer-to-fall spread. By mid-November, the nationwide number of positive influenza tests surpassed the alert threshold, and schools reported frequent class suspensions. Experts link the surge to record numbers of foreign tourists, suggesting that influenza A, previously circulating in East Asia, has taken hold in Hokkaido. Looking ahead, authorities warn of a winter peak and, as in the previous season, a possible rise in influenza B through spring. Health professionals urge vaccination and continued vigilance to mitigate transmission during holidays and cold weather. The report highlights the interconnectedness of tourism and transmission dynamics, with local outbreaks potentially reflecting broader East Asian trends, emphasizing the need for preparedness among clinics, schools, and public health systems in Hokkaido.

triage.headline_ja: 道内インフル、異例の長期流行に？　外国人観光客増が影響か　春まで続く恐れ：北海道新聞デジタル
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの流行に関する日本国内の通常報道であり、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当する発生国がなく、IHR基準・社会的関心ともに特段の懸念は見られない。
triage.notes: 記事は日本（北海道）における季節性インフルエンザ流行を扱っており、中国（上海等）への言及は感染源の推測に留まる。対象国リストに日本は含まれず、中国についても主題として発生している記述ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Mässlingsfall upptäckt på flyg till Sverige
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles case detected on a flight to Sweden.
article.articleSummary: Measles detected in a traveler on a flight from Bangkok, Thailand to Stockholm, Sweden on 19 November. Aftonbladet reports this based on an email the airline sent to passengers. According to the Public Health Agency of Sweden (Folkhälsomyndigheten), all passengers aboard may have been exposed to measles. The affected region is following up the case. The agency notes that the risk of a larger outbreak is small, due to high vaccination coverage in Sweden. The article does not provide details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or infection source beyond international travel, and no further case counts are mentioned. Imported exposure highlights ongoing public health surveillance for measles tied to international flights.

triage.headline_ja: スウェーデン行きの機内で麻疹症例が発見される
triage.triage_reason: 単一の輸入麻疹症例であり、スウェーデン保健当局はアウトブレイクのリスクは低いとしているが、麻疹は感染力が強く機内曝露による拡大可能性があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はタイ発バンコク〜ストックホルム便での麻疹曝露例を報じているが、タイ国内での発生・感染源としての明記はなく、主題はスウェーデンでの機内曝露対応であるため、タイは発生地域として確定できず除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Misamis Oriental town halts F2F classes over rising dengue cases
article.articleSummary: 132 dengue cases in Talisayan, Misamis Oriental, in 2026 (up from 51 in 2025; 158.8% rise) with three fatalities. Face-to-face classes in all public and private schools are suspended starting Friday; learning shifts to modular/alternative modalities per DepEd guidelines until dengue conditions improve. Notable concentrations are in Barangays Poblacion, San Jose, Santa Ines, Bugdang, and Punta Santiago. Measures under Local Health Board Resolution No. 05, Series of 2026, include notifying stakeholders, sanitizing campuses to remove mosquito breeding sites, and issuing dengue prevention reminders. The MHO and barangays will intensify dengue surveillance, clean-up drives, and prevention campaigns in high-case areas until health authorities recommend resuming in-person classes, subject to mayoral directive. Authorities urge continued 5S actions—to eliminate breeding sites, protect against bites, seek early medical care for symptoms, support fogging in high-case areas, and maintain adequate hydration."

triage.headline_ja: ミサミス・オリエンタル州の町、デング熱症例増加により対面授業を停止
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン一自治体(Talisayan)でのデング熱症例増加（132例、死亡3名）に伴い学校閉鎖の地域的対応が取られているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは見られず、地方レベルで管理可能な事案であるため継続監視とする。
triage.notes: 死者3名を含む132例の報告があり、前年比158.8%増。地方自治体（Local Health Board）が主体で対応しており、国レベル・国際レベルの関与は現時点で確認されない。季節的な蚊媒介感染症の地域的増加であり、今後の拡大動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: СМРТОНОСНА ЕПИДЕМИЈА ОД ЕБОЛА ВО КОНГО: Починаа над 5.900 луѓе од реткиот вирус
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly Ebola Epidemic in Congo: More than 5,900 people have died from the rare virus
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has surpassed 12,000 cases and killed more than 5,900 people. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, was first diagnosed in mid-May in the northeast Ituri province and has since spread to eight of the country’s 26 provinces, signaling escalating regional risk. There are currently no approved therapies or vaccines for this strain, and detection is hampered by ongoing armed clashes and an overwhelmed health system, accelerating transmission. The Africa CDC notes only about 15% of new patients have known contacts, indicating many transmission chains remain undetected in communities. This crisis ranks as the second-largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak on record, behind West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (over 28,600 cases and over 11,000 deaths); satellite analyses suggest the true toll may be higher than official counts.

triage.headline_ja: 致死的なエボラ感染症の流行がコンゴで発生：稀なウイルスにより5,900人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、大規模かつ承認済み治療薬・ワクチンがない致死的流行であるため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行について述べている。アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文では言及されておらず、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。武装紛争と医療システムの逼迫により検出・対応能力が著しく制限されている点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情未見趨緩！剛果民主共和國致死率近5成　台延長邊境管制 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak shows no signs of easing! Democratic Republic of the Congo's case fatality rate nearly 50%; Taiwan extends border controls
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) persists. As of November 17, 11,613 confirmed cases and 5,678 deaths (case fatality rate 48.9%) have been reported across eight provinces and 68 health zones, with 48 zones still reporting new cases in 21 days. Ituri Province accounts for about 68% of cases; North Kivu Province’s CFR is 55%. Weekly cases remain ~400–500; no approved vaccine or treatment, though candidates are in clinical trials. WHO maintains the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) after the November 17 IHR Emergency Committee meeting, citing high transmission risk. Neighbors report cases: Uganda 20 cases (2 deaths); Kenya 9 cases (2 deaths); Nigeria one imported case recovered (monitoring through Dec 7). Taiwan extends border controls for 90 days to Feb 26 next year; seven travelers with DRC travel history since May 27 entered, all completing 21-day home quarantine with no symptoms. Visa suspension for DRC residents continues, with exemptions for certain categories. 21-day self-monitoring required; report symptoms to authorities (1922 if ill).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疫情は収まらず！コンゴ民主共和国の致死率約5割、台湾は国境管制を延長
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを維持するエボラ大規模流行で、致死率約49%、複数国への越境拡大、渡航制限（台湾の入国管理延長・ビザ停止）が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。台湾・中国の対応は水際対策であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: கடலூரில் பறவைக் காய்ச்சல் பாதித்த பண்ணையிலிருந்து சென்னைக்கு 8,000 கோழிகள் விற்பனை? அதிகாரிகளின் அலட்சியத்தால் அதிர்ச்சி! - Dinakaran - Dinakaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Cuddalore, were 8,000 chickens from a farm affected by avian influenza sold to Chennai? Shock at officials' negligence!
article.articleSummary: In Cuddalore district’s Kurinjchipadi area, avian influenza outbreaks led to mass culling and concerns of lax enforcement. From Oct 25–31, successive deaths in poultry prompted sampling; on Nov 14, infection confirmed as avian influenza. Across 16 farms in Katchiyanguppam, Thamanampettai, Rasapettai, Naduttittu, and Nochchikadu, more than 80,000 chickens were buried and destroyed. In total, the Tamil Nadu Animal Husbandry Department imposed a three-month ban on rearing and selling in affected zones, and districts ordered culling within a 1-km radius of infected farms. Allegations of negligence focus on Arun’s private farm in Naduttittu, where birds were reportedly left to grow for 15 days and then shipped to Chennai before enforcement. Police investigations indicate that on Oct 24–25, around 8,000 chickens were transported to Chennai by trucks; late on Nov 26, authorities halted further movement of remaining birds as an inquiry is urged into how birds were moved despite the ban.

triage.headline_ja: クダロールで鳥インフルエンザに感染した養鶏場から8,000羽の鶏がチェンナイに販売？当局の怠慢に衝撃！
triage.triage_reason: 家禽での鳥インフルエンザ発生自体は動物疾病だが、規制違反により感染疑いの家禽が主要都市チェンナイへ流通した点が社会的関心・当局の信頼性問題として大きく取り上げられており、WPRO基準の複数該当と社会的関心の高さからフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 本件は家禽（動物）における鳥インフルエンザ発生であり、現時点でヒト感染の報告は記事中に記載なし。規制違反（禁止期間中の鶏の移動・販売）による公衆衛生リスクの波及と当局対応への批判が焦点。ヒトへの感染有無・規模など続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kết nối y tế dự phòng công - tư, ứng phó bệnh truyền nhiễm mới nổi và tái nổi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public-Private Partnership in Preventive Health Care: Responding to Emerging and Re-emerging Infectious Diseases.
article.articleSummary: Long Châu Pharmacy and Vaccination Network presented its Vaccine Traceability system at the Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City conference on November 17, 2026, marking 135 years since 1891. Attended by WHO, US CDC, and 400+ experts, the event highlighted public-private collaboration in preventive health amid rising emerging and re-emerging infectious diseases. Vaccine Traceability attaches a unique QR code to each vaccine box, enabling real-time tracking from import to the vaccination center, including temperature, storage conditions, origin, lot, import date, and storage location; customers can scan to verify information. The system enhances vaccine management, transparency, and public access to data, with 24/7 monitoring and MoH GSP-compliant, WHO-standard equipment. Pasteur Institute warns of rising vaccine-preventable diseases in southern Vietnam: measles outbreaks in 2024–2025 exceed 2014/2019, with >85% of cases in children under 10; pertussis, diphtheria, neonatal tetanus, and polio in neighboring Laos are noted. Causes include uneven vaccination coverage and hesitancy; emphasis on proactive vaccination schedules for children.

triage.headline_ja: 官民連携による予防医療の連携:新興・再興感染症への対応
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な急性アウトブレイクの速報ではなく、ワクチントレーサビリティシステム発表とカンファレンスに関する記事だが、南部ベトナムでの麻疹等ワクチン予防可能疾患の増加傾向への言及があり、ワクチン接種率の低さやヒト-ヒト感染の可能性から経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はワクチントレーサビリティシステムの発表イベントだが、付随情報として2024-2025年の南部ベトナムでの麻疹アウトブレイクが過去を上回る規模であること、10歳未満が85%超を占めること、百日咳・ジフテリア・新生児破傷風の増加、隣国ラオスでのポリオ発生が言及されている。ラオスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。具体的な症例数・致死率等のデータが不足しており、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Video: Minsa prevé aumento de casos de dengue en las próximas semanas por Radio Nacional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video: Ministry of Health predicts an increase in dengue cases in the coming weeks on Radio Nacional.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Peru is expected to rise in the coming weeks. The Ministry of Health reports more than 10,000 dengue cases currently, concentrated across ten regions including Tumbes, Piura, La Libertad, Áncash, Lima, Amazonas, Loreto and San Martín. Dr. César Munaico, director general of the National Center for Epidemiology, Prevention and Control of Diseases, said the uptick is anticipated in the near term. A dengue vaccination campaign has begun, targeting individuals aged 10–20 years; minors require parental authorization to be vaccinated. The remarks were made during an interview on Nacional en la noticia, second edition, aired by Radio Nacional. The report does not detail symptoms or laboratory confirmation. No information is provided on infection sources or imported/exported cases in the article.

triage.headline_ja: 動画：保健省、今後数週間でデング熱症例の増加を予測 - ラジオ・ナシオナル
triage.triage_reason: 記事はペルーにおけるデング熱の状況を報じており、対象国リストに該当する国（ブラジル等）は記事の主題ではないため、監視対象外と判断する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBrazilが含まれるが、記事内容は一貫してペルー国内（Tumbes, Piura, La Libertad, Lima等）のデング熱流行に関するものであり、ブラジルは主題ではないため verified_locations から除外した。ペルーは対象国リストに含まれないため、該当国なしと判定。

article.articleHeadline: 한 번 앓아도 또 걸린다?"...中 독감 3종 유행, 국내 백신으로 막을까?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Even if you've had it once, you can catch it again?"... "Three strains of influenza are circulating in China; can domestic vaccines protect against them?"
article.articleSummary: China is experiencing concurrent circulation of three influenza virus types in mid-November 2026: A(H1N1), A(H3N2), and B/Victoria. During Nov 16–22 surveillance, 212 influenza-like illness outbreaks were reported nationwide; positive samples were 65.0% A(H1N1), 9.7% A(H3N2), and 25.3% B/Victoria. Reinfection risk exists because immunity between types is limited; cross-protection is weak, so H1N1 recovery could lead to B infection, and H3N2 could lead to H1N1, with reinfection possible even within the same A type, though not universal. Korea’s 2026–2027 influenza guidelines target A(H1N1), A(H3N2), and B(Victoria); the KDCA notes current domestic circulation is A(H1N1) and vaccines prevent infection, severe disease, and death. High-risk groups (children, pregnant women, elderly) should be vaccinated; if past the recommended window, vaccinate when eligible. Maintain handwashing (30 seconds), cough etiquette, and masking to limit transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 「一度かかってもまた感染する？」…中国でインフルエンザ3種流行、国内ワクチンで防げるか？
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常のサーベイランス報告であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準に該当する異常性や重篤性は認められない。社会的関心も通常の季節性情報提供の範囲内。
triage.notes: 韓国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事は季節性インフルエンザの株構成とワクチン有効性に関する一般的な公衆衛生情報であり、通常のサーベイランス報告の範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus da gripe tem estado "mais activo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza virus has been more active.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in Macau has increased to a moderate-high prevalence. The Health Services (SSM), led by Alvis Lo, urged precaution, especially for pregnant women, children, the elderly, and those with chronic diseases not yet vaccinated. Vaccination is urged promptly given the risk of severe complications or death from influenza. Lab monitoring shows the influenza positivity rate rose to 24.3% in the week of 15–21 November, after four weeks at 4.1%, surpassing the 15.2% alert level. Emergency data show pediatric consultations for flu-like illness rising from 363 to 501 last week (+38%); adult visits remained stable. Outbreaks of influenza-like illness have increased, mainly in kindergartens and primary/secondary schools. Nearly 141,000 people had been vaccinated by 25 November (62,000 elderly and 50+). Campaigns since October report >80% uptake in care homes and ~70% in schools; completion is expected soon. With December travel peak, residents not yet vaccinated should book via Single Account.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザウイルスがより活発化している
triage.triage_reason: マカオにおける季節性インフルエンザの活動増加であり、例年の流行パターンの範囲内。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められず、現地保健当局が通常のワクチン接種・注意喚起で対応している。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの活動上昇に関する定例的な公衆衛生報告であり、学校・保育園でのアウトブレイクはあるが重症例の急増や異常な病原性の報告はない。マカオは香港と同様に中国(1814991)に集約。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 29 membres des équipes de MSF infectés, trois décès depuis le début de l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 29 MSF team members infected, three deaths since the outbreak began.
article.articleSummary: Since the declaration of the 17th Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, MSF reports 29 team members infected and three deaths among personnel, with 2,900 deployments in the response. Nationally, hundreds of health workers have been infected and dozens have died. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, transmitted via body fluids, with mortality near 50%. A MSF-backed report published Nov 10, 2026, highlights frontline toll: Dr. Sylvain Radjabu Lubangi (35) in Bunia, Ituri, contracted while treating patients, likely at his father’s funeral, and later transmitted to his wife; both survived after more than two weeks in a treatment center. Dieudonné Tchuma Longa (29) in Mongbwalu lost eight family members since July and suspects infection at his father’s funeral, which he also transmitted to his wife; they recovered. Security challenges, including armed groups, displacement, threats, and a tent near the hospital used to receive patients, hinder response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱DRC流行：MSF医療チーム29人感染、流行開始以来3人死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱（第17次流行）で医療従事者を含む多数の感染・死亡が報告され、致死率約50%、武装勢力による治安悪化も対応を妨げており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス、致死率約50%）でMSFスタッフ29人感染・3人死亡、全国で医療従事者数百人感染。武装勢力活動や住民避難など治安上の課題が対応を阻害しており、既に既知の流行だが深刻度・拡大リスクともに高くフルRRA相当と判断。

article.articleHeadline: สสจ.โคราช ผวาไข้หวัดใหญ่ระบาดหนัก ดับพุ่ง 51 ราย เร่งตัดวงจรเชื้อจากโรงเรียนสู่ผู้สูงอายุ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nakhon Ratchasima Provincial Public Health Office fears a severe influenza outbreak; deaths rise to 51; stepping up efforts to break the transmission chain from schools to the elderly.
article.articleSummary: Influenza outbreak escalates in Nakhon Ratchasima Province, Thailand, with 21,831 cumulative cases and 51 deaths as of November 24, 2026 (vs 42,105 cases and 39 deaths in 2025). Disease impact is highest among children 0–14, especially 5–9, in schools and early-childhood centers; fatalities occur mainly in the elderly and those with chronic diseases (diabetes, hypertension, kidney disease, gout, COPD) who were not vaccinated in 2026. The districts with the most cases are Mueang Nakhon Ratchasima, Kham Thale So, Lam Thamenchai, Huai Thalaeng, and Phimai. Four measures to break transmission from schools to the elderly: (1) separate and limit close contact if children have fever, cough, or runny nose; (2) sick children stay home and inform teachers; (3) vaccinate high-risk groups (65+, chronic diseases, pregnant women, infants 6 months–2 years); (4) monitor warning symptoms and seek urgent medical care. Public health urges community vigilance and adherence to guidance.

triage.headline_ja: ナコンラチャシマ県保健事務所、インフルエンザの深刻な流行を懸念；死者数51人に急増、学校から高齢者への感染連鎖を断つため対策強化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの地域的流行で死者数増加が見られるが、国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の兆候はなく、既知の病原体のため現時点ではフルRRAに進める根拠は限定的。続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 2026年の症例数・死亡者数は前年比で大幅増加（死者39→51人）。地域は県内に限定されており国レベルの対応で管理可能と見られるが、死亡率増加の背景や株の変異有無など続報を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Эксперт объяснила, как отличить оспу обезьян от ОРВИ и ветрянки
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An expert explained how to distinguish monkeypox from acute respiratory viral infection (ARVI) and chickenpox.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox distinguished from ARVI and chickenpox by lymphadenopathy and a rash on the backs of the hands and feet. On November 27, two people in Saint Petersburg and Leningrad Oblast were hospitalized with suspected monkeypox, and authorities launched an epidemiological investigation. An infectious disease expert noted that early monkeypox can mimic flu or ARVI due to fever above 38°C, chills, fatigue, and muscle pains. The rash may resemble chickenpox, but lesions on the dorsum of hands and feet are characteristic of monkeypox, unlike typical varicella. Transmission is via direct contact with an infected person and respiratory droplets; importation risk persists with travel abroad, especially to African countries or Thailand. Monkeypox is a rare viral disease that can be dangerous for immunocompromised individuals; there is no current pandemic threat. Seek medical advice promptly if characteristic symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家が猿痘とARVI・水痘の見分け方を解説
