article.articleHeadline: 科学网-王伟炳：算一笔肺炎链球菌疫苗的公共卫生账
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ScienceNet - Wang Weibing: Reckoning the Public Health Impact of the Pneumococcal Vaccine
article.articleSummary: Global VIEW-hub shows 178 countries have introduced pneumococcal conjugate vaccines (PCV), covering 92% of nations. In China, serotypes 19F and 19A drive nearly half of pediatric pneumococcal infections; Shanghai/Suzhou data indicate PCV13 covers about 88% of invasive pneumococcal disease (IPD) strains in children, with limited gains expected from 20- or 23-valent vaccines beyond ~90%. Serotype replacement is emerging: non-vaccine types 3, 9N, and 15A rise; 3’s protection is weaker despite inclusion in PCV13, 9N is covered by PCV20/PCV21, and 15A associates with antibiotic-resistant clones. Globally, PCV reduces vaccine-type IPD by 57–100%; Norway’s under-2 IPD dropped 100%; Israel and US under-5 declines are 95% and 93%. In Shanghai, PCV13 provides ~19% protection against all clinical pneumonia, ~20% against IPD/severe outcomes, and 30–50% for serotype-related disease. Full vaccination could cut respiratory infections ~72% and antibiotic exposure ~40%, with herd effects saving elderly deaths (Suzhou) and large nationwide benefits. Economic: per-dose prices under ~500 RMB (3x GDPpc) or ~200 RMB (1x) are cost-effective; NIP inclusion could yield ~3.58 million QALYs and ~13.5 billion RMB in societal net benefits. Four PCV13 products are approved in China (1 imported, 3 domestic); Weifang and other pilots explore free vaccination and diversified financing to enable scale.

triage.headline_ja: 科学网-王伟炳：算一笔肺炎链球菌疫苗の公衆衛生アカウントを計算する

The agency assesses the risk of a larger outbreak as small. The information was reported by Aftonbladet. This incident involves an imported measles case in Sweden, with authorities continuing to follow up on exposed passengers and provide guidance.

article.articleHeadline: 科学网-田野：儿童肺炎链球菌感染为何"越治越难
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ScienceNet Field: Why are pediatric pneumococcal infections getting harder to treat?
article.articleSummary: Winter climate drives pediatric respiratory infections; Streptococcus pneumoniae remains the leading cause of pneumonia in children under five. Antibiotic resistance is rising, with Chinese guidelines (2019) reporting >90% resistance to erythromycin, clindamycin, and tetracycline, reducing response to standard regimens and sometimes necessitating meropenem. Beyond pneumonia, pneumococcus can invade the central nervous system, causing meningitis and subdural effusion; a 2-year-old required 28 days in PICU and neurosurgical drainage for pneumococcal meningitis. Diagnosis is hampered by 2–3 day culture turnarounds and the masking effect of prior antibiotics, though NAATs and sequencing improve detection amidst high nasopharyngeal carriage. Prevention via vaccination dramatically lowers invasive disease and antibiotic use; WHO classifies pneumococcal disease as extremely high priority for vaccination. China promotes medical-prevention collaboration, including vaccine prescriptions and targeted vaccination assessments.

triage.headline_ja: 科学網 田野：小児肺炎球菌感染症はなぜ「治療するほど難しく」なるのか

article.articleHeadline: Pemkab Bandung Barat Wanti-wanti Ancaman Flu Burung, Peternak Diminta Aktif Melapor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Bandung Regency Government Warns of Avian Influenza Threat, Poultry Farmers Urged to Report Actively
article.articleSummary: Avian Influenza risk prompts West Bandung Regency government to urge poultry farmers to report unusual poultry deaths; in West Java, Indonesia. Farmers often treat sudden poultry deaths (one or two birds) as normal, risking undetected AI spread that could reach human populations. Authorities in Bandung Barat (KBB) are intensifying public education on avian influenza, targeting farmers and extending to communities down to kecamatan and desa levels. Rony Rudyana, head of Diskominfosantik, stresses multi-channel information dissemination via media and government social media, with careful messaging to avoid panic while conveying signs, transmission risks, and actions when sick or dead poultry are found. In addition, individuals with fever and cough within ten days of contact with sick poultry should promptly seek examination. The focus is on early warning, reporting, and prevention to curb potential outbreaks and human exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 西バンドン県政府、鳥インフルエンザの脅威を警告、養鶏農家に積極的な報告を要請
triage.triage_reason: 現時点でヒト感染の確定例は報告されておらず、行政による予防的注意喚起・啓発活動の段階であるが、鳥インフルエンザの潜在的リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はヒト感染例の確定報告ではなく、行政による予防的注意喚起と報告奨励の内容。家禽の異常死への警戒とヒトへの感染リスク啓発が中心。

article.articleHeadline: Quảng Trị chủ động kiểm soát dịch bệnh, thúc đẩy chăn nuôi phát triển
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Quảng Trị proactively controls disease outbreaks, promotes the development of livestock farming.
article.articleSummary: Quảng Trị Province, Vietnam, is proactively controlling African swine fever outbreaks while boosting biosecure livestock farming. From January to November 2026, 12 hamlets across 8 communes (Vĩnh Linh, Bac Trach, Vĩnh Thủy, Tuyên Hóa, Ba Lòng, Khe Sanh, Vĩnh Hoàng, Tuyên Lâm) reported ASF cases. The Department of Livestock and Veterinary Medicine coordinated with local authorities to intensify surveillance, sanitation, and disinfection; 437 pigs were culled to prevent spread. By late November five localities (Vĩnh Linh, Bac Trach, Vĩnh Thủy, Tuyên Hóa, Khe Sanh) had 21 days without new cases; three localities (Ba Lòng, Vĩnh Hoàng, Tuyên Lâm) remained in outbreak. Livestock numbers include buffalo over 45,300; cattle about 140,000; pigs over 482,000; poultry about 10,200,900. Investments in large-scale farms total 22,500 cattle, 5,900 pigs, and 10 million poultry. Ongoing vaccination, transport control, and biosecurity measures are planned through year-end to support 2026–2027 growth.

triage.headline_ja: クアンチ省、疾病を積極的に制御し、畜産業の発展を促進
triage.triage_reason: 動物（豚）のアフリカ豚熱であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生リスクはなく、当局による管理下で沈静化傾向にあるため、シグナルとして取り上げる必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 動物衛生（畜産）に関する記事であり、ヒト感染症のEBS対象としての優先度は低い。地方当局が主体的に対応し、一部地域は21日間新規症例なしと改善傾向。

article.articleHeadline: Двух петербуржцев госпитализировали с оспой обезьян - АБН 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two residents of St. Petersburg were hospitalized with monkeypox - ABN 24.
article.articleSummary: ABN 24 reports that two Saint Petersburg residents have been hospitalized with monkeypox after returning from Thailand. The Interregional Administration of Rospotrebnadzor for Saint Petersburg and Leningrad Oblast stated that specialists identified a circle of contacts and prevented further spread of the infection. The patients are described as in stable condition. The report notes that the outbreak in Saint Petersburg was previously recorded in October, indicating an existing concern in the northern capital. The current cases are tied to travel from Thailand, illustrating imported infections and the effectiveness of contact tracing to contain transmission in the region. Currently ongoing monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: サンクトペテルブルク在住の2名がサル痘（エムポックス）で入院 - ABN24

article.articleHeadline: Ebola - 12 000 cas positifs, 5900 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 12,000 positive cases, 5,900 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 12,000 cases with 5,904 deaths across 69 health zones in eight provinces as of 24 November, marking the 17th Ebola epidemic and the largest by case count. The latest tally reports 66 new cases and 37 deaths on 24 November. Affected provinces are Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, Tshopo, Nord Ubangi and Sud Ubangi. Ituri remains the main hotspot, accounting for about 67.7% of infections, though this share has declined due to confinement measures, indicating spread to other areas.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：陽性症例12,000件、死者5,900人

article.articleHeadline: Kuş gribi ticaret dengesini vurdu: Hong Kong, Güney Kore'den kanatlı alımını durdurdu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu hits the trade balance: Hong Kong halts poultry imports from South Korea.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region authorities halted imports of poultry meat and products from South Korea due to avian influenza outbreaks in several regions. The Hong Kong Centre for Food Safety (CFS) directed suspensions on imports of poultry meat, eggs, and other products from Jincheon-gun in Chungcheongbuk-do; Jeonnam-Gwangju; Gyeonggi-do; Gyeongsangbuk-do; and Incheon. The CFS stated it has been in contact with South Korean authorities and will closely monitor information from the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) and other relevant bodies. The measure represents precautionary trade controls in response to avian influenza activity, with ongoing coordination and risk assessment with international authorities.

article.articleHeadline: AI 인체감염증 유입 차단...임승관 질병청장, 제주공항 검역 '점검'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Blocking the entry of avian influenza infections in humans... KDCA Commissioner Im Seung-kwan inspects quarantine at Jeju International Airport
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza enters risk at Jeju International Airport: KDCA Commissioner Im Seung-kwan inspected quarantine readiness amid overseas AI human infections. China-origin flights accounted for about 63.6% of inbound services to Jeju as of October (6,401 of 10,067 flights), with 1,722,434 arrivals screened that month. The Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency designated parts of China and Cambodia as high-risk quarantine regions and requires travelers with overseas stays or transits to submit Q-CODE or health status questionnaires. A paperless quarantine program now mandates Q-CODE submission for flight crews and passengers on high-risk routes. Arrival facilities feature Q-CODE kiosks and automated quarantine screening desks for rapid, non-contact checks. If symptoms such as fever or cough appear, individuals should alert 1339 or a health center. Domestic avian influenza human infections have not been reported; authorities seek to maintain vigilance and rapid response for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ人体感染の流入阻止…イム・スンクァンKDCA庁長、済州空港検疫を点検

article.articleHeadline: Кількість заражень Еболою в ДР Конго сягнула 12 000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 12,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have reached 12,021 confirmed cases as the eastern outbreak continues to spread, the fastest in history, with about half of those infected dying. It is the deadliest of the DRC's 17 Ebola outbreaks and could surpass West Africa's 2014–2016 outbreak that killed about 11,000. The flare-up, declared in May, is caused by Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Nine Ebola cases have also been detected in Kenya, with three deaths. The ongoing transmission underscores urgent needs for enhanced surveillance and infection control measures, given the absence of a licensed vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo virus.

article.articleHeadline: Количество заражений Эболой в ДР Конго достигло 12 000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 12,000.
article.articleSummary: As of November 27, 2026, Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 12,021 confirmed infections, with roughly half of patients dying. This marks the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in DR Congo’s history and the deadliest among its 17 outbreaks, potentially surpassing the 2014–2016 West Africa death toll of about 11,000. The outbreak, declared in May, is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Across Kenya, at least nine Ebola cases have been reported, with three deaths, indicating cross-border transmission from the DR Congo outbreak.

article.articleHeadline: பறவை காய்ச்சல் பாதித்த பகுதியில் இருந்து சென்னைக்கு கோழிகள் அனுப்பி வைப்பு - அதிகாரிகள் தீவிர விசாரணை
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chickens shipped to Chennai from the avian influenza-affected area; officials intensify investigation.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 November 2026, avian influenza has been confirmed in poultry from Nochikadu in Cuddalore district, triggering culling orders across the infected zone and district. More than 100,000 chickens have been culled to contain the outbreak; yesterday, 25,000 birds were culled in Nochikadu following lab confirmation. Authorities have ordered nearby farms to slaughter and dispose of all birds. Separately, a farm was found transporting chickens in five lorries; three lorries were seized, two under investigation. Earlier on 24-25 November, about 8,000 chickens from the same area were sent to Chennai. Officials are probing whether these chickens were sold in Chennai or diverted elsewhere, amid concerns over movement of birds from the infected area. The investigation is ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ発生地域からチェンナイへ鶏が搬送される－当局が本格捜査

triage.notes: 記事は家禽（鶏）における鳥インフルエンザ発生と、感染地域からチェンナイへの鶏の移送調査に関するもの。ヒト感染例の報告はなく、動物衛生当局による対応（殺処分・移送調査）が中心。人への感染拡大の有無について続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: โคราชวิกฤตไข้หวัดใหญ่! ป่วยทะลุ 2.1 หมื่นราย-ดับ 51 ชีวิต สสจ.งัด 4 มาตรการตัดวงจรโรค
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Korat in influenza crisis! Over 21,000 cases, 51 deaths; the Provincial Public Health Office unveils four measures to break the transmission cycle.
article.articleSummary: Influenza outbreak in Nakhon Ratchasima Province, Thailand, with 21,831 cumulative influenza cases and 51 deaths through November 24, 2026. The fatality burden is 2.5 times higher than in 2025. The heaviest burden is among young children (0–14 years), who spread the virus at home, while fatalities occur mainly among the elderly and those with chronic diseases who were not vaccinated this year. Districts with the highest cases are Mueang Nakhon Ratchasima, Kham Thale So, Lam Thamenchai, Huai Thalaeng, and Phimai. Four urgent measures to cut transmission: 1) separate spaces and avoid close contact with the elderly when children show symptoms; 2) sick children stay home from school; 3) vaccinate high-risk groups (elderly 65+, chronic disease patients, pregnant women, and infants 6 months to 2 years) promptly; 4) monitor warning signs; elderly with fever, shortness of breath, or lethargy should not self-medicate and must go to hospital promptly.

triage.headline_ja: コラート(ナコーンラーチャシーマー)でインフルエンザ危機！患者2万1000人超、死者51人。県保健事務所が感染拡大を断つ4つの対策を発表
triage.triage_reason: 単一県で死者51人・患者2.1万人に達し、前年比2.5倍の死亡負荷という異常な増加が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性）に複数該当するためフルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザと見られるが、前年比死亡者2.5倍という異常な増加と地域内での持続的な感染拡大（小児から高齢者への家庭内伝播）が確認されており、継続的な監視とワクチン未接種高齢者への対応状況の確認が必要。新型株の可能性については記事内に言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Maï-Ndombe : plus de 506 000 enfants ciblés par la 3ᵉ phase de la vaccination contre la polio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Maï-Ndombe: more than 506,000 children targeted by the 3rd phase of polio vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Maï-Ndombe province launches the third phase of its polio vaccination campaign, targeting 506,215 children aged 0–59 months across 14 health zones from 26 to 28 November 2026. Each child receives two drops of the oral polio vaccine type 2 and a left-hand fingernail mark for dose verification. A door-to-door approach will ensure coverage at homes. Dr. Francis Kambol Yav, chief medical officer of the Provincial Health Division, underscored prevention, while Gisèle Rava of technical and financial partners affirmed ongoing support to reduce child mortality and protect health. Interim provincial Finance Minister Aimé-Césaire Mikolo urged caregivers to bring children for vaccination. The campaign begins with first doses at homes; a three-day operation will be followed by a catch-up period for those missed.

article.articleHeadline: Россиянам объяснили, как отличить оспу обезьян от ОРВИ и ветрянки
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russians were told how to distinguish monkeypox from ARVI and chickenpox.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox can be distinguished from ordinary respiratory infections (ARVI) and chickenpox by lymphadenopathy and rashes on the palms and soles. According to Ekaterina Nikitina, head of the Department of Anatomy and Physiology of Humans and Animals at Herzen University, enlarged lymph nodes are a hallmark not typical in ARVI. Early stages may mimic flu or ARVI with fever above 38°C, chills, fatigue, and muscle pains. If characteristic rashes appear, seek medical care promptly. The virus spreads by direct contact with an infected person and via droplets. Importation risk remains with international travel, particularly to Thailand and African countries. Nonetheless, the share of monkeypox cases worldwide is very small, and there is no epidemic threat.

article.articleHeadline: Спалах Еболи в Конго перевищив 12 тисяч випадків: медики евакуюються через бойові дії
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 12,000 cases: healthcare workers are being evacuated due to fighting.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has exceeded 12,000 confirmed cases, with 12,021 laboratory-confirmed infections and nearly half of patients dying, according to the Ministry of Health via Associated Press on November 26. Declared in May 2026, this Bundibugyo-strain outbreak is among the largest and fastest-spreading in DRC history, with no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Ongoing conflict in Ituri province worsens response, as fighting near Iga-Barrière about 25 km from Bunia disrupts access, triggers displacement, and hampers case finding and contact tracing. WHO noted violence impeded medical teams, leaving several treatment centers understaffed. About ten people, including two WHO staff, were evacuated to Bunia after three days trapped in a clinic in Akve. Public mistrust and misinformation hinder isolation and safe burials, complicating outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、症例数1万2000件を超過：戦闘により医療従事者が避難

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: casos mais que dobram em novembro em Santa Catarina - Visor Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: Cases More Than Double in November in Santa Catarina - Visor News
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Santa Catarina, Brazil, shows 727 probable cases in the first three weeks of November, a 120% rise from 331 in the same period in 2025. Year-to-date through November 25, there are 3,838 probable and 1,587 confirmed dengue cases, with no deaths reported. The state Health Department notes ongoing transmission and urges residents to spend at least 10 minutes weekly eliminating Aedes aegypti breeding sites: discard water-collecting containers, clean gutters, drains and rooftops, place sand in plant saucer trays, and store tires in covered areas.

triage.notes: ブラジルはデング熱の流行国であり、季節的な症例増加は例年見られる現象。死亡例なく重症度も低いため、現時点でのフルリスク評価の必要性は低いが、感染拡大傾向のため経過観察とする。

article.articleHeadline: Hlavné správy v zahraničných médiách 27. novembra: Pôžičku pre Ukrajinu sa nepodarilo schváliť. Zelenskyj útočí na Trumpa. V Afrike zúri ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Main foreign media headlines on November 27: The loan to Ukraine could not be approved. Zelensky attacks Trump. Ebola rages in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is the focal infectious-disease story. Officially confirmed cases exceed 12,000 with about 5,900 deaths, yielding a case fatality rate near 50%. This is described as the fastest-spreading and deadliest Ebola outbreak in the DRC’s history. The epidemic began in May in the Ituri province and has spread to eight of the country’s 26 provinces. Cases have been reported in five other countries, though the surge remains concentrated in Congo. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo, for which there is no proven vaccine or specific treatment. With no decisive medical countermeasure, the outbreak requires continued public health interventions to slow transmission and prevent further international spread.

triage.headline_ja: 海外メディア主要見出し11月27日：ウクライナへの融資承認ならず。ゼレンスキー氏がトランプ氏を攻撃。アフリカではエボラが猛威を振るう。

triage.notes: 記事はスロバキアのニュースまとめ記事内でエボラ流行を取り上げている。DRC国内のIturi州が発端だが、記事主題は国全体及び周辺国への拡大状況。周辺5カ国は対象国リストに含まれないため列挙せず。Bundibugyo株でワクチン・治療薬が確立されていない点が特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 2 milioane de porci uciși de pesta porcină! Avertisment dur al medicilor veterinari, reuniți la Timișoara
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 2 million pigs killed by swine fever! A stern warning from veterinarians gathered in Timișoara.
article.articleSummary: African Swine Fever (ASF) devastates Romania’s pork sector, with about 38,000 ASF outbreaks in domestic pigs and total losses nearing 2 million animals, including over 200,000 euthanized in recent months. Romania remains Europe’s hotspot, accounting for roughly 81% of EU ASF outbreaks in 2025 and about 67% in 2026. The crisis follows a sequence of shocks since 2007, including ASF emergence, the COVID-19 pandemic, the Ukraine war, and export restrictions that hit prices. In early 2026, national live-pig prices averaged €1.20/kg, dipping to around €0.90–€1.00/kg, with prices down about 25% after the German ASF outbreak and export bans to markets such as China. In the Pink Zone, farms lose about €20 per pig slaughtered; producers’ profits have collapsed from up to €48 per pig to roughly €-22 in 2026. The Timisoara Swine Day Romania forum urged stronger biosecurity, rapid diagnostics, and One Health approaches.

article.articleHeadline: Disbunnak Kalbar optimalkan iSIKHNAS untuk deteksi dini penyakit hewan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Kalimantan's Department of Animal Husbandry and Animal Health optimizes iSIKHNAS for early detection of animal diseases.
article.articleSummary: On 27 November 2026, West Kalimantan's Department of Animal Husbandry and Animal Health (Disbunnak Kalbar) optimized the national Animal Health Information System iSIKHNAS to underpin policy decisions, program evaluation, rapid response, and early detection of animal diseases. iSIKHNAS data are analyzed to monitor regional animal health and inform action. A two-day training for 38 participants from eight districts/cities — Sanggau, Bengkayang, Sambas, Kapuas Hulu, Kubu Raya, Mempawah, Singkawang, and Pontianak — strengthened reporting of both common and priority diseases. Training employs a Learning Management System with scenario-based learning to improve timeliness and completeness of reports. Data feed indicators for the Strategic Contagious Animal Disease Control Program (PHMS) and other agricultural KPIs, and support operational payments for Foot-and-Mouth Disease (PMK) vaccination and related interventions. Supported by CARE-I, the effort aims to translate data into policy and evaluative action for disease control in Kalbar.

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : les deuils et veillées mortuaires suspendus en raison de la propagation d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Mourning and funeral vigils suspended due to the spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 November 2026, mourning, wakes, and memorial services are suspended in North Kivu’s health zones affected by the Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak, in a bid to limit transmission and protect public health. The North Kivu provincial government announced the measure, with Luanda Kamala Prisca, the governor’s chief health coordinator, stating that only 20 people may attend funerals of relatives who died from non-EVD causes. For Ebola-related deaths, only response teams are authorized to perform dignified and secure burials to prevent further spread. With Beni city now the epicenter of the outbreak in North Kivu, authorities urge strict adherence to the decision to halt the rise of Ebola cases and address health concerns across the province.

article.articleHeadline: Оспа обезьян: что это такое и насколько опасно
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox: What Is It and How Dangerous Is It?
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (MPXV) is a rare orthopoxvirus disease affecting humans and animals, with natural hosts including African rodents. First detected in 1958 in monkeys; the first human case was in 1970 in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Transmission occurs from animals to humans (bites, scratches, contact with blood, secretions, or skin, or eating undercooked wild meat) and from person to person (direct contact with rashes, crusts, or bodily fluids; contaminated objects; and prolonged close contact; respiratory droplets can contribute). Vertical transmission from mother to fetus is possible. Incubation is 5 days to 3 weeks (usually 10–14). Early symptoms resemble influenza-like illness with fever and malaise, followed by lymphadenopathy and a rash that starts on the face (about 95% of cases) and spreads to the limbs and trunk, evolving from macules to papules, vesicles, pustules, and crusts over 2–4 weeks. Most cases are mild; higher risk for young children, immunocompromised, and pregnant individuals. Mortality varies by clade: West African clade up to 1%; Central African clade up to 10% where care is limited. Diagnosis is via PCR from lesion material; no specific antiviral exists; treatment is supportive. Prevention includes smallpox vaccination (cross-protection) and targeted vaccines (modified vaccinia Ankara), hygiene, avoiding wild game, and isolating suspected cases.

article.articleHeadline: For the second time this year, Guindy Children's Park closed as birds die of suspected flu
article.articleSummary: Guindy Children's Park, Chennai, will be closed to the public from November 28–30, or until further orders, after the death of birds at the facility on November 27. The cause is not yet established; samples have been sent to NIHSAD, Bhopal, for testing, with results awaited. The closure is precautionary; the affected enclosure will be isolated, premises disinfected, and biosecurity measures intensified, with close monitoring of other birds and animals. This is the second avian-influenza–related closure in Tamil Nadu this year. In March, Vedanthangal Aviary inside the park saw nearly 40 deaths; NIHSAD confirmed H5N1 and closed March 20. The March 13 night saw 30 deaths (24 night herons, 6 pelicans); more deaths followed until March 18 before reopening. Separately, Arignar Anna Zoological Park at Vandalur closed wetland-bird enclosures after virus detection, reopening November 18 after two NIHSAD-tested negatives. Public cooperation urged.

article.articleHeadline: Four die at Twycross Zoo as chimp Jambo is put down and bonobos fall ill
article.articleSummary: Four primates at Twycross Zoo, Leicestershire, have died in recent weeks: Jambo, a male chimpanzee euthanised on November 26 after deteriorating health, and three young bonobos from the Congo Basin troop who died following a flu-like respiratory illness. The bonobo habitat was closed to visitors at the end of October and is set to reopen the following day as staff warn of group dynamics changes after Jambo's death. Zookeepers and veterinary teams treated the bonobos intensively, but the illness claimed three lives despite efforts. Jambo was a recognizable ambassador known for alopecia and previously a dominant male within his group. The zoo emphasised ongoing commitment to animal welfare and to protecting species, thanking visitors and the primate and veterinary teams for their support.

article.articleHeadline: Những điều cha mẹ cần biết để bảo vệ trẻ giữa thiên tai, dịch bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What parents need to know to protect children during natural disasters and disease outbreaks
article.articleSummary: Vietnam faces natural disasters and disease outbreaks that threaten infant nutrition and hygiene. The article emphasizes breastfeeding as the safest, most reliable protection for infants, especially under 6 months, since breast milk provides energy, nutrients, and antibodies, and is not dependent on clean water or electricity. Stress does not cause lactation loss if feeding is regular. In evacuation settings, communities should support mothers. If formula is necessary, strict hygiene and clean water are essential; avoid widespread formula distribution without guidance; use cups and spoons when possible. After 6 months, complementary foods should be nutritious and easily stored—eggs, canned fish, pasteurized milk, legumes—while continuing breastfeeding to at least 24 months. Clean water, handwashing, safe food handling, and proper sanitation reduce diarrheal and respiratory infection risks. If diarrhea occurs, continue breastfeeding and provide oral rehydration, seek medical care for severe symptoms.

article.articleHeadline: Dengue prevention measures in all Mandaue schools stepped up
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention measures intensified in Mandaue City, Cebu after three dengue-related deaths and 70 learner cases this year. DepEd-Mandaue reports 36 new dengue cases this month, mostly elementary students, with 31 recovering. Measures include campus-wide clean-up drives, misting operations coordinated with the City Health Office, and medicated nets installed in ground-floor classrooms. Schools enforce the daily 4 o’clock clean-up habit aligned with the 4Ts (Taob, Taktak, Tuyo, Takip) to eliminate standing water, remove debris, dry wet areas, and cover water containers. Dengue brigades comprising staff and learners ensure ongoing activity; principals urge parents to seek medical care for fever. Fever lasting 2–3 days warrants CBC testing. Excused absences are provided for ill learners to catch up. Focused monitoring of Opao; misting depends on CHO schedules. PTA involvement and Local School Board coordination support a proactive approach across all public schools.

triage.headline_ja: マンダウエ市内の全学校でデング熱予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 地域限定的な季節性デング熱の学校内対策強化に関する記事であり、死亡例や継続例はあるが異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められず、社会的関心の高まりも確認できないため、続報の注視対象とする。
triage.notes: フィリピン・セブ州マンダウエ市における季節性デング熱流行への学校単位の予防策強化を伝えるローカルニュース。死亡3名、学童70例の報告があるが、毎年同地域で発生する典型的な蚊媒介性疾患であり、WHO通報相当の異常事態とは判断できない。地域内の保健所・教育局の対応で管理可能とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Vụ chó nghi dại cắn 7 người ở Cà Mau: Tiêm vắc-xin khoanh vùng ổ dịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies-suspected dog bites seven people in Ca Mau: Ring vaccination to contain the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Rabies-suspected dog bites seven people in Ca Mau; ring vaccination launched in U Minh and Nguyen Phich communes. On 27 November, the U Minh Area Veterinary Station administered 350 vaccine doses to dogs and cats from 116 households. The previous day, 258 dogs and 92 cats were vaccinated in Ca Tau and Hamlet 9 in Nguyen Phich. On 27 November, vaccination expanded to Dong Cuoc hamlet near the U Minh office, with teams listing unvaccinated households and stray dogs for completing coverage. The seven bite victims received wound care, rabies vaccine, and immunoglobulin; all are stable and under close follow-up. The 23–24 November biting dog, about 18 kg from Ca Tau, bit seven people. Since 2026, Ca Mau has had three dog rabies outbreaks (Tran Phan, Khanh Lam, Gan Hoa) resolved after 21 days with no new cases.

triage.headline_ja: カマウ省で狂犬病疑いの犬が7人を咬む：感染拡大防止のためリング・ワクチン接種を実施
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病疑い犬による咬傷事例でヒトへの曝露があり対応が取られているが、地域限定的でヒト-ヒト感染リスクはなく、国際的拡大の懸念は低い。続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 7名の咬傷被害者は適切な創傷ケア・ワクチン・免疫グロブリンを受け容態安定。地元当局によるリング・ワクチン接種等の対応が既に実施されており管理可能と見られる。2026年以降カマウ省では複数回の犬狂犬病アウトブレイクが発生しているが、いずれも21日後に収束している。

article.articleHeadline: Northeast states review strategies to accelerate TB elimination
article.articleSummary: TB elimination efforts in Northeast: Itanagar, 26-27 Nov 2026 — senior health officials from Northeastern states convened a two-day zonal task force meeting to accelerate tuberculosis elimination under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP). The conference aimed to align regional implementation with current policy guidelines and review state task force progress since the last zonal meeting. Attendees included National Task Force chairperson Dr Anil Purty and Dr Sanjay Kumar Mattoo of the Central TB Division. Key discussions covered performance of state task forces, bottlenecks in medical college core committees and zonal task forces, and the Programme Implementation Plan (PIP) for medical colleges. Emphasis was placed on strengthening medical college participation, boosting notification of TB patients, and ensuring timely public health interventions through enhanced collaboration between state and zonal bodies and medical institutions.

article.articleHeadline: Meslingsmitte på fly fra Bangkok: Svenske myndigheter slår alarm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles transmission on a flight from Bangkok: Swedish authorities sound the alarm.
article.articleSummary: One traveler diagnosed with measles traveled from Bangkok to Stockholm, landing on 19 November, prompting warnings from Swedish health authorities. The Public Health Agency of Sweden (Folkhälsomyndigheten) confirms the passenger was infectious during the flight and is coordinating with Thai Airways to notify those affected. An airline email warned that all passengers on board may have been exposed, and travelers are advised to monitor for measles symptoms: high fever, dry cough, and skin rash. Sweden’s vaccination coverage is high, and authorities assess the risk of a larger outbreak as small, though isolated cases cannot be ruled out. People who suspect infection should contact health services and avoid sitting in waiting rooms; cases are being managed with special procedures. The response involves cross-organization cooperation with the airline and public health surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: バンコク発の便内ではしか感染、スウェーデン当局が警鐘
triage.triage_reason: スウェーデンでの単一輸入症例であり、当局はさらなる流行リスクを小さいと評価しており、対象国（タイ）での発生拡大を示す情報もない。
triage.notes: 感染者はバンコクからの渡航者だが、発生自体はスウェーデンでの輸入症例として報告されており、タイでの流行拡大を示す記述はないため対象国リストには該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: O hábito doméstico que parece higiênico, mas espalha doenças trazidas por pombos | Band
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The household habit that seems hygienic, but spreads diseases carried by pigeons | Band.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 November 2026, dry pigeon droppings on balconies, yards, or near air‑conditioning units release aerosolized particles when brushed, spreading fungi and bacteria into the air. Inhalation allows organisms to reach alveoli and, for some, the bloodstream, potentially affecting meninges and causing severe meningitis. Brazilian surveillance via Fiocruz identifies five major risks linked to urban pigeons: cryptococcosis ( Cryptococcus neoformans ), histoplasmosis ( Histoplasma capsulatum ), psittacosis/ornithosis ( Chlamydia psittaci ), salmonellosis ( Salmonella ), and allergic/mite-related symptoms from pigeon mites. Cryptococcosis can progress from pulmonary infection to cryptococcal meningitis; histoplasmosis may cause lasting lung lesions; psittacosis presents with high fever and pneumonia requiring antibiotics. Early signs resemble a cold—persistent dry cough and breathlessness after exposure to contaminated areas warrant medical assessment; risk is higher for immunocompromised individuals. Do not disturb dry droppings; dampen and clean cautiously to reduce aerosolization.

triage.headline_ja: 一見衛生的に見える家庭の習慣が、実はハトが運ぶ病気を広める | Band
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な健康啓発記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや症例急増の報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はハトの糞による一般的な衛生リスク啓発であり、具体的なアウトブレイクや症例数の報告がないため、特定の国における感染症イベントとしての地域検証対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情未見趨緩！剛果民主共和國致死率近5成　台延長邊境管制
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak shows no signs of slowing! The Democratic Republic of the Congo's case fatality rate is nearly 50%; Taiwan extends border controls.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) persists: as of Nov 17, 11,613 confirmed cases and 5,678 deaths (case fatality rate 48.9%), with weekly additions of 400–500. Ituri Province accounts for about 68% of cases; North Kivu CFR 55%. Across 8 provinces and 68 health zones, 48 zones reported new cases in the last 21 days; seven-day case growth ~40%. Neighboring Uganda has 20 cases, 2 deaths; Kenya 9 cases, 2 deaths; Nigeria 1 imported case recovered. WHO maintains the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; vaccines and therapeutics remain in clinical trials. Taiwan extends border controls by 90 days to 2027-02-26; visa issuance for DRC residents remains suspended, with exceptions for students admitted, diplomats, and immediate family of Taiwanese. Since May 27, seven travelers with DRC history have entered Taiwan; all completed 21 days of self-health management. Inbound travelers must self-monitor 21 days and report daily; seek care (call 1922) for fever, headache, myalgia, N/V, abdominal pain, diarrhea, or bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疫情は未だ鎮静化せず！コンゴ民主共和国の致死率は約5割、台湾は国境管制を延長
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱(Bundibugyoエボラウイルス)アウトブレイクが拡大継続中で致死率約49%、複数国への越境拡大とWHOのPHEIC認定が継続しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準も複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行とその周辺国（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）への波及、台湾の水際対策強化が主題。ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Thúc đẩy kết nối y tế dự phòng công-tư, phòng chống bệnh truyền nhiễm mới nổi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Promoting public-private linkages in preventive health care, and the prevention and control of emerging infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: Long Châu promotes public-private linkages in preventive health care and control of emerging infectious diseases. At the Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City conference on 17 November 2026 (marking 135 years since 1891), with WHO and US CDC participation, Long Châu unveiled Vaccine Traceability—a real-time vaccine cold-chain tracking system. Each vaccine box carries a unique QR code enabling customers to trace its journey from central warehouse intake to vaccination, including storage temperature, origin, batch, entry to storage, and storage location; the system also provides full product data and supports rapid data retrieval. The initiative aims to boost transparency, strengthen surveillance and prevention, and empower citizens to verify information. Long Châu guarantees 100% genuine vaccines, stored under MOH GSP standards, using WHO-standard equipment with 24/7 monitoring. The collaboration with Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City will continue, aligning with national resolutions 72-NQ/TW and 282/NQ-CP to build a modern preventive health system.

triage.headline_ja: 予防医療における官民連携の推進、新興感染症の予防と制御
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な感染症の発生や症例報告ではなく、ワクチン流通管理システムに関する官民連携の発表記事であり、IHR・WPROいずれの基準にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 疾患名はUnknown Illnessとなっているが、記事内容は特定の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、ワクチン追跡システムの発表に関するもの。

article.articleHeadline: 聚焦呼吸介入，链接国际前沿 -- -- 扬州市第二届结核病呼吸内镜诊疗技术学习班成功举办
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Focusing on Respiratory Interventions, Connecting to International Frontiers -- Yangzhou's Second Tuberculosis Bronchoscopic Diagnostic and Therapeutic Techniques Training Workshop Successfully Held
article.articleSummary: On November 27, 2026, Yangzhou's Second Tuberculosis Bronchoscopic Diagnostic and Therapeutic Techniques Training Workshop concluded, organized by the Yangzhou Medical Association and hosted by Yangzhou Third People's Hospital to enhance TB respiratory-endoscopy diagnosis and treatment across the city. About 100 clinicians from municipal and county-level institutions participated. The program featured expert lectures on complex airway stenosis, EBUS-TBNA, airway interventional therapies, pediatric bronchoscopy, and TB immunotherapy, anchored by interpretation of the 2025 Guidelines for Diagnosis and Treatment of Tracheobronchial Tuberculosis. An international segment welcomed Ian Adcock, Professor from the National Heart and Lung Institute at Imperial College London, who discussed clinical-translational research in airway diseases and biomarkers for severe asthma using multiple sample types. The event underscored Yangzhou's move toward standardized, cross-disciplinary TB care, with plans to expand academic exchanges and frontline training.

triage.headline_ja: 呼吸介入に焦点を当て、国際的な最前線とつながる―扬州市第2回結核病呼吸内視鏡診療技術研修会が成功裏に開催
triage.triage_reason: これは学術研修会の開催報告であり、疾病の発生や流行に関する情報ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の呼吸内視鏡診療技術に関する研修会の開催報告であり、感染症発生イベントではない。発生地域として挙げられた江蘇省・ロンドン・中国等は会議参加者の所属機関所在地であり、疾病発生地点ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : dépistage obligatoire des voyageurs, ce qui change vraiment pour vous
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: mandatory screening of travelers, what it really means for you.
article.articleSummary: Ebola triggers mandatory traveler screening in France as a precaution against an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where deaths exceeded 2,000 in three months. Travelers from affected zones undergo arrival screening: questionnaire, temperature check, and possible medical referral. France has already managed a single import: a humanitarian doctor returning from Congo tested positive in Paris; the case was isolated and contacts traced. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids of a symptomatic patient, not through the air, keeping public spaces relatively low risk. Incubation is 2–21 days; symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pains, headaches, and digestive issues. A vaccine exists for certain strains, mainly for healthcare workers. For travelers, non-affected destinations see no changes; returnees should allow extra time on arrival, report symptoms, and monitor for three weeks, calling 15 if fever appears. The risk to the French population remains very low, with established isolation protocols.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：渡航者への検査義務化、実際にあなたにとって何が変わるのか
triage.triage_reason: DRCで3ヶ月に2000人以上の死者を出す大規模なエボラアウトブレイクが継続し、フランスへの輸入症例も発生、渡航者スクリーニング義務化という具体的な対策が取られており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: フランスでの輸入症例・渡航者スクリーニング義務化は対応措置であり、発生源はDRCであるためverified_locationsにはDRCのみを含めた。フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Un año de peste porcina en España: cronología de este aniversario
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Year of Classical Swine Fever in Spain: The Chronology of This Anniversary.
article.articleSummary: A year after African swine fever (ASF) returned to Spain, 27 November 2025 marks the first wild boar foci at Cerdanyola del Vallès, Barcelona, triggering export bans affecting 40 countries. By 29 November outbreaks persisted in wild boar; 6-km and 20-km restriction rings were imposed. On 1 December China suspended imports from 12 Barcelona firms, while the EU mobilized veterinary experts; the Military Emergencies Unit deployed 117 personnel. Origin investigations began; late December sequencing ruled out a lab source. Jan–Feb 2026 losses exceed 150 million, and by 30 January the outbreak surpassed 100 infected wild boars. In 2026 four origin scenarios were considered; by March cases exceeded 200. May–June saw intensified control, with about 900 million in losses, prompting funding to boost capture and meat marketing. By 27 November 2026, 86 foci, 458 positives, ~100 export certificates blocked, and losses over 1,000 million; a three-year eradication program is launched.

triage.headline_ja: スペインにおける豚熱（アフリカ豚熱）発生から1年：この記念日の時系列
triage.triage_reason: 本件はスペインの野生イノシシにおけるアフリカ豚熱（動物疾病）の経過報告であり、対象国（中国等）は輸入停止措置の対象として言及されているのみで発生地ではないため、ヒト感染症シグナルとしては該当しない。
triage.notes: ASFは動物疾病でありヒト感染症ではない。発生地はスペイン（対象国リスト外）。中国は輸入停止措置の対象国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Patient with TB history discharged without tests, Delhi hospital told to pay Rs 2 lakh
article.articleSummary: Delhi consumer commission held a hospital and two doctors liable for medical negligence for failing to perform tuberculosis tests despite the patient’s TB history and presenting fever and leg pain. In June 2014, a chest CT (28.06.2014) showed enlarged mesenteric lymph nodes in the right iliac fossa, described as suggestive of TB, prompting referral to a specialist. At the second hospital, the two respiratory medicine specialists conducted various investigations but did not review the prior CT or order fresh TB testing; the patient was discharged on 12.07.2014 with a note that he was still under evaluation and without proper TB treatment. He later sought care elsewhere, spending about Rs 25,000. The commission ruled deficiency in service and medical negligence, emphasizing the importance of timely, accurate diagnosis, and ordered Rs 2 lakh in compensation to the complainant.

triage.headline_ja: 結核既往歴のある患者が検査を受けずに退院、デリーの病院に20万ルピーの支払い命令
triage.triage_reason: 本件は2014年の個別医療過誤訴訟に関する法的判決報道であり、公衆衛生上の発生事象やアウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は2014年の医療過誤訴訟に関する消費者苦情委員会の判決報道であり、結核の集団発生や公衆衛生上の脅威を報告するものではないため対象国リストへの該当なしとした。

article.articleHeadline: 過去一周本港新增兩宗登革熱及一宗基孔肯雅熱個案　均屬外地傳入
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the past week, Hong Kong recorded two new dengue fever cases and one chikungunya fever case, all imported.
article.articleSummary: Two imported dengue fever and one imported chikungunya fever were reported in Hong Kong in the past week. The two dengue cases had traveled in the incubation period to Mainland China and Thailand, respectively. The chikungunya case involves a 51-year-old man who had visited Mainland China during the incubation period; the infection is considered travel-related. The patient was admitted to hospital in a mosquito-free environment and has since recovered and been discharged. Epidemiological investigations are ongoing, and authorities have notified Mainland health authorities. For the year to date, Hong Kong has recorded 44 dengue fever cases (42 imported, 2 local) and 10 chikungunya cases (9 imported, 1 local).

triage.headline_ja: 過去一週間、香港でデング熱2件と基孔肯雅熱1件を新たに記録、いずれも海外からの輸入症例
triage.triage_reason: 少数の輸入症例であり、患者は蚊のいない環境で入院・既に回復退院しているため国内拡大リスクは低く、IHR基準・社会的関心ともに該当しない。
triage.notes: 香港の輸入症例報告のルーチン更新。渡航歴は中国本土・タイであり、記事の主題は香港だが、感染地として中国・タイが言及されている。局地的感染は既に蚊のいない環境で管理済み。

article.articleHeadline: ES registra circulação de nova variante da Covid-19; OMS monitora - Sim Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ES records circulation of a new COVID-19 variant; WHO monitors - Sim Notícias.
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1, a new SARS-CoV-2 variant, circulating in Espírito Santo, Brazil, with detections also reported in Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Distrito Federal, Rio Grande do Sul, and Santa Catarina. The World Health Organization has categorized PJ.2.1 as a variant under monitoring, indicating it warrants close observation but not necessarily increased severity. In November 2026, Espírito Santo recorded 5,410 COVID-19 cases and 1 death; the report does not specify how many are PJ.2.1. Genomic surveillance by IOC/Fiocruz, in collaboration with Rio de Janeiro’s health authorities, found PJ.2.1 predominating in Rio de Janeiro city, representing about 58% of 167 sequenced genomes. The lineage was first reported in Canada in May 2026, spread across North America in the second half of 2026, and reached Brazil in August. Vaccines remain protective against severe disease; no unique symptom profile is observed; continued vaccination is emphasized, especially for at-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: ESで新型コロナウイルスの新変異株の流行を確認、WHOが監視中
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1はWHOにより「監視下の変異株」に分類されているが重症度増加は確認されておらず、ワクチンも有効とされているため、現時点ではフルRRAに進むほどの緊急性はなく継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: PJ.2.1はWHOの『監視下の変異株(VUM)』であり、重症度や特異的症状の増加は報告されていない。ブラジル国内複数州で検出されているが、カナダ発祥であり国際的拡大自体は既知の事象。ワクチンの有効性も維持されているため緊急性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Peste 12.000 de cazuri de Ebola confirmate în RDC, dintre care aproape jumătate sunt decese
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 12,000 confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC, of which nearly half have died
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases, with 5,904 deaths, based on data through 24 November. The outbreak, declared on 15 May in the DRC, is the seventh in the country and the second deadliest globally, with a case fatality rate of 49.1% and affecting 69 health zones across eight of the 26 provinces. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reiterated that the outbreak remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). He warned that about two-thirds of deaths occur outside treatment centers, suggesting late detection and insufficient contact tracing. The report underscores ongoing transmission and the need for sustained, expanded response efforts across affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の確認症例が12,000例を超え、そのうち約半数が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクがPHEICと宣言されており、致死率49.1%、8州69保健地域に拡大しているため、IHR基準に複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長がPHEICであることを改めて表明。死亡例の約3分の2が治療施設外で発生しており、検知の遅れと接触者追跡の不足が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Banco Mundial apoia vítimas na RDCongo com 50 milhões de dólares
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: World Bank supports victims in the Democratic Republic of the Congo with $50 million.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompts a $50 million World Bank investment to assist more than 37,000 people affected by Ebola in Ituri via the STARR-RDC program, launched in Bunia. The project aims to strengthen social response, community mobilization, and preventive measures to end the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC. Each affected family will receive about $500. The outbreak has 12,021 laboratory-confirmed cases, with almost half of patients dying, making it the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the DRC and approaching West Africa's 11,000 deaths from 2014–2016. It is caused by the Bundibugyo variant, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists. Efforts are hampered by armed conflict, limited access, violence, distrust, and misinformation. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood or bodily fluids of the sick or deceased.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：世界銀行がコンゴ民主共和国の被災者を5000万ドルで支援
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最も致死率の高い（約50%）第17次エボラ流行で、感染者12,021人、武力紛争により対応が阻害され、ワクチン・治療薬も未承認というIHR複数基準に該当する深刻な公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC（イトゥリ州）のみが主題であり、Angolaへの言及はないため除外した。本事案はDRC史上最悪のエボラ流行として既に継続中のものであり、フルリスク評価による最新状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 51歲漢北上返港證染基孔　另2人染登革熱曾訪內地及泰國
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 51-year-old man who traveled north to return to Hong Kong diagnosed with Chikungunya; two others diagnosed with dengue fever who had visited Mainland China and Thailand.
article.articleSummary: Three imported vector-borne cases reported in Hong Kong: a 51-year-old man diagnosed with chikungunya fever after travelling north to return to Hong Kong; and two dengue fever cases who had visited Mainland China and Thailand. The chikungunya patient, with reported incubation period, was hospitalized in a mosquito-free environment and has recovered and been discharged, with the case reported to Mainland health authorities. The dengue cases also involved travel to Mainland China and Thailand. Year-to-date totals: dengue 44 cases (42 imported, 2 local); chikungunya 10 cases (9 imported, 1 local). No local transmission is described beyond these imported cases. Authorities continue monitoring travel-related cases and coordinate with Mainland authorities.

triage.headline_ja: 51歳男性、北部渡航後に香港でチクングニア熱感染確認　他2名は中国本土・タイ訪問歴ありデング熱感染
triage.triage_reason: いずれも輸入症例で地域内伝播は限定的（局地症例少数）であり、重症度や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響も報告されていないため、現時点でピックアップ基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 香港での輸入症例報告。患者は蚊媒介のない環境で隔離・回復済み。地域内伝播の兆候は限定的（デング熱の地元感染2例のみ）。香港はPCLS（特別行政区）として対象国リストのChinaに含めた。タイも渡航歴として言及されているため含めたが、発生国としての主体はHong Kong（中国）。

article.articleHeadline: Update on mosquito-borne diseases, dengue fever and chikungunya fever
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever (DF) in Hong Kong: from Nov 20–26, two imported cases; HK’s 2026 total DF is 44 (42 imported, 2 local). For comparison, 2025 had 59 (all imported) and 2024 had 161 (156 imported, 5 local). Globally, the WHO reports DF surged with >14 million cases in 2024 and >5 million cases with >4,000 deaths in 2025 across 90+ countries; as of Oct 2026, about 3 million cases and >2,000 deaths. DF remains endemic in nearby destinations; Guangdong Province has 740 cases this year through October (154 in October). Other high-burden areas include Bangladesh, Cambodia, India, Sri Lanka, Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Singapore. Chikungunya fever (CF) in HK: from Nov 20–26, one imported CF case, a 51-year-old male who visited Mainland; recovered and discharged; HK has 10 CF confirmations this year (9 imported, 1 local), 82 cases last year (11 local). Globally CF: 363,307 cases and 122 deaths as of Oct; Guangdong CF: 2,558 cases (804 in October). Preventive measures emphasize mosquito control and DEET guidance, plus removal of breeding grounds.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊媒介感染症（デング熱・チクングニア熱）に関する最新情報
triage.triage_reason: 香港衛生当局による定例サーベイランス報告であり、新規の異常事態ではないが、広東省での症例数増加やグローバルなデング熱急増が継続して報告されているため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は香港CHPの定例モスキート媒介感染症サーベイランス報告。ベトナム・カンボジア・インドネシア・スリランカ・バングラデシュ・インド・マレーシア・シンガポールは『高流行地域』として一般的に言及されているのみで、具体的な症例データや主題としての記述はないため verified_locations から除外した。広東省・香港（China）のみ具体的な症例数報告があり主題として扱われている。

article.articleHeadline: তথ্য চাপত মমতার সরকার! শুভেন্দু জমানায় ডেঙ্গু রোধে সাফল্য বাংলার, পিঠ চাপড়াল কেন্দ্র
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Under information pressure, Mamata's government! In Shubhendu's regime, Bengal achieves dengue-control success; the Centre pats Bengal on the back.
article.articleSummary: West Bengal's dengue data were revised amid political shifts, with the central government praising the state's dengue-control model. Health Minister Sharadwata Mukhopadhyay, in Durgapur, said the 2026 dengue burden is down by about 3,500–4,500 cases versus the previous three to four years, crediting the state's planning and administrative actions. Central authorities have reportedly highlighted Bengal as an example for dengue management. The revisions show dramatic increases in earlier reported figures: in one year, reported dengue cases rose from about 30,000 to over 100,000; in another year, from 441 to 31,000; dengue deaths were previously recorded as zero but are now listed at 31. The article contrasts this with earlier alleged underreporting under the TMC government, and notes the Centre's praise for current governance.

triage.headline_ja: 情報操作の圧力の中、マムタ政権！シュヴェンドゥ体制下でベンガルのデング熱抑制が成功、中央政府が称賛
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は過去のデング熱データ改訂をめぐる政治的論争が主題であり、現在進行中の新規公衆衛生上の脅威を報告するものではないため、ピックアップ基準に該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 本港新增三宗蚊傳疾病輸入個案｜METROHK.com.hk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three new imported cases of mosquito-borne diseases in Hong Kong
article.articleSummary: Two imported dengue fever cases and one imported chikungunya fever case were reported in Hong Kong for Nov 20–26, 2026. Dengue total for the year reaches 44 (42 imported, 2 local); the two dengue patients had incubation-period exposure in Mainland China and Thailand. The single chikungunya case involves a 51-year-old man who traveled to Mainland China and has recovered and been discharged; total chikungunya cases reach 10 (9 imported, 1 local). Globally, dengue remains highly active: last year over 90 countries reported more than 5 million cases and 4,000+ deaths; by October this year about 3 million cases and 2,000+ deaths. For chikungunya, global counts by October this year are 363,307 cases and 122 deaths, with the Americas and Southeast Asia regions bearing most. Authorities urge mosquito precautions, including DEET-containing repellents; remove standing water, change vase water weekly, scrub interiors, and keep drains clear; report mosquito problems at 1823.

triage.triage_reason: 香港における輸入症例（デング熱2件・チクングニア熱1件）の定例サーベイランス報告であり、いずれも軽症・回復済みで、異常な増加や新たな公衆衛生上の脅威は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Bahia registra aumento de casos graves de Covid-19; incidência ainda é baixa, aponta Fiocruz - Metro 1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bahia records an increase in severe COVID-19 cases; incidence remains low, Fiocruz says - Metro 1
article.articleSummary: Bahia is among eight Brazilian states with a rise in severe COVID-19 cases, with the Federal District also rising, though overall incidence remains low. Minas Gerais, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo, Paraná, Santa Catarina, and Rio Grande do Sul show similar increases. Nationally, COVID-19–related influenza‑like illness is rising in 23 states and the DF for six weeks; as of 23 November, 159,275 cases were notified, with 4,101 severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS) cases testing positive for coronavirus and 481 deaths (325 over 65). Vaccination efforts include 25.7 million doses distributed in 2026, about 8.5 million administered, and 2.1 million extra doses sent to states, plus WhatsApp and GOV.BR reminders. Lineages PJ.2.1 (~5% nationally; 58% of 167 sequences in Rio de Janeiro) and XFG and descendants (~76%) circulate; no evidence PJ.2.1 drives severity. Precautions: PFF2/N95 masks, ventilation, and hand hygiene. Over 3 million rapid tests distributed; antiviral treatment available for high-risk patients.

article.articleHeadline: Innoviva's (INVA) Nuzolvence Gets WHO Recommendation As Oral Alternative For Gonorrhea
article.articleSummary: WHO guideline development group recommended Nuzolvence (zoliflodacin) as an oral alternative to injectable ceftriaxone for uncomplicated urogenital gonorrhea, where available and appropriate. WHO estimates 82 million new gonorrhea infections occur worldwide each year. Nuzolvence is a single-dose oral antibiotic that inhibits bacterial type II topoisomerase; it received U.S. approval in December 2025 and is approved in Thailand for the same indication in patients aged 12 and older weighing at least 35 kilograms. The drug is commercially available in the United States and was co-developed with Innoviva Specialty Therapeutics, the Global Antibiotic Research and Development Partnership and the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases. It is now the only WHO-recommended oral alternative to injectable ceftriaxone for uncomplicated urogenital gonorrhea, where available. Common adverse effects include headache, dizziness, nausea and diarrhea; labeling warns of potential fetal harm and risks to male fertility from animal studies. Innoviva Q3 2026: net loss $73.89M; revenue $106.12M; cash $581.39M. INVA closed at $18.85, down 2.18%.

article.articleHeadline: 高雄登革熱一周增12例 高師大餐廳員工驗出越南移入病毒株
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever in Kaohsiung: 12 more cases in a week; Kaohsiung Normal University restaurant staff test positive for a Vietnam-imported dengue virus strain.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Kaohsiung intensifies with 3 new local cases in Gushan District, bringing the year’s total to 25. In Qianzhen District, a Kaohsiung Normal University Lan Yuan restaurant staff member is infected with dengue virus type II; genome sequencing matches a Vietnam-imported strain detected Sept–Oct this year, marking Kaohsiung’s first domestic case this year carrying that strain. Across Kaohsiung, 12 dengue cases were reported in the last week. To uncover hidden infections, the Health Bureau expanded testing: 668 people in Gushan, 460 at Kaohsiung Normal University sites, totaling 1,128; more than 3,000 SMS invitations issued since Nov 1 to residents who visited Qingfeng Department Store, Qingfeng Street, or related areas, offering a NT$100 voucher for testing. In Yu-Xing Li, four positive containers (household items) were found today. Fines for breeding mosquitoes can reach NT$15,000. With tomorrow’s Nov 28 local elections, authorities have completed polling-site precautions and will conduct preventive spraying/larviciding and ongoing vector surveillance to ensure safe voting.

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 avança em 23 estados e no DF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 advances in 23 states and in the Federal District
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 is resurging in Brazil, with cases rising across 23 states and the Federal District as of 27 November 2026, amid low vaccination uptake (8.5 million of 25.7 million doses distributed in 2026 have been administered). Fiocruz and the Ministry of Health report increased severe cases in Bahia, Espírito Santo, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina, São Paulo and the Federal District, though overall incidence remains low. In the 46th epidemiological week (through 21 November), 159,275 COVID-19–related influenza-like illness notifications have been recorded this year. Public RT-PCR positivity rose from 1.5% to 2.51%; private labs show a sustained uptick. Since 2026, 4,101 SRAG cases and 481 deaths (325 among 65+). The PJ.2.1 lineage is spreading, identified in Canada in May 2026 and detected in Brazil in August; about 5% nationwide; XFG remains ~76%. No clear link to greater severity; waning immunity may contribute. Vaccination remains focused on high-risk groups, with semiannual doses for 60+, immunocompromised on similar schedules, and annual updates for others.

article.articleHeadline: Hải Phòng: Số ca sốt xuất huyết giảm, nguy cơ dịch vẫn ở mức cao
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hai Phong: The number of dengue fever cases has declined, but the risk of an outbreak remains high.
article.articleSummary: In Hai Phong, week 47/2026 (17–23 Nov) recorded 53 dengue fever cases, down 29 from the previous week, with no fatalities. Since Jan 1, 2026, total dengue cases reached 889, up 37 from 852 in the same period of 2025; the four-week average is 71.25 cases per week. No dengue deaths have occurred this year; the incidence is 19 per 100,000 population. The five top localities by case count are An Bien (125), Le Chan (125), Hai An (51), Gia Vien (49), and Cat Hai (40). Seven new dengue outbreaks occurred this week, bringing the yearly total to 153; 13 outbreaks remain active across Cam Giang, Le Chan, Gia Phuc, Yet Kieu, An Bien, Thuy Nguyen, Phu Thai, Hoa Binh, and Gia Vien. Authorities warn of ongoing rises in dengue and influenza, and advocate environmental sanitation, larval source reduction, vector control, testing, and public communications; residents should cover water containers, eliminate larvae weekly, sleep under nets, wear long sleeves, consider vaccination, and seek care for fever with travel history.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : la France achemine 1,5 tonne de médicaments à Bunia pour renforcer la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: France ships 1.5 tonnes of medicines to Bunia to bolster the outbreak response.
article.articleSummary: France shipped 1.5 tonnes of medicines to Bunia, the capital of Ituri province in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, to bolster the Ebola outbreak response. Delivered on 26 November 2026, the consignment supports humanitarian groups Première Urgence Internationale and ALIMA in patient care, contact tracing, and community awareness as part of ongoing aid tied to DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak. The shipment aims to prevent stockouts and strengthen health facilities’ capacity to manage cases and reduce transmission. The operation underscores Kinshasa–Paris cooperation in public health emergencies and France’s commitment to continued technical and humanitarian support as frontline teams operate in affected health zones to curb virus spread and protect communities.

article.articleHeadline: डेंगू होने पर कैसे लक्षण दिखते हैं? स्वास्थ्य मंत्रालय ने बताए Dengue Symptoms और इसकी रोकथाम के तरीके
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What are the symptoms when dengue occurs? The Health Ministry explains Dengue symptoms and ways to prevent it.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 November 2026, India's National Vector Borne Disease Control Programme (NCVBDC) under the Health Ministry outlines Dengue fever caused by Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. Dengue is a viral fever; symptoms begin days after bite and include intense frontal headache, retro-orbital pain, muscle and joint pains, reduced appetite, and a rash on the chest and upper body. If untreated, severe dengue may develop with repeated vomiting (including blood), bleeding from the nose, gums, or skin, lethargy, thirst, dry mouth, weak pulse, and breathing difficulties. Prevention emphasizes personal protection (mosquito repellents, long-sleeved clothing, full-coverage pants, nets for infants and bedrooms), biological control (larvivorous fish in decorative tanks, biosides), chemical control (larvicides like Abate; daytime aerosols), and environmental management (eliminate standing water, cover containers). Seek medical care within 7–8 days of symptoms to prevent progression.

article.articleHeadline: Kemdiktisaintek kerahkan kampus percepat eliminasi TBC di Jawa Tengah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kemdiktisaintek deploys campuses to accelerate TB elimination in Central Java
article.articleSummary: Central Java TB elimination is accelerated by a 12-university consortium led by Universitas Sebelas Maret (UNS) with Universitas Muhammadiyah Surakarta (UMS) as co-anchor. The initiative pools university resources for research, health education, and thematically focused Community Service (KKN) to support TB control under the Ministry of Education and Culture and local health authorities. As of November 2026, about 79,000 TB cases had been detected in Central Java, within a national burden of roughly 1–1.1 million new TB cases annually. The plan emphasizes active case finding and TB Preventive Therapy (TPT) for close contacts to interrupt transmission, not just treating patients. Governor Ahmad Luthfi aims to broaden university participation, linking TB efforts with Dokter Spesialis Keliling (Speling) and Free Health Checks (CKG) programs, and MoU with 177 universities.

The two dengue patients travelled to Mainland China and Thailand during incubation. The chikungunya case involved a 51-year-old man who had been in Mainland China; he received treatment in a mosquito-free environment, is recovering, and has been discharged. Epidemiological investigations continue, and the case has been reported to Mainland health authorities. Year-to-date, Hong Kong has 44 dengue cases (42 imported, 2 locally transmitted) and 10 chikungunya cases (9 imported, 1 locally transmitted). Separately, researchers report a four-year Brazilian study in a dengue-endemic community with high mosquito activity where releasing Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes reduced dengue and chikungunya infections by about 69% among children; Belo Horizonte was studied. The World Mosquito Program conducts this work. In the United States, Florida reports 650 locally transmitted dengue cases, about 75% in Hillsborough County (Tampa).

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Equateur - Environ 641 000 enfants attendus à la vaccination contre la poliomyélite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Équateur Province — About 641,000 children expected to receive polio vaccination.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Equateur Province launches a polio vaccination campaign targeting nearly 641,000 children under five across 18 health zones over three days, starting November 25, 2026 in Mbandaka. In total, 640,825 children are slated for vaccination; this is the fourth local campaign in Equateur. Door-to-door teams will administer two drops to children aged 0–59 months. The launch occurred at Mbandaka Market 3 in the Wangata health zone, with Vice-Governor Thomas Boyenge Ifaso urging communities to mobilize for high coverage. article.articleHeadline: Bundibugyo Ebola Outbreak: WHO Warns as Deaths Rise
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains a PHEIC, with 11,613 laboratory-confirmed infections and 5,678 deaths (crude case fatality 48.9%) and 3,148 recoveries as of 17 November 2026. Began in May 2026 and subsequently led to cases beyond the DRC, spanning 68 health zones across eight provinces, most severely in Ituri and North Kivu amid insecurity and displacement. WHO reaffirmed the emergency designation on 18 November after the Emergency Committee review. A new Bundibugyo virus molecular diagnostic test received emergency listing to bolster testing. Transmission is via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids; contaminated materials and unsafe burial practices also transmit. Early symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, muscle pain, sore throat; progression to vomiting, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, weakness, and sometimes bleeding. Lab confirmation and travel/exposure history are essential; notable deaths outside treatment centres (452 of 720 in late Oct–mid-Nov) highlight barriers to care.

article.articleHeadline: Oxygen Depletion Causes Neisseria gonorrhoeae Colonies to Turn Inside Out
article.articleSummary: Neisseria gonorrhoeae—the pathogen causing gonorrhoea and a globally prevalent sexually transmitted infection—forms dense colonies and biofilms that shield bacteria from antibiotics and host defenses. Oxygen depletion at the colony core reduces production of type 4 pili, weakening central cell–cell adhesion relative to the periphery. This adhesion gradient triggers a capillary instability, driving outward flow of the core’s weakly interacting cells toward the oxygen-rich exterior, effectively turning the colony inside out. The eversion was observed by microscopy and supported by theoretical modeling. Central cells enter a dormant state with reduced metabolism and growth, conferring antibiotic tolerance but limiting nutrient and oxygen access. Researchers from the University of Cologne, TU Dortmund, Wenzhou Business College, and Universidade NOVA de Lisboa highlight the physical control of microbial architecture and plan to study spatiotemporal dynamics in infection models.
