article.articleHeadline: Nova variante da Covid-19 se espalha por nove estados; veja situação do Acre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New COVID-19 variant spreads to nine states; see the situation in Acre.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-27, nine Brazilian states have detected the SARS-CoV-2 variant PJ.2.1, with Acre still reporting no identified PJ.2.1 cases. The affected states are Espírito Santo, São Paulo, Mato Grosso, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina, Rio de Janeiro, and the Distrito Federal, per Fiocruz’s update using Gisaid data. Acre’s capital, Rio Branco, remains under SRAG alert with rising activity, though the bulletin does not specify pathogens there. In Rio de Janeiro, PJ.2.1 co-circulates with metapneumovirus and influenza A/B. Nationally, severe COVID-19 cases persist at low levels in the Centro-Sul, Bahia, and the Distrito Federal, with Mato Grosso fluctuating; growth may reflect waning immunity and spread of the lineage. The OMS lists PJ.2.1 as monitored; Brazil’s Health Ministry reports rising notifications in 17 states and DF. A Journal of Infection study (Oct 24) suggests higher ACE2 receptor binding affinity for PJ.2.1.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの新変異株が9州に拡大、アクレ州の状況を確認
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1がブラジル9州（最新報告では17州+DF）に拡大し、ACE2受容体結合親和性の上昇が指摘されるなど流行性・異常性の観点でWPRO基準に複数該当し、政府・メディアの関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 重症例は低水準だが、新変異株の急速な拡大とACE2結合親和性上昇の報告、インフルエンザ・メタニューモウイルスとの共流行がみられる点で続報を要する。WHOはPJ.2.1を監視下に置いているが、国際的拡大の実態は記事からは不明。

article.articleHeadline: Francisco Beltrão realiza Dia D de combate à dengue neste sábado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Francisco Beltrão hosts D-Day for dengue control this Saturday
article.articleSummary: Francisco Beltrão, Brazil, on Saturday, November 28, hosts the National Dengue Control Day with activities to raise awareness and reinforce Aedes aegypti prevention. The event begins at 7:30 a.m. at the Municipal Market parking lot with an educational tent illustrating the dengue mosquito life cycle, viewing eggs under a microscope, children's activities, and guidance on eliminating potential breeding sites. Citywide cleanup brigades and recyclable material collection will run at multiple points, complemented by a loudspeaker campaign with prevention messages. The Cango Health Unit will be open all morning for vaccination and updating vaccination records. Dengue vaccine will also be offered to children and adolescents aged 10 to 14 years. Health Secretariat urges families to spend at least 10 minutes inspecting homes to remove containers that collect water, strengthening ongoing efforts against dengue transmission.

triage.headline_ja: フランシスコ・ベルトラン市、今週土曜にデング熱対策「Dデー」を実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防啓発活動・ワクチン接種キャンペーンに関する記事であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の重大な懸念を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は地方自治体による定例的なデング熱予防啓発イベントの告知であり、感染拡大や異常事態の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Calor e chuva aumentam alerta para dengue em Rio das Ostras | Rio das Ostras | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Heat and rain raise dengue alert in Rio das Ostras.
article.articleSummary: Heat and rain raise dengue risk in Rio das Ostras, Brazil, as Aedes aegypti—the vector for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya—reproduces more rapidly. Health Surveillance combines property inspections, ovitrampas, and digital tools (e-FAD) to identify high-risk areas. Residents are urged to spend at least ten minutes weekly removing standing water and cleaning potential breeding sites inside and around homes, including plant pots, bottles, buckets, water tanks, tires, drains, and animal bowls. Eggs can persist on container walls for months; simply dumping water is insufficient. If larvae are found, water should be discharged on a dry surface and containers sanitized. El Niño could modify regional temperatures and rainfall, potentially shifting arbovirus patterns. Field teams use tablets to log data, enabling risk maps and prioritized interventions.

triage.headline_ja: リオ・ダス・オストラスで気温上昇と降雨によりデング熱警戒が強化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱予防啓発記事であり、異常な流行や重篤な公衆衛生インパクトの報告はなく、通常の公衆衛生対策活動の範囲内である。
triage.notes: 地方自治体の季節的なデング熱予防啓発・媒介蚊対策に関する一般的な記事であり、具体的な感染者数や異常な増加の報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Peneliti BRIN temukan adanya bakteri kebal obat pada anjing dan kucing
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BRIN researchers find antibiotic-resistant bacteria in dogs and cats.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 November 2026, BRIN researchers report multi-drug resistant bacteria in domestic dogs and cats across Indonesia. Escherichia coli and Enterococcus isolates from pets in Bukittinggi, Solok, Kota Kupang and six clinics in Jakarta, Bogor, and Depok showed resistance to ampicillin, tetracycline, and high-dose streptomycin, with 26% and 13.8% of isolates respectively categorized as resistant to multiple drugs. Notably, 77.8% of cefotaxime-resistant isolates carried the blaCTX-M gene, requiring >265 µg/mL to kill. Most resistant cases were observed in adolescent animals. About 56.8% of isolates exhibited characteristics of extrainintestinal pathogens that could infect humans (skin, gastrointestinal, and urinary tract) if transmitted to owners. BRIN urges pet owners to rely on veterinarians for diagnosis and treatment, maintain vaccination, enforce biosecurity, and practice hand hygiene to curb AMR spread.

triage.headline_ja: BRIN研究者、犬と猫に薬剤耐性菌を発見
triage.triage_reason: ヒトへの実際の感染例は報告されておらず、研究報告の段階だが、薬剤耐性菌（AMR）が人獣共通感染のリスクを持つため継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は研究機関（BRIN）による調査報告であり、実際のヒト感染事例は報告されていない。ペットから飼い主への伝播リスクが指摘されているが、具体的な症例数や重症度の情報はない。AMR動向として継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : la protection civile sensibilise la population d'Isangi aux mesures préventives contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: Civil Protection sensitizes the population of Isangi to preventive measures against Ebola - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) awareness campaigns are under way in the Yalikandja-Yanonge sector of Isangi Territory, Tshopo Province, DRC, as of 27 November 2026. No confirmed Ebola cases have been reported in Isangi; Kisangani is described as the outbreak epicenter in the province. The Civil Protection initiative emphasizes preventive measures: regular handwashing with soap, avoiding crowds, and good hygiene in public venues, churches (about 85% have handwashing kits), schools requesting installations, and some health facilities with kits. The agency cannot fully fund all installations and is seeking support from NGOs and partners. Residents are urged to seek medical care promptly for suspected symptoms (vomiting, bleeding) and to avoid touching bodies of the deceased; healthcare workers must use PPE. Outreach to remote areas is hampered by logistical and financial constraints, but sensitization continues in churches, markets, schools, and health facilities.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州：民間防衛がイサンギ住民にエボラ予防対策を啓発 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラウイルス病アウトブレイク（キサンガニが震源地）に関連する続報であり、致死率の高い疾患であることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、既存アウトブレイクの一環としてフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事自体はイサンギ地区での予防啓発活動の報告で、イサンギでの確認症例はないが、同州キサンガニが既存アウトブレイクの震源地とされている。新規症例情報や拡大状況については本記事からは不明であり、既存のDRCエボラアウトブレイクのフォローアップとして評価した。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄本土登革熱+3！衛生局發3千封簡訊籲採檢　投開票所加強噴藥防治
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung Local Dengue Fever Cases Rise by 3! Health Bureau Issues 3,000 Text Messages Urging Testing; Polling Stations Strengthen Spraying for Prevention.
article.articleSummary: Local dengue fever case confirmed in Kaohsiung City’s Qianzhen District (Ruigangli): a Kaohsiung University of Education restaurant employee infected with Dengue virus serotype 2. Genomic sequencing by Taiwan CDC matches a Vietnam-imported strain circulating in Oct–Nov 2026, marking the year’s first locally acquired dengue case. To speed detection, Kaohsiung Health Bureau expanded proactive testing, with 668 people tested in Gushan District and 460 linked to Kaohsiung University of Education sites, totaling 1,128. Over 3,000 SMS alerts have been sent since Nov 1 to residents who visited Xiaobei Department Store Qingfeng branch, Qingfeng Street, or the university’s Lanyuan restaurant and related areas, offering a 100 NT voucher for testing. In Yuxingli, four positive mosquito breeding containers were found during environmental cleanup, with penalties up to NT$150,000 for vector breeding. Ahead of the nine-in-one elections, authorities intensified preventive measures at polling stations. Incubation can be up to 14 days; seek care promptly and report travel history; public health line: 07-7230250.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄本土登革熱+3！衛生局が3,000通のSMSで検査を呼びかけ、投票所では消毒を強化
triage.triage_reason: 高雄市で今年初の国内感染（本土感染）デング熱症例が確認され、媒介蚊の継続的な存在と選挙前の社会的関心の高まりが見られるため、フルリスク評価への移行を検討する。
triage.notes: 発生国は台湾（Kaohsiung）であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。ベトナムは輸入株の由来として言及されているのみで、発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Perú lidera mortalidad por dengue en Sudamérica: OPS registra 3.58 fallecidos por millón de habitantes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Peru leads dengue mortality in South America: PAHO records 3.58 deaths per million inhabitants.
article.articleSummary: Peru leads dengue mortality in South America with 3.58 deaths per million inhabitants, based on PLISA indicators cited by PAHO/WHO. The MINSA (CDC-MINSA) situational report shows 126,986 dengue cases nationwide through November 25, 2026: 87,563 confirmed and 39,423 probable. There have been 124 confirmed deaths, plus 60 additional deaths under epidemiological investigation, bringing total dengue-attributed or pending-death count to 184. The dengue case fatality rate is 0.124%, ranking second in the Americas after Panama (0.158%). Peru is positioned above Ecuador (2.71 per million), Brazil (1.77), and Colombia (1.43) for mortality per capita, despite Brazil reporting higher absolute totals. The report underscores Peru’s ongoing dengue burden, with laboratory-confirmed and probable cases and deaths still under investigation, highlighting the need for continued surveillance and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: ペルーが南米のデング熱死亡率トップ：PAHOが人口100万人当たり3.58人の死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はペルーにおけるデング熱の定例サーベイランス報告であり、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン等）には該当しない。ブラジル等は比較統計として言及されているのみで主題ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はペルーの季節性デング熱流行に関するPAHO/MINSAの定例統計報告。ブラジル・エクアドル・コロンビア・パナマは死亡率比較のための言及のみで、いずれも対象国リストに含まれず、記事の主題国（ペルー）も対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: "جافي" يشتري 1.5 مليون جرعة من لقاح تجريبي ضد إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gavi buys 1.5 million doses of an experimental Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-27, Gavi announced plans to purchase up to 1.5 million doses of an experimental Ebola vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain, developed by the University of Oxford and the Serum Institute of India, currently in clinical trials in the Democratic Republic of Congo where there are no licensed vaccines or therapies for this strain. The ongoing outbreak in DRC has caused more than 5,700 deaths. Gavi has allocated $40 million to support vaccine development and, if efficacy is proven, accelerate distribution protocols. Sania Nishtar, Gavi's CEO, urged additional funding and rapid establishment of monitoring and distribution guidelines, hoping the World Health Organization will expedite regulatory processes. Implementation would require regulatory clearance and clear follow-up guidelines for monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: Gavi、エボラ治験ワクチン150万回分を購入へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクによる死者数が5,700人超と深刻で、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響・異常性）を2つ以上満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: インドと英国はワクチン開発元（Serum Institute of IndiaとOxford大学）として言及されているのみで、感染発生地ではないため除外。記事は主にDRCでの継続中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクとそれに対するワクチン調達計画に関するもの。死者数5,700人超という情報の正確性は要確認。

article.articleHeadline: एमपी में डेंगू से मौत होने पर प्रशासन अलर्ट, 277 घरों का किया गया सर्वे, आप भी रहें अलर्ट | Administration On Alert Following Dengue Deaths In Mp 277 Homes Surveyed
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Administration on alert following a dengue death in MP; 277 homes surveyed; you should also stay alert.
article.articleSummary: Dengue death triggers alert in Seoni Malwa, Madhya Pradesh, after 32-year-old Romita Dubey dies amid a dengue outbreak in village Bhiladia Kalan. Authorities report 277 homes surveyed and 64 people screened, with 3 fever cases identified. A 45-member team from the district malaria office, health departments, and ASHA workers is conducting door-to-door larval control and fogging under SDM Vijay Rai, along with sanitation and public-awareness campaigns. Family claims dengue was detectable earlier (noted on 25 October) and that officials misclassified it as malaria; they seek accountability for inaction. Ongoing dengue cases persist, and residents are using private hospitals due to costs. Calls include broader dengue testing, improved sanitation, larval source reduction, and effective preventive measures. Symptoms to watch for: sudden high fever, severe headache and retro-orbital pain, intense joint/muscle pain, nausea/vomiting, fatigue, and rash.

triage.headline_ja: MPでデング熱による死亡を受け行政が警戒、277世帯を調査―あなたも注意を
triage.triage_reason: インド・マディヤプラデーシュ州の一村落での単発的なデング熱死亡例に対し地方当局が調査・防除を実施しているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなく、情報量も限定的であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 単一村落（Bhiladia Kalan村）での死亡例とそれに伴う地域調査に関する報道であり、インド国内の季節性デング熱流行の一環と見られる。マラリアとの誤診を巡る家族の訴えがあるが、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大性を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Nakhon Ratchasima on influenza alert
article.articleSummary: Influenza in Thailand's Nakhon Ratchasima province remains a major concern, accounting for 53 of the 164 influenza deaths recorded nationwide through Nov 21. Almost 700,000 people have been diagnosed countrywide this year, with the northeastern region hardest hit. Nakhon Ratchasima also led flu fatalities last year (40 of 129). The Disease Prevention and Control Office 9, which oversees Nakhon Ratchasima and three neighbouring provinces, has urged calm and is offering free flu vaccinations at public hospitals for residents aged six and older. Provincial public health chief Dr Wichan Kidhen said the spread from sick students at school to elderly relatives is a concern and urged families to monitor the health of children and older people living under the same roof. The data underscores ongoing influenza activity and vaccination efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ナコンラチャシマ県でインフルエンザ警戒
triage.triage_reason: 例年と同様の季節性インフルエンザであり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、地域の公衆衛生当局が予防接種等で対応済みのため。
triage.notes: 死亡者数・症例数は多いが、前年も同様の傾向（同県で最多死亡）があり季節性インフルエンザの定例的な流行として地域保健当局が無料ワクチン接種等で対応中。新規病原体や異常な拡大パターンは示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Botucatu intensifica aplicação de larvicida biológico contra o Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Botucatu intensifies the application of a biological larvicide against Aedes aegypti.
article.articleSummary: Botucatu, Brazil, intensifies biological larvicide application against Aedes aegypti to curb dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Using VectoBac WG (Bacillus thuringiensis israelensis), targeting larvae in water containers via vehicular spraying. In still water, residual effect up to 60 days; larvae die within 24 hours after ingestion. Regions prioritized from October 2026 infestation survey; Jardim Ypê on Nov 26; Jardim Itamaraty on Nov 27; next week Real Park, Jardim Continental, Jardim Eldorado, Vila Paulista, Vila Ferroviária/Jardim Shangrilá, Vila Antártica, Jardins Paraíso 1 and 2. Application hours 07:00–11:30 and 14:00–18:30, weather permitting; rain or winds >10 km/h may suspend or reschedule. Residents do not need to stay indoors, but should avoid sidewalks during spraying; drivers should avoid routes. The product is selective for larvae, with low risk to people, pets, and non-target insects when used as directed. Households should continue preventive measures: weekly inspections, eliminate standing water, seal water tanks, clean gutters, tidy yards.

triage.headline_ja: ボトゥカトゥ、ネッタイシマカ対策で生物学的幼虫駆除剤の散布を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の蚊媒介感染症対策（幼虫駆除剤散布）に関する行政広報であり、異常な感染拡大や症例急増を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊媒介感染症予防のための定例的な防除活動を報じたもので、症例数や流行状況についての記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Tia Nastácia do Sítio do Picapau Amarelo, Rosa Marya Colin é internada aos 81 anos com leishmaniose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rosa Marya Colin, Aunt Nastácia from Sítio do Picapau Amarelo, is hospitalized at 81 years old with leishmaniasis.
article.articleSummary: Rosa Marya Colin, 81-year-old Brazilian actress and singer who portrayed Aunt Nastácia on Sítio do Picapau Amarelo (2001–2007), is hospitalized at Hospital Universitário de Campo Grande in Mato Grosso do Sul after a leishmaniasis diagnosis. She has been admitted since Monday, November 23, and is receiving intravenous treatment; doctors report stable status and expect about ten days of hospitalization to complete therapy. The infection appeared as a facial wound; leishmaniasis is transmitted by bites from infected insects, and the infection origin could not be determined. Her manager said she had started oral meds at home, but hospital monitoring was deemed necessary. Colin has lived in Campo Grande for about four years and attends the Zigurats community in Corguinho, MS, with family in São Paulo. Career highlights include Vicky and the Musa (2023–2024); a concert is planned for February 7, 2027, in Guaramiranga, Ceará, during Carnival.

triage.headline_ja: 『黄色いキツツキの館』のナスターシア役、ロサ・マリア・コリン（81歳）がリーシュマニア症で入院
triage.triage_reason: 著名人個人の単発感染事例であり、公衆衛生上の異常発生やアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يحصد 6 آلاف وفاة بالكونغو و12 ألف إصابة مع صعوبة احتواء التفشي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola claims 6,000 lives in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and 12,000 infections, with difficulty containing the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, with 12,021 confirmed infections and 5,904 deaths as of early November 2026. The current epidemic began mid-May 2026 in Ituri Province (northeastern DRC), driven by a rare Bundibugyo strain and has since spread to eight of 26 provinces. Containment faces major challenges: delayed case detection, armed conflict, and strain-specific gaps, including no vaccines or therapies approved for Bundibugyo. Only about 15% of new cases are among known contacts, signaling undetected transmission chains. This is the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak in history, after West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (over 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths). Reuters satellite analysis suggests official death tolls may underestimate fatalities in two heavily affected areas, underscoring the outbreak’s true scale.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が猛威、死者6,000人・感染者12,000人に、アウトブレイク封じ込めが困難に
triage.triage_reason: 史上2番目に死者数が多いエボラ流行であり、まれなブンディブギョ株によるワクチン・治療薬の不在、未検出の感染連鎖拡大など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC国内（イトゥリ州を起点に8州へ拡大）のみが言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認できないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde de Guarani d'Oeste promove ação nas fábricas sobre prevenção à perda auditiva e combate à dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guarani d'Oeste Health promotes action in factories on preventing hearing loss and fighting dengue.
article.articleSummary: Guarani d'Oeste, Brazil, health authorities conducted an educational outreach across city factories to address Noise-Induced Hearing Loss (PAIR) and dengue prevention during the Semana de Combate ao Aedes aegypti. Industrial visits integrated Workforce Health Surveillance with vector-control messaging. The team warned workers about the risks of PAIR, characterized by gradual, irreversible hearing loss from chronic exposure to high noise levels, and stressed correct, consistent use of PPE—especially hearing protectors. In parallel, dengue prevention guidance urged elimination of containers that collect standing water and maintaining clean work and surrounding areas to reduce Aedes aegypti breeding sites. The effort involved Lucas Delazari (Vigilância Sanitária), ESF nurse Patrícia Jeane Ferreira, ESF doctor Renan Cesar Caldas, IEC coordinator Nadir Santos de Oliveira, and vector agent Ademilson Machado. By bringing information directly to the workplace, the municipal administration aims to strengthen collective health protections at work and home.

triage.headline_ja: グアラニ・ドエステ保健局、工場で難聴予防とデング熱対策の啓発活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は通常の予防啓発・公衆衛生教育活動を報じるものであり、デング熱の異常発生や症例急増等の情報はなく、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は定例的な蚊媒介性疾患予防キャンペーン（Semana de Combate ao Aedes aegypti）の一環であり、具体的な症例数や流行状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Banco Mundial apoia vítimas na RDC com USD...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: World Bank supports victims in the DRC with USD....
article.articleSummary: World Bank will fund a $50 million project to support more than 37,000 people affected by the Ebola outbreak in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo. The STARR-RDC program in Bunia launched the initiative to bolster social protection, community mobilization, and prevention, aiming to end the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC. Each affected family is expected to receive $500. The outbreak has logged 12,021 confirmed cases, per government figures, amid ongoing conflict that hampers containment. Declared in May, the strain is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant, for which no vaccine or approved treatment exists. Efforts face challenges from armed conflict, limited access, violence, and misinformation. The virus spreads by direct contact with blood or other bodily fluids of the sick or deceased. It is the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the DRC to date and could surpass deaths in West Africa (2014-2016).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：世界銀行がコンゴ民主共和国の被災者に5000万ドルを支援
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州における第17回エボラ流行は確定症例12,021例に達し、DRC史上最も致死的な流行とされる。紛争による封じ込め困難、ワクチン・治療法の不在、国際機関による大規模支援の必要性からIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC（イトゥリ州、ブニア）のみが主題であり、Angolaへの言及はないため除外した。ワクチン・承認された治療法が存在しないBundibugyo型であることも懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Sawai Madhopur News: सर्दी में पशुधन पर मंडरा रहा बीमारियों का खतरा | The Threat Of Diseases Looming Over Livestock In Winter Prt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sawai Madhopur News: The Threat of Diseases Looming Over Livestock in Winter Part
article.articleSummary: Sawai Madhopur district faces winter-related health risks for livestock as daily temperature swings affect milk yield and animal well-being. The Animal Husbandry Department says cold stress can raise the risk of seasonal infections among cattle, goats, and poultry, risking farmers’ livelihoods. To counter this, shelters should be windproof, well-lit, and ventilated; use jute mats and tarpaulins to block cold drafts; protect small stock and poultry; lay dry grass or fodder bedding to reduce cold and dampness. Monitor for sudden drops in milk or health changes and consult a veterinarian promptly. Provide quality greens and a balanced, energy-rich diet to maintain immunity; follow veterinary guidance on anti-parasitic use. Vaccination is advised against diseases including Peste des Petits Ruminants (PPR) and Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD), among others. Do not smoke in animal houses; gaushalas should implement these measures. District totals: livestock 712,000; gaushalas 37; cattle 6,866; small cattle 1,206; large cattle 5,460.

triage.headline_ja: サワイ・マドプールニュース：冬季に家畜に迫る病気の脅威
triage.triage_reason: 冬季の家畜管理に関する一般的な予防啓発記事であり、具体的な疾病発生報告ではないため、シグナルとしての該当基準がない。
triage.notes: 実際の発生報告ではなく、冬季の家畜飼育管理に関する予防的アドバイス記事。PPRやFMDは予防接種推奨の文脈で言及されているのみで、発生事例の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Esporotricose: Justiça dá cinco dias para governo do RS explicar ações contra doença transmitida por gatos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sporotrichosis: Court gives five days for Rio Grande do Sul government to explain actions to combat the disease transmitted by cats.
article.articleSummary: Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, faces escalating Sporotrichosis, a cat-associated fungal zoonosis caused by Sporothrix. A regional environmental court ordered the state government to report within five days on diagnostic capacity, drug provision, epidemiological surveillance, and animal protection. In humans, 1,465 confirmed cases in Rio Grande do Sul, with the Porto Alegre metropolitan region as the epicenter; last year recorded 1,960 confirmed cases, 231 discarded, and 384 inconclusive. In animals, 2,510 notifications in 2026 involving dogs and cats; cats—especially male, non-neutered with outdoor access—predominate. The Desidério Finamor Center coordinates diagnostic labs; risk of interruption to laboratory tests noted. The state must report stock and demand for itraconazole and potassium iodide and identify served municipalities. An appeal hearing is set for December 11 in Porto Alegre. Transmission occurs via scratches or bites; lesions commonly affect the nose, ears, or paws; prevention emphasizes neutering, indoor housing, and protective gear.

triage.headline_ja: スポロトリコーシス：リオグランデドスル州政府に対し、裁判所が猫媒介疾患対策の説明を5日以内に行うよう命令
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・リオグランデドスル州で猫媒介の真菌症スポロトリコーシスが継続的に流行し、裁判所が州政府に診断・治療体制の説明を命じるなど行政・社会的関心が高まっており、WPRO基準にも複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 動物由来の地域流行であり、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性は低い。診断・治療薬の供給継続性が今後の焦点。国際的拡大リスクは低いが、州レベルでの公衆衛生体制の脆弱性が司法介入の対象となっている点が特徴的。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo's Ebola death toll may be far higher than reported
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Mongbwalu, may have fatality toll far higher than official counts. Reuters analysis of local records shows rapid cemetery expansion, with hundreds of new graves and rising burial numbers months before authorities declared the outbreak in May, suggesting many deaths went unregistered. Official tallies run in the thousands, but satellite imagery and accounts from local officials and health workers indicate the true toll is higher, underscoring gaps in early death detection amid ongoing conflict that hampers containment efforts. The findings highlight how uncounted fatalities can distort outbreak scale and hinder response, emphasizing the need for improved mortality surveillance and humanitarian access to affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数、報告より大幅に多い可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のDRCでの発生で、公式死者数を大幅に上回る可能性が報道されており、紛争による封じ込め困難、死亡把握の不備など公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はReuters分析に基づくもので、実際の死者数が公式統計より大幅に多い可能性を示唆。紛争地域での死亡登録の不備と人道的アクセスの必要性が強調されている。既知のDRCエボラ流行の継続・拡大に関する続報として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Casos graves de covid quintuplicam em dois meses na capital paulista e hospitais privados registram alta nas internações respiratórias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe COVID-19 cases quintuple in two months in São Paulo's capital, and private hospitals report an increase in respiratory hospitalizations.
article.articleSummary: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) due to COVID‑19 in São Paulo, capital, rose fivefold from 26 cases in September to 135 by 25 November (99 in October). In the state’s private hospitals, 91% reported increases in respiratory emergencies, with Covid‑19 the leading etiologic agent among SARS patients in the capital. Among severe cases, 49.6% are aged 65+ and 20.5% are under 2 years. Year‑to‑date: 1,291 COVID‑SARS cases in Jan–Nov 2025 vs 590 in 2026 (−54.3%). Covid‑19 deaths in 2026: 7 (Sept), 3 (Oct), 7 (Nov). SindHosp surveyed 89 private hospitals (71% in capital/Greater SP); 91% reported increases in respiratory illnesses; Covid‑19 accounted for the majority of rising cases in 53% of facilities, influenza 43%. Vaccination remains central: 1,149,801 doses in the capital Jan–Nov 25, 2026; schedules emphasize semi‑annual boosts for elderly/immunocompromised and annual doses for others. Symptoms include sore throat, runny nose, headache, and cough.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州都でCOVID-19重症例が2か月で5倍に増加、民間病院では呼吸器系入院が増加
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロでCOVID-19由来の重症急性呼吸器症候群（SARS）症例が増加し死亡例も継続しているが、季節性の範囲内と見られ国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、フルRRAより経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: COVID-19とインフルエンザによる季節性の呼吸器疾患増加であり、新規病原体や異常事態の兆候はない。高齢者・乳幼児の重症化率上昇と死亡例の継続が見られるため、国内保健当局の対応状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Fujian Hepatitis C Surveillance Finds Subtype 1b Dominance and Frequent
article.articleSummary: Genomic surveillance of hepatitis C virus in Fujian Province, China (2022–2025) analyzed 91 full-length genomes from sentinel populations. Subtype 1b was the most prevalent, with subtypes 3b and 6a as major lineages following 1b; subtypes 1a and 2a were also detected, indicating evolving genetic diversity. Phylogenetic analyses revealed that 1b, 3b, and 6a sequences largely cluster with strains from neighboring Guangdong Province, while some branches align with international sequences from Japan and Denmark; 1a and 2a group with foreign sequences, indicating divergent trajectories. Resistance-associated substitutions were common across nonstructural regions: NS3/4A S122G/N/C (31/91, concentrated in 1b/6a); NS5A mutations including L31V, Y93H, R30Q, L28M in 1b and Q30K/L31M in 3b; NS5B C316N mainly in 1b (21/32), and S282T in one 3b isolate. Findings support ongoing genomic monitoring of circulating subtypes and drug-resistant variants to guide regional control.

triage.headline_ja: 福建省のC型肝炎サーベイランス、サブタイプ1bの優勢と頻繁な薬剤耐性変異を発見
triage.triage_reason: 慢性感染症であるC型肝炎の分子疫学的サーベイランス研究であり、急性の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常な発生を示すものではないため、シグナルとしての基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は福建省におけるC型肝炎ウイルスの遺伝子型・薬剤耐性変異に関する学術的サーベイランス研究報告であり、アウトブレイクや急性イベントではない。日本・デンマークは系統解析における比較対象として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Health Dept. approaches VCRC for serotyping of dengue currently prevalent in Puducherry
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Puducherry UT has prompted the Health Department to seek serotyping and genome sequencing from the Vector Control Research Centre to understand the current outbreak. Four youths have died—aged 16, 19, 23, and 29—with three being women—driving the year's death toll to the highest in nine years. As of November 26, the UT reported 1,510 dengue cases, concentrated mainly in Puducherry. Blood samples from dengue patients have been sent to the Microbiology Laboratory at Indira Gandhi Government Medical College and Research Institute for molecular testing to identify the prevailing strain and to assess whether a new variant is fueling transmission. A meeting chaired by the Health Secretary on November 26 reviewed the situation with representatives from Karaikal, Mahe, and Yanam via videoconference. Officials urged eliminating stagnant water to curb Aedes aegypti breeding: water in cups, bottle caps, buckets, pots, tyres, coconut shells, and overhead tanks.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、プドゥチェリーで流行中のデング熱の血清型特定をVCRCに依頼
triage.triage_reason: プドゥチェリー連邦直轄地で9年間最高となる死者数（4名）と1,510症例が報告され、保健当局が新変異株の可能性を調査するため遺伝子解析を依頼するなど、異常性・重症度・行政の関心の高さが認められる。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドの風土病的な年次流行だが、今回は死亡者数が9年間で最高となり、新変異株の可能性を調査するため保健省が血清型・ゲノム解析を依頼するなど、通常以上の公衆衛生対応が行われている点でピックアップ対象とした。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは現時点で確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola avanza rápido en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads rapidly in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 12,021 confirmed cases with nearly half deaths as of 27 November 2026, per the Health Ministry. It is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history and the deadliest among Congo’s 17 outbreaks, potentially on track to exceed the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak that killed about 11,000. The May-declared outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood or other bodily fluids of sick or deceased individuals. Containment requires rapid isolation, monitoring of exposed contacts, and safe burials, though response is hampered by armed conflict, poor roads, and violence fueled by distrust and misinformation. Bunia, capital of Ituri province and a key Ebola response hub, lies near Iga-Barrière, where fighting between the army and rebels has driven displacement.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で急速に拡大
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%のエボラ出血熱が12,021例を超え史上最速拡大・最悪の流行となっており、ワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、武力紛争により対応が妨げられているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョウイルスによるエボラ流行で承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、武力紛争により封じ込めが困難。2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を超える可能性があり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Six of family down with malaria in Godda, 12-year-old girl critical
article.articleSummary: As of 27 November 2026, six members of a family from Bada Puru village in Sundarpahari, Godda district, have been hospitalized with malaria. A 12-year-old girl, Basanti Soren, is in critical condition with cerebral malaria and admitted to the pediatric intensive care unit after losing consciousness. Her father, Pujhar Soren, is also undergoing treatment. The other patients are Chameli Soren, Nicholas Soren, Pradeep Soren, and Golu Murmu. They were first taken to Sundarpahari Community Health Centre before referral to Godda Sadar Hospital, where Basanti’s cerebral malaria was confirmed. Sundarpahari and Boarijor blocks are malaria-prone; cerebral malaria typically peaks Aug–Oct, but cases detected late in Nov raise concerns about ongoing transmission. Mosquito nets are being distributed and screening camps conducted; officials say intensified surveillance may follow if more villagers are affected.

triage.headline_ja: ゴッダ県で家族6人がマラリアに罹患、12歳少女が重体
triage.triage_reason: 単一家族内での局所的なマラリア集団発生で、国際的拡大リスクは低いが、例年のピーク時期を外れた晩期発生であり地域内での継続的な感染拡大の可能性があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ジャールカンド州ゴッダ県の単一家族内でのマラリア集団発生を報告。通常の流行期（8〜10月）を外れた11月の発生であり、地域の保健当局が監視強化の可能性を示唆している。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には至らないが、地域の季節外流行動向として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 em Foz do Iguaçu chega a 38 casos em novembro, quase o triplo de outubro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 in Foz do Iguaçu reaches 38 cases in November, nearly three times that of October.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Foz do Iguaçu, Brazil, rose to 38 confirmed cases in November (as of Nov 19), nearly triple October's 14, with 194 total influenza-like syndrome cases due to COVID-19 in 2026; six progressed to severe acute respiratory syndrome (SRAG) and two deaths. Children 0–4 years accounted for 61 cases; among seniors, 19 aged 60–70 and 20 aged 71+, with females 55% of infections and males 45%. In Paraná state, 95 cases were reported in September, 306 in October, and 1,487 in November (through Nov 21); 2026 totals are 9,519 cases and 26 deaths. Brazil-wide, 159,326 COVID-19 influenza-like syndrome cases in 2026, with 3,875 (Sept), 8,457 (Oct), and 33,408 (Nov). Vaccination remains free at all Basic Health Units; seniors should receive a booster every six months, and children with at least one dose should complete a three-dose schedule. Early diagnosis and antiviral treatment via SUS are emphasized for high-risk patients.

triage.headline_ja: フォス・ド・イグアスのCOVID-19、11月に38例に増加（10月の約3倍）
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の季節性COVID-19症例数増加を報告する定例統計記事であり、異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航貿易制限の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既存の流行病であり、ワクチン接種体制や抗ウイルス治療も確立されている。死亡率も比較的低く、地域保健当局による通常の疫学モニタリング範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Casos graves de Covid-19 quintuplicam em dois meses na cidade de SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe COVID-19 cases quintuple in two months in the city of São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Severe COVID-19 cases in São Paulo surged more than fivefold, with SRAG due to Covid-19 rising from 26 in September to 135 by November 25 (419% increase); October had 99. The private sector mirrored the trend: a SindHosp survey of 89 institutions found 91% reporting higher admissions for severe respiratory syndromes in the past 15 days, with 68% noting a 6–20% rise. Among units with higher demand, 53% attributed it to Covid-19 and 43% to influenza. In the capital, severe cases concentrate among the elderly (65+) and children under 2 (49.6% and 20.5%). Year-to-date 2026 totals remain well below 2025: Covid-19 SRAG down 54.3% to 590; influenza-like illness down 55% to 14,271; deaths down 70.7% to 61 (7 in Sept, 3 in Oct, 7 in Nov). Vaccination continues via SUS, with boosters for elderly/immunocompromised, pregnant, and other groups. Symptoms resemble flu; seek urgent care if dyspnea or low oxygen.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ市で新型コロナウイルスの重症例が2カ月で5倍に増加
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ市で季節性と見られるCOVID-19重症例の増加が報告されているが、年間累計は前年を大幅に下回り、異常事態や国際的拡大の兆候は認められないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 季節性呼吸器疾患（COVID-19・インフルエンザ）の増加であり、ブラジル公式統計（SUS）とSindHosp調査に基づく定期的なサーベイランス報告。死亡者数・年間累計は前年比で大幅減少しており、現時点で緊急対応を要する兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Japan's MAFF Reports 3rd H5N9 Outbreak, South Korea MAFRA Reports 9th
article.articleSummary: Japan's MAFF reports the third confirmed case of highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N9) in Japan, with the infected animal in Toyohashi City, Aichi Prefecture; genetic analysis by the Animal Health Research Division confirmed HPAI infection and identified the NA subtype as H5N9. This marks Japan's third HPAI H5N9 case. Separately, South Korea's MAFRA reports its ninth outbreak of HPAI H5N9 in poultry, during the 2025-2026 season, with five H5N9 outbreaks making up about 8% of the total 62 outbreaks. HPAI H5N9 remains comparatively rare globally, with other subtypes (e.g., H5N6 in parts of China, H5N5 in northern latitudes) more common. The reports reflect ongoing cross-border avian influenza activity during the current season as of 27 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 日本の農林水産省、H5N9型の第3例目の高病原性鳥インフルエンザ発生を報告、韓国農林畜産食品部は第9例目を報告
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザ(H5N9)は家きんにおける動物感染事例であり、人への感染報告はない。また発生国は日本・韓国であり、対象国リストに含まれないため監視対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 中国への言及はH5N6との比較のための参考情報であり、記事の主題ではないため除外。発生国（日本・韓国）は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Lapu-Lapu City intensifies dengue prevention as cases rise to 2,507
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu, reaches 2,507 cases and 17 deaths from January to November 2026, a 262% rise from 692 in 2025. Basak leads with 354 cases and four deaths; Mactan 283 (1 death); Pusok 198 (1); Babag 185 (1); Gun-ob 176. Top five areas have recorded no additional deaths to date. Males and children aged 1–10 are most affected (median age 9). Cases began surging in September, with citywide increases and similar trends in other LGUs. Authorities emphasize targeted misting in clustered areas rather than indiscriminate spraying, alongside a citywide cleanup across all barangays and island communities. The City Health Office extended Saturday operations and offers free CBC and NS1 testing to support early diagnosis, while urging parents to seek early care and monitor for warning signs such as persistent vomiting, abdominal pain, or nosebleeds. Coordination with DepEd supports school dengue prevention.

triage.headline_ja: ラプラプ市、デング熱予防を強化、症例数2,507件に増加
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・ラプラプ市でデング熱症例が前年比262%増加し死者も出ているが、季節性の流行であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められないため、IHR基準には該当しないが重症度・流行しやすさの観点から経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンの風土病であり季節性の増加が報告されているが、262%増という大幅な増加と死亡例の発生から地域保健当局の対応状況を継続的に注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 高市本土登革熱+3　衛生局：疫調研判為同一波社區感染 - OwlNews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three locally transmitted dengue fever cases in Kaohsiung City; Health Bureau says the epidemiological investigation indicates they are part of the same wave of community transmission.
article.articleSummary: Three locally transmitted dengue fever cases were reported in Kaohsiung City, signaling ongoing community transmission. The Kaohsiung City Health Bureau reported 3 new cases (2 men, 1 woman), aged 42–55, with onset Nov 23–25; all infected with dengue virus serotype 1, except a Ruagangli in Qianzhen District case with serotype 2. Genomic sequencing linked the type 2 strain to a Vietnam-imported lineage from Sept–Oct 2026, the year’s first local type 2 case. Testing expanded in Gushan (668) and near NKNU (460): 1,128 tested; SMS to >3,000 visitors since Nov 1 offering NT$100 voucher. Risk venues include Xiao Bei Department Store Qingfeng Store, Qingfeng Street, and NKNU Lanyuan Restaurant; four positive breeding containers were found. Penalties up to NT$150,000 for vector breeding. Ahead of Nov 28 elections, enhanced measures around polling stations include cleanup and preventive spraying. Incubation can reach 14 days; seek care and tell doctors travel/history. Hotline: 07-723-0250.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄市で本土感染のデング熱患者+3　衛生局：疫学調査の結果、同一波の地域感染と判断
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄市での局地的デング熱の市中感染拡大事例で、今年初の血清型2型の国内感染例が確認されたが、重症例や広域拡大の情報はなく、対象国リストにも該当しないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾高雄市での市中感染拡大であり、ベトナムは輸入株の系統解析上の起源として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではない。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: prevenção de arboviroses em São Sebastião do Rio Verde - Jornal Panorama
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevention of Arboviral Diseases in São Sebastião do Rio Verde - Jornal Panorama
article.articleSummary: Arboviral prevention for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya was conducted in São Sebastião do Rio Verde, Brazil, through home visits by Endemic Agents on Monday (23). The program targeted pregnant women, delivering tailored guidance on preventing Aedes aegypti mosquito breeding and protecting maternal and fetal health during pregnancy. In addition to counseling, participants received a prevention kit with informational leaflets and repellents to reduce exposure to arboviruses. The initiative emphasizes community participation and sustained vector-control efforts to minimize arboviral risks among populations requiring closer health monitoring. The report cites information and photos provided by the Prefeitura de São Sebastião do Rio Verde.

triage.headline_ja: サン・セバスティオン・ド・リオ・ヴェルデにおけるアルボウイルス感染症予防 - ジョルナル・パノラマ

article.articleHeadline: Chủ động phòng ngừa sốt xuất huyết từ cộng đồng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Proactive Community-Based Dengue Fever Prevention
article.articleSummary: In Ho Chi Minh City, a Nov 27, 2026 symposium on proactive dengue prevention highlighted rising dengue activity into 2026. Week 45 (2–8 Nov 2026) recorded 2,099 dengue cases, up 16.8% from the prior four-week average, with a cumulative 46,690 cases since 2026 began. Spatial patterns are shifting at the commune/ward level, prompting intensified local surveillance. Key drivers include the susceptible human population, circulating dengue serotypes (four serotypes) and Aedes mosquitoes, with El Niño-linked drier spells and intermittent warmth potentially sustaining vector breeding and larval habitats. Prior infection does not guarantee protection due to serotype variation and antibody-dependent enhancement. Vaccination can reduce risk, hospitalization, and severity but does not fully prevent infection, necessitating ongoing vector control. Emphasis on school-age children, the elderly, those with comorbidities, and previously infected individuals; families should eliminate standing water 10–15 minutes weekly, and communities must maintain vigilant, localized epidemiological monitoring.”} }13-11-2026 14:33

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Covid-19 dobram em novembro e acendem alerta em BH
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases double in November and trigger an alert in Belo Horizonte.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases in Belo Horizonte, Brazil more than doubled in early November 2026, rising from 2.6 to 5.7 cases per 100,000 residents by November 18 (≈119% increase). The municipal health system reports higher demand for medical care and hospitalizations related to the disease, though public units remain within capacity. Testing rose from 1,105 tests (Nov 8–14) to 1,369 tests (Nov 15–21), a 24% increase, with positivity edging up from 29% to 30%. COVID-19 is currently the leading cause of acute respiratory diseases in Belo Horizonte. As of November 25, 2026, 837 cases and 13 deaths have been recorded in the year. Vaccination is emphasized to prevent complications, hospitalizations, and deaths; the vaccine is part of the basic schedule for adults over 60, pregnant people, children 6 months to under 5 years, health workers, and those with special clinical conditions.

article.articleHeadline: बंगाल में पांच साल बाद सामने आए डेंगू के आंकड़े, 2023 में एक लाख से अधिक संक्रमित; 79 की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue figures emerge in West Bengal after five years; over 100,000 infected in 2023; 79 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Dengue figures for West Bengal have been released after a five-year gap, showing 2023 dengue infections exceeding 100,000 and 79 deaths. The state health department published 2021–2026 dengue cases and dengue-related fatalities, and also released chikungunya data. Kolkata, North 24 Parganas, Nadia, and Murshidabad were among the hardest hit in 2022–2023. New BJP government under Chief Minister Shubhendu Adhikari pledged transparency; after a review meeting the health department sent the 2021–2026 figures to the National Vector Borne Disease Control Programme (NVBDCP). Previously, central authorities and medical bodies accused the West Bengal government of suppressing data and not uploading to the central portal, which had stalled central funding. Some doctors welcomed the release; others had alleged instructions to record dengue as other febrile illness. By September this year, dengue cases stood at over 9,000.

triage.notes: 記事は2023年までの過去データ公開に関する政治的内容が中心で、現在進行中のアウトブレイクの新規性は低い。ただし2026年9月時点で9000例超との記述もあり、デング熱・チクングニアの地域流行状況は継続的な監視対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Nova variante faz casos de Covid-19 dispararem no Brasil; veja vídeo de alerta de especialista da Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New variant makes COVID-19 cases surge in Brazil; watch a Fiocruz specialist's warning video.
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1, a SARS-CoV-2 variant linked to Omicron, is being monitored by the WHO in Brazil amid a surge in cases. First detected in Canada in May 2026, it circulated in North America before arriving in Brazil in August 2026. Fiocruz genomic surveillance shows PJ.2.1 in about 58% of 167 sequenced samples across Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Espírito Santo, the Federal District, Rio Grande do Sul and Santa Catarina. Signals of rising cases are also seen in Paraná, Minas Gerais, Bahia and Roraima. Weekly COVID-19 notifications rose from roughly 1,000 to about 17,000 in late November 2026; test positivity reached 17%, the highest since February. SRAG cases linked to SARS-CoV-2 also increased in some regions. Symptoms remain typical: fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, body aches. Vaccination is stressed; Brazil’s SUS offers free vaccines, boosters for elderly/immunocompromised, and three-dose schedule for children 6 months to 4 years.

triage.headline_ja: 新変異株がブラジルでCOVID-19症例を急増させる：フィオクルス専門家の警告動画

triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内（複数州：リオデジャネイロ、サンパウロ、エスピリトサント、リオグランデドスル、サンタカタリーナ、パラナ、ミナスジェライス、バイーア、ロライマ）での症例急増を報告。カナダは変異株の初検出地として言及されているが、現在の主題イベントの発生地ではないため除外。重症度（入院・死亡率）の具体的データは記事に記載なく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Governo de SP promove Dia D de combate à dengue neste sábado com foco em vistorias residenciais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo State Government promotes D-Day for dengue control this Saturday with a focus on residential inspections.
article.articleSummary: On Saturday, November 28, 2026, São Paulo State Health Secretariat (SES-SP) conducts D-Day for prevention and control of Aedes aegypti, vector of dengue, chikungunya, and Zika, closing the Week of Intensification of Vector Control started November 23. The campaign urges residents across São Paulo to inspect homes, backyards, and outdoor spaces for standing water. As of 2026, São Paulo reports 65,671 confirmed dengue cases and 45 deaths, with municipality-level data publicly available on the SES-SP dashboard; however, dengue transmission remains active. Guidance emphasizes removing unused containers (bottles, tires, plant pots), washing pet water bowls, filling plant saucers with sand, sealing or screening water storage tanks, clearing gutters and drains, and keeping pools clean and treated. The mobilization supports the El Niño 2026–2027 Health Plan to bolster surveillance, clinical care, and municipal support, alongside an online seminar on urban arboviruses and updated monitoring technologies.

article.articleHeadline: Com 57 casos de sarna em escolas, cidade mineira decreta emergência
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With 57 cases of scabies in schools, a city in Minas Gerais declares a state of emergency.
article.articleSummary: Scabies outbreak leads Divinópolis, a city in the Central-West region of Minas Gerais, Brazil, to declare a 60-day public health emergency after confirming 57 cases across ten schools. The measures include removing infected students from class and the potential suspension of in-person classes in any class with three confirmed cases on the same day, along with reinforced cleaning of classrooms, toys, and school transport. The first identified cluster is at Escola Municipal Sidney José de Oliveira in Jardim Candides, with 15 confirmed cases; 46 additional cases are under investigation. Scabies is a skin disease caused by a mite and is transmitted primarily through direct and prolonged skin-to-skin contact. Early recognition of symptoms and appropriate treatment are emphasized to prevent further cases.

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: Teresina investiga sete casos suspeitos e reforça vigilância
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: Teresina investigates seven suspected cases and reinforces surveillance
article.articleSummary: Mpox in Teresina, Brazil, is under investigation with seven suspected cases; four are confirmed in 2026. Confirmed cases are all male—three aged 30–39 and one aged 40. Eleven notifications have been recorded in Teresina through Nov 26, with seven under investigation (e-SUS Sinan). Brazil reports 1,479 mpox cases in 2026, including 627 in November (up 103.6% from October) and one death. DVS/FMS-CIEVS monitor notifications and coordinate with clinics and labs to strengthen the municipal response. Mpox is transmitted mainly via direct contact with lesions, bodily fluids, or secretions, and through prolonged close contact or shared contaminated objects; lesions can appear anywhere. Prevention emphasizes avoiding contact with suspected cases, hand hygiene, and surface cleaning. Vaccination at CRIE (Hospital Infantil Lucídio Portela) targets PVHIV, PrEP users, and lab workers; call 86 98832-4756. Health professionals should report suspected cases within 24 hours via e-SUS Sinan and conduct investigations and contact tracing.

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde alerta para avanço da Covid-19 em 24 unidades da Federação e reforça vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health warns of the progression of COVID-19 in 24 federative units and reinforces vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports a renewed COVID-19 surge across 23 states and the Federal District, with week 46 (ended Nov 21) marking six consecutive weeks of rising infections. Of 25.7 million vaccine doses distributed in 2026, only about 8.5 million have been administered. Health authorities are expanding outreach via WhatsApp and GOV.BR and have dispatched over 2.1 million more vaccines and 3 million rapid tests (1.9 million extra). Since the start of 2026, the country has recorded 159,275 COVID-19–related flu-like syndrome cases, 4,101 SRAG cases, and 481 deaths, 325 in people 65+. Public RT-PCR positivity rose from 1.5% to 2.51%; private labs have higher positivity for 11 weeks. The PJ.2.1 lineage accounts for about 5% of nationwide sequences and up to 58% in Rio de Janeiro; severity remains unproven. SUS vaccination follows priority schedules; Fiocruz urges isolation and masking; antivirals may be offered.

article.articleHeadline: Esporotricose: Saiba como identificar os sintomas e como o fungo é transmitido
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sporotrichosis: Learn how to identify the symptoms and how the fungus is transmitted.
article.articleSummary: Sporotrichosis, a subcutaneous fungal infection caused by Sporothrix species (notably S. brasiliensis in Brazil), is rising in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. In 2026, RS recorded 1,465 confirmed human cases, concentrated in the Porto Alegre metropolitan region; 2025 reported 1,960. Among animals, 2,510 notifications were recorded, with cats most affected. Transmission occurs via environmental exposure to contaminated soil and plant material, or via scratches, bites, or contact with lesions from infected animals—especially cats. Early recognition is essential: humans develop a small reddened nodule at the injury site that can ulcerate, followed by nodules along lymphatics; cats develop deep pus-filled wounds, nasal discharge, and respiratory signs. Treatment is long, with itraconazole prescribed for three to six months or more, with cure possible. Preventives include keeping cats indoors, neutering, gloves in gardening, sanitizing environments, and cremating deceased animals. The RS court ordered a five-day report on control measures.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・リオグランデ・ド・スル州でスポロトリコーシス（人獣共通真菌感染症）の症例数が高水準で推移しており、動物由来感染の継続的リスクがあるが、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の懸念は見られないため経過観察とする。

article.articleHeadline: La recrudescence des combats dans l'Est de la RDC perturbe la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The resurgence of fighting in eastern DRC disrupts the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 November 2026, fighting in Djugu district of Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, has disrupted the Ebola response. Intense clashes between Congolese government forces and the CRP rebels, led by Thomas Lubanga, forced evacuation of WHO and health personnel from Akwe hospital after more than three days sheltering there, and temporarily pulled intervention teams from Mongbwalu. The outbreak remains centered in Ituri, with security concerns provoking mass civilian displacement—thousands fleeing to Bunia—while schools and businesses suspend operations. Humanitarian access is increasingly constrained and UN personnel movement is restricted in parts of Djugu. The CRP announced a pause in its offensive and withdrawal from recently occupied areas following negotiations under Ugandan mediation; the army accuses the group of continuing attacks on civilians and security forces. Health authorities and partners maintain surveillance, treatment, contact tracing, and vaccination despite the insecurities.

article.articleHeadline: Balaghat News: मलेरिया से एक वर्षीय बैगा बालक की मौत, बोंडारी गांव में शोक, स्वास्थ्य विभाग पर उठे सवाल
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Balaghat News: Death of a one-year-old Baiga boy due to malaria, mourning in Bondari village, questions raised about the health department.
article.articleSummary: Balaghat district, Madhya Pradesh: In Bondari village in the South Baihar region, a one-year-old Baiga boy named Harail died from malaria, triggering mourning in the tribal community. The death raises questions about health service delivery and the effectiveness of malaria control campaigns in remote tribal areas. Shahu Baiga, the child's father, and local residents report limited access to medical facilities and delays in diagnosis and treatment, prompting calls for tighter monitoring and accountability within the health department. The incident unfolds amid ongoing malaria control efforts, underscoring concerns about the reach of preventive measures, surveillance, and emergency response in Bondari and surrounding tribal settlements. Families urge authorities to address gaps in healthcare access to prevent future malaria-related fatalities in the region.

triage.triage_reason: 単発のマラリア死亡例で、地域医療アクセスの問題を示唆するが、国際的拡大や異常な病原体ではなく、情報も限定的なため経過観察とする。

article.articleHeadline: Dia D de combate à dengue em Arantina - Jornal Panorama
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: D-Day in the fight against dengue in Arantina - Panorama Journal
article.articleSummary: D-Day dengue control in Arantina targets Loteamento Osório as Municipal Health Department and Health Surveillance organize a door-to-door action on Saturday, November 28, 2026, starting at 08:00. Endemias agents will visit homes to educate residents and identify potential Aedes aegypti breeding sites, the vector for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Residents should welcome the agents, who will be wearing uniforms and caps, and point out areas in houses and yards where water can accumulate. Preventive measures highlighted include eliminating standing water in plant pots and saucers, tires, bottles, and gutters; keeping water storage tanks tightly closed; and routinely cleaning yards. Residents in other Arantina neighborhoods needing a single collection can call (32) 98459-8164. See Prefeitura de Arantina for details.

article.articleHeadline: Health Dept. prepared to handle KFD cases in Shivamogga, says Khader
article.articleSummary: Shivamogga Health Department is prepared to prevent Kyasanur Forest Disease (KFD) spread, with a special 10-bed ward established at every taluk hospital in the district. Health Minister U.T. Khader told a review meeting that officials will identify KFD hotspots and convene inter-departmental gram panchayat-level meetings to curb transmission. Campaigns will target plantation workers, forest-adjacent residents, and villagers for awareness. People who visit forests and plantations where tick exposure is possible should stay vigilant. Gram panchayats must report monkey deaths to Health Department. Clinicians should collect blood samples from fever patients with KFD symptoms and send them to the Virus Diagnostic Laboratory (VDL) for testing. KFD is a tick-borne viral infection; common symptoms include fever, body ache, and headache, with the near-forest population particularly at risk.

article.articleHeadline: São Miguel das Matas realiza mutirão de limpeza e promove mobilização contra a dengue neste sábado (28) | Criativa On Line
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Miguel das Matas carries out a cleanup drive and promotes mobilization to combat dengue this Saturday (the 28th).
article.articleSummary: São Miguel das Matas in Vale do Jiquiriçá launches a week-long cleanup-and-education mobilization to fight dengue, led by the Municipal Health Secretariat with Endemic Control Agents (ACE), UNIECO, and Surveillance teams. Part of the National Dengue Mobilization Week, activities target the Onha, Tabuleiro, Estação, and Alto São Miguel neighborhoods through home visits to identify and eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites, material collection, distribution of hypochlorite, and educational leaflets. The drive has already begun, with public bags distributed on Wednesday (25) and discarded materials collected on Thursday (26). On Saturday, November 28, from 8:00 to 10:30, the Dia D mobilization will take place at the Municipal Market (Feira Municipal), offering educational activities and prevention guidance. The effort aims to curb dengue and the associated diseases chikungunya and Zika by reducing standing water and breeding sites.

article.articleHeadline: Qué es el mpox, cuáles son sus síntomas y cómo se contagia el virus | HSB Noticias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is mpox, what are its symptoms, and how is the virus transmitted.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) is a viral disease caused by mpox virus (MPXV), an Orthopoxvirus related to smallpox. First described in animals and detected in humans in 1970 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, it has triggered international surveillance due to outbreaks in the Americas and elsewhere. Incubation is 3–21 days. Early symptoms resemble other viral infections: fever, chills, headache, muscle or back pain, fatigue, and lymphadenopathy. One or more days after, skin or mucosal lesions appear and progress from flat macules to vesicles, then pustules and crusts, potentially on the face, palms, soles, mouth, genital and perianal areas. Most cases are mild to moderate and resolve in 2–4 weeks, though complications can occur in immunocompromised individuals, pregnant persons, or children. Transmission is via close contact with lesions, crusts, or bodily fluids, including sexual contact, prolonged close contact, or contaminated objects; zoonotic transmission can occur from animals. Prevention: avoid contact with affected individuals, do not share personal items, wash hands, seek medical advice, isolate as advised and undergo testing.

Unveiled by Mayor Janete Aparecida on Nov 26, 2026, the measure is administrative and sanitary, documenting epidemiological situation and Surveillance protocol while maintaining procurement rules. The protocol requires schools to report suspected and confirmed cases via an online form, identifying unit, class, and affected students. If three confirmed cases occur in a class, that class is suspended for one day for cleaning, not the whole school. Ten schools reported cases; 57 students are confirmed; Sidney School has suspended classes. Pediatric referrals to the Policlínica ambulatory are streamlined; free scabies medications are available in the municipal network. Additional measures cover enhanced cleaning, gloves for staff, fixed seating on buses, and avoiding attendance by symptomatic children. Covid-19 has risen (316 cases in November), with daily updates at 18:00, alongside mpox.

The US-backed project, part of a $13.5 million program to strengthen Kenya’s Ebola preparedness amid a nearby Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak, prompted protests in June, leaving at least three people dead in Nanyuki. Kenyan Health Minister Aden Duale said the facility is not exclusively for Americans. Since confirming the first Ebola case in October, Kenya has recorded nine cases and two deaths. The court’s decision requires publication of the agreement and risk assessments before activities resume.

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria de Saúde realiza ação de conscientização sobre tuberculose no Presídio Regional de Brusque
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department carries out a tuberculosis awareness campaign at the Brusque Regional Prison.
article.articleSummary: Brusque Regional Prison in Brusque, Brazil hosted a tuberculosis awareness campaign on Thursday, November 26, led by the Brusque Health Department's Specialized Care Service (SAE). Nurses Elise Meri de Souza and Joelma Ferreira da Silva spoke to three groups of detainees, including a primary school class. TB spreads primarily in closed, crowded settings; people deprived of liberty are among the highest-risk groups. In 2025 Brazil registered over 7,000 new TB cases inside prisons; nationwide over 84,000. Community members with a cough lasting more than two weeks or other TB symptoms should seek care at their local Basic Health Unit or 24-hour urgent care. TB is airborne; coughing, sneezing, or talking releases aerosolized bacteria. Diagnosis uses rapid testing, sputum analysis, and chest X-ray. Treatment generally lasts six months; improvement after 2-3 weeks, but adherence is critical to prevent relapse.

article.articleHeadline: Vírus da dengue: simulações mostram como ele invade células
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue virus: simulations show how it invades cells.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian dengue study using molecular dynamics shows how the virus enters human cells. Researchers at Unesp analyzed DENV-2 and DENV-3 with computer simulations, testing temperatures of 28°C (mosquito), 37°C (human body), and 40°C (fever) and pH levels 7, 6 and 5. Results indicate that shifting from 28°C to 37°C weakens the surface E protein dimer bonds, with acidity amplifying the effect; at 40°C some bonds partially re-form. DENV-3 exhibits significant changes already at pH 6. The two halves of the dimer do not dissociate simultaneously, a compensatory embrace that could hinder antibody recognition. The team maps intradimer forces to identify therapeutics that stabilize the dimer, such as molecular glues and nanobodies. Findings published in Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling; funded by FAPESP, with collaboration from the Italian Institute of Technology. Brazil reported 2025: ~1.7 million probable cases and ~1,800 deaths; by Oct 2026: ~490,000 probable cases and ~370 deaths.

article.articleHeadline: Review Explores Why Schistosomal Kidney Disease Persists After
article.articleSummary: Schistosoma mansoni–endemic areas in sub-Saharan Africa face schistosomal glomerulopathy as a driver of chronic kidney disease. Globally, schistosomiasis affects about 200 million people. Renal involvement arises via two paths: urogenital tract disease from urinary pathology and hepatosplenic disease–associated glomerulopathy, which occurs in 5–6% of active infection (≈15% with hepatosplenic involvement). Praziquantel sharply reduces urogenital morbidity, with 65–75% of treated patients showing ultrasonographic regression within 12 months and reduced microhematuria and albuminuria, but established glomerulopathy often fails to regress—the 'praziquantel paradox'. Clinically, glomerulopathy ranges from mild proteinuria to nephrotic/nephritic syndromes; in a Brazilian cohort (n=24, median follow-up ~5 years), 37.5% progressed to ESRD, with higher baseline creatinine predicting worse outcome. Pathophysiology is immune-complex mediated, with schistosomal antigens, IgG/IgM/IgA, and C3 depositing in glomeruli; circulating anodic/cathodic antigens have been detected. Lesions span Class I–VI; therapeutic responsiveness is not inferred from class.

article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) alert for the Americas: PAHO/OPS notes a resurgence since late September, led by Brazil, with clade Ib detected. From January–November 2026, 13 countries reported 3,269 confirmed cases and 4 deaths; Brazil accounted for 1,325 infections and 1 death. Since 2022 the region has recorded over 76,000 cases and 202 deaths across 31 countries/territories. Transmission occurs via close physical contact, including intimate and skin-to-skin contact, and to contaminated objects. Vulnerable groups include people living with HIV; of 114 deaths with known serology, 97% were HIV-positive. OPS recommends strengthening timely detection and investigation, monitoring shifts in transmission, and vaccination for high-risk groups (including before travel to areas with virus circulation), complemented by other preventive measures. Symptoms include skin lesions, fever, headache, muscle pain, fatigue, and enlarged lymph nodes; seek care and testing after suspected exposure.
