article.articleHeadline: They compiled 47 studies on 49 species of sick reptiles and amphibians. Then the amphibians broke the prediction.
article.articleSummary: 47 studies spanning 49 reptile and amphibian species show that sick individuals engage in behavioral fever by moving to warmer microhabitats to raise body temperature and bolster immune responses, with stronger evidence in amphibians than reptiles. Most infections are opportunistic bacterial infections; dehydration risk for amphibians exists, yet warming behavior persists to fight infection. The meta-analysis drew from wild and controlled observations, and climate records indicated that larger day–night temperature swings amplified fever responses. Importantly, fever was more commonly linked to bacterial infections than viral or fungal ones. It remains unknown whether behavioral fever improves survival. Previously, lizards showed adaptive fever benefits, but the new study surprised researchers with the amphibian response. Those from variable climates exhibited greater fever magnitude, underscoring the value of thermal heterogeneity in habitats. Lead author Danilo Giacometti, University of São Paulo and São Paulo State University; published in Proceedings of the Royal Society B.

triage.headline_ja: 47件の研究、49種の病気の爬虫類・両生類を対象に調査。すると両生類が予測を裏切った
triage.triage_reason: 動物(爬虫類・両生類)の行動性発熱に関する基礎研究であり、ヒトの公衆衛生リスクや感染症アウトブレイクとは無関係。
triage.notes: 研究は学術的な動物生理学の内容であり、ヒトの感染症イベントではないため対象国の該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Dia D de combate à dengue em Divinópolis ocorre neste sábado (28) - Portal MPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: D-Day to combat dengue in Divinópolis takes place this Saturday (28) - Portal MPA.
article.articleSummary: Divinópolis, Brazil, launches a Saturday 'Day D' to combat Aedes aegypti, the mosquito that transmits dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. The 7:00–13:00 operation is part of the Minas Unida Contra o Aedes campaign and includes mutirões in Danilo Passos I, Danilo Passos II, and Vila Romana to collect waste that can hold water. The effort also features educational activities and a vaccination drive for dengue at Posto Central (Avenida Coronel Júlio Ribeiro Gontijo, 370, Esplanada) per the National Immunization Program. The neighborhood selection follows the 4th Rapid LIRAa survey (Nov 9–13), which identified high infestation, prompting intensified prevention as the rainy season approaches. Residents are urged to maintain preventive practices year-round: seal water tanks, clean gutters, dispose of unused containers, and regularly inspect yards to reduce breeding and protect community health.

triage.headline_ja: ジヴィノーポリスで28日(土)にデング熱対策の「Dデー」実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の蚊媒介感染症予防キャンペーンの告知記事であり、異常な流行や重症例の報告はなく、既存の公衆衛生対策活動の一環である。
triage.notes: LIRAa調査で高い蚊の感染指数が確認され雨季に備えた予防活動だが、具体的な症例数や異常な流行拡大の記載はない。地域の定例的な予防キャンペーンとして位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: Teresina confirma quatro casos de Mpox em 2026 e investiga outras sete suspeitas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Teresina confirms four Mpox cases in 2026 and investigates seven more suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: Mpox in Teresina, Brazil: Four confirmed mpox cases in 2026, with seven additional suspected cases under investigation as of 26 November, per e-SUS Sinan. The capital has 11 resident notifications, seven still under investigation. Officials say this does not indicate a surge or outbreak; surveillance is being intensified by the CIEVS of the Fundação Municipal de Saúde (FMS) with ongoing lab and care-unit coordination. Mpox is caused by monkeypox virus (MPXV) and spreads via direct contact with skin lesions, body fluids, or secretions; it can also transmit through prolonged close respiratory contact or shared contaminated objects. Symptoms include skin lesions, fever, headache, muscle pain, fatigue, and lymphadenopathy. Preventive guidance: avoid close contact with suspected cases, do not share personal items, and maintain hand and surface hygiene; seek care promptly and isolate as advised. Vaccination is free at CRIE, Hospital Infantil Lucídio Portela, for PVHIV, PrEP users, and lab workers handling MPXV samples; report suspected cases within 24 hours in e-SUS Sinan.

triage.headline_ja: テレジーナ市、2026年のMpox症例4件を確認、さらに7件の疑い例を調査中
triage.triage_reason: 確定4例・疑い7例と小規模で、当局も「急増・アウトブレイクではない」と明言しているが、Mpoxはヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事内で当局は「これは急増やアウトブレイクを示すものではない」と明言しており、監視体制の強化とワクチン提供が進行中。症例数が少なく深刻度も不明であるため、現時点ではWATCH判定とし、続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Rosa Marya, atriz de Sítio do Picapau Amarelo, é internada com leishmaniose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rosa Marya, actress on Sítio do Picapau Amarelo, hospitalized with leishmaniasis.
article.articleSummary: Leishmaniasis in Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil. 81-year-old Rosa Marya Colin, known for playing Tia Nastácia in Sítio do Picapau Amarelo, has been admitted to Hospital Universitário de Campo Grande since Monday, November 23, 2026, for treatment of leishmaniasis. She remains in stable condition and is receiving intravenous medications; doctors expect about ten days of hospitalization to complete treatment. The diagnosis followed the appearance of a facial wound, after which tests confirmed infection. The infection source has not yet been identified. Leishmaniasis is transmitted by bites of infected sandflies. Rosa Marya had begun treatment at home, but a follow-up consultation prompted hospital admission for closer monitoring. She has lived in Campo Grande for about four years, with ties to the Zigurats community in Corguinho, MS. A future show is planned for February 7, 2027 in Guaramiranga, Ceará.

triage.headline_ja: 『黄色いキツツキの牧場』の女優ローザ・マリヤさん、リーシュマニア症で入院
triage.triage_reason: 著名人個人の単発症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 有名女優の個人症例に関する芸能ニュース。リーシュマニア症はブラジルで既知の地方病であり、流行や集団発生を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Nova variante da covid-19: o que se sabe sobre a linhagem PJ.2.1, monitorada pela OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New COVID-19 variant: what is known about the PJ.2.1 lineage, monitored by the WHO.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 November 2026, the World Health Organization is monitoring SARS-CoV-2 lineage PJ.2.1, classified as a Variant Under Monitoring after first being detected in May in Canada. PJ.2.1 appears to have arisen through rapid mutational evolution and shows high binding to the human ACE2 receptor, but there is no evidence it increases disease severity. Laboratory data indicate sera from recipients of vaccines adapted to lineages LP.8.1 and XFG neutralize PJ.2.1, and vaccination remains the most effective protection against hospitalization and death. In Brazil, PJ.2.1 is linked to rising COVID-19 activity, with Rio de Janeiro state showing increased cases and the city accounting for 58% of sequenced genomes. The lineage has also been detected in Distrito Federal and eight states: Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo, São Paulo, Mato Grosso, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Rio Grande do Sul, and Santa Catarina. Fiocruz’s InfoGripe notes rising Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases across Minas Gerais, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo, Paraná, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Bahia, and Distrito Federal for 15–21 November. Vaccination remains freely available via SUS.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの新変異株：WHOが監視するPJ.2.1系統について分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: WHOが監視対象とする新変異株PJ.2.1がブラジル国内で複数州に拡大し、重症急性呼吸器症候群（SRAG）症例も増加傾向にあるが、重症度増加のエビデンスはなく、ワクチンの有効性も維持されているため、現時点ではフルリスク評価より継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: カナダで最初に検出されたが、記事の主題はブラジル国内での感染拡大状況。重症度増加のエビデンスはなく、ワクチンの交差防御も確認されているため緊急性は低いが、SRAG症例増加の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo restricts funerals to contain Ebola transmission
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's North Kivu province restricts funeral attendance to 20 people for deaths from non-Ebola causes, while Ebola-related deaths must be handled only by response teams to ensure secure, dignified burials and limit transmission. Ebola is caused by the Bundibugyo virus strain and has reached 12,000+ confirmed cases and 5,904 deaths since the outbreak began in May, affecting eight provinces: Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, Tshopo, South-Ubangi, and North Ubangi, with Beni city in North Kivu the current epicenter. Authorities urge strict compliance with measures to stop the surge. Last week, the World Health Organization maintained the outbreak as a public health emergency of international concern, noting deteriorating insecurity hampers response operations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ感染拡大抑制のため葬儀を制限
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを維持しているエボラ大規模流行（12,000人超感染、5,904人死亡）で、治安悪化により対応が困難化しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: WHOはPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を維持中。治安悪化が対応の障害となっている点は国際的関与の必要性を示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: ONU expresa preocupación por aumento de casos de mpox en las Américas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN expresses concern over the rise in mpox cases in the Americas.
article.articleSummary: UN expresses concern over mpox rise in the Americas. The United Nations notes that the Pan American Health Organization issued an epidemiological alert after reporting more than 3,200 confirmed mpox cases and four deaths in the Americas this year. From January through November, 13 countries reported 3,269 cases and four deaths, with Brazil accounting for 1,325 cases and one death. Since 2022 the region has logged over 76,000 mpox cases and 202 deaths across 31 countries and territories. Mpox, formerly monkeypox, disproportionately affects men who have sex with men and people living with HIV. OPS urges strengthened surveillance, laboratory capacity, prevention, and vaccination, and monitoring of transmission patterns, focusing on high-risk groups. Transmission occurs via close physical contact, including intimate skin-to-skin contact and contact with contaminated materials; common symptoms include rash lesions, fever, headache, muscle and back pain, fatigue, and lymphadenopathy. Clade Ib variant is increasingly detected in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、米州でのエムポックス症例増加に懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻性・異常性・国際拡大の3項目が該当し、PAHOが疫学的警告を発出するなど国際的関心も高いため、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はPAHO（米州保健機関）による疫学的警告を基に、ブラジルを含む米州13か国でのエムポックス症例増加とクレードIbの検出増加を報告。カナリア諸島/スペインは発生地域に含まれるが対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Covid-19 aumentam em Santos e acendem alerta para prevenção na Baixada Santista
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases rise in Santos and raise an alert for prevention in Baixada Santista
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases rise sharply in Santos, Brazil, with 102 confirmations in November through November 23, elevating the 2026 total to 187 in the Baixada Santista region. A recent local case, Santos resident Fabiana Honorato, reports fatigue, headaches, fever, nasal congestion, loss of smell/taste, and household transmission, amid variable access to tests. Vaccination is available at municipal clinics 9:30–16:00. Dose schedules include: children 6 months–<5 years two-dose primary series; pregnant individuals one dose per pregnancy; adults 60+ a booster every six months; immunocompromised individuals start with three doses, then annual doses; and group-specific plans for comorbidities and other populations, with a general 5–59-year-old without prior vaccination receiving one dose. São Vicente (SP) records 19 COVID-19 cases in 2026 with no deaths; vaccination occurs at 26 UBSs and Brisamar Shopping, with age/group-specific intervals and sites outlined for the public health response.

triage.headline_ja: サントスでCOVID-19症例が増加し、バイシャーダ・サンティスタで予防への警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の地域的な季節性増加であり、重症度・異常性・国際的拡大のいずれも認められず、既存の予防接種体制で管理可能な事例であるため。
triage.notes: COVID-19の既知の流行パターンであり、死亡例の報告もなく、通常の公衆衛生対応（ワクチン接種案内）の範囲内の記事。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : appel aux jeunes de Beni à plus d'implication dans la lutte contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: appeal to Beni's youth for greater involvement in the fight against Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: In Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola virus disease persists with ongoing cases as authorities urge broader public participation. A sensitization session organized by a citizen movement linked to Lucha (Lutte pour le changement) and led by the Task Force for preventing incidents, violence and conflicts related to the Ebola response, in collaboration with Pole Institute, gathered youths, community leaders and politico-administrative authorities to bolster trust and compliance with prevention measures. Christian Balewa Mahamba stressed that every segment of the population must engage—no exception—to end the outbreak, noting resistance and some claims that Ebola is a business. Lucha militants report they are already educating their communities on barrier measures and adherence to the Ebola response. The effort aims to deepen community involvement as the epidemic continues in Beni, with adherence to prevention and response strategies across society.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：ベニの若者にエボラ対策への一層の関与を呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州ベニで継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する報道であり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大リスク）が2つ該当するためフルリスク評価へ進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はベニにおける既存のエボラ対応強化のための地域住民動員活動を報じており、新規発生ではなく継続中のアウトブレイクに対するコミュニティ関与の呼びかけが主題。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Mambasa : 255 relais communautaires en formation pour renforcer la surveillance - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Mambasa: 255 community health volunteers in training to strengthen surveillance - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Mambasa, Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, is being intensified through training of 255 community health volunteers to strengthen prevention, early detection, and alert reporting. The volunteers from high-risk health areas Binase, Mambasa, and Salama will be organized in groups to reflect local realities. The training, led by national, provincial, and zonal experts, covers investigations, community-based surveillance, risk communication, community engagement, and contact tracing. Upon completion, participants will be deployed to educate households, identify at-risk situations, and ensure rapid alert transmission. Funded by UNICEF, the initiative operates under PPSSP in collaboration with health authorities and communities to bolster the Ebola outbreak response in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: マンバサのエボラ出血熱：監視体制強化のため地域保健ボランティア255名が研修中 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州マンバサで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク対応に関する記事であり、エボラは致死率が高く国際的拡大リスクもあるためIHR基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGuatemala（バハベラパス県）が含まれているが、記事本文はDRCイトゥリ州マンバサでのエボラ対応のみを扱っており、Guatemalaは記事内容と無関係のため除外した。UNICEF資金による既存アウトブレイク対応の地域保健ボランティア研修に関する続報記事。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19: Ministério da Saúde envia alerta pelo WhatsApp e reforça vacinação em todo o Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: Ministry of Health sends alert via WhatsApp and reinforces vaccination across Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Brazil ramps up COVID-19 vaccination outreach via WhatsApp and the GOV.BR app, announced on 26 November 2026, urging the population to stay up to date and seek vaccines at Unidades Básicas de Saúde (UBS). The Ministry also allocated additional vaccine doses to states to bolster stocks for the nationwide campaign. Vaccination remains free through SUS, with target groups including children 6 months–<5 years, pregnant women, adults 60+, immunocompromised individuals, and those with comorbidities. Dosing intervals: elderly and immunocompromised every six months; other special groups annually; unvaccinated children should complete a three-dose primary series. By 2026, over 25.7 million doses were distributed, with more than 8.5 million administered and an extra 2.1 million doses made available. Through the first week of November 2026, 132,735 COVID-19–related influenza-like illness cases, ~3,900 SRAG cases, and 468 deaths were reported; a late November uptick prompted renewed emphasis on vaccination. More than 3 million rapid tests were distributed, including 1.9 million additional units.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19：保健省がWhatsAppで警告を送信し、ブラジル全土でワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19のルーチンのワクチン接種キャンペーンに関する報道であり、新規異常事態ではないが、11月下旬の症例増加傾向が言及されているため継続監視とする。
triage.notes: 既存のワクチン接種キャンペーン強化と季節的な症例増加に関する通常の公衆衛生対応の記事。468人の死亡やSRAG症例数が報告されているが、文脈上は季節性の範囲内と見られる。続報で症例急増の規模を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: CPI (M) workers stage protest over failure of Puducherry government to control dengue
article.articleSummary: Dengue concerns dominate Puducherry as CPI(M) workers staged a protest at Raja Theatre junction, accusing the N. Rangasamy-led government of failing to contain the outbreak. Carrying mosquito nets and hand pumps for anti-larval spraying, the demonstrators urged tougher public health measures to prevent further spread. The party said four people died due to administrative lethargy in addressing dengue, and it criticized the administration for not strengthening Municipalities and Commune Panchayats in recent years. Local unit secretary S. Ramachandran, along with senior leaders T. Murugan and V. Perumal, participated in the action. The protest, reported on 27 November 2026, underscores ongoing dengue worries in Puducherry and calls for heightened disease-control efforts at urban local bodies.

triage.headline_ja: CPI(M)が抗議活動、プドゥチェリー政府のデング熱対策失敗を非難
triage.triage_reason: WPRO基準（重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ）に複数該当し、死者発生と行政批判による社会的関心の高まりが見られるため。
triage.notes: プドゥチェリー（インド）における季節性デング熱流行に対する政治的抗議活動。死者4名との報道あり。地域的な行政対応の問題が中心で、国際的な公衆衛生緊急性は低いが、地域住民への継続的な曝露リスクと社会的関心の高まりからWATCH～PICKUP相当と判断。

article.articleHeadline: South Africa prepares 36 hospitals for possible Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: South Africa designated 36 hospitals (24 public, 12 private) to manage potential Bundibugyo Ebola cases as part of heightened preparedness amid the ongoing Bundibugjo virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. To date, no cases linked to the outbreak have been reported in South Africa; measures include screening at ports of entry, hospital readiness assessments and healthcare worker training. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in May 2026 and has since strengthened surveillance, cross-border screening, contact tracing, laboratory testing and infection prevention; a November 2026 update notes continued transmission in the DRC and cases across several countries. Bundibugyo virus disease spreads via direct contact with infected bodily fluids; incubation 2–21 days; early symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headaches and sore throat; no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. South Africa maintains low risk and NICD monitors developments.

triage.headline_ja: 南アフリカ、エボラ出血熱の潜在的症例に備え36の病院を準備
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のBundibugyoエボラウイルス病アウトブレイクがWHOによりPHEIC宣言されており、ウガンダなど複数国に拡大。IHR基準を複数満たし、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC・ウガンダで継続中のBundibugyoエボラウイルス病アウトブレイクへの南アフリカの備えであり、南アフリカ・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのみverified_locationsに含めた。2026年5月にWHOがPHEIC宣言済みで、継続的な監視が必要な重大シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : les autorités suspendent des services funéraires dans l'est
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: authorities suspend funeral services in the east.
article.articleSummary: In eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, North Kivu authorities suspend funeral practices across 18 health zones from 26 November 2026 to curb Ebola virus disease transmission. Mourning rites, wakes and memorials are halted, with funerals limited to 20 family members; barrier measures remain mandatory and safe burials are to be conducted by response teams. The 17th Ebola outbreak Situation Report (21 November 2026) lists 11,821 cases and 5,810 deaths (case fatality 49.1%), with 3,265 recoveries. Transmission is concentrated in North Kivu (32 cases, 54.2%) and Ituri (24 cases, 40.7%), making up 94.9% of new infections. Ituri remains the epicenter (68.1% of cumulative cases; 28 of 36 zones affected); North Kivu has the highest fatality among major provinces (56.0%). The outbreak has caused about 5,900 deaths among over 12,000 confirmed cases. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood and bodily fluids, and corpses remain highly contagious; funeral rites pose a key risk. Decontamination, contact tracing, and isolation are implemented by response teams, with community support.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：当局が東部で葬儀サービスを停止
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（11,821症例、致死率49.1%）が継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラアウトブレイクで症例数・死亡者数が非常に多く、北キブ州とイトゥリ州で感染が集中。葬儀を介した感染拡大リスクが高く、当局が葬儀慣行を制限する対応を実施している。

article.articleHeadline: ಟೈಫಾಯ್ಡ್‌ಗೆ ಕೊನೆಯ ಅಸ್ತ್ರವೂ ಕೈಕೊಡುವ ಭೀತಿ; ಆ್ಯಂಟಿಬಯೋಟಿಕ್‌ಗಳಿಗೂ ಬಗ್ಗುತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಟೀರಿಯಾ!Typhoid
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The fear that even the last resort against typhoid is failing; bacteria aren't affected by antibiotics! Typhoid.
article.articleSummary: XDR Typhi, caused by Salmonella enterica serovar Typhi, exhibits extensive drug resistance threatening typhoid treatment. Strains resistant to ampicillin, chloramphenicol and trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole, and increasingly to fluoroquinolones and third-generation cephalosporins, have emerged. An international study analyzing 3,489 Typhi isolates collected in India, Pakistan, Bangladesh and Nepal (2014–2019) found rising prevalence of XDR Typhi, with resistance extending to oral azithromycin. Pakistan first detected XDR Typhi in 2016, and by 2019 the strain had become established there, signaling wider regional risk. Since 1990, around 200 international spread cases have been identified, with transmission from South Asia to Southeast Asia, East Africa, and Southern Africa; cases also reported in the UK, the United States and Canada. Public health responses emphasize clean water, safe food, hygiene, vaccination, and prudent antibiotic use to slow resistance.

triage.headline_ja: チフスへの最後の切り札も効かなくなる恐れ;抗生物質にも屈しない細菌!
triage.triage_reason: XDRチフス菌(Salmonella Typhi)が第三世代セファロスポリンやアジスロマイシンにも耐性を示し始め、南アジアから複数地域へ国際的拡大が既に確認されているため、薬剤耐性による深刻な公衆衛生影響が懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事は2014-2019年に収集された国際サーベイランスデータに基づく研究報告であり、急性アウトブレイク情報ではないが、薬剤耐性拡大という公衆衛生上の重大な懸念を示す。インド・パキスタン・バングラデシュ・ネパールが主要発生地域とされるが、対象国リストに該当するのはインドのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Porto Velho registra queda de 53% nos casos confirmados de covid-19 em outubro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Porto Velho records a 53% drop in confirmed COVID-19 cases in October.
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho, Brazil, reports a 53% drop in confirmed COVID-19 cases in October 2026, with 57 cases vs 121 in October 2025; by November 24, 2026, 21 cases were recorded for the month. In October 2026, there were no COVID-19–related Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) cases or deaths in the capital, per Semusa surveillance. Fiocruz InfoGripe nationwide signals a regional uptick in SARS linked to COVID-19 in some areas, but overall incidence remains low, underscoring ongoing monitoring and vaccination. Mayor Léo Moraes and Health Secretary Sandra Cardoso stress keeping residents informed and maintaining vaccination. 2026 vaccination guidance: elderly 60+ and immunocompromised receive a dose every six months; health workers and those with comorbidities get an annual dose; pregnant women a dose per pregnancy. Vaccination should be sought at the nearest Basic Health Unit (UBS) with the vaccination card.

triage.headline_ja: ポルトベーリョ市、10月のCOVID-19確定症例が53%減少
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19症例は減少傾向で死亡例・重症例もなく、異常性や公衆衛生への深刻な影響は認められないため見送り。
triage.notes: 症例数は減少傾向にあり、SARS関連死亡・重症例もゼロ。定例サーベイランス報告であり、通常の公衆衛生広報の範疇。

article.articleHeadline: 天鹅到家"育儿嫂入户20多天查出梅毒抗体、甲肝抗体双阳性
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Swan Comes Home" nanny tests positive for both syphilis antibodies and hepatitis A antibodies after more than 20 days in the household.
article.articleSummary: Shenzhen employer hires a nanny via the Swan Comes Home platform to care for a newborn. After over 20 days in the household, the nanny’s finger cracks bled; examination found positive syphilis treponemal antibodies and positive Hepatitis A total antibodies. The platform reportedly only screened for hepatitis B; syphilis and HAV testing were not performed before deployment and would require employer self-payment. In 2020, the government ordered domestic workers classified into four categories with varying health checks; home-based care adds gonorrhea screening, ocular screening, and syphilis antibody testing, while HAV/HEV are listed as disqualifying in some standards. Platform staff said treponemal antibodies do not prove infectiousness without titer data. The employer rejected the remedies offered (refund of intermediary fees and test costs) and reported the issue to Shenzhen 12345, seeking an apology and expanded screening, and reserving legal action. Experts urge standardized, transparent health checks and accessible channels.

triage.headline_ja: 「天鵝到家」の家政婦、入居から20日余りで梅毒抗体・A型肝炎抗体がいずれも陽性と判明
triage.triage_reason: 個別の家政婦雇用トラブルに関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生や感染拡大の兆候はなく、消費者保護・業界規制の問題が主題である。
triage.notes: 単一個人の健康診断結果に関する消費者トラブル記事であり、感染症アウトブレイクの事例ではない。家政婦業界の健康診断基準・透明性に関する社会的関心が主題。

article.articleHeadline: Vacaciones en Brasil: ¿son necesarias las vacunas de dengue, fiebre amarilla y Covid?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vacation in Brazil: Are dengue, yellow fever, and COVID vaccines necessary?
article.articleSummary: Vaccination is not mandatory for travel to Brazil, but region-specific recommendations exist. Public health services are free for foreign tourists, and emergencies are handled via SAMU 192. Yellow Fever vaccination is advised in numerous states, including Roraima, Amapá, Amazonas, Pará, Acre, Rondônia, Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Maranhão, Tocantins, Goiás, São Paulo, Paraná, Santa Catarina, Rio de Janeiro, Rio Grande do Sul, and parts of Bahia, Minas Gerais, and Espírito Santo; areas where it is not routinely required include eastern/northern Piauí, Ceará, Rio Grande do Norte, Paraíba, Pernambuco, Alagoas and Sergipe. Dengue vaccination requires two doses three months apart, with 15 days post-vaccination before travel; Qdenga can be used from age 4, but has no data for under 4 or over 60. COVID-19 vaccination or testing is not required for entry. Pre-travel advice includes a 10-day pre-travel window, use of repellents, long sleeves/pants, and seeking care for fever, headache, vomiting, or muscle pains.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル旅行：デング熱・黄熱・COVIDワクチンは必要か？
triage.triage_reason: 旅行者向けワクチン接種に関する一般的な健康アドバイス記事であり、新規の感染症発生や異常事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は旅行者向けの予防接種推奨情報であり、具体的な発生状況や症例数の急増等の報告はない。既存の風土病（デング熱、黄熱）に関する一般的な渡航アドバイスのため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Cattle farmers in Tamil Nadu advised to undertake early intervention to contain spread of tick fever
article.articleSummary: Tamil Nadu cattle farmers were advised to undertake early intervention to contain tick fever, with authorities noting no official fatalities yet but urging strict preventive measures. The Animal Husbandry Department reports vaccination against lumpy skin disease has largely been completed district-wide; focus now shifts to tick management and sanitation of cattle sheds. Farmers should vigilantly monitor cattle for fever and anaemia; indicators include two consecutive days of loss of appetite, difficulty in breathing, reduced milk yield, and changes in urinary output, with advanced jaundice and brown urine likely fatal. Tick fever tends to rise during the rainy season in damp conditions and can spread from wild animals and peafowl. Tick checks should occur weekly, and only medicines prescribed by veterinary doctors must be used; ticks should be removed rather than crushed. Cattle require clean water and adequate rest, and medications may be periodically updated as immunity develops.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州の酪農家に、マダニ熱の拡大防止へ早期対応を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 家畜（牛）を対象とした動物感染症の予防啓発記事であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生リスクや国際的拡大の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は牛のマダニ熱（Tick Fever）とランピースキン病に関する家畜衛生管理の注意喚起であり、ヒト感染症のシグナルではない。地域行政レベルでの予防対策情報にとどまる。

article.articleHeadline: Canada extends Ebola travel rules for 90 days as outbreak rages on
article.articleSummary: Canada extends Ebola-related travel and immigration restrictions for 90 more days amid the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. The government says measures aim to reduce the risk of Ebola entering and spreading in Canada. The outbreak has surpassed 12,000 cases and more than 5,900 deaths. Travelers from Uganda, South Sudan, and the Democratic Republic of Congo have been barred from travelling to Canada since May, and immigration documents, including valid visas and travel authorizations, remain suspended for people from these countries. The expiry date is now February 25, 2027, extending the prior deadline. This extension reflects continued public health concerns over Ebola transmission in affected regions and the need to prevent importation.

triage.headline_ja: カナダ、エボラ流行継続を受け渡航制限を90日間延長
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が12,000症例・5,900人以上の死者に達し、カナダが渡航・入国制限を延長するなど国際的対応が継続しており、IHR基準を複数満たす重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事はカナダの渡航制限延長措置を報じているが、発生国はDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）。ウガンダ・南スーダン・カナダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。死者数・症例数から既に大規模流行と判断され、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Atriz Rosa Marya Colin, a Tia Nastácia de 'Sítio do Picapau Amarelo', é internada com leishmaniose; saiba estado de saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Actress Rosa Marya Colin, Aunt Nastácia from 'Sítio do Picapau Amarelo', is hospitalized with leishmaniasis; find out her health status.
article.articleSummary: 81-year-old Brazilian actress Rosa Marya Colin was hospitalized in Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul, with leishmaniasis. She has known diagnosis prior to admission and is in stable condition at Hospital Universitário de Campo Grande since 23 November 2026, with a ten-day hospital stay planned to complete treatment under medical supervision. Leishmaniasis is a parasitic infection transmitted by sandflies (phlebotomines) and can present as cutaneous, mucocutaneous, or visceral disease; the specific form for Rosa has not been disclosed. Initial signs included a facial sore. She resides in Campo Grande and has ties to the Zigurats community in Corguinho, MS. The actress, who is 81, remains focused on health; Suzana Queiroz, her representative, said she is doing well and hopes to return home soon.

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo Terá Dia D Contra A Dengue Neste Sábado; Estado Já Registra 45 Mortes Em 2026 - Rnews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo Will Have D-Day Against Dengue This Saturday; State Has Already Recorded 45 Deaths in 2026 - Rnews
article.articleSummary: São Paulo state holds a D-Day Mobilization against Dengue on Saturday, 28 November 2026, to intensify elimination of Aedes aegypti breeding sites ahead of summer. The initiative by the Health Secretariat targets dengue, as well as transmission of chikungunya and Zika. As of November 2026, São Paulo reports 64,998 dengue cases and 45 deaths in 2026. The campaign closes a Week of Intensification of Aedes aegypti control, urging residents to identify water-collecting containers such as refrigerator trays, rarely used drains, gutters, and outdoor vessels; after rains, objects can accumulate water, so a ten-minute weekly check is advised. Prevention steps include closing water tanks, cleaning gutters, turning bottles upside down, removing water from tires and tarps, cleaning plant saucers, and keeping trash bins closed. Dengue symptoms include high fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgias, rash, and nausea; seek care for warning signs. Avoid aspirin and certain NSAIDs. Municipal residents in Caieiras, Cajamar, Franco da Rocha, Francisco Morato, and Mairiporã should follow local alerts.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、今週土曜日にデング熱対策「Dデー」を実施；2026年の州内死者数はすでに45人に
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州における例年の季節性デング熱流行であり、州保健局による予防啓発キャンペーンの告知記事であるため新規性・異常性に乏しいが、累計64,998例・45人死亡という規模は注視に値する。
triage.notes: 記事は毎年恒例のAedes aegypti対策キャンペーンの告知であり、ブラジルでは季節性にデング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱が流行することが通常である。死亡者数・症例数の推移は継続的に監視が必要だが、現時点でフルRRAに進む緊急性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en Congo democrático supera los 12 mil contagios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 12,000 cases
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 12,000 cases, with 12,021 infections and 5,904 deaths since the start on May 15, according to the National Institute of Public Health. As of 27 November 2026, 66 new cases and 37 deaths were reported in the latest hours; case fatality stands at 49.1%. About 1,092 people remain hospitalized or in isolation, and contact tracing coverage is 85.1%. This outbreak is the deadliest in the RDC’s history and could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa wave that left 28,616 cases and 11,325 deaths in Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone. Ebola is caused by viruses in the Orthoebolavirus genus; three species commonly drive large outbreaks: Ebola virus, Sudan virus, Bundibugyo virus. Natural reservoirs include fruit bats (Pteropodidae); transmission to humans occurs via contact with blood or bodily fluids of infected animals, and humans become infectious only after symptom onset.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、感染者数が1万2000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が12,000人超・致死率49.1%に達し、同国史上最悪の流行となっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年西アフリカ流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現行の発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Covid-19 crescem pelo país e Ministério da Saúde reforça alerta para vacinação em Rondônia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases rise nationwide, and the Ministry of Health reinforces the call for vaccination in Rondônia.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases rise across Brazil, with six weeks of increases in 23 states and the Federal District. The Health Ministry expanded vaccination, distributing over 2.1 million additional doses and issuing alerts via WhatsApp and GOV.BR to boost uptake. Rondônia joins vaccination push; UBSs remain priority. Of 25.7 million doses distributed this year, about 8.5 million have been administered. Per PNI, the vaccine is free year-round at UBSs; boosters are every six months for 60+ and immunocompromised after the initial schedule, one dose per pregnancy, and initial schedules for children 6 months–<5 years. Adults 5–59 without priority groups generally do not receive routine boosters. A new PJ.2.1 lineage is WHO-monitored. Through Nov 21, 2026, Brazil logged 159,275 COVID-19 ILI cases, 4,101 SRAG, and 481 deaths (68% >65). Fiocruz recommends masks, ventilation, and hand hygiene; SUS maintains antiviral treatment for high-risk early and stockpiles over 3 million rapid tests.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル全土でCOVID-19症例が増加、保健省がロンドニア州でのワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19はブラジルで季節的な増加を示しているが、既存の対応体制（ワクチン接種拡大、抗ウイルス薬備蓄等）が機能しており異常事態ではない。ただしWHOが監視する新系統PJ.2.1の動向は継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 季節的なCOVID-19増加に対するブラジル保健省の通常のワクチン接種強化策。死亡者の68%が65歳以上と高リスク群に集中しており、既存の医療体制で対応可能とみられる。新系統PJ.2.1がWHO監視対象である点は今後の情報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Musim Hujan, 5 Benda di Rumah Ini Bisa Jadi Sarang Nyamuk dan Pemicu DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rainy Season: 5 Things in This House That Could Become Mosquito Breeding Grounds and Trigger Dengue Fever
article.articleSummary: As of 27 November 2026, rainy-season conditions heighten dengue risk as Aedes aegypti mosquitoes breed in water-holding containers around homes. Dengue fever is transmitted by Aedes aegypti; the World Health Organization notes breeding grounds are man-made receptacles such as plant pot saucers, tires, bottles, and other water storage items. The Indonesian article identifies five common household items to inspect; the first highlighted is plant pot saucers, which can collect drainage and rainwater. These small pools can persist and become mosquito breeding sites. To prevent, empty saucers after watering or rainfall and regularly clean their interiors to remove any eggs or larvae. The guidance draws on The Times of India, CDC, and WHO recommendations on reducing indoor water-holding containers to curb dengue transmission.

triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生事例を報じるものではなく、雨季における一般的なデング熱予防啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や社会的関心の高まりを示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性の予防啓発コンテンツであり、具体的な感染者数や発生地域の報告を含まない。インドネシアに関する記述はあるが、特定の発生事例ではないためverified_locationsは空とする。

article.articleHeadline: Dia D contra dengue tem mosquitos estéreis e com bactéria que sabota doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: D-Day against dengue features sterile mosquitoes and a bacterium that sabotages the disease.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Health Ministry launches a D-Day to combat dengue, Zika and chikungunya using Wolbachia-infected and sterile Aedes aegypti mosquitoes across 11 states, including Amambai in Mato Grosso do Sul and Garanhuns in Pernambuco. A national campaign via WhatsApp and Gov.br targets more than 30 million people. Wolbachia releases aim to reduce virus development and transmission, with the bacteria passed to offspring by mosquitoes. Studies show reductions: Niterói, RJ, 2025—89% dengue decline; Campo Grande, MS, 2026—about 63% decline; Belo Horizonte, MG—dengue down 68.5% and chikungunya down 73.3% among children. The program has benefited 5.94 million Brazilians in 16 cities; 44 more municipalities are progressing. Production to cover about 10 million residents in 2026; expansion planned for 2027. Dengue vaccine is available for 10–14-year-olds; 2025 doses: 3.6M; 2026: >5.1M. Nearly 4M doses sent to municipalities unused; over 3M adolescents have only first dose. Instituto Butantan vaccine development expected in 2027 after safety review (42 serious reactions, 2 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策の「D-デー」、不妊蚊とウイルスを阻害する細菌を活用
triage.triage_reason: これはブラジル政府によるデング・ジカ・チクングニア対策の既存プログラム（ウォルバキア蚊・ワクチン接種）の進捗報告であり、新規の異常な感染拡大や緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は既存の公衆衛生対策（ウォルバキア蚊放出、ワクチン接種キャンペーン）の実施状況報告であり、新規発生イベントではないためDISMISSと判定。デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱は流行性の疾患だが、本記事は対策の成果を伝える内容。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo clashes displace civilians, disrupt Ebola response
article.articleSummary: As of 27 November 2026, renewed clashes between government forces and the CRP rebel group in Ituri Province's Djugu territory have displaced thousands and disrupted the Ebola response. Fighting near Bunia, the provincial capital, has escalated since the weekend, despite the CRP's declaration—after Uganda-facilitated talks—that it would halt its advance. The Congolese military accuses rebels of killings, abductions and ambushes, undermining a ceasefire. Thousands have fled toward Bunia; displacement is ongoing, with schools and businesses disrupted and rising needs for food, water and healthcare in host communities. The UN has restricted staff movements in parts of Djugu, complicating humanitarian work. Violence now affects areas central to the Ebola outbreak, forcing evacuation of health personnel and hindering containment and delivery of essential health services.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国での衝突により市民が避難、エボラ対応が混乱
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク地域での武力衝突により、医療従事者の避難や封じ込め活動の中断が生じており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はイトゥリ州ジュグ地域での武力衝突がエボラ対応（医療従事者の避難、UN職員の移動制限等）を阻害している状況を報告。ウガンダは仲介国として言及されているが発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: GOIATUBA REALIZA DIA D DE MOBILIZAÇÃO CONTRA AS ARBOVIROSES NESTA SEXTA-FEIRA | Prensa Mercosur
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Goiatuba holds D-Day mobilization against arboviruses this Friday | Mercosur Press.
article.articleSummary: D-Day mobilization against arboviruses is held in Goiatuba on Friday, 27 November 2026, starting at 7:30 a.m., targeting the Novo Horizonte, Primavera and Maranata sectors. Led by the City Health Department, the initiative aims to intensify prevention and awareness to curb Aedes aegypti, the vector of dengue, Zika and chikungunya. Activities include door-to-door visits with guidance on eliminating potential mosquito breeding sites and daily preventive practices as the rainy season arrives. Residents are urged to keep water tanks covered, remove containers that collect water, keep yards clean, clean gutters, place sand in plant saucers, store tires in covered areas, and dispose of waste properly. Community participation is essential for receiving health teams and sustaining preventive measures year-round, contributing to reduced arbovirus transmission in Goiatuba.

triage.triage_reason: 特定の集団発生報告ではなく、通常の季節的な蚊媒介感染症予防啓発活動であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な症例数や流行状況を報告しておらず、市の保健局による予防啓発活動の案内のみ。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、記事内容は通常の公衆衛生活動であり感染症イベントのシグナルとしては該当しないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Canada extends Ebola travel rules for 90 days as outbreak rages on
article.articleSummary: On 2026-11-27, Canada extended its travel and immigration restrictions related to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo for 90 more days. The government says the measures remain in place to reduce the risk of Ebola entering and spreading in Canada. This reflects ongoing concern about cross-border transmission as the DRC outbreak continues. The announcement provides no new details on case counts or transmission chains. The extension maintains a precautionary posture while health authorities monitor the outbreak dynamics in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: カナダ、拡大が続くエボラ出血熱の流行を受け渡航制限を90日間延長
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が継続し、カナダが渡航制限を延長するなど国際的対応が取られており、IHR基準の複数該当と社会的関心の高さからフルRRAに進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事はカナダの渡航制限延長措置についての報道であり、発生国はDRC。カナダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。症例数や感染経路の新情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Gene variant helps malaria mosquito adapt to high temperatures, study finds
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-27, a five-kilobase deletion in the timeless circadian-clock gene in Anopheles stephensi increases male mating success under high temperatures (roughly 3.6–4.7x) by boosting energy mobilization, flight, and mating-communication chemistry, while females carrying the same deletion become more susceptible to malaria parasite infection due to weakened immune defenses. The urban-dwelling malaria vector, first detected in Djibouti in 2012 and now spread across several African countries, may spread faster as global temperatures rise and heat tolerance facilitates city-based transmission. The discovery, published in Cell by researchers at the Center for Excellence in Molecular Plant Sciences (CEMPS) of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, underscores the need to monitor genetic variation alongside geographic spread for surveillance and control. Wang Sibao notes the study links climate-change-driven vector evolution to transmission risks.

triage.headline_ja: 遺伝子変異がマラリア媒介蚊の高温適応を助けることが研究で判明
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は中国科学院の研究者による学術研究（蚊の遺伝子変異に関する基礎研究）の紹介であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや症例報告ではないため、トリアージ対象外と判断する。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊（Anopheles stephensi）の遺伝子変異による高温適応・マラリア感染リスクに関する基礎研究の報告であり、ジブチや中国での実際の感染症発生事例ではない。中国は研究機関（中国科学院）の所在地として言及されているのみで、疾病発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。将来的な気候変動による媒介蚊の分布拡大リスクへの言及はあるが、現時点で具体的なアウトブレイク情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : Ebola éloigne les femmes des maternités et fragilise leur accès aux soins - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Ebola drives women away from maternity wards and undermines their access to care - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, is undermining women's access to maternity and other health services as fear of hospital-based transmission drives avoidance of facilities. In Bunia on 27 November 2026, Jean-Marc Mazio, head of the provincial Gender Division, notes that Ebola has disrupted services, with maternity care among those halted. The reluctance to seek care due to infection fears has led to delayed or inaccessible maternity services, including in the Nia-Nia health zone where women reportedly died because they could not access maternity care in time. He urges intensified community sensitization to restore trust in health facilities and encourage care-seeking, stressing that Ebola should not worsen women's situations. Communities are urged to observe preventive measures and build resilience during the ongoing outbreak, in the context of the 16 Days of Activism against Violence against Women and Girls.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州：エボラが女性を産科施設から遠ざけ、医療アクセスを脆弱化させる - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する記事で、死亡例や医療アクセス悪化など深刻な公衆衛生影響が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存のエボラアウトブレイクの二次的影響（妊産婦ケアへのアクセス悪化）に焦点を当てたフォローアップ記事。新規発生ではないが、進行中の重大な公衆衛生危機であり、既存のRRA対象として継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Minsa: más de 9.4 millones de viviendas fueron inspeccionadas en el país para eliminar criaderos del zancudo transmisor del dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health: More than 9.4 million homes were inspected nationwide to eliminate breeding sites of the dengue-transmitting mosquito.
article.articleSummary: Nationwide dengue-control efforts by Peru’s Ministry of Health (Minsa) through Digesa targeted Aedes aegypti from January through 2026-11-27, inspecting 9,440,844 dwellings and fumigating 918,858 to eliminate larval habitats and reduce adult mosquitoes. Larval breeding hotspots identified were barrels/cylinders (30.1%), buckets (19%), other containers (16.3%), tires (9%), and flower pots (5.6%). Fumigation by spatial nebulization reached Amazonas, Áncash, Cajamarca, Callao, Cusco, Ica, Junín, La Libertad, Loreto, Lambayeque, Piura, San Martín, Tumbes, and the Lima Metropolitan and Lima region. National stocks include piriproxyfen 8,270 kg of 0.5% G for treating 6,891,688 dwellings and malathion 15,327 L of 57% EC for 971,316 dwellings, with 1,696 operational thermonebulizers to conduct interventions against dengue transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省：デング熱媒介蚊の発生源除去のため、全国で940万戸以上の住宅を点検
triage.triage_reason: 記事はペルー保健省によるデング熱媒介蚊対策（住宅点検・燻蒸）の実施報告であり、対象国リストに含まれる国での発生事例ではないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事はペルー（対象国外）における政府の媒介蚊対策活動に関する内容。発生地域にBrazilが含まれているが、記事本文はペルーに関するものでありBrazilは主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue se expande a una 'velocidad alarmante' en el Mundo... ¿a qué se debe la subida histórica de casos?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue is spreading at an 'alarming rate' around the world... what is behind the historic rise in cases?
article.articleSummary: Dengue reached historic global levels, rising from about 430,000 cases in 1990 to 14.7 million in 2024, per a presentation at the ASTMH meeting in National Harbor, Maryland on Nov 22. The surge is driven by Aedes aegypti expansion into new regions and climate-accelerated urban conditions that favor breeding. The analysis, drawing on multinational health records and modeling, is a preprint awaiting peer review. Dengue symptoms include fever, headache, and muscle or joint pain; severe cases may require urgent care. Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes are being deployed; in Brazil, about 32 million Wolbachia-bearing Aedes aegypti released between Jan 2021 and May 2022, with follow-up on ~6,000 children showing a 68% reduction in dengue infections. Evidence for other tools is mixed: Peru observed a 34% risk reduction (2016–2019) with spatial emitters, while Puerto Rico (2024–2025) found no significant difference. Experts call for integrated surveillance, vector control, vaccination, and multiple strategies, not a single solution.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱が世界で「驚異的な速度」で拡大…過去最多の症例数急増の背景とは？
triage.triage_reason: 特定の国・地域における新規アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、学会発表（プレプリント）に基づく世界的なデング熱増加傾向と対策技術（ウォルバキア等）に関する総説的記事であるため、個別シグナルとしてのピックアップは不要と判断した。
triage.notes: 本記事はASTMH学会発表（査読前プレプリント）に基づく世界的なデング熱動向の総説であり、特定国での新規アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。ブラジルのウォルバキア蚊放出事業のデータが具体的に言及されているため対象国として記載したが、ペルー・プエルトリコは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Rondônia integra Programa Brasil Saudável e articula plano de microeliminação das hepatites virais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rondônia joins the Healthy Brazil Program and outlines a plan for the micro-elimination of viral hepatitis.
article.articleSummary: Rondônia state government, through Agevisa/RO and the NISTHV with the Ministry of Health, launched a micro-elimination program for hepatitis B, C and hepatitis D in Guajará-Mirim on November 26, 2026, including a technical visit to Aldeia Tanajura (Oro Nao) home to 58 families. The action is part of the federal Brasil Saudável interministerial program addressing socially determined diseases. Guajará-Mirim, hosting about 6,375 Indigenous people across 77 aldeias recognized by Funai, was selected alongside Lábrea (AM) and Santarém (PA) as one of three municipalities for the project. The effort unites SAE/Guajará-Mirim, Municipal Epidemiological Surveillance, Border Laboratory (Lafron), Dsei Porto Velho, Casai and Ifro to coordinate diagnosis, prevention and treatment on the ground. Leaders emphasize listening to communities to tailor logistics and services; Aldeia Tanajura cacique Dimaito Oro Nao highlighted the urgent need for action against a disease that kills.

triage.headline_ja: ロンドニア州、「健康なブラジル」プログラムに参加しウイルス性肝炎のマイクロ除去計画を策定
triage.triage_reason: これは政府主導の慢性ウイルス性肝炎（B型・C型・D型）の除去・予防プログラムに関する行政施策の発表であり、急性の公衆衛生上の緊急事態やアウトブレイクではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル・ロンドニア州における慢性ウイルス性肝炎の除去プログラム開始を報じるもので、急性アウトブレイクの検知には該当しない。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、本件は通常の公衆衛生施策であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外（DISMISS）と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans la Tshopo : trois nouveaux cas confirmés à Kisangani - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Tshopo: Three Newly Confirmed Cases in Kisangani - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Three newly confirmed Ebola virus disease cases were reported in Kisangani, capital of the Tshopo province in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, on 27 November 2026. The cases are in the Kabondo health zone (Umoja health area), Makiso-Kisangani health zone (Kilanga), and Mangobo health zone (Bondeko). The outbreak total now stands at 117 confirmed cases, 53 deaths, and 64 patients still alive (including 56 cured), with five probable cases. Among the confirmed cases, 28 are frontline health workers (PPL), including five deaths. The figures highlight the urgency of intensifying response activities to curb Ebola virus disease in Tshopo and across the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州のエボラ出血熱：キサンガニで新たに3例確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクが継続しており、確定症例117例・死亡53例、医療従事者への感染も多数発生していることから公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 致死率約45%（53/117）と高く、医療従事者28例中5例死亡という点からヒト-ヒト感染対策の脆弱性が示唆される。継続的なモニタリングとフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Isiro : le maire appelle la population au respect strict des mesures barrières - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Isiro: the mayor calls on the population to strictly observe barrier measures - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 27 November 2026, in Isiro, Haut-Uélé, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, authorities highlighted the Ebola virus disease outbreak and urged residents to strictly observe barrier measures. Mayor Guillaume Lola Malawa urged the population to take the disease seriously, stressing that Ebola is lethal and that community involvement is decisive to ending the outbreak. He condemned incivism toward response teams and called for patriotism and collaboration with health workers. Key prevention measures emphasized include regular handwashing with soap or an alcohol-based solution, physical distancing, reporting suspected cases and community deaths, and cooperating with teams to facilitate sampling when a death occurs. The city of Isiro, with more than 180,000 inhabitants based on 2025 demographic data, is at the center of the outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: イソロでのエボラ出血熱：市長が住民に感染予防策の厳格な遵守を呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イソロでエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、致死性の高い感染症でヒト-ヒト感染のリスクがあるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は市長による住民への感染予防措置遵守の呼びかけが中心で、具体的な症例数・死亡者数の記載はないが、エボラ出血熱という疾患特性上、重大な公衆衛生リスクとして扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: Junagadh GMERS resident doctor dies of dengue
article.articleSummary: Junagadh, Nov 27, 2026 — A 30-year-old resident doctor, Sonali Odedara, a first-year postgraduate in anaesthesia at GMERS Medical College and Hospital, Junagadh, died of dengue while undergoing treatment. Odedara was initially treated at Rajkot’s K.J. Patel General Hospital and later shifted to GMERS, where she passed away on Thursday. She is survived by her husband, a private orthopaedic surgeon, and their three-year-old child. Official statements dismissed claims that she was forced to report for duty; authorities said she had been granted leave, briefly resumed duties after two days off, felt weak again, and was advised to return home before her condition deteriorated. GMERS in-charge dean Dr Hanmant Ambe confirmed the sequence of events. No infection source or broader outbreak details were provided.

triage.headline_ja: ジュナガド・GMERS研修医、デング熱で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 個別の死亡事例の報道であり、アウトブレイクの規模や異常性を示す情報がなく、デング熱はインドにおいて流行性の既知疾患であるため特段のシグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: 単一の死亡例の報道で、感染源やアウトブレイクの詳細は不明。デング熱はインドで季節性・流行性のため特段の異常性なし。

article.articleHeadline: '45 Days to Disclose US Deals': Kenya Court Rules Ebola Site 'Unconstitutional' | Firstpost Africa
article.articleSummary: Kenya's High Court ruled the government breached constitutional requirements for public participation, transparency, and access to information by approving a US-backed Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base without consulting citizens. Justice Patricia Nyaundi ordered all work halted and mandated disclosure within 45 days of the full US agreements, safety/biosafety assessments, and isolation protocols. The 50-bed unit, linked to about $13.5 million in US Ebola preparedness support, triggered months of anger, deadly clashes, and legal challenges from the Law Society of Kenya and Katiba Institute. The decision arrives as the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces a historic Ebola outbreak with over 12,000 confirmed cases and nearly 6,000 deaths in its eastern region. Nairobi now must decide whether to comply with the disclosure order or appeal.

triage.headline_ja: 「45日以内に米国との取引を開示」：ケニア裁判所、エボラ施設建設を違憲と判断 | Firstpost Africa
triage.triage_reason: 記事はケニアの法的措置が主題だが、DRCで12,000例超・死亡6,000人近くという歴史的規模のエボラ流行が進行中である事実が明記されており、深刻な公衆衛生インパクトと国際関心（米国支援・国際機関関与）が認められるためフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事本文の主題はケニアにおける米国支援エボラ隔離施設建設を巡る違憲判決であり、ケニア自体はエボラ発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。一方、記事中で言及されるDRCの大規模エボラ流行（12,000例超、死者6,000人近く）は既知の継続事案であり実際の発生地としてDRCを計上。続報でケニアの対応（上訴・情報開示）とDRC疫学状況の更新を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Covid e influenza puxam alta de atendimentos em hospitais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 and Influenza Drive Up Hospital Visits
article.articleSummary: São Paulo state, Brazil: 89 private hospitals surveyed by Sindhosp reported a 91% increase in SRAG consultations and a 72% rise in admissions from Nov 12–23, 2026. COVID-19 was cited as the main associated cause in 53% of hospitals, followed by influenza at 43%. Vaccination remains crucial to prevent severe disease. Seventy-one percent of facilities are in the capital and Greater São Paulo; 29% are in the interior/coast. In clinical beds, 64% reported adult SRAG admissions rising up to 10%; 66% reported pediatric increases up to 5%. Findings align with Fiocruz InfoGripe and a Health Ministry brief for Nov 15–21, showing more SRAG due to COVID in the Center-South; statewide incidence remains below Fiocruz’s alert threshold. The PJ.2.1 lineage is under monitoring; preliminary data show no evidence of reduced vaccine protection. Booster recommendations: elderly/immunocompromised every six months; children 6 months–<5 years—three doses; pregnant women—one dose per pregnancy; health workers—annual dose; unvaccinated individuals should obtain a first dose at vaccination sites with their card.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19とインフルエンザが病院受診数の増加を牽引
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州における季節性のCOVID-19・インフルエンザ受診増加の定例サーベイランス報告であり、州の警戒閾値を下回っておりワクチン効果低下の証拠もないため、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 既知病原体（COVID-19・季節性インフルエンザ）による季節的な医療機関受診増加であり、Fiocruz InfoGripeの警戒閾値を下回る通常のサーベイランス報告。新規変異株PJ.2.1は監視中だがワクチン効果低下の証拠なし。

article.articleHeadline: Sarna humana: conheça sintomas, transmissão e tratamento - Portal MPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Human Scabies: Learn About Symptoms, Transmission and Treatment - Portal MPA
article.articleSummary: Human scabies is a contagious skin disease caused by the mite Sarcoptes scabiei. In November 2026, Minas Gerais reported outbreaks in 40 municipalities, mainly in the Central, Central-West, and Southern regions; Divinópolis authorities conducted school disinfection. Symptoms include intense nocturnal itching, red bumps, itching-related excoriations, and small skin lines; lesions commonly appear between fingers, on wrists, elbows, armpits, waist, abdomen, and buttocks; in young children, the head, palms, and soles may be affected. Diagnosis must be made by a healthcare professional. Treatment is available and may involve topical or oral medications; close contacts may need treatment even without symptoms. Itching may persist weeks after treatment. Prevention includes not sharing clothing, towels, or bed linens; wash and heat-dry items; seal nonwashable items for at least 72 hours. Scabies is not a matter of hygiene. Seek evaluation at a Primary Health Care Unit for severe itching.

triage.headline_ja: ヒト疥癬：症状、感染経路、治療法について - Portal MPA
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は一般的な皮膚感染症であり、重症度・国際的拡大リスクともに低く、公衆衛生上の緊急性や社会的関心の高まりを示す情報もない。
triage.notes: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州の40自治体で疥癬の発生が報告されているが、疥癬自体は重篤性が低く、地域内での対応（学校の消毒など）で管理可能な事案。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تفرض قيودا على الجنازات لمواجهة تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo imposes funeral restrictions to curb an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Funeral restrictions in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, aim to curb an Ebola outbreak, allowing only 20 attendees at funerals for deaths not linked to Ebola; Ebola-related burials are conducted exclusively by response teams to ensure safe, dignified rites and prevent transmission. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases and 5,904 deaths since it was first declared in May, across eight provinces including Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, Tshopo, and Ubangi (North and South Ubangi); Beni city is identified as a hotspot. The provincial authorities urge strict adherence to the new measures. The World Health Organization kept the outbreak classified as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern last week, noting deteriorating security hampering response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行を抑制するため葬儀に制限を課す
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを維持しているエボラ流行で、12,000人超の感染・5,904人の死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、安全保障悪化により対応が困難化している国際的懸念事案のため。
triage.notes: WHOはPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として既に分類しており、フルリスク評価が必須。治安悪化が対応の障害となっている点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : lancement à Bunia d'un projet de riposte sociale contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Launch in Bunia of a social-response project against Ebola
article.articleSummary: In Bunia, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, a World Bank–funded social-response program against Ebola was officially launched. The $50 million initiative, funded for eight months and led by Star RDC, aims to reinforce prevention and support economic recovery for more than 37 people affected by the Ebola outbreak. General-major Kasongo Mulumba Gaby, military governor of Ituri, underscored provincial authorities’ commitment and urged broad community mobilization. Star RDC Ituri coordinator Steve Sengida Batchulu detailed interventions focused on direct aid to vulnerable families, with cash subsidies of up to $500 per household, distributed across health zones in Ituri and other affected provinces. The program complements government and partners’ ongoing efforts to curb the spread of the Ebola virus in the region, strengthening resilience and outbreak response at the community level.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州：ブニアでエボラに対する社会的対応プロジェクトが開始
triage.triage_reason: 既存のエボラ流行に対する社会経済支援プログラムの開始に関する報道であり、新規感染拡大や症例急増の情報はないが、エボラ流行が継続中であることを示唆するため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は既知のエボラ流行への対応強化（世界銀行資金による社会的支援プログラム）に関する内容であり、新規症例や流行拡大の具体的データは含まれていない。継続中のアウトブレイク状況の確認のため続報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda launches Africa's first trial of an mRNA Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine
article.articleSummary: Uganda launched Africa's first clinical trial of an mRNA vaccine against the Bundibugyo species of Ebola in Kampala, partnering with Moderna. The study will assess safety and immunogenicity, including for the first time children aged 1 year and older, and plans to enroll 224 volunteers. The trial follows the Congo-centric Bundibugyo outbreak, currently the second-largest on record globally. Moderna's vaccine will also enter trials in Congo soon, alongside a separate Bundibugyo candidate developed by Oxford University and the Serum Institute of India. Scientists are evaluating whether Merck's Ervebo can offer cross-protection against Bundibugyo. UVRI notes that this marks Africa's first mRNA Bundibugyo vaccine trial. The project previously conducted adult testing in Canada starting in August. CEPI is helping fund the vaccine development.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、アフリカ初のmRNA型ブンディブギョ・エボラワクチン臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国で発生中の「過去最大級」とされるブンディブギョ種エボラ出血熱の流行を背景としたワクチン開発・臨床試験の動きであり、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的な支援体制（CEPI、Moderna、Oxford等）が示されているためフルリスク評価の対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事本文はウガンダでのワクチン臨床試験開始が主題だが、その背景にはコンゴ民主共和国における『過去最大級』のブンディブギョ種エボラ出血熱流行があり、これが実際の発生国として該当する。ウガンダ・インド・カナダは試験実施国・ワクチン開発拠点として言及されているのみで、発生地域ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Diadema reforça mobilização contra o mosquito da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diadema steps up mobilization against the dengue-carrying mosquito.
article.articleSummary: Diadema launches a week-long mobilization (Nov 23–28) to prevent the spread of Aedes aegypti–borne diseases in the run-up to summer. The initiative targets dengue, chikungunya, and Zika, urging residents to reduce breeding sites as rains and high temperatures favor mosquito reproduction. Activities include guidance by Endemic Control Agents (ACEs), home visits, and educational material distribution at Basic Health Units (UBSs). The program culminates on Saturday, Nov 28, with an educational event at Praça da Moça where agents will advise residents and hand out materials on preventing mosquito proliferation. Health officials emphasize cooperation, noting that home inspections help identify potential traps inside properties. Residents are urged to regularly inspect yards, gutters, drains, plant pots, water containers, and similar sites, eliminate unnecessary containers, and keep water storage covered.

triage.headline_ja: ディアデマ市、デング熱媒介蚊対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節的な蚊媒介性疾患の予防啓発活動であり、異常な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル・サンパウロ州ディアデマ市における季節前の予防啓発活動に関するものであり、具体的な症例数や流行の報告はない。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、記事内容は定例的な公衆衛生キャンペーンでありシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola en Ituri - 50 millions USD de la Banque mondiale pour appuyer les familles affectées
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola in Ituri - $50 million from the World Bank to support the affected families.
article.articleSummary: Over 37,000 people affected by Ebola in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, will receive social and economic support under the STARR-RDC programme. A US$50 million World Bank–funded initiative launched November 26, 2026 in Bunia aims to strengthen community mobilization, reinforce prevention measures, and protect communities exposed to Ebola as the DRC’s 17th outbreak. The plan will provide direct household assistance, including a one-time grant of US$500 per family, to support recovery in the affected health zones. Provincial authorities and partners seek to boost adherence to control measures while mitigating the outbreak’s socio-economic impacts. The project, operated under the Eastern Stabilization and Recovery Programme, targets long-term resilience alongside outbreak response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国・イツリ州のエボラ出血熱：世界銀行が被災家族支援に5000万米ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の第17次エボラ流行（イツリ州）に関する国際的資金支援の動きであり、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事は世界銀行による経済・社会支援プログラム（STARR-RDC）の発表が主題であり、新規の疫学的変化は報告されていないが、エボラ出血熱という疾患の性質上、継続的な監視とフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Pará e RJ entram em alerta por vírus respiratórios, diz Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pará and RJ go on alert for respiratory viruses, says Fiocruz.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-27, Pará and Rio de Janeiro are on alert for respiratory viruses, with rising Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome cases driven by COVID-19, human metapneumovirus, influenza A and B. In Pará, increases affect primarily children and adolescents up to 14 years; specific circulating viruses are not yet identified. COVID-19 rises may reflect a more transmissible circulating variant and waning immunity, a variant also detected in Espírito Santo, São Paulo, Mato Grosso, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina and the Distrito Federal. In the last four epidemiological weeks, rhinovirus accounted for 42% of SARS-positive cases, COVID-19 22%, with RSV and influenza making up the rest. COVID-19 deaths accounted for more than 40% of fatalities. The Health Ministry is sending vaccination messages via WhatsApp and GOV.BR, with doses to states; vaccines target children 6 months to under 5 years, pregnant women, the elderly over 60, and other high-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: パラ州とリオデジャネイロ州、呼吸器ウイルスで警戒態勢に入る とフィオクルスが発表
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル複数州でCOVID-19・RSV・インフルエンザ等の季節性呼吸器感染症増加とSARS症例・死亡増加が報告されており、新変異株の検出もあるため監視継続が必要だが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: 季節性呼吸器感染症（COVID-19、RSV、インフルエンザ、ヒトメタニューモウイルス）の複数州での増加。新変異株検出とワクチン接種強化の動きがあり、続報を注視する必要がある。国際的拡大の兆候はなく国内対応で管理可能と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: 一周確診12人次...登革熱升溫 高師大附中3投票所急噴藥、市府擴大警戒里防治
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 12 new confirmed cases in a week... Dengue fever on the rise; three polling stations at the National Kaohsiung Normal University Affiliated High School were urgently sprayed with insecticide; the city government expands neighborhood-level alert and prevention and control measures.
article.articleSummary: Kaohsiung reports 12 dengue cases in the past week, with a National Kaohsiung Normal University (KHNU) staff member’s infection that genome-sequencing shows matches Vietnam-origin DENV-2, marking the year’s first domestic detection of this strain. A Guzhan District community cluster (two men, one woman, aged 42–55) had onset most recently on Nov 23–25 and is Dengue virus type 1, suspected to be part of the same transmission wave. Additional cases appear in Xiaogang and Qianzhen; one KHNU restaurant employee’s virus also aligns with the Vietnam DENV-2 strain. Health authorities intensified control: three polling stations at KHNU Affiliated High School, near the campus, were sprayed; environment and vector control reinforced. An Aedes aegypti breeding site behind Lan Yuan Restaurant led to a 60,000 NTD fine. Testing expanded to 1,128 people; over 3,000 SMS invitations urged testing for visitors to Xiaobei Department Store Qingfeng branch, Qingfeng Street, and KHNU Lan Yuan Restaurant, with 100 NTD vouchers.

triage.headline_ja: 一週間で12人確診...デング熱が上昇；高雄師範大学附属高校の3か所の投票所で緊急消毒、市政府は警戒区域を拡大し防疫強化
triage.triage_reason: 高雄市内で複数クラスター（ベトナム由来DENV-2株の今年初の国内検出含む）が確認され、当局が検査拡大・消毒・罰金措置など対応を強化しており、社会的関心も高いため、流行拡大リスクの精査が必要。
triage.notes: イベントは台湾・高雄市で発生しており、対象国リストに台湾は含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。記事中の中国（広西）・ベトナムは株の起源として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura cancela atrações do Natal Iluminado devido à sarna humana em Divinópolis - Portal MPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall Cancels Christmas in Lights Attractions Due to Human Scabies in Divinópolis - Portal MPA
article.articleSummary: Divinópolis, Brazil reports a preventive cancellation of Christmas in Lights attractions due to a rising number of human scabies and COVID-19 cases. The municipal government canceled cultural and lighting-ceremony events scheduled for Nov 28–29, 2026 at Praça do Santuário and Praça da Catedral, to avoid large gatherings. The Christmas illumination will still be lit as planned. Mayor Janete Aparecida stated that the measure is preventive to protect health, with only the attractions canceled, not the lighting. Residents are advised to visit the sites in off-peak hours and those with symptoms to avoid public spaces and seek medical care. The effort seeks to preserve the festive season while reducing transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: ディヴィノーポリスで疥癬（人疥癬）とCOVID-19の流行によりクリスマスイルミネーションのアトラクションを市が中止
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一地方都市における予防的なイベント中止措置に過ぎず、重症度・国際的拡大リスク・渡航貿易制限等のIHR基準に該当せず、社会的関心も限定的である。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。疥癬は対象疾患として通常トリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Governo fará Dia D contra dengue amanhã e notifica 30 milhões por WhatsApp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The government will conduct D-Day against dengue tomorrow and notify 30 million people via WhatsApp.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Health Ministry launches a D-Day against dengue, Zika, and chikungunya, with alerts via WhatsApp and Gov.br to over 30 million people in more than 400 high-risk cities, ahead of peak arbovirus transmission. The national campaign urges daily home sanitation to eliminate stagnant water and relies on Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes in indigenous areas and additional cities, beginning this Saturday in Amambai, Mato Grosso do Sul, and Garanhuns, Pernambuco. From January to October 2026, Brazil reported about 489,100 probable dengue cases, a 67% drop from 1.5 million in the same period of 2025. Public vaccination against dengue surpassed 5.1 million doses in 2026, targeting children and adolescents aged 10–14. The Wolbachia program now reaches around 6 million residents in 16 municipalities; in Niterói, Rio de Janeiro, dengue incidence fell 89% after releases.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、明日デング熱対策の「D-Day」を実施、3000万人にWhatsAppで通知
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル政府による季節性デング・ジカ・チクングニア対策の定例広報キャンペーンであり、2026年のデング症例数は前年同期比67%減少と改善傾向にあるため、新規の異常事態や緊急性を示すシグナルではない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル保健省による毎年恒例のデング熱等対策キャンペーン（Dia D）の開始を報じたもの。症例数は前年比67%減少しており、ワクチン接種やWolbachia蚊プログラムも進展中。公衆衛生上の通常対応であり、緊急性の高い新規シグナルとは判断されない。
