article.articleHeadline: "جافي" يستعد لمواجهة إيبولا في الكونغو بـ1.5 مليون جرعة لقاح تجريبي - أخبار ليبيا 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Gavi' gears up to confront Ebola in Congo with 1.5 million doses of an experimental vaccine - Libya News 24.
article.articleSummary: On 27 November 2026, Gavi signs an advance purchase with Serum Institute of India for up to 1.5 million doses of the experimental Ebola vaccine ChAdOx1 BDBV, aimed at Bundibugyo ebolavirus, in response to an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The agreement is contingent on favorable safety and efficacy data from ongoing trials, regulatory approvals, and WHO recommendations before use. Developed through a collaboration between Oxford Vaccine Group at the University of Oxford and Serum Institute, ChAdOx1 BDBV is being evaluated in field trials in DRC. The plan employs ring vaccination of contacts to curb transmission, given the absence of licensed vaccines or treatments for this strain. Gavi's First Response Fund ($40 million) supports regulatory readiness and expanded-use protocols; Serum Institute has begun manufacturing the active ingredient for over 500,000 doses to ensure rapid supply.

triage.headline_ja: 『Gavi』、コンゴでのエボラ流行に対応するため実験的ワクチン150万回分を確保
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクに対し、Gaviが大規模なワクチン事前購入契約を締結するなど国際的対応が進行しており、公衆衛生上の懸念と国際支援の必要性が明確であるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン調達（Gavi・Serum Institute・Oxford連携）が主題であり、アウトブレイクの症例数・死亡者数等の詳細は記載なし。インドは製造拠点、英国は開発拠点として言及されているのみで、発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Vaccine alliance buys 1.5m doses of experimental Ebola jab
article.articleSummary: Gavi has bought 1.5 million doses of an experimental Ebola vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak that began in May, which has reached over 11,000 cases and more than 5,700 deaths (WHO). Two potential vaccines are entering trials in the outbreak’s epicentre: the ChAdOx1 adenoviral vector vaccine developed by Serum Institute and Oxford, and Moderna’s mRNA candidate. Through its $50 million First Response Fund, Gavi pre-purchased doses before full testing, with hundreds of thousands to be deployed if trials prove successful and WHO/DRC approvals are granted. Trials are expected to wrap up in the first half of 2027, potentially in Q1 in an optimistic scenario. Gavi also has a stockpile of 500,000 Ervebo doses, tested for cross‑protection against Bundibugyo. Local partners, community leaders, and efforts to counter hesitancy accompany vaccine delivery in this volatile region.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン同盟、実験的エボラワクチン150万回分を購入
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が1万1000人以上の症例、5700人超の死者を出しており、深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性からIHR基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 2026年5月に始まったDRCのエボラ流行は大規模で、GaviやWHOを含む国際的な対応（ワクチン事前購入、臨床試験）が進行中。続報でワクチン有効性や流行制御状況を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Eight-State Indian Survey Finds 1.5 Percent Malaria Prevalence and Focal
article.articleSummary: Eight-state India cross-sectional study finds malaria RDT prevalence of 1.5% (368/25,268) across Assam, Chhattisgarh, Goa, Gujarat, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu, Tripura, and Uttar Pradesh, with highest local burden in North Goa at 10.1%. Fieldwork Jan 2022–Sep 2023 across 15 high-incidence districts, sampling blocks via GIS grid; design effect 64.7; pooled 95% CI 0.6–3.3%, with malaria infection determined using WHO-prequalified bivalent rapid diagnostic tests. Seasonal crude positivity 1.1% (low) vs 1.8% (high) but seasonal difference not significant after accounting for block clustering (design p=0.271). Children 1–10 years show 3.0% prevalence; males 1.9% vs females/transgender 1.2% (unadjusted RR 1.59; p=0.067 after design). Anaemia not different overall; among under-fives, severe stunting is markedly higher in malaria-positive (85.4% vs 40.6%, p=0.005), limited by small sample. Multivariable models link younger age, low education, prior malaria, current illness, and recent travel with positivity. Conclusion: malaria remains highly focal, requiring micro-stratified planning; pediatric malaria co-occurring with severe stunting highlights nutrition-integrated surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: インド8州調査でマラリア有病率1.5%、局所的な感染伝播を確認
triage.triage_reason: 新規アウトブレイクではなく、既存のマラリア流行状況を把握するための学術的疫学調査（横断研究）の結果報告であり、異常事態や緊急対応を要する兆候は見られない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリアが地域的に既知の流行地域（インド8州）における研究調査結果であり、新規の感染症イベントや急激な拡大を示すものではないため、トリアージ対象外と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Canada extends immigration restrictions affecting 3 African countries over Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Canada extends immigration restrictions for foreign nationals from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Uganda and South Sudan for another 90 days, to February 25, 2027, as authorities monitor the Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak in Central and East Africa. Affected applicants who listed these countries as their country of residence will face delays; IRCC will process new and existing applications but will not finalise decisions during the suspension, and previously approved visas, permits, or electronic travel authorisations cannot be used while restrictions are active. The outbreak was declared in May 2026 in the DRC. WHO data as of November 17, 2026 report 11,613 confirmed cases and 5,678 deaths across 68 health zones in eight provinces, with active transmission in 48 zones and the situation designated a public health emergency of international concern since November 18. Uganda’s outbreak is under control; Kenya reported an imported Bundibugyo case in October 2026, with 9 cases and 2 deaths as of November 17; 8 secondary infections linked to the index case; 7 hospitalised recovered; no transmission outside the cluster.

triage.headline_ja: カナダ、エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクを理由にアフリカ3カ国を対象とした入国制限を延長
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクはPHEICに指定され、1万人超の感染者・5千人超の死者を記録し、ケニアへの越境感染例もあり、カナダが渡航制限を延長するなど国際的影響が顕著であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOにより2026年11月18日にPHEICが宣言された大規模エボラアウトブレイク。ウガンダ・ケニア・南スーダン・カナダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、国際的波及の文脈情報として重要。

article.articleHeadline: OPS emite alerta por aumento de mpox en las Américas y pide reforzar la vigilancia epidemiológica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PAHO issues alert over increase in mpox in the Americas and calls for strengthening epidemiological surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) is resurging in the Americas, with Brazil reporting 1,325 cases and one death in 2026; overall 3,269 confirmed cases and four deaths across 13 countries from January–November 2026. From 2022 to date, the region totals 76,084 cases and 202 deaths across 31 countries/territories. PAHO notes increased notifications since epidemiological week 39 and greater detection of mpox clade Ib, with Ecuador's 2026 bulletin (as of 13 April 2026) showing eight confirmed cases from 19 suspected, seven of clade IIb and one clade Ib. The agency urges strengthened epidemiological and genomic surveillance, improved diagnostics, and vaccination for high-risk groups, along with reinforced prevention and control measures. Mpox continues to disproportionately affect men who have sex with men; among the 114 deaths with known HIV status, 111 were people living with HIV (97%).

triage.headline_ja: PAHOが米州地域でのMpox増加を受けて警告を発し、疫学的監視の強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルを含む米州複数国でMpox症例が増加し、クレードIbの検出拡大やHIV合併症による重症例が報告されており、PAHOが国際的な監視強化を要請していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はPAHO管轄の米州地域全体（ブラジル、エクアドル、スペイン領カナリア諸島等）を扱うが、対象国リストに含まれるのはブラジルのみ。エクアドルやスペインは対象国外のためverified_locationsから除外。クレードIbの検出増加が特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا تطلق أول تجربة في أفريقيا للقاح ضد سلاسة من إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda launches Africa's first trial of a vaccine against an Ebola strain.
article.articleSummary: Uganda launches Africa’s first clinical trial of an mRNA vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, in collaboration with Moderna and Oxford University. The Uganda Virus Research Institute says the trial marks Africa’s first such study and will test Moderna’s vaccine, with Congo (DRC) soon hosting trials as well of a separate Bundibugyo-targeting candidate from Oxford and the Serum Institute of India. Researchers are also evaluating whether Merck’s Ervebo vaccine offers any cross-protection against Bundibugyo. This Ugandan trial is the second for this vaccine, following Canada’s initial human trial in August that enrolled adults 18–65. The Ugandan study will assess safety and immunogenicity in children aged 1 year and older, aiming to enroll 224 volunteers. CEPI’s Richard Hatchett notes that children are often among the most affected and late to benefit from vaccines amid Ebola outbreaks, which are centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo and currently the second-largest globally.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、アフリカ初のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）ワクチン臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はウガンダでのmRNAワクチン臨床試験開始に関するもので、新規感染症アウトブレイクの検知情報ではない。DRCの既存エボラ流行への言及はあるが新規性のある情報は含まれない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン臨床試験（ウガンダ、今後DRCでも実施予定）に関するニュース。インド（Serum Institute of India）はワクチン製造企業の所在地であり発生地域ではないため除外。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا تطلق أول تجربة أفريقية للقاح "إم آر إن إيه" لمكافحة سلالة بونديبوجيو من إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda launches Africa's first trial of an mRNA vaccine to combat the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Uganda launches Africa's first clinical trial of an mRNA vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus, led by the Uganda Virus Research Institute in collaboration with Moderna. The study will assess safety and immunogenicity, starting with children as young as one year and enrolling about 224 volunteers across ages. The Bundibugyo strain has driven large Ebola outbreaks centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo, marking the second-largest Ebola outbreak globally. Canada began first human trials in August 2025; similar trials are planned in the DRC testing a second vaccine developed through Oxford University and the Serum Institute of India for the same strain. Merck's Ervebo vaccine is also being studied for cross-protection against Bundibugyo. The research is funded by CEPI, signaling a push to accelerate vaccine readiness for Africa."} ,

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ出血熱ブンディブギョ株に対するmRNAワクチンのアフリカ初臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事は実際の新規エボラ発生ではなくワクチン臨床試験開始の報道だが、エボラという重大疾患かつDRC・ウガンダでの過去大規模流行株に関する研究動向であるため、今後の関連情報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は現在進行中のエボラ発生報告ではなく、ウガンダにおけるmRNAワクチン（Moderna開発）の臨床試験開始に関する報道。DRCはBundibugyo株による過去の大規模流行地として言及されているのみで、現在の発生事例ではない。India（Serum Institute of India）もワクチン開発パートナーとして言及されているだけで発生国ではないため、対象国リストに該当する発生地域はなしと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: WHO demands faster vaccine trials as DR Congo death toll hits 5,900
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak driven by Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) now records more than 12,000 cases and over 5,900 deaths as of November 24, 2026. WHO urges accelerated vaccine and treatment trials, urging researchers to speed up clinical testing while preserving scientific, ethical, and safety standards, and to actively inform and involve communities. The agency maintains the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) following a November 17 Emergency Committee meeting. Security concerns hamper response, with at least 94 attacks on healthcare services since the PHEIC was declared six months earlier. Committee members call for faster infection detection, stronger infection prevention and control in facilities and communities, early supportive care, and safer access for response teams. Targeted traveller screening is advised; broad travel restrictions should be avoided. The IHR Emergency Committee has met 12 times since 2007, with nine PHEIC events.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHO、DRコンゴの死者数5,900人到達を受けワクチン治験の加速を要求
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を継続宣言しており、死亡者数5,900人超・症例12,000件超と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準の複数該当が確認されるためフルRRAへ進むべき案件。
triage.notes: PHEIC継続下での大規模エボラ（Bundibugyoウイルス）流行。医療従事者への攻撃94件が対応を阻害しており、セキュリティ面でも国際支援が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Nova variante da Covid-19 chega a estados brasileiros; OMS monitora cenário epidemiológico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New COVID-19 variant reaches Brazilian states; WHO monitors the epidemiological situation.
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1 sublineage of SARS-CoV-2 circulating in Brazil, with Rio de Janeiro accounting for about 58% of 167 sequenced genomes; confirmed cases also in São Paulo, Espírito Santo, Distrito Federal, Rio Grande do Sul and Santa Catarina. WHO, as of 2026-11-27, rates the global public health risk as low. First detected in Ontario, Canada, on May 2, 2026, PJ.2.1 spread through North America and reached Brazil in the second half of 2026. Genomic surveillance under Fiocruz’s InfoGripe shows a rise in Severe Acute Respiratory Illness associated with Covid-19, but data are not yet sufficient to attribute the national surge solely to PJ.2.1. Vaccines in Brazil’s SUS remain protective against severe disease and death; authorities urge vaccination updates for groups 60+, pregnant individuals, children 6 months to under 5, and immunocompromised, especially if last dose was over a year ago. The lineage is linked to greater transmissibility with ongoing global monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの新変異株がブラジル各州に到達、WHOが疫学状況を監視
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1がブラジル複数州に拡大しているが、WHOは世界的な公衆衛生リスクを低いと評価しており、重症化増加の明確な根拠も不十分なため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: カナダ（オンタリオ州）は変異株の最初の検出地として言及されているが、記事の主題はブラジルでの流行状況であるため対象国リストに該当するブラジルのみを検証済み地域とした。WHOは2026年11月27日時点でグローバルリスクを低いと評価。

article.articleHeadline: JJ: Casos de dengue caem 92% em Várzea Paulista neste ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: JJ: Dengue cases fell by 92% in Várzea Paulista this year.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Várzea Paulista, Brazil, shows strong control gains in 2026 with 103 confirmed cases to date, a 92.2% drop from 2025’s 1,323 cases; 2025 had one death, while 2026 has recorded no fatalities so far. The municipal Zoonoses Control program implements house-to-house visits, vaccination, larval habitat mapping, prioritized interventions, and public education to curb transmission. This year, inspectors surveyed 26,604 properties, finding 66 larval-containing containers (e.g., cans, buckets, tires), with 41 testing positive for Aedes aegypti. Ongoing vector surveillance uses the Levantamento Rápido de Índices para o Aedes aegypti (Liraa) to identify high-risk areas, followed by targeted insecticide applications in busy locations per technical priorities. The efforts focus on preventing outbreaks by reducing vector populations and educating communities. keywords: dengue, Aedes aegypti, vector control, vaccination, outbreak prevention, Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: JJ:ヴァルゼア・パウリスタで今年のデング熱症例92%減少
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数が前年比92%減少し死亡例もゼロであり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められず、むしろ対策成功を報告する内容であるため。
triage.notes: 記事は症例減少と対策成功を報告する内容であり、デング熱の流行拡大やアウトブレイクを示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا تطلق أول تجربة سريرية في أفريقيا للقاح بتقنية "إم آر إن إيه" ضد سلالة من إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda launches Africa's first clinical trial of an mRNA-based vaccine against an Ebola strain.
article.articleSummary: Uganda launches Africa's first clinical trial of an mRNA vaccine against the Ebola Bundibugyo strain, in partnership with Moderna, amid a Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak described as the second-largest on record. The Ugandan Virus Research Institute said the study will assess safety and immunogenicity in 224 volunteers, starting with children aged 1 year and older. The trial will also take place in the DRC, alongside an Oxford University/SERUM Institute of India vaccine trial targeting the same Bundibugyo strain. Scientists are evaluating whether Merck's Ervebo vaccine offers cross-protection against Bundibugyo. Moderna's trial is its second human study, following an August trial in Canada that enrolled adults 18–65. CEPI’s Richard Hatchett underscored the goal of delivering vaccines to children—the group most at risk during outbreaks—and expanding protection to the most vulnerable.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、アフリカ初となるエボラ株に対するmRNAワクチンの臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で発生中の『史上2番目に大規模』とされるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行を背景としたワクチン臨床試験開始を報じており、深刻性・異常性の観点からIHR基準を2つ以上満たすためフルリスク評価が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでのワクチン臨床試験開始だが、背景にあるエボラ流行自体はDRCで発生中とされる。インドはSERUM Institute（ワクチン開発パートナー）としての言及のみで、疾病発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。ウガンダ・カナダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'OMS maintient l'urgence internationale et appelle à accélérer les essais de vaccins et de traitements
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the WHO maintains the international public health emergency and calls for accelerating vaccine and treatment trials.
article.articleSummary: On 27 November 2026, the World Health Organization keeps the Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as a PHEIC (Public Health Emergency of International Concern). Director-General Tedros updated recommendations on 25 November after an Emergency Committee meeting on 17 November for the third time. The committee calls to accelerate clinical trials of vaccines and candidate treatments, while upholding scientific, ethical, and safety standards, and to involve affected communities in trial design and procedures. Six months after the emergency was declared, WHO has verified at least 94 attacks against health care in the DRC, hindering case detection and patient access and endangering staff. In areas with new or intensified transmission, the organization urges reducing the time from symptom onset to diagnosis and care, and addressing unsafe injection practices. For other countries, targeted traveler controls for exposed individuals may be used to limit cross-border spread while avoiding travel disruption.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱 DRC：WHOが国際的な緊急事態を維持し、ワクチン・治療の試験加速を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を継続していると明言しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限）に該当するためフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: WHOが既にPHEICを宣言・維持している既知のエボラ流行の継続報道。医療従事者への攻撃94件、ワクチン・治療の試験加速要請など、継続的な公衆衛生上の重大懸念が示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda lança primeiro ensaio clínico da África com vacina de mRNA contra cepa Bundibugyo do Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda launches Africa's first clinical trial with an mRNA vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Uganda launches Africa's first clinical trial of an mRNA vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, announced by the Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI) in collaboration with Moderna. The Uganda trial follows Moderna’s first-in-human study in Canada in August for adults 18–65 and represents the second Moderna trial globally. UVRI says the study will assess safety and immunogenicity in children from age 1, recruiting up to 224 volunteers. In parallel, Congo (the Democratic Republic of the Congo) will soon test Moderna’s vaccine, alongside another Bundibugyo candidate developed by the University of Oxford and the Serum Institute of India. Researchers are also evaluating whether MSD’s Ervebo vaccine could offer cross-protection against Bundibugyo. The Bundibugyo outbreak is centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and described as the second-largest outbreak on record.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、アフリカ初のエボラ・ブンディブギョ株mRNAワクチン臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事はワクチン臨床試験開始に関する内容であり、DRCでのブンディブギョ株アウトブレイクが「史上2番目の大規模」と言及されているため、背景の流行状況を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はワクチン臨床試験であり、ウガンダは試験実施国だが、実際のアウトブレイクはDRCで発生している。インド（Serum Institute of India）は研究協力機関として言及されているのみで、疾患発生国ではないため除外。Canadaも第一相試験実施地だが発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Beni : Un corps disparaît de la morgue de l'Hôpital général de référence en pleine riposte contre Ebola | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Beni: A body disappears from the morgue of the General Reference Hospital amid the Ebola response
article.articleSummary: During the 17th outbreak of Ebola Virus Disease in North Kivu, a 19-year-old body has been missing from the morgue at Beni General Reference Hospital since November 23, 2026, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. On November 26, Prisca Luanda Kamala, senior health coordinator for the provincial governor’s military administration, visited the facility to investigate the disappearance and coordinate search efforts. Health officials cited an influx of bodies and insufficient morgue capacity, which may have caused confusion in handling and removing remains. Kamala instructed staff to strengthen identification procedures before burial to ensure safe, dignified, and infection-controlled management of corpses—a critical precaution during Ebola response to protect families, healthcare workers, and the community in Beni and the wider North Kivu region.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：エボラ対応の最中、総合病院の遺体安置所から遺体が消失
triage.triage_reason: 北キブ州における第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク対応下での事案であり、遺体管理の不備は感染拡大・公衆衛生リスクを示唆するため、既存の深刻な公衆衛生事象として注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事自体は遺体紛失という個別事案だが、背景にある北キブ州の第17次エボラ流行は継続中の重大な公衆衛生イベントであり、遺体管理の不備は感染対策の弱点を示す。既存アウトブレイクの進捗として継続監視・フルRRA実施が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Teresina registra 11 notificações de Mpox e intensifica vigilância após quatro casos confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Teresina records 11 Mpox notifications and intensifies surveillance after four confirmed cases
article.articleSummary: Teresina, Brazil, reports 11 Mpox notifications in 2026, with four confirmed and seven under investigation; vaccination is available at the CRIE unit of Hospital Infantil Lucídio Portela for people living with HIV, PrEP users, and laboratory staff handling viral samples. As of Nov 26, 2026, the Municipal Health Foundation has intensified epidemiological surveillance, monitoring suspected cases and coordinating with facilities and laboratories, using data from the e-SUS Sinan system. In Piauí state, four cases have been confirmed this year, all in men from Teresina; the first diagnosis was in October, with three more confirmed in November. Nationwide, 2026 totals include 1,631 confirmed cases (838 in November), 66 probable, and 1,948 suspected. Mpox transmits through direct contact with skin lesions, body fluids, and secretions; symptoms include rash, fever, headache, myalgia, lymphadenopathy, and malaise. Guidance emphasizes avoiding close contact, not sharing personal items, maintaining hygiene, and seeking care; vaccination targets specified groups.

triage.headline_ja: テレジーナ市、Mpoxの届出11件を記録、4件確定後に監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でMpoxの確定・疑い例が継続的に報告されており、全国的な症例数も多く（確定1,631例）、自治体が監視体制を強化していることから社会的・行政的関心が認められる。
triage.notes: ブラジル全国で2026年の確定例1,631件、疑い例1,948件と報告されており、既知の流行継続事例と考えられる。地域（テレジーナ/ピアウイ州）での新規確定例・監視強化が主題。

article.articleHeadline: Sesapi reforça orientações sobre sintomas e prevenção da Mpox após casos no Piauí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sesapi Reinforces Guidance on Mpox Symptoms and Prevention After Cases in Piauí
article.articleSummary: Four mpox cases were confirmed in Piauí, Brazil, in 2026, prompting Sesapi to reinforce symptoms awareness and prevention. Mpox is a viral infection transmitted from animals to humans and between people. Core symptoms include skin lesions with possible edema of lymph nodes, fever, body aches, headache, malaise, and chills; lesions can be flat or raised, containing clear or yellow fluid, and may crust as they heal, appearing on face, hands, feet, mouth, genitals, and anus. Suspected cases or exposures should seek care at a Unidade Básica de Saúde (UBS) for evaluation and laboratory confirmation. Isolation typically lasts 2–4 weeks, with Epidemiological Surveillance monitoring; contacts are observed for 21 days per Ministério da Saúde guidance. Vaccination against mpox has been available since 2025, with 832 doses in 2026, but not routine for the entire population. Access at CRIE (Hospital Infantil Lucídio Portella) and via Estratégia de Vacinação Especial/CTAs. Pre-exposure vaccination targets high-risk groups; post-exposure vaccination should be given within 4 days (up to 14 days) after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: Sesapi、ピアウイ州でのMpox症例確認後、症状と予防に関する指導を強化
triage.triage_reason: ピアウイ州でMpox4例確認との報告だが、既知の疾患で地域保健局による通常の注意喚起・予防啓発の域を出ず、重症度や拡大リスクに関する情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: Mpoxはブラジルで既知の流行性疾患であり、既にワクチン接種体制（CRIE、CTA等）が整備されている。本記事は保健局による症状啓発・予防指導の強化を伝える通常の公衆衛生情報であり、重症度や死亡例、ヒト-ヒト感染拡大の具体的エビデンスは記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: República Democrática do Congo registra mais de 12 mil casos de ebola em seis meses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo records more than 12,000 Ebola cases in six months.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports over 12,000 Ebola cases in six months due to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, the deadliest of 17 outbreaks in the country, approaching West Africa’s 2014–2016 toll of about 11,000 deaths. The epicenter remains Ituri Province in the northeast, with transmission expanding to other regions. Ongoing conflict, poor road networks, resource shortages, and community violence driven by distrust and misinformation hinder containment. The Bundibugyo strain is a high-risk pathogen (WHO Biosafety Level 4) with no approved vaccine or treatment. About two-thirds of deaths occur in communities, and roughly 70% of confirmed pediatric cases under five die. Transmission occurs via direct contact with secretions, blood, or other bodily fluids of infected or bereaved individuals. Control relies on early diagnosis, rapid isolation, 21-day contact monitoring, strict PPE, supportive care, and safe burials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、6か月でエボラ症例1万2千件以上を記録
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いブンディブギョ株による大規模流行で、西アフリカ2014-2016年流行に迫る規模。ワクチン・治療法が未承認で、紛争地域での対応困難、地域拡大がみられIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域として付与されているが、記事サマリーはDRCのみを主題としており、対象国リストにAngolaは含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Pemprov NTB Luruskan Simpang Siur Data Rabies, Ini Penjelasannya |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Nusa Tenggara Provincial Government Clears Up Conflicting Rabies Data; Here's the Explanation.
article.articleSummary: NTB Province clarifies divergent rabies data: 3,517 Human Rabies Exposure Reports (GHPR) up to September 2026, 286 clinically symptomatic animal bites, and 30 laboratory-positive samples. These figures reflect different objects and stages and are not directly comparable: GHPR counts people exposed to potentially rabid animals; clinical-sign bites reflect animal-side events; a single animal can bite multiple people. Lombok Island shows no FAT-positive samples; positives all originate from Sumbawa Island (30 samples): Sumbawa Barat 20, Sumbawa 5, Kota Bima 4, Dompu 1. Ministerial Decree 287/KPTS/HK.150/M/04/2026 lists Lombok as rabies-free and Sumbawa as rabies-affected. Vaccination efforts include 14,680 VAR and 117 SAR distributed to districts; animal vaccination reached 30,833 in 2024, 19,460 in 2025, and 10,000 in 2026. One Health approach emphasizes continued surveillance, lab confirmation, and cross-sector vaccination; GHPR by location: Mataram 878, Sumbawa 746, Dompu 579.

triage.headline_ja: 西ヌサトゥンガラ州政府、狂犬病データの食い違いを整理・説明
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の発生状況に関する行政側のデータ整理・説明記事であり、新規の異常な増加や緊急対応を要する内容ではない。既存の風土病管理体制内の情報である。
triage.notes: 記事はスンバワ島における既知の狂犬病流行状況とロンボク島の清浄地域指定に関するデータの整合性を説明するもので、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。ワクチン接種等の対策は継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda lansează primul studiu clinic din Africa pentru un vaccin de tip ARNm împotriva tulpinei Bundibugyo a virusului Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda launches Africa's first clinical trial for an mRNA vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Uganda launches Africa’s first clinical trial for an mRNA vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus. The Bundibugyo outbreak is centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo and is described as the second-largest Ebola epidemic worldwide. The Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI), in collaboration with Moderna, will move the Moderna mRNA vaccine into testing in Congo alongside a second candidate developed by the University of Oxford and the Serum Institute of India, both targeting Bundibugyo. Researchers are evaluating whether Merck’s Ervebo vaccine could offer cross-protection against Bundibugyo. The Uganda study is a Phase II trial, focusing on safety and immunogenicity, including children aged at least one year, with an intended enrollment of 224 volunteers. Previously, Moderna began a Canadian trial in August for adults 18–65. CEPI supports the effort, underscoring that children are among those most affected when Ebola strikes.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ出血熱ブンディブギョ株に対するmRNAワクチンのアフリカ初の臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で発生中のエボラ・ブンディブギョ株の流行（『世界で2番目に大きいエボラ流行』と記述）を背景としたワクチン臨床試験開始を報じており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を満たすためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでのワクチン臨床試験だが、実際のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行はDRCで発生中とされる。ウガンダ・英国・カナダ・インドは臨床試験実施国/協力機関所在地であり、発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: GAVI compra 1,5 millones de dosis de vacuna experimental contra el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: GAVI buys 1.5 million doses of an experimental Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: GAVI purchased 1.5 million doses of an experimental Ebola vaccine to address the outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. There is currently no approved vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain responsible for the outbreak, which has caused more than 5,700 deaths and about 11,000 infections since May 2026 (WHO). Candidate vaccines, including the ChAdOx1 adenoviral vector developed by Serum Institute of India and the University of Oxford, are entering trial phases after GAVI committed to procure 1.5 million doses. Officials hope trials conclude in early 2027, possibly the first quarter under optimistic assumptions. Separately, Moderna is developing an mRNA Ebola vaccine undergoing clinical trials in Uganda. GAVI also maintains a reserve of 500,000 Ervebo doses and recently tested efficacy against Bundibugyo. Distribution aims to reach conflict zones and counter vaccine hesitancy.

triage.headline_ja: GAVI、エボラ実験的ワクチンを150万回分購入
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で進行中のエボラ(Bundibugyo株)アウトブレイクにより死者5,700人超・感染者約11,000人という深刻な被害が継続しており、国際機関(GAVI、WHO)による大規模なワクチン調達・対応が行われている。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部での進行中エボラ(Bundibugyo株)アウトブレイクへの対応（GAVIによるワクチン調達）が主題。インド(ワクチン開発元Serum Institute)、イギリス(Oxford大学)、ウガンダ(Moderna臨床試験実施国)は発生地域ではなく技術・製造・試験関連国として言及されているため、verified_locationsから除外した。既に大規模な死者・感染者数が報告されている進行中の重大アウトブレイクであり、続報としてPICKUP判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Dia D Minas Unida Contra o Aedes mobiliza 54 municípios do Norte de Minas nesse sábado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: D-Day: Minas United Against Aedes mobilizes 54 municipalities in Northern Minas this Saturday.
article.articleSummary: On 28 November 2026, 54 municipalities within the Montes Claros Regional Health Superintendency in Northern Minas Gerais join the Day D mobilization Minas Unida Against Aedes aegypti. Activities from 7:00 include educational blitzes, talks, home visits, informational materials, dengue vaccination for children and adolescents aged 10–14, and removal of water-holding items. In Montes Claros, events start at Santos Reis Square and extend to about 30 neighborhoods for cleaning of tires, bottles, and other containers that can breed mosquitoes. Officials warn that rains and higher temperatures boost Aedes aegypti proliferation and transmission risk. Northern Minas reports 7,900 dengue cases and six deaths this year, plus 71 chikungunya and two zika. Across the 54 municipalities, 6,984 dengue cases and four deaths; two additional deaths under investigation. Statewide: 50,083 dengue cases and 54 deaths; 15,788 chikungunya cases and six deaths. Health guidance: eliminate standing water, keep yards clean, seek care for symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 「D-Day：ミナスがAedesに立ち向かう」が今週土曜日に北ミナス54市町村を動員
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル北ミナス地域でデング熱等の継続的流行が報告されているが、本記事は既存の防疫啓発活動の案内であり新規異常事態ではないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊媒介性感染症対策の啓発イベント告知が主題。デング・チクングニア・ジカの症例数は既存の流行状況の報告であり、新規性・異常性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: അഞ്ചാംപനി വ്യാപനം രൂക്ഷം: 26 വര്‍ഷത്തിന് ശേഷം യു എസിന് മുക്ത പദവി നഷ്ടമായി; ഇന്ത്യയിലും കേസുകള്‍ ഇരട്ടിയായി വര്‍ധിക്കുന്നു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe outbreak of the fifth fever: U.S. loses malaria-free status after 26 years; cases in India are doubling as well.
article.articleSummary: Global fifth fever outbreak intensifies: the United States loses its 26-year malaria-free status after sustained transmission of a single virus variant for over a year, according to PAHO/WHO; Mexico and Bolivia also lose malaria-free status. India reports doubling cases, with 28,605 cases Jan–Sep 2026 (WHO regional verification), up from 12,313 in 2025. In the US, 6,039 cases were recorded by Nov 24, 2026 (CDC), compared with 2,289 in 2025. Kindergarten MMR vaccination coverage fell from 95.2% (2019–20) to 92.4% (2025–26), leaving about 280,000 children at risk. India’s National Measles-Rubella elimination drive continues, with first-dose coverage at 93.7% and second-dose 92.2% (target ≥95%), hindered by hesitancy and logistical barriers. Fifth fever is airborne; one case can spread to about 18. Global 2024 deaths: ~95,000, mainly unvaccinated under-five; vaccines have averted ~59 million deaths since 2000.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹（五号病）の流行が深刻化：26年ぶりに米国が麻疹排除国の地位を喪失、インドでも症例数が倍増
triage.triage_reason: 米国が26年ぶりに麻疹排除国の地位を喪失し、インドでも症例が倍増するなど、国際的な拡大と公衆衛生への深刻な影響が確認されるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事は米国・メキシコ・ボリビアでの麻疹排除国地位喪失とインドでの症例倍増を主題としているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはインドのみ。米国・メキシコ・ボリビアは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。ワクチン接種率低下とR0約18という高い感染力が流行しやすさを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Kinshasa-Brazzaville : les personnes âgées ciblées par la vaccination synchronisée contre le choléra - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kinshasa–Brazzaville: elderly people targeted by synchronized vaccination against cholera - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa and Brazzaville launched a synchronized cholera vaccination campaign targeting the elderly and children aged two years and older in riverine areas as part of the 'Fleuve sans choléra' project to interrupt transmission along the Congo River corridor. The first phase ran 24–28 November 2026, with cross-border coordination as Kinshasa’s authorities crossed the Congo River to Brazzaville. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, operations are led by INSP with technical and financial support from Gavi, WHO, UNICEF, and AFENET. The vaccination is described as safe, effective, and free, and is complemented by strengthened epidemiological surveillance and improved cross-border coordination. Communities are urged to participate and maintain hygiene and sanitation. The initiative aims to curb the epidemic in affected localities and support long-term cholera elimination along the river corridor.

triage.headline_ja: キンシャサ・ブラザビル：高齢者を対象としたコレラ同時ワクチン接種キャンペーン
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ川回廊沿いで進行中のコレラ流行に対し、国際機関（Gavi、WHO、UNICEF等）が支援する越境ワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施されており、継続的な感染拡大リスクと国際的関与が認められるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はキンシャサ（DRC）とブラザビル（コンゴ共和国）間の同時ワクチン接種キャンペーンを報じているが、コンゴ共和国（Republic of the Congo）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。背景にある流行自体は既知のコンゴ川沿いコレラ流行であり、新規性は低いが国際支援を伴う継続的公衆衛生イベントとして評価した。

article.articleHeadline: Rondônia inicia plano de microeliminação das hepatites virais em Guajará-Mirim pelo programa Brasil Saudável
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rondônia begins micro-elimination plan for viral hepatitis in Guajará-Mirim through the Brasil Saudável program.
article.articleSummary: Rondônia launches a micro-elimination plan for hepatitis B, C, and D in Guajará-Mirim, Rondônia, under the Brasil Saudável program, initiated on November 26, 2026. Led by Agevisa and the State HIV/AIDS and Viral Hepatitis Surveillance Nucleus in partnership with Brazil’s Ministry of Health, the effort targets Guajará-Mirim as one of three municipalities (alongside Lábrea, Amazonas, and Santarém, Pará) to address six indigenous peoples totaling 6,375 individuals across 77 villages. The plan mobilizes local health networks—the Specialized Care Service, Municipal Epidemiological Surveillance, Border Laboratory, Special Indigenous Health District, Indigenous Health House, and the Federal Institute of Rondônia—for diagnosis, prevention, and treatment of hepatitis B, C, and D with culturally informed approaches. A technical visit to Aldeia Tanajura (58 Oro Nao families) marked the kickoff. Authorities emphasize community engagement, logistics planning, and sustained dialogue with Indigenous leadership to strengthen health protection in border areas. Keywords: vaccination, outbreak, public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: ロンドニア州、グアジャラ・ミリンでブラジル健康プログラムによるウイルス性肝炎のマイクロエリミネーション計画を開始
triage.triage_reason: これは既存の公衆衛生プログラム（肝炎マイクロエリミネーション計画）の開始を報じるもので、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではなく、通常の保健施策に関する記事である。
triage.notes: 本記事は先住民コミュニティにおける既知のB型・C型・D型肝炎に対する予防・診断・治療の計画的プログラム開始を報じるものであり、新規または異常な感染症イベントではない。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、本件は通常の保健事業であるためシグナルとしては見送り。

article.articleHeadline: Nytt ebolavaccin testas i Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola vaccine tested in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Moderna’s mRNA Ebola vaccine is the second candidate to begin testing in Uganda within a month; at the end of October, a vaccine from Ervebo started trials in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Both vaccines are testing against the Ebola variant driving the large outbreak centered in the DRC, which has caused more than 5,300 deaths. Uganda has kept its Ebola outbreak under control and was declared Ebola-free in August. The World Health Organization has approved another vaccine for testing. The report highlights concurrent vaccine evaluations linked to the DRC outbreak and regional containment efforts, illustrating international momentum to expand vaccination options for Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: 新型エボラワクチン、ウガンダで治験開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事はDRCで進行中の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（死者5,300人超）に対するワクチン治験の進捗報告であり、新規シグナルというより既知アウトブレイクの続報的内容だが、死亡規模が大きく進行中のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで継続中の大規模エボラアウトブレイクに対するワクチン治験（モデルナ社mRNAワクチン、Ervebo）の進捗であり、新規発生ではない。ウガンダは『エボラフリー宣言済み』で治験実施国として言及されているのみのため対象国に含めず。既存の重大アウトブレイクとしてフルRRAの要否を含め経過観察が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Ponta Porã: Com surto de escabiose no Estado, Saúde de Ponta Porã faz alerta e orienta população - Ponta Porã Informa - Notícias de Ponta Porã/MS e Pedro Juan Caballero/PY
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ponta Porã: Amid a scabies outbreak in the state, Ponta Porã Health Department issues alert and guides the population - Ponta Porã Informs - News from Ponta Porã/MS and Pedro Juan Caballero/PY.
article.articleSummary: Scabies outbreaks are ongoing in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with border-area cases in Ponta Porã and Pedro Juan Caballero. Although Ponta Porã has no confirmed surge yet, border-area cases have been confirmed, but records are not sufficient to characterize an outbreak in the municipality; state-wide transmission has increased and municipalities report outbreaks. The Ponta Porã Health Secretariat, with CIEVS-Fronteira and SUS, is intensifying guidance. Scabies is caused by Sarcoptes scabiei and spreads mainly through direct skin contact and shared personal items. Common affected areas include interdigital spaces, wrists, armpits, breast/nipple areas, and genitals. Symptoms: intense nocturnal itch, small blisters, crusted lesions, and thin serpiginous tracks. Prevention emphasizes not sharing clothing, bedding, towels, and ensuring proper washing; unwashable items should be sealed in plastic bags. Treatment with topical or oral medications stops transmission within 24 hours; itch may persist weeks. Seek evaluation at a Basic Health Unit for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: ポンタポラン：州内で疥癬の流行発生、ポンタポラン保健局が警戒を発し住民に注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は公衆衛生上重症度が低く、国際的拡大や渡航貿易制限のリスクもないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当せず社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 疥癬はブラジル・マトグロッソドスル州の地域的な流行であり、重症度・国際的拡大リスクは低い。パラグアイとの国境地域の事例も言及されているが、対象国リストにパラグアイは含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana: 'Dwiibaadwiibaa' (Scabies) - The Itchy Condition You Should Not Ignore
article.articleSummary: Scabies (Sarcoptes scabiei) is a parasitic skin infestation, known in Ghana as dwiibaadwiibaa. In a Ghana case, ESI Mansa developed itchy rashes after heat-related symptoms; diagnosis progressed from suspected dermatitis to confirmed scabies, treated with permethrin cream and ivermectin tablets. WHO describes scabies as a skin infestation with intense itching and burrows, spread mainly by prolonged skin-to-skin contact; transmission via shared clothing is possible but less common. Crusted (Norwegian) scabies is a severe form affecting the immunocompromised or elderly and spreading more easily. Worldwide, WHO estimates over 200 million people affected at any time and more than 400 million annually; in Africa, about 5.7% of children, higher (9.4%) in certain Ghanaian studies. A 2025 BMC Public Health study in Ghana’s Bono Region (Wenchi and Tain) found 9.4% prevalence among 164 people, with Abekwai 3 at 13.5% and gaps in awareness delaying care. Emphasize education and timely treatment to prevent complications.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ：「ドゥイーバードゥイーバー」（疥癬）—無視してはいけないかゆみを伴う症状
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は既知の風土病的皮膚疾患であり、本記事は一般啓発・教育目的の内容で、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 疥癬は慢性的・地域流行的な皮膚疾患であり、本記事はガーナ・ボノ地域における啓発記事。緊急性のあるアウトブレイクではない。

article.articleHeadline: Automated Urine Assay Improves Paediatric Tuberculosis Detection in
article.articleSummary: Automated PATHFAST TB LAM Ag urine chemiluminescent immunoassay detected 83% of microbiologically confirmed TB cases in HIV-infected, and 67% in HIV-uninfected hospitalized children with presumptive TB in Zambia, outperforming Determine TB-LAM and an in-house IS6110 urine PCR on the same samples. The urine sub-study (PROMISE-TB) analyzed 339 children at University Teaching Hospital, Lusaka, and Arthur Davison Children’s Hospital, Ndola, using archived urine collected 2013–2015; 63 had microbiologically confirmed TB, 276 were negative on respiratory testing. Context highlights extensive pediatric TB diagnostic gaps per WHO TB Report 2025, with ~52% of under-fives undiagnosed and 1.2 million cases and 172,000 deaths in 2024. LAM is a non-invasive biomarker; WHO guidance centers Determine LAM for hospitalized adults and HIV‑positive children, while newer urine assays show variable sensitivity. PATHFAST’s higher sensitivity with preserved specificity suggests potential for improving pediatric TB detection in low-resource settings.

triage.headline_ja: 自動化尿検査法、ザンビアの入院小児コホートにおける小児結核検出を改善
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は診断法研究に関する学術的報告であり、新規発生やアウトブレイクに関する情報ではないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は2013-2015年に収集された検体を用いた診断精度研究（PROMISE-TB）の報告であり、感染症アウトブレイクや急性の公衆衛生事象ではない。結核は既知の慢性感染症であり、本記事の内容は診断技術の改善に関するものでイベント性がないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Dia D contra dengue terá soltura de mosquitos em terras indígenas de Amambai
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: D-Day to combat dengue will involve releasing mosquitoes on Amambai's indigenous lands.
article.articleSummary: Dengue, chikungunya, and Zika control efforts in Brazil include releasing Wolbachia-infected and sterile male mosquitoes on indigenous lands in Amambai, Mato Grosso do Sul, and in Garanhuns, Pernambuco, on Saturday, November 28, as part of a D-Day campaign. A government prevention push also uses WhatsApp and Gov.br messages, with educational outreach and community actions to eliminate Aedes breeding sites. As of epidemiological week 44 (through November 13), Mato Grosso do Sul recorded 2,327 confirmed dengue cases, 4,030 under investigation, one confirmed dengue death and another under investigation. Chikungunya totals were 11,231 confirmed cases, 13,311 under investigation, and 33 deaths, with 128 pregnant women affected. The emphasis remains eliminating standing water to curb transmission ahead of the arbovirus peak season.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策の「D-デー」、アマンバイの先住民族の土地で蚊を放出
triage.triage_reason: 記事はブラジルにおけるデング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱対策のための定期的な蚊媒介対策キャンペーン（ウォルバキア感染蚊・不妊化雄蚊の放出）に関する報道であり、既知の季節的流行への通常の予防対応である。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はマットグロッソ・ド・スル州とペルナンブコ州における蚊媒介感染症対策キャンペーンの定期報道。症例数データ（デング2327例、チクングニア11231例、33死亡）は既存の流行状況の疫学週報告であり、新規の異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: OMS alerta para estagnação do combate ao sarampo no mundo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of stagnation in the global fight against measles.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns progress toward measles elimination stagnates amid rising misinformation, as the United States loses elimination status due to declining vaccination coverage. The COVID-19 pandemic disrupted vaccination programs, and many countries struggle to restore pre-pandemic coverage. Last year measles caused 9.8 million cases and 72,000 deaths; 59 countries had outbreaks in 2025, 11 of which had previously eliminated measles. Latin America reported 58,795 cases and 84 deaths from Jan 1 to Nov 14, 2026. Brazil maintains elimination after recovery in 2024, with 70 cases in 2026, down 99.7% from 2019. The U.S. outbreak is the worst in three decades with over 5,400 cases in 2026. First-dose coverage was 84% and second-dose 77% in 2025; Gabon and the Central African Republic have not added a second dose. About 20.8 million children received no vaccine in 2025; 8.3 million had only one dose. A 95% two-dose target is needed to stop transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、世界的な麻疹対策の停滞を警告
triage.triage_reason: 記事はWHOによる世界的な麻疹対策停滞に関する包括的報告であり、対象国の中で言及されているブラジルは麻疹排除状態を維持し症例数も減少傾向にあるため、具体的な流行シグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: 記事は世界的な麻疹排除停滞に関するWHOの一般報告で、米国・ガボン・中央アフリカ共和国の状況にも言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれない。ブラジルは麻疹排除状態を維持し、2026年の症例数は2019年比99.7%減と良好な状況であり、具体的な新規アウトブレイクの兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: L'Ouganda lance le premier essai clinique en Afrique d'un vaccin à ARNm contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda launches Africa's first clinical trial of an mRNA vaccine against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Uganda announces Africa’s first clinical trial of an mRNA Ebola vaccine, targeting the Bundibugyo strain, with the Uganda Virus Research Institute and Moderna. The trial, focused on safety and immunogenicity, will enroll 224 volunteers aged 1 year and older, and marks the second human study after Moderna’s August launch in Canada (18–65 years). The Ugandan trial will also inform next-phase testing in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the Bundibugyo outbreak has centered and is described as the second-largest Ebola epidemic ever recorded globally. In parallel, a separate vaccine targeting Bundibugyo by the University of Oxford and Serum Institute of India is set for trials in the DRC. Scientists are evaluating whether Merck’s Ervebo vaccine, which targets a different Ebola strain, could offer cross-protection. CEPI funding underscores the need to bring vaccines to children, often hardest hit in outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、アフリカ初のエボラmRNAワクチン臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事はワクチン臨床試験開始に関する研究開発ニュースであり新規アウトブレイクの検知情報ではないが、DRCでのBundibugyo株流行が「史上2番目に大きいエボラ流行」と言及されており、進行中の重大な公衆衛生事象として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はワクチン臨床試験開始であり新規アウトブレイクの一次検知情報ではない。ウガンダ・カナダ・インドは試験実施国・開発機関所在地であり、実際の感染発生国はDRCのみ。DRCのBundibugyo株流行の規模・進行状況について続報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: إيبولا لا يزال يشكل حالة طوارئ صحية دولية في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 November 2026, the World Health Organization confirms that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) under the International Health Regulations (IHR, 2005). Following an Emergency Committee meeting chaired by Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, WHO updated its recommendations for the response. The outbreak has surpassed 12,000 cases and about 5,900 deaths to date. Persistent insecurity and attacks on health-care facilities continue to hinder outbreak response activities, limiting surveillance, case management, and containment efforts. The situation maintains international concern and underscores the ongoing challenges of delivering effective public health interventions amid instability in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:エボラ出血熱はコンゴ民主共和国において国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)であり続けている
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを継続認定しており、致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が1万2千例超・死者約5900人に達し、治安悪化により対応が阻害されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: WHOによりPHEICとして継続認定されている既知の大規模アウトブレイク。治安悪化による対応阻害が継続的リスクとなっている。

article.articleHeadline: Porto Velho registra queda de 53% nos casos confirmados de covid-19 em outubro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Porto Velho records a 53% drop in confirmed COVID-19 cases in October.
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho, Brazil, reported 57 confirmed COVID-19 cases in October 2026, a 53% drop from 121 in October 2025. By November 24, 2026, the city had 21 cases in November to date, versus 68 for the full November 2025 period. The Municipal Coordination for Surveillance of Influenza, COVID-19 and Other Respiratory Viruses (Semusa) reported no COVID-19–related Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) cases or deaths through November 24. Semusa continues ongoing surveillance of virus circulation and epidemiological indicators to detect changes and guide prevention. The Fiocruz InfoGripe bulletin shows some regions with rising SARS cases linked to COVID-19, but overall incidence remains low. Vaccination remains the principal preventive measure, with 2026 Ministry of Health guidance specifying interval schedules by groups; residents are advised to visit the nearest Basic Health Unit with vaccination card to check for pending doses. Ongoing surveillance and vaccination are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: ポルトヴェーリョ市、10月のCOVID-19確定症例数が53%減少
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19症例数は前年比で大幅減少しており、SARS関連死亡例もなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの地方都市における定例サーベイランス報告であり、症例数は減少傾向。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、本記事の内容はルーチンな疫学報告でシグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Taguatinga e Ceilândia recebem ações de combate à dengue neste sábado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taguatinga and Ceilândia receive dengue control actions this Saturday.
article.articleSummary: Dengue control actions unfold in Taguatinga and Ceilândia, Federal District, Brazil, on Saturday, November 28, 2026, including environmental surveillance to identify and eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites, preventive guidance, and dengue vaccination for children and adolescents aged 10–14. In Taguatinga, activities start at 8:30 a.m. at Praça do Bicalho, Praça do Relógio, Avenida Comercial and around Taguacenter; teams will search for larvae and mosquitoes transmitting dengue, chikungunya and Zika. Vaccination will be offered at UBS 2 Taguatinga (Praça do Bicalho). Ceilândia actions begin at 8:00 a.m. in QNO 18 and 19, with similar surveillance; involvement of Corpo de Bombeiros, SLU, and DF Legal. Between Jan 4 and Nov 21, 2026, the Distrito Federal recorded 4,687 suspected dengue cases (1,178 in the Southwest Health Region, including Taguatinga, Vicente Pires, Águas Claras, Samambaia, Recanto das Emas, Água Quente); 278 probable chikungunya cases (56 in these areas).

triage.headline_ja: タギャティンガとセイランディアで今週土曜日にデング熱対策活動が実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の公衆衛生対策（予防接種・環境調査）の実施報告であり、異常な増加や重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は定例的なデング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱媒介蚊対策活動の告知であり、症例数は報告されているが例年の流行状況の範囲内と考えられる。地方自治体による通常の公衆衛生活動であり、国際的な関心や緊急対応の必要性は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en République démocratique du Congo : lancement des essais du vaccin à ARN messager en Ouganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Launch of mRNA vaccine trials in Uganda
article.articleSummary: On 27 November 2026, the Ugandan Virus Research Institute announced Uganda has launched Phase 1 trials of an experimental mRNA Ebola vaccine to quell the latest outbreak that began in the eastern part of neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo. The trial, conducted in collaboration with Moderna, targets the Ebola Bundibugyo strain, a rare variant behind the epidemic that has killed more than 5,500 people since May, with most deaths in the DRC. This marks the first mRNA vaccine trial for this strain. The development underscores ongoing efforts to address Ebola outbreaks centered in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：ウガンダでmRNAワクチンの治験開始
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で発生中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行は5月以降5,500人以上の死者を出しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と地域的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでのmRNAワクチン治験開始を報じているが、アウトブレイク自体はDRC東部が中心であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。致死者数5,500人超という規模と希少株（ブンディブギョ株）である点から高い懸念度。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox já foi confirmada em 20 cidades do Ceará; veja lista dos municípios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox has already been confirmed in 20 cities in Ceará; see the list of municipalities.
article.articleSummary: Mpox has been confirmed in 20 municipalities in Ceará, Brazil, with 230 total confirmations; Fortaleza accounts for 190 (about 82.6%). Caucaia has 9 and Sobral 7; 19 other municipalities also report cases. Ceará has 789 mpox-related notifications: 230 confirmed, 229 discarded, 329 under investigation, and one probable case. The first confirmed case in 2026 occurred in February; after a lull, cases rose from late October into November, peaking on November 13 with 17 new cases. Most confirmed patients are male, aged 24–51; only two women. Mpox presents with fever, headache, myalgia, fatigue, lymphadenopathy, and skin/mucosal lesions that can appear on face, hands, mouth, or genital/anal regions. Transmission is via close contact with lesions or secretions, sexual contact, shared items, or prolonged respiratory exposure. Prevention: avoid direct contact with lesions, do not share personal items, practice hand hygiene, avoid close contact during symptoms, and isolate until lesions heal.

triage.headline_ja: セアラ州の20都市でMpoxが確認、市町村リストを公開
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・セアラ州で230例の確定例が報告され拡大傾向にあるが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は不明であり、既知の疾患であるためIHR基準の該当は限定的。
triage.notes: 地元メディア報道で局地的な症例数増加を伝えているが、重症度や死亡例の記載はなく、国家レベル・国際的な懸念拡大の情報は不明。続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: Lancement des essais du vaccin à ARN messager en Ouganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Launch of mRNA vaccine trials in Uganda
article.articleSummary: As of 27 November 2026, Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in the east, has killed more than 5,500 people since May. Uganda has launched phase 1 trials of an experimental mRNA vaccine developed with Moderna, tested against the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, a rare variant fueling the epidemic. The Ugandan Virus Research Institute announced the initiation of the first messenger RNA vaccine trial in collaboration with Moderna. The trial seeks to provide a preventive option against the Bundibugyo strain driving the outbreak that started in eastern DRC. The report does not specify clinical details such as symptoms or laboratory confirmation.

triage.triage_reason: DRCで5500人以上の死者を出す進行中のエボラ流行があり、稀少なBundibugyo株による国際的拡大の懸念とワクチン治験という国際的対応が報じられているため、フルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Dia D contra a dengue acontece neste sábado (28) em Sorocaba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: D-Day Against Dengue Takes Place This Saturday (28) in Sorocaba
article.articleSummary: As of November 27, 2026, a D-Day against dengue is held Saturday, November 28, in Sorocaba and across São Paulo state. Zoonoses teams will inspect properties identified as Aedes aegypti breeding sites from 8:00 to 14:00, while the Health Secretariat (SES) conducts educational activities from 9:00 to 13:00 at Parque da Água Vermelha João Câncio Pereira (Rua România, 150, Jardim Europa) and CEI-17 Issa Latuf (Rua Marechal Castelo Branco, 242, Jardim Sandra). Residents are urged to eliminate standing water in pots, bottles, tires and other containers, wash animal water bowls, add sand to plant dishes, and clean gutters and drains, ensuring water tanks are sealed or screened. São Paulo state reports 65,671 dengue cases and 45 deaths in 2026. Prevention must be year-round; reports of potential Aedes aegypti breeding in Sorocaba can be made via 156, Central 156 website, Casas do Cidadão, or WhatsApp (15) 99691-2783 (8–17h). Collaboration aims to reduce dengue, chikungunya, and Zika transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 11月28日(土)にソロカバでデング熱対策「Dデー」実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州における定例のデング熱予防啓発キャンペーンの告知記事であり、新規性・異常性は認められず、既知の流行状況下でのルーチン活動である。
triage.notes: サンパウロ州全体で2026年にデング熱65,671例・死亡45例の報告があるが、これは年間累計データであり、本記事自体は地域の定例予防キャンペーンの告知。既存の流行対策活動であり新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Qatar lifts Ebola-related travel curbs on Ugandans, says Alan Kasujja
article.articleSummary: Qatar has lifted Ebola-related travel restrictions on Ugandans, with normal entry and transit through Doha resuming; Ugandans recruited via licensed agencies may again work in Qatar under standard entry and work requirements. Uganda’s 2026 Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak was declared over in August by the WHO and Africa CDC after 42 consecutive days with no new confirmed cases. In concurrent UN updates, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reported the safe evacuation of WHO staff and DRC Health Ministry officials from a hospital in Akwe, Ituri Province, amid heavy fighting, and noted a temporary relocation of the WHO Ebola team from Mongbwalu due to rising insecurity. The safeguarding of health workers and responders remains a priority while Ebola operations adapt to security challenges in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: カタール、ウガンダ人に対するエボラ関連渡航制限を解除、アラン・カスッジャ氏が発表
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダの2026年ブンディブギョ・エボラ流行はWHO/Africa CDCにより既に終息宣言されており、本記事はカタールの渡航制限解除という収束後の行政措置に関する内容。対象国（DRC含む）における新規感染症発生の主題ではない。
triage.notes: ウガンダのエボラ流行は終息済みであり対象国リストにも含まれない。DRCに関する記述は治安悪化によるWHO職員・DRC保健省職員の退避の話であり、新規エボラ発生の報告ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Η Ουγκάντα ​​ξεκινά την πρώτη στην Αφρική δοκιμή εμβολίου mRNA κατά του στελέχους Bundibugyo του ιού Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda launches Africa's first trial of an mRNA vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Uganda launches Africa's first clinical trial of an mRNA vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus, announced by the Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI) in collaboration with Moderna. The Bundibugyo outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is the world’s second-largest. The Moderna vaccine will soon enter trials in Congo alongside another Bundibugyo vaccine developed by the University of Oxford and Serum Institute of India. Researchers are also assessing whether Merck's Ervebo, which targets a different Ebola strain, may offer cross-protection against Bundibugyo. The Ugandan trial is the second for this vaccine, following a Canadian adult trial in August (ages 18–65). In Uganda, the study will test safety and immunogenicity in children aged 1 year and older, enrolling up to 224 volunteers. CEPI funds the effort; CEPI CEO Richard Hatchett notes that children are often heavily affected yet slow to benefit.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ出血熱ブンディブギョ株に対するmRNAワクチンのアフリカ初の臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中とされる世界第2位規模のブンディブギョ株エボラ流行に言及しているが、本記事の主眼はワクチン臨床試験開始の報であり、現行の症例数・死亡者数・拡大状況等の詳細情報が不足しているため、現時点ではフルRRAに進めず経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は主にワクチン臨床試験（ウガンダ、カナダ、将来的にコンゴ）に関する内容であり、DRCでの実際の症例動向・公衆衛生対応の詳細は含まれていない。ウガンダ、インド、カナダは臨床試験実施国/ワクチン開発関連国であり、実際の疾病発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Alertan sobre aumento de notificaciones por posible dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning about an increase in notifications of possible dengue.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 November 2026, dengue surveillance in Paraguay shows no new confirmed cases or active virus circulation, despite an average of 318 weekly reports of suspected infections. The highest levels of suspicion are in Central, Asunción, Itapúa, San Pedro and Alto Paraná. The last three epidemiological weeks recorded no new infections, outbreaks or related deaths. Authorities urge reinforced prevention ahead of upcoming rains, since water in containers and discarded items can sustain Aedes aegypti and other arboviruses, including chikungunya. Recommended measures: remove water-holding objects, store discarded items under cover, close water deposits, treat pools, and daily change water in animal drinkers. Also wash containers, place damp sand in flower vases, drain plant saucers, clean gutters, and keep drainage unobstructed. Seek medical care for fever, headache, or muscle pains; there have been 294 dengue diagnoses in Paraguay this year.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱疑い例の通知増加について警告
triage.triage_reason: 記事はパラグアイにおけるデング熱サーベイランス状況の定期報告であり、新規確定症例や異常な流行は報告されていない。また対象国リストに該当する国（フィリピン等）での発生は言及されていない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にフィリピンの地名が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はパラグアイのデング熱サーベイランスのみであり、フィリピンでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。パラグアイは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列。

article.articleHeadline: Ny ebolavaksine testes i Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola vaccine tested in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Uganda is testing an experimental Ebola vaccine variant targeting the Bundibugyo strain as part of a public-health initiative. The Bundibugyo variant has driven an outbreak in neighboring Congo (DRC) since May, with 5,700 confirmed deaths and 11,000 confirmed cases reported by the World Health Organization. Two experimental vaccine variants will be tested from Monday in eastern Congo, focusing on close contacts and high-risk groups. Uganda is testing one of these vaccines, developed by Moderna (United States). The outbreak briefly spread to Uganda in the summer, but Uganda has contained the virus.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダで新型エボラワクチンの試験開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で5月以降続くエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の大規模アウトブレイクで死者5,700人・症例11,000人に達し、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境拡大は言及されているが、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。米国(Moderna)はワクチン開発企業所在地であり発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde promove Dia D de combate à dengue, Zika e chikungunya neste sábado - Metro 1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health promotes D-Day to combat dengue, Zika and chikungunya this Saturday.
article.articleSummary: Brazil launches D-Day on Saturday, November 28, 2026, to combat dengue, Zika and chikungunya, prioritizing elimination of water-holding containers to reduce Aedes aegypti. The Unified Health System (SUS) coordinates prevention and control actions across states and municipalities. The Ministry of Health will roll out a national arbovirus prevention campaign and send personalized messages via WhatsApp and Gov.br to over 30 million people, guiding prevention and mosquito-control measures. Planned activities include educational outreach, community mobilization, cycling events, and life-cycle guidance. Eleven states have programs on Saturday, with twelve more during the week. From January to October 2026, Brazil recorded a 67% reduction in probable dengue cases compared with the same period in 2025, totaling about 489,100 dengue records in 2026 so far.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、今週土曜日にデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱対策の「Dデー」を実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル政府による定例的な予防啓発キャンペーンであり、デング熱症例は前年比67%減少と報告されている。異常な増加や新たな公衆衛生上の脅威は見られない。
triage.notes: 記事は政府の予防啓発活動に関する内容で、症例数は前年より大幅に減少している。シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: mRNA Ebola vaccine trial starts in Uganda: Institute
article.articleSummary: Uganda’s Uganda Virus Research Institute, in collaboration with Moderna, has launched Africa’s first mRNA phase 1 Ebola vaccine trial, testing an investigational Bundibugyo ebolavirus vaccine in 224 healthy volunteers aged 1–65 to assess safety and immunogenicity. The move accompanies two other experimental vaccines slated to begin testing in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, the epicenter of the current Bundibugyo-strain outbreak, targeting contacts of cases and other high-risk groups. The DRC outbreak has produced more than 11,000 cases and over 5,700 confirmed deaths since May, according to the WHO. Despite a long border with eastern DRC, Uganda has contained the virus after earlier imported cases and was declared Ebola-free in August following 20 cases, including two deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでmRNAエボラワクチンの治験が開始：研究所発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の流行は5月以降11,000例超、死亡5,700例超と極めて深刻であり、国境を越えてウガンダにも波及した実績がある。IHR基準複数該当のためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでのmRNAワクチン治験開始だが、背景にあるDRCのエボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株、11,000例超・死亡5,700例超）が本質的なイベントであるため、DRCのみを対象国として記載。ウガンダは既に8月にエボラ終息宣言済みで対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'Ouganda teste un vaccin Moderna, le Gavi achète 1,5 million de doses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Uganda tests a Moderna vaccine, Gavi buys 1.5 million doses.
article.articleSummary: Experimental Ebola vaccines commence testing in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo to curb the Bundibugyo strain outbreak, which has caused about 11,000 cases and over 5,700 deaths since May, predominantly in the DRC. Uganda, the neighboring country with roughly 20 cases and two deaths and which declared its outbreak over in August, is not the primary site but hosts vaccine efforts. Two trials begin in the DRC: a Moderna mRNA Ebola vaccine in a Phase 1 trial enrolling 224 healthy volunteers aged 1–65 to assess immunogenicity, described as Africa's first mRNA Phase 1 study; and Serum Institute/Oxford’s ChAdOx1 adenoviral vector vaccine. Gavi signs a purchase for 1.5 million doses from Serum Institute, while maintaining a stock of 500,000 Ervebo doses that were recently tested for efficacy against Bundibugyo. Gavi aims to support deployment in conflict zones and counter misinformation; U.S. funding support was reaffirmed in June, with hopes for results by early to mid-2027.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：ウガンダがモデルナ製ワクチンを試験、Gaviが150万回分を購入
triage.triage_reason: DRCで約11,000症例・5,700人以上の死亡という大規模なエボラアウトブレイクが継続中で、近隣国ウガンダへの拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。記事では主にDRCでの大規模流行とワクチン試験・調達（Gavi、Moderna、Serum Institute）が焦点。

article.articleHeadline: Nova variante da Covid-19 avança no país e entra no radar da OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New COVID-19 variant advances in the country and enters the WHO's radar.
article.articleSummary: New SARS-CoV-2 lineage PJ.2.1 is circulating in Brazil and is under World Health Organization monitoring as a Variant Under Monitoring. Descendant of Omicron, it was first identified in Canada and has since been documented across Brazil, with notable predominance in Rio de Janeiro in genomic analyses conducted with the Municipal Health Secretariat. Other states reporting detections include São Paulo, Espírito Santo, the Federal District, Rio Grande do Sul, and Santa Catarina. Clinically, PJ.2.1 presents with typical Omicron-like symptoms: fatigue, body aches, and headaches, often resembling a common cold or flu, making diagnosis based on symptoms unreliable. WHO and PAHO assess a low additional public health risk globally; no conclusive evidence of increased severity or mortality. Brazilian vaccination campaigns continue, with booster doses delivered to Basic Health Units; priority groups include pregnant individuals, the elderly, children, and other vulnerable populations.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの新変異株がブラジル国内で拡大、WHOの監視対象に
triage.triage_reason: WHOはこの変異株（PJ.2.1）について世界的な公衆衛生リスクは低いと評価しており、重症度や死亡率の増加を示す明確な証拠もないため、現時点でシグナルとして拾う必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 疾患名は『Influenza』と記載されているが、記事内容はCOVID-19新変異株(PJ.2.1)に関するものであり、BluedotのAPI分類に誤りがある可能性が高い。WHO/PAHOは低リスクと評価しており、通常の変異株モニタリング報道と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola - L'Alliance du vaccin achète 1,5 million de doses de vaccin face à l'épidémie en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola - Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance buys 1.5 million vaccine doses in response to the outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo strain has killed more than 5,700 people and infected about 11,000 since May, according to the WHO. Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance, announced a purchase agreement for 1.5 million doses of an experimental Ebola vaccine (ChAdOx1 vector) from Serum Institute of India for outbreak response. No licensed vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo; candidates were set to enter phase trials this week, including the ChAdOx1-based vaccine and a Moderna mRNA approach. Gavi hopes this investment will accelerate deployment if trials show positive signals, with aims to complete testing by early 2027 or, in the best case, by Q1 2027. Gavi previously activated its Rapid Response Fund for the DRC mpox outbreak in 2024. It works with local health partners and community leaders to deliver doses in conflict zones and combat vaccine hesitancy.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱 - ワクチンアライアンス(Gavi)がコンゴ民主共和国での流行に対応するためワクチン150万回分を購入
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行により5月以降5,700人以上が死亡、約11,000人が感染しており、深刻かつ異常な公衆衛生事象であり、国際機関(Gavi)による大規模な支援が行われていることからフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: インドはワクチン製造元(Serum Institute of India)として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。ライセンス済みワクチン・治療法が存在せず、紛争地域での対応という点からも管理の困難さが示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda inicia en África el primer ensayo clínico de vacuna de ARNm contra el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda Begins in Africa the First Clinical Trial of an mRNA Vaccine Against Ebola
article.articleSummary: Uganda launches Africa’s first Phase I trial of an Ebola mRNA vaccine, mRNA-1469-P102, developed by the Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI) with Moderna. The trial targets the Bundibugyo strain and has regulatory approval in Uganda; about 224 healthy volunteers aged 1–65 will be enrolled to assess safety and immunogenicity, including children from age one, with roughly one year of follow-up post-vaccination. This follows a Canada Phase I study in adults (18–65) initiated in August and aligns with WHO SAGE prioritization for vaccines amid the Democratic Republic of Congo’s (DRC) large Ebola outbreak. As of 24 November 2026, DR Congo reports 12,021 infections and 5,904 deaths; the outbreak, declared May 15, spans 69 health zones across eight provinces. The Uganda episode involved 20 confirmed cases (15 imported from DRC) and 2 deaths, which WHO declared over on 26 August. CEPI funds Moderna up to $58.5 million.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、アフリカ初のエボラ出血熱mRNAワクチンの臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）で12,021例・死亡5,904例に達する大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、国際的なワクチン開発・支援体制が動いていることから、深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念とフルリスク評価の必要性が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでのmRNAワクチン臨床試験開始だが、背景としてDRCの大規模エボラ流行（69保健区・8州、死亡率約49%）が強調されている。ウガンダ（対象国リスト外）およびカナダ（同）はverified_locationsから除外。DRCの流行状況は継続監視・フルリスク評価の対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Δραστική μείωση των μολύνσεων από δάγκειο πυρετό στα παιδιά με την απελευθέρωση "καλών" κουνουπιών στη Βραζιλία
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Drastic reduction in dengue infections in children following the release of "good" mosquitoes in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, declined by 69% in children after releasing Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti mosquitoes in 29 neighborhoods (EVITA study). The trial monitored over 5,000 children aged 6–11; releases of ~150 mosquitoes per container were repeated over months to establish a Wolbachia-infected local population. Wolbachia is transmitted maternally and reduces mosquitoes’ ability to transmit dengue, chikungunya, and Zika without eliminating the vector. Dengue and chikungunya infections fell 69% and 73% respectively; Zika infections also decreased, though numbers were too small for robust statistics. Results align with Indonesia’s 2021 Yogyakarta study showing a 77% dengue reduction. Brazil plans expansion to dozens of cities by 2027; a southern facility could produce up to 150 million Wolbachia-infected eggs weekly. The WHO will assess broader use of this intervention.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで「良い」蚊の放出によりデング熱の子供の感染が劇的に減少
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱対策（ウォルバキア感染蚊の放出）の成功事例を報じるポジティブな内容であり、公衆衛生上の脅威や異常な流行を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ベロオリゾンテでの感染症対策研究（EVITA試験）の成果報告。インドネシアの過去研究（2021年）への言及はあるが、現時点でのインドネシアでの発生事例ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Atriz do Sítio do Pica Pau Amarelo é internada com doença grave transmitida por mosquito
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Actress from Sítio do Pica Pau Amarelo is hospitalized with a serious mosquito-borne disease.
article.articleSummary: 81-year-old Brazilian actress Rosa Marya Colin was hospitalized in Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul, to treat leishmaniasis. She is stable, receiving intravenous treatment, and is expected to stay about 10 days; discharge could occur early next week if recovery continues without complications. Leishmaniasis is caused by Leishmania protozoa and transmitted by female phlebotomine sandflies, via bites; it is not transmitted directly person-to-person. The disease presents in tegumentary (cutaneous and mucosal) and visceral (kala-azar) forms, with visceral being more severe and potentially fatal if untreated. Brazil provides treatment through the SUS, with early diagnosis reducing complications. Prevention emphasizes avoiding sandfly bites with repellents, screens, protective clothing, and environmental controls. The actress is known for Tia Nastácia on Sítio do Picapau Amarelo; she remains active as a musician, with recent and upcoming shows, and has lived in Mato Grosso do Sul for about four years.

triage.headline_ja: 『黄色いキツツキの牧場』の女優、蚊が媒介する重い病気で入院
triage.triage_reason: 著名人個人の罹患事例を報じる記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常な集団発生や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: リーシュマニア症は媒介動物（サシチョウバエ）由来の風土病であり、人-人感染はない。本記事は個人の闘病報道であり、集団感染やアウトブレイクの情報は含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda inicia los ensayos de una vacuna de ARN mensajero contar el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda begins trials of an mRNA vaccine against Ebola
article.articleSummary: Uganda began Africa's first clinical trial of an mRNA Ebola vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo variant at the Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI) with Moderna. The study will enroll about 224 volunteers to assess safety and immunogenicity in children from age one. It is Moderna’s second human trial after August tests in Canada in adults 18–65. Future trials are planned in the Democratic Republic of the Congo for Bundibugyo, with Oxford/Serum Institute of India candidates, and assessment of cross-protection from Merck’s Ervebo. The neighboring DRC outbreak has surpassed 12,000 cases and about 6,000 deaths since May 2026, centered in the east, making it the second-largest global outbreak and the largest in DRC to date. CEPI notes children are often most affected but late beneficiaries.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ出血熱に対するmRNAワクチンの治験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事はワクチン治験が主題だが、隣接するDRCでのエボラアウトブレイクが1.2万症例・約6,000人死亡とDRC史上最大規模に達しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態としてPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の直接の主題はウガンダでのmRNAワクチン治験開始だが、DRCでの大規模エボラアウトブレイク（2026年5月以降、12,000例超・約6,000死亡）が背景情報として記載されており、こちらがシグナルの核心と判断。ウガンダ・インド・カナダは治験/ワクチン開発拠点であり発生国ではないため、verified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Justiça obriga o RS a detalhar em cinco dias o combate à esporotricose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Justice orders Rio Grande do Sul to detail within five days its fight against sporotrichosis.
article.articleSummary: Sporotrichosis, transmitted by cats, infected 1,465 people in Rio Grande do Sul in 2026, according to the State Health Secretariat; the Sporothrix fungus lives in soil, plants and organic matter, with diseased cats as the main transmission link to humans. A judge ordered the state to detail its fight against animal sporotrichosis within five days; Judge Patricia Antunes Laydner issued the Nov 26, 2026 decision after a civil action by the National Association of Animal Lawyers. The greatest concentration of human cases is in the Porto Alegre Metropolitan Region. In 2026, 2,510 animal notifications (dogs and cats) were made via voluntary reporting; coverage may be incomplete. The state must outline diagnostics expansion and the availability of itraconazole and potassium iodide, stock levels, demand forecasts, and city coverage. IPVDF lab analyses risk disruption; prevention emphasizes neutering, indoors, PPE, and avoiding contact with lesions; dead animals must not be discarded as trash or buried.

triage.headline_ja: 司法当局、リオグランデ・ド・スル州に5日以内にスポロトリコーシス対策の詳細報告を命令
triage.triage_reason: ヒトへの感染者数が1,465人に達し、裁判所が州政府に対策詳細の報告を命じるなど社会的・行政的関心が高まっているため、フルリスク評価への移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: スポロトリコーシスは猫由来の人獣共通真菌感染症で、ヒト-ヒト感染は確認されていない。地域内での継続的な曝露と、診断薬・治療薬（イトラコナゾール等）の供給体制に関する行政的対応が課題となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Uganda lansează primul studiu clinic din Africa pentru un vaccin cu ARNm împotriva tulpinii Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Uganda launches the first clinical trial in Africa for an mRNA vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 November 2026, Uganda announced Africa’s first clinical trial of an mRNA vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus. The Bundibugyo lineage is linked to the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which Reuters reports has become the second-largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded globally. The article does not provide Ebola case or death counts, laboratory confirmation details, infection sources, or information on imported or exported cases. This development marks a significant step in Ebola prevention by applying messenger RNA vaccine technology to the Bundibugyo lineage, reflecting ongoing regional and global focus on countermeasures against Ebola transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Ουγκάντα: Ξεκινά δοκιμή εμβολίου mRNA κατά στελέχους του ιού Έμπολα | Ειδήσεις
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda: An mRNA vaccine trial against an Ebola virus strain begins | News
article.articleSummary: Uganda has launched Africa’s first clinical trial of an mRNA Ebola vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain, in partnership with Moderna and the Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI). The Bundibugyo-driven outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is described as the second-largest Ebola epidemic globally. The Moderna vaccine will soon enter parallel trials in the DRC alongside a separate vaccine developed by the University of Oxford and the Serum Institute of India. Researchers are also evaluating whether Merck’s Ervebo vaccine for a different Ebola strain might confer cross-protection against Bundibugyo. The Ugandan trial is the second human study for this vaccine after a Canada trial in August, aiming to enroll about 224 volunteers. For the first time, it will assess safety and immunogenicity in children aged one year and older, per UVRI.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ：エボラウイルス株に対するmRNAワクチンの治験開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で進行中の「世界で2番目に大きい」とされるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行を背景に、ウガンダでmRNAワクチン治験が開始されたという内容で、重症度・流行継続性・国際的な管理対応の必要性が高く、社会的関心も高いためフルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Nytt ebolavaccin testas i Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola vaccine tested in Uganda
article.articleSummary: Uganda has begun a new clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine, according to the country's virus institute. The trial of Moderna's mRNA Ebola vaccine is the second to start within a month, following a late-October initiation of a vaccine from Ervebo in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo. Both vaccines are being tested against the Ebola virus variant responsible for the large outbreak centered around Kinshasa in the DRC, which has caused more than 5,300 deaths. Uganda has kept the outbreak under control and was Ebola-free as of August. The World Health Organization has also approved another Ebola vaccine for testing.

triage.headline_ja: 新たなエボラワクチンがウガンダで試験開始
