article.articleHeadline: В России выявлен еще один случай заражения оспой обезьян
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another case of monkeypox infection detected in Russia
article.articleSummary: On 25 November 2026, a new case of monkeypox was detected in Saint Petersburg, Russia, in a traveler returning from a tourist trip. The Interregional Rospotrebnadzor for Saint Petersburg and Leningrad Oblast announced an epidemiological investigation and a full set of anti-epidemic measures; the situation is under control. The day prior, two people were hospitalized with suspected monkeypox in Saint Petersburg. Risk of monkeypox infection is reported as high in Madagascar, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Thailand, Spain, and the United Kingdom, with additional risk in France, Germany, and Italy. In 2026, cases have been reported in Colombia, Denmark, Ecuador, Singapore, Norway, Costa Rica, Ghana, and Lithuania. Russia has registered the domestic antiviral NIOH-14 for monkeypox and smallpox. Monkeypox is a rare viral disease characterized by fever, toxicity, lymphadenopathy, followed by a spreading rash.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでサル痘感染のさらなる症例が確認
triage.triage_reason: ロシア（サンクトペテルブルク）における渡航者の輸入症例1件であり、既に制御下にあると報告されている。対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC等）での新規発生は確認されず、既知のMpoxリスク地域への言及に留まる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア（サンクトペテルブルク）での輸入症例。DRC・ガーナ・タイなどは世界的なMpoxリスク地域として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地としての記述ではないため、対象国リストには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு காய்ச்சலைக் கட்டுப்படுத்த புதுச்சேரி சுகாதாரத் துறை தீவிர நடவடிக்கை
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Puducherry Health Department steps up measures to control dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever control measures have been intensified in Puducherry Union Territory. The Health Department reported that delays in seeking hospital care and severe dehydration contribute to fatalities. Under CM Rangasamy, two high-level review meetings were held to strengthen vector-control efforts, followed by a government secretariat meeting to escalate actions. Teams have been formed to identify mosquito breeding sites in homes, with rapid surveillance of fever cases, monitoring in areas with migrant workers, and immediate vector elimination in affected zones. School and community programs are delivering weekly dengue-awareness drives, and fumigation is being carried out where needed in coordination with local authorities. Villianur PHC's district administrator A. Gulothungan conducted an inspection emphasizing mosquito-control importance and dengue prevention. A dengue-awareness march took place at Rettiyapalayam Government Higher Secondary School, opened by MLA K. Narayanasami. Separately, Puducherry Marxist Communist Party activists staged a demonstration near the Kamaraj statue advocating mosquito eradication.

triage.headline_ja: プドゥチェリー保健局、デング熱対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: プドゥチェリーにおけるデング熱の季節的・定例的なベクター対策活動を報じる記事であり、具体的な感染者数・死亡者数の急増や異常な流行拡大を示す情報がなく、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事はプドゥチェリー連邦直轄地における定例的なデング熱対策（蚊発生源の特定、啓発活動、燻蒸）の実施を報じるもので、具体的な感染者数・死亡者数の統計データは示されていない。地域の医療・行政当局による通常の季節対応と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Salvador recebe Dia D contra a dengue neste sábado (28); veja onde será a mobilização
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Salvador to host D-Day against dengue this Saturday (28); see where the mobilization will take place.
article.articleSummary: Salvador, Brazil, will host a D-Day on dengue, Zika, and chikungunya on Saturday, November 28, starting at 8:00 local time, at the Bloco Afro Malê Debalê headquarters in Itapuã near Lagoa do Abaeté, with awareness and vector-control activities targeting Aedes aegypti. Part of the Unified Health System mobilization, the event involves state and municipal health workers, arboviral surveillance officials, and partner institutions. The campaign urges elimination of water-holding containers to curb mosquito breeding ahead of peak arbovirus transmission. A national prevention push will reach more than 30 million Brazilians via WhatsApp and Gov.br messages. Beyond Salvador, 11 states scheduled actions on Saturday, with 12 more mobilizations during the week. The effort includes Wolbachia-release programs and sterile-insect releases: Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes in Amambai Indigenous area, Mato Grosso do Sul, and the first Wolbachia releases in Garanhuns, Pernambuco.

triage.headline_ja: サルバドール、今週土曜日(28日)にデング熱対策「Dデー」を開催予定；動員場所一覧
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防啓発・ベクターコントロール活動の案内記事であり、異常な流行や重篤な公衆衛生イベントを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル保健当局による季節的なデング・ジカ・チクングニア熱に対する予防啓発・媒介蚊対策（ウォルバキア菌利用含む）キャンペーンの告知であり、具体的な症例急増や異常事態の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: O que se sabe sobre a nova variante da Covid-19 e o aumento de casos no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is known about the new variant of COVID-19 and the increase in cases in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19–related Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) cases in Brazil are rising, according to Fiocruz's Infogripe bulletin. The increase may reflect circulation of a new SARS-CoV-2 variant PJ.2.1, monitored by the World Health Organization since the 19th, potentially more transmissible, alongside waning population immunity due to lower booster uptake. The rise is observed in the Centro-Sul states (Minas Gerais, São Paulo, Espírito Santo, Paraná, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul) as well as the Federal District and Bahia, with additional circulation detected in Espírito Santo, São Paulo, Mato Grosso, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina and DF. Preliminary data show no evidence of reduced vaccine protection against PJ.2.1; vaccines remain the main protection against severe disease, says Tatiana Portella.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおける新型コロナウイルスの新変異株と症例増加について分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: WHOが監視する新変異株PJ.2.1によるブラジル国内でのCOVID-19関連SARS症例増加が報告されているが、重症度やワクチン効果低下の明確な証拠はなく、現時点では国際的拡大等の明確な根拠も不明のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: WHOが監視する新変異株PJ.2.1の拡大とブラジル複数州でのSARS症例増加が報告されているが、重症度やワクチン効果低下への影響については『証拠なし』と記載されており、現時点で深刻な公衆衛生インパクトとは言えない。続報を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Atriz do "Sítio do Picapau Amarelo" é internada com leishmaniose; entenda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Actress from 'Sítio do Picapau Amarelo' hospitalized with leishmaniasis; find out more.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian actress Rosa Marya Colin, 81, was hospitalized on November 23, 2026 at Hospital Universitário de Campo Grande in Mato Grosso do Sul with leishmaniasis. She remains stable and is expected to receive about 10 days of intravenous antibiotics, with discharge anticipated in early next week if she improves. The illness is caused by Leishmania protozoa and is transmitted by sandflies (phlebotomine). Leishmaniasis manifests as cutaneous or visceral disease; visceral forms can affect internal organs and dogs are the main reservoir, though there is no evidence of direct human-to-dog transmission. Colin is known for playing Tia Nastácia on Sítio do Picapau Amarelo (Globo), and currently resides in Mato Grosso do Sul after four years there; her recent activities include singing with the album Raridades. No details were given on how she contracted the infection. Further health updates will be provided as available.

triage.headline_ja: 『黄色いキツツキの牧場』の女優がリーシュマニア症で入院、詳細を解説
triage.triage_reason: 著名人個人の単発症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常発生やアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。社会的関心は有名人ニュースとしての側面が中心で、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: リーシュマニア症はブラジルで地方風土病として知られており、本記事は著名人の単発症例報告に過ぎず、集団発生や異常な増加を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Sarna humana: Prefeitura de BH confirma casos da doença em escola infantil da capital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Human scabies: Belo Horizonte City Hall confirms cases of the disease at a preschool in the capital.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-27, human scabies has been confirmed at Belo Horizonte’s Emei Urca Confisco in the Pampulha region, with 10 student cases and no evidence of staff transmission, per SindRede and the city’s Health Secretariat (CIEVS). Other centers report cases: Emei Urucuia (Barreiro) eight; Emei Floramar (Norte) six; CEI (Centro-Sul) one. In Minas Gerais, 49 municipalities have outbreaks in 2026, including Divinópolis with 57 cases across 10 schools. The Divinópolis municipality issued a 60-day public health emergency, with student absences for diagnosed individuals, enhanced cleaning, and potential suspensions in affected classes. SES-MG notes scabies is not on mandatory national or state notification lists; municipalities should report to SES-MG when two or more epidemiologically linked cases are identified. Sarcoptes scabiei infestation causes intense nocturnal itch and rash; transmission is mainly prolonged skin contact; treatment by health professionals, with household contacts possibly treated and decontamination advised.

triage.headline_ja: ヒト疥癬：ベロオリゾンテ市役所、州都の保育園でのヒト疥癬症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州の複数自治体で疥癬の集団発生が報告されているが、疥癬自体は重症度が低く国際的拡大リスクも限定的であるため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 疥癬は対象国リストのうちブラジルの複数学校・自治体（ベロオリゾンテ、ディヴィノーポリス等）で集団発生。ミナスジェライス州49自治体で発生中だが、国レベルの届出義務疾患ではなく、重症度は低い。地域の公衆衛生対応（60日間の緊急事態宣言）が取られている点は注視対象。

article.articleHeadline: Η Ουγκάντα ​​ξεκινά την πρώτη δοκιμή εμβολίου mRNA κατά του Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda starts the first clinical trial of an mRNA vaccine against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Uganda announced on Friday that it has begun the first clinical trial in Africa of an mRNA vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus. This strain is linked to an outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo, which is now the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record globally. The development marks a milestone for African involvement in Ebola vaccine research and for the use of mRNA technology against Ebola. The report did not provide details on trial sites, participant numbers, duration, or results.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ出血熱に対するmRNAワクチンの初の臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ流行は史上2番目の規模とされ重篤性・異常性が高く、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでのワクチン臨床試験開始に関する報道だが、対象のエボラ流行はDRCで発生し史上2番目の規模とされているため、DRCを主発生地として記録。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ação educativa na UFRGS aborda prevenção à dengue e combate ao mosquito Aedes aegypti, em Porto Alegre - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Educational action at UFRGS addresses dengue prevention and the fight against the Aedes aegypti mosquito in Porto Alegre - Jornal O Sul
article.articleSummary: On National Dengue Prevention Day, Porto Alegre’s Health Surveillance Directorate’s Vector Surveillance Unit conducted an educational action at the UFRGS Campus do Vale in Porto Alegre, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, on November 26. Demonstrations included didactic materials, dengue-control and monitoring devices, and samples of Aedes aegypti at eggs, larvae, pupae, and adults, with informational materials distributed. A follow-up outreach is planned for December 3 at the university (Tenda of the School of Physical Education, Physiotherapy and Dance), 750 Felizardo Street, Jardim Botânico, from 12:00 to 16:00, by invitation through the university’s Working Group for Prevention and Combat of Aedes aegypti. The actions aim to raise dengue awareness and strengthen vector-control education on campus to support prevention of Aedes aegypti–borne transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ポルトアレグレのUFRGSでデング熱予防とネッタイシマカ対策の啓発活動を実施 - Jornal O Sul
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は教育啓発活動の紹介であり、実際の感染拡大や症例急増を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱啓発・予防教育イベントの報告であり、症例数や流行状況についての具体的データは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Aumento de casos de Covid-19 no Paraná pode estar relacionado a nova variante, diz Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in COVID-19 cases in Paraná may be related to a new variant, says Fiocruz.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19-related Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases are rising in Brazil, though overall incidence remains low, with increases in Paraná, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Minas Gerais, São Paulo, Espírito Santo, Bahia and the Federal District. The trend, based on 15–21 November data from Fiocruz’s Infogripe bulletin, may reflect circulation of a new variant, PJ.2.1, which the World Health Organization has monitored since 19 November and which could be more transmissible. Waning population immunity due to lower recent booster vaccination coverage is also suspected. Paraná has identified PJ.2.1 circulation; Espírito Santo, São Paulo, Mato Grosso, Minas Gerais, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina and the DF have likewise reported it. Preliminary data show no evidence of reduced vaccine protection against PJ.2.1; vaccines remain the main protection against severe disease, says Fiocruz’s Tatiana Portella.

triage.headline_ja: パラナ州でのCOVID-19症例増加は新変異株に関連している可能性、とフィオクルスが発表
triage.triage_reason: WHOが監視中の新変異株PJ.2.1がブラジル複数州で確認され、重症急性呼吸器症候群(SRAG)症例が増加しているため、IHR基準（異常性・国際拡大リスク）を2件満たす。
triage.notes: 新変異株PJ.2.1はWHOが11月19日から監視しており、伝播性増加の可能性があるが、全体の発生率は依然低く、ワクチン効果の低下は確認されていない。複数州（パラナ、サンタカタリーナ、リオグランデドスル、ミナスジェライス、サンパウロ、エスピリトサント、バイーア、連邦直轄区）で増加傾向が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Νέο εμβόλιο για την μετάλλαξη Bundibugyo δοκιμάζεται στην Ουγκάντα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: A new vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain is being tested in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Uganda launches Africa’s first clinical trial of an mRNA Ebola vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain, as the Democratic Republic of Congo's Bundibugyo-linked outbreak persists as the second-largest on record. The Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI), in partnership with Moderna, will assess safety and immunogenicity in a trial enrolling 224 volunteers, including children aged 1 year and older, to broaden protection across ages. A parallel assessment in the Congo is expected as Moderna moves into further testing there; a separate Oxford University–Serum Institute of India candidate is also being evaluated for Bundibugyo. Researchers are evaluating whether Merck’s Ervebo vaccine could offer partial cross-protection against Bundibugyo. CEPI funds the initiative, highlighting the priority of pediatric inclusion given Ebola’s disproportionate impact on children.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ブンディブギョ株に対する新ワクチンがウガンダで試験中
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における史上2番目に大きいエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが継続中であり、ウガンダでの臨床試験開始など国際的な関与・支援が示されているため、重症度・流行可能性の観点からフルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでのmRNAワクチン臨床試験開始に関するもので、主な感染拡大自体の新情報ではないが、DRCでの大規模アウトブレイク継続が背景にあるためDRCを発生地域として維持。ウガンダ・インドはワクチン開発関連国であり、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ebola stellt in der Demokratischen Republik Kongo weiterhin einen internationalen Gesundheitsnotstand dar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola remains an international health emergency in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) under the International Health Regulations (2005), according to the World Health Organization. After an Emergency Committee meeting convened by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, the agency updated its recommendations on the response. As of 27 November 2026, WHO reports more than 12,000 infections and approximately 5,900 deaths linked to the outbreak. Ongoing challenges include uncertainty about transmission dynamics and attacks on health facilities, which continue to hamper response activities and hinder containment efforts. The declaration and updated guidance reflect ongoing international concern and the need for strengthened measures to control spread in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:エボラ出血熱はコンゴ民主共和国において引き続き国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態である
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを継続宣言しており、12,000人以上の感染・約5,900人の死亡という重大な公衆衛生インパクト、国際的拡大懸念、渡航・貿易制限の可能性があり、IHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: WHOによるPHEIC継続宣言であり、既存のRRAの更新・再評価が必要な重大シグナル。医療施設への攻撃等により封じ込めが困難な状況が継続している点にも注意。

article.articleHeadline: Canada Extends Ebola Travel Restrictions for 90 Days Amid Ongoing Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Canada extends Ebola travel and immigration restrictions tied to the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak for 90 days. The move follows WHO guidance urging identification and assessment of travellers exposed to the disease, while stopping short of a blanket ban. The outbreak has surpassed 12,000 cases and more than 5,900 deaths, described by WHO as the fastest-growing in history. Canada has barred travellers from Uganda, South Sudan, and the DRC since May; immigration documents remain suspended for people from these countries. Anyone entering after recent visits must complete a 21-day self-isolation. Foreign nationals who visited the DRC within 21 days cannot board flights bound for Canada; those who visited South Sudan or Uganda may enter but must quarantine. Uganda’s outbreak was declared over in August after 20 illnesses and had spread to Kenya and Nigeria by October. No domestic cases reported; vigilance remains.

triage.headline_ja: カナダ、進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクを受け渡航制限を90日間延長
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが12,000例・5,900人超の死者に達し、WHOが史上最速の拡大と評価。複数国への拡大とカナダによる渡航制限実施という国際的影響が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで進行中のエボラアウトブレイクに起因するカナダの渡航制限延長が主題。スーダン、ケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリアへの波及も言及されているが対象国リストには該当せず、カナダも対象国リスト外のため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Juiz de Fora registra 153 casos confirmados de Covid-19 neste ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Juiz de Fora records 153 confirmed cases of COVID-19 this year.
article.articleSummary: Juiz de Fora, Minas Gerais, Brazil, reports 153 confirmed COVID-19 cases in 2026, with November the highest month, surpassing February. A surge in vaccination demand temporarily exhausted doses for adults and the elderly in some clinics, prompting a new shipment from SES-MG, expected early next week to restore supply. Child vaccination (6 months to 5 years) continues normally. Target groups include children 6 months–5 years, pregnant people, and those 60+. From age 5, eligibility extends to immunocompromised individuals, people with comorbidities or permanent disabilities, healthcare workers, Indigenous and quilombo communities, riverine populations, homeless and incarcerated people, and other PNI groups. Unvaccinated 5–59-year-olds may receive a dose; those already vaccinated and not in priority groups currently do not need additional doses. Seek care for respiratory symptoms at the UBS; rapid tests can be collected from day three; fever or dyspnea requires immediate care; those with comorbidities should monitor.

triage.headline_ja: ジュイス・デ・フォーラ、今年のCOVID-19確定症例153件を記録
triage.triage_reason: 通常の地域的なCOVID-19症例報告とワクチン供給状況に関する内容で、異常性や重大な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体レベルの通常のCOVID-19症例数報告とワクチン接種案内であり、季節的な感染者数増加とワクチン供給の一時的逼迫について述べているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox dispara e novembro tem mais casos do que todos os outros meses juntos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox surges and November has more cases than all the other months combined.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) outbreak in Brazil shows sharp surge in November 2026, with 901 new cases this month, surpassing the sum of all prior months (859). Year-to-date Brazil totals: 1,760 cases, with 1,695 confirmed and 65 probable, and one death. Cases began rising in October (313), with no other month exceeding 100. São Paulo currently has the highest case count (636), followed by Rio de Janeiro (491). Brazil has secured 25,000 mpox vaccine doses and distributed them to states; vaccination started in São Paulo on November 25 with 600 doses to prioritized groups, while Rio de Janeiro has already begun administering its doses. Public health monitoring from the Ministry of Health indicates the outbreak is ongoing, with vaccination rollout underway to mitigate transmission.

triage.headline_ja: Mpoxが急増、11月の症例数は他の全月の合計を上回る
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでMpox症例が11月に急増し、年間累計を大きく押し上げている。死亡例も発生し、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常な増加が確認されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: サンパウロ・リオデジャネイロなど複数州で症例が急増しており、保健省はワクチン配布を開始しているが、依然として流行が継続中。Clade種別は記事内で明示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda vai testar a vacina da Moderna contra a nova estirpe do Ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda to test Moderna vaccine against the new Ebola strain
article.articleSummary: Uganda will begin Phase 1 trials of an experimental Moderna mRNA vaccine (mRNA-1469) against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola to curb the outbreak linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo. The eastern DRC outbreak has caused about 11,000 cases and 5,700 deaths since May, with a 50% case-fatality rate. Uganda has reported roughly 20 cases and 2 deaths so far, with cross-border transmission at the Congo border. The Ugandan trial will enroll 224 healthy volunteers aged 1–65 to assess immunogenicity. In the neighboring DRC, two additional experimental vaccines are set to commence trials Monday in the east: Moderna mRNA-1469 and ChAdOx1, an adenoviral vector vaccine developed by Serum Institute of India in collaboration with the University of Oxford. As of now, no licensed vaccine or treatment exists for the Bundibugyo strain; this is Ebola’s 17th outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、新型エボラ株に対するモデルナワクチンの臨床試験を開始へ
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダで大規模エボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が継続中で約11,000症例・5,700死亡、国境を越えた伝播も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ(Uganda)は対象国GeoNamesリストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは主たる発生地として含めた。ワクチン未承認・治療法なしで致死率50%と極めて高く、エボラ史上17回目の流行。

article.articleHeadline: В Петербурге обнаружена оспа обезьян: чем опасен вирус и как не заболеть
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox detected in St. Petersburg: how dangerous is the virus and how to avoid getting sick
article.articleSummary: Three monkeypox cases identified in St. Petersburg; two cases hospitalized on November 26 after returning from Thailand, all lab-confirmed and stable. A third patient is hospitalized; Rospotrebnadzor has launched a sanitary-epidemiological investigation and ordered disinfection. Russia’s first monkeypox case occurred in summer 2022; the current outbreak began in October 2026 with five confirmed cases in the city and no severe outcomes by late October. The third case was reported in late November 2026. Transmission is mainly through close contact with lesions, contaminated clothing or bedding; prolonged face-to-face contact and droplets can also spread. Incubation is 6–16 days, up to 21. Symptoms include fever above 38 C, malaise, headache, lymphadenopathy, followed by a facial rash that becomes vesicles, pustules and crusts over 2–4 weeks. Management is supportive; no virus-specific antivirals. Smallpox vaccination can prevent; contacts monitored for 21 days; travelers to endemic regions advised to avoid rodents and primates and maintain hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: サンクトペテルブルクでサル痘（エムポックス）検出：ウイルスの危険性と予防法
triage.triage_reason: ロシア非流行地域での輸入例を含むエムポックス集団発生であり、異常性と公衆衛生当局の関与（社会的関心）が認められるためフルリスク評価への移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: 症例はロシア（サンクトペテルブルク）で発生しており、タイは渡航歴として言及されているのみで同国内での感染確認は記事に記載がないため、対象国リストには該当なし。ロシア自体も対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Aumento de casos de Covid pode ter relação com nova variante e redução de imunidade da população
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in COVID-19 cases may be related to a new variant and reduced population immunity.
article.articleSummary: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases due to COVID-19 in Brazil are rising, though the incidence remains low. Fiocruz’s Infogripe bulletin links the uptick to a potentially more transmissible new variant PJ.2.1 and to waning population immunity from lower booster coverage. In Mato Grosso (Central-West) SRAG shows oscillation; Pará (North) and Rio de Janeiro (Southeast) report SRAG at alert levels, as do Porto Velho (RO) and Rio Branco (AC). Brasília (DF) and Cuiabá (MT) show elevated SRAG but no long-term growth signal (data from 15–21 November 2026). In Rio de Janeiro, SRAG is also caused by metapneumovirus and influenza A/B; in Pará, cases are mainly among children up to 14. PJ.2.1 circulation has been identified in Espírito Santo, São Paulo, Mato Grosso, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina and DF. Preliminary data show no evidence of reduced vaccine protection against PJ.2.1; vaccines remain the main protection.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19症例の増加は新変異株と人口免疫の低下に関連している可能性
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19のSRAG症例増加と新変異株PJ.2.1の検出が報告されているが、発生率は低く重症度急増の明確な証拠はないため、定期サーベイランス情報として経過観察とする。
triage.notes: Fiocruzによる国内サーベイランス速報。新変異株PJ.2.1の伝播性増加の可能性とワクチン効果への影響は未確認とされており、続報の確認が必要。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: பறவைக் காய்ச்சல் பாதித்த 8 ஆயிரம் கோழிகள் சென்னைக்கு அனுப்பிவைப்பு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 8,000 avian influenza-affected chickens sent to Chennai.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (H5N1) outbreak in Tamil Nadu’s Cuddalore district, with infected poultry moved toward Chennai. Over 8,000 chickens from the district were transported to Chennai for sale in the last two days; authorities halted attempts to move about 20,000 more in three trucks, due to spillover risk. On the 13th, H5N1 was confirmed across more than 20 poultry farms in the Kurinjipadi area. In response, farms began culling to contain spread, totaling around 80,000 birds culled across 16 farms, while movement and sale restrictions were imposed in affected zones. Nearby, about 25,000 chickens were raised within 150 meters of the infected farm; on the 25th, birds died, and officials culled 8,000, with the remaining 20,000 slated for Friday. Three trucks were seized en route to Chennai, and a police case was filed. A district investigation panel was formed to probe possible officer involvement. Four people have been charged, including owner Saravananpriya (Nattuthittu) and three truck drivers from Erode and surrounding areas.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザに感染した8000羽の鶏がチェンナイへ搬送される
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州で大規模なH5N1家禽アウトブレイク（20農場以上、計約8万羽の殺処分）が発生し、感染家禽の不正な域外搬送・流通が確認され当局が捜査・規制強化に乗り出しており、ヒトへの波及リスクと社会的関心の高まりからフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 人への感染報告は記事中になく、家禽（鶏）における大規模感染・殺処分・不正搬送が主題。感染家禽の広域流通（チェンナイ搬送）とトラック押収・刑事事件化など管理上の問題が顕著で、ヒトへの波及リスク評価のためフルRRAへの移行が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: В Санкт-Петербурге за два дня выявили три случая заражения оспой обезьян -- Meduza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Saint Petersburg, three cases of monkeypox infection were detected in two days — Meduza.
article.articleSummary: On 27 November 2026, Saint Petersburg recorded a new monkeypox case in a city resident who had returned from Thailand, per Rospotrebnadzor, which said the situation is under control. This brings three confirmed infections in Saint Petersburg across two days, as two other cases were reported the day prior and were hospitalized. Monkeypox is a viral disease that typically runs milder than smallpox; common symptoms include fever, severe headache, swollen lymph nodes (a key distinguishing feature), back and muscle pain, and profound fatigue. In October 2026, Saint Petersburg had diagnosed five monkeypox cases; all patients recovered after hospitalization. The authorities continue outbreak surveillance and emphasize medical care for confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: サンクトペテルブルクで2日間に3人のサル痘（Mpox）感染が確認 — Meduza
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・サンクトペテルブルクでMpoxの小規模クラスター（2日間で3例、10月にも5例）が発生しているが、症状は軽症で当局は「制御下にある」としており、対象国での発生でもないため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（サンクトペテルブルク）であり対象国リストに含まれない。タイは患者の渡航歴として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Canada extends Ebola travel restrictions for DRC and neighboring countries through February 2027
article.articleSummary: Canada extends Ebola-related travel and immigration restrictions tied to the Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak through February 25, 2027, effective 2026-11-27. Entry remains banned for citizens of the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, with visas and permanent-residency approvals suspended for nationals of these countries outside Canada. Travelers who have stayed in the DRC within the past 21 days face a mandatory 21-day self-isolation; those from Uganda or South Sudan may enter but must undergo quarantine. The measure aims to reduce the chance of Ebola introduction to Canada, despite WHO guidance favoring risk-based traveler assessment over blanket bans. The Ebola epidemic has surpassed 12,000 cases and 5,900 deaths. The DRC outbreak continues amid insecurity (94 health-worker attacks in six months); Uganda’s outbreak was declared over in August after 20 cases, while Kenya and Nigeria reported cases in October. WHO urges accelerated vaccine/treatment trials and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: カナダ、DRCおよび隣国に対するエボラ出血熱関連の渡航制限を2027年2月まで延長
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は12,000例・5,900人死亡と深刻で、複数国への国際的拡大とカナダの渡航制限措置が発生しており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・南スーダン・カナダも記事に登場するが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。主たる発生国はDRC。

article.articleHeadline: Em "médio risco" para casos de arbovirores, BH terá Dia D de combate à dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In 'moderate risk' for arboviral cases, BH will have D-Day to combat dengue.
article.articleSummary: Dengue and chikungunya in Belo Horizonte (BH), Brazil, with about 2,000 dengue and 82 chikungunya cases in 2026; four dengue deaths. The city is classified as medium risk for arboviruses per the latest LIRAa, prompting a D-Day dengue combat operation on Saturday, 28 November 2026. Endemic-control agents will intensify house-to-house inspections to identify water-holding containers and eliminate breeding sites, with possible biolarvicide use. Larvae were found in 2.4% of 53,000 inspected properties. Main breeding sites include plant saucers (24.7%), nonfunctional materials (23.2%), domestic containers (17.7%), and barrels/drums (7.2%). Interventions also involve Mobiliza SUS educational efforts for children. Each weekly inspection reportedly takes about 10 minutes per property. Since January, Belo Horizonte has logged over 3.5 million actions across capital properties to curb arboviral transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アルボウイルス感染症「中リスク」判定、ベロオリゾンテ市がデング対策「Dデー」実施へ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ベロオリゾンテ市における季節性のデング熱・チクングニア熱に関する通常の監視報告であり、既存の媒介動物対策プログラムの一環であるため、異常性や国際的拡大の兆候は認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱・チクングニア熱はブラジルで季節的に流行する既知の媒介動物媒介感染症であり、市当局による定期的な巡回調査・駆除活動（LIRAa、Dデー作戦）が実施されている。4件の死亡例は報告されているが、全体として通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织更新埃博拉疫情应对建议 呼吁加强安全措施并加快疫苗和治疗研究
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Updates Ebola Outbreak Response Guidance, Calls for Strengthening Security Measures and Accelerating Vaccine and Treatment Research.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) persists, with more than 12,000 cases and 5,900 deaths reported as of November 24. Persistent security turmoil remains a major obstacle, hindering humanitarian access and endangering patients, health workers, responders, and facilities. Since its designation as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern six months ago, WHO has documented at least 94 attacks on health facilities in DRC. On November 25, the WHO Emergency Committee, convened under the International Health Regulations (2005), updated outbreak response guidance. Emergency Committee Chair Bloomberg called for accelerated case finding, stronger infection prevention in medical facilities, including safe injections, and shorter times from symptom onset to diagnosis and care, while maintaining community trust. The committee also urged accelerated vaccine and therapeutic trials and targeted cross-border measures to identify travelers potentially exposed to Ebola to prevent spread outside DRC, avoiding undue disruption to air travel.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク対応ガイダンスを更新し、治安対策強化とワクチン・治療研究の加速を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱はPHEIC指定中で12,000例以上・死亡5,900人超と深刻かつ国際的拡大懸念があり、IHR緊急委員会が越境対策を要請しているためフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 既にPHEIC宣言済みで継続中のアウトブレイク。治安悪化により医療アクセスが阻害されており、国境を越えた拡大リスクが明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Com aumento de doenças infecciosas em Divinópolis-MG, especialista orienta sobre sintomas e prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With an increase in infectious diseases in Divinópolis, MG, a specialist advises on symptoms and prevention.
article.articleSummary: Divinópolis, Minas Gerais, declared a public health emergency amid rising scabies, COVID-19, and mpox. As of 27 November 2026, mpox was confirmed in two cases on 18 November, with additional suspected, and a scabies outbreak prompted a 60-day emergency decree signed 25 November, allowing removal of diagnosed students for 48 hours post-treatment and possible suspension of a class if three cases occur in a day after surveillance review. The Hospital Universitário da UFSJ treated five cases of severe acute respiratory syndrome between October and November, including one confirmed COVID-19, with no deaths; most patients were stable and admitted via state regulation. Infection-control: COVID-19 standard and droplet; scabies contact; mpox contact and droplets (airborne in specific settings). Guidance: seek care at UBS for mild symptoms; UPA for urgent issues; early antiviral for high-risk COVID-19. Scabies treatment with ivermectin or permethrin; close contacts must be treated.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州ジヴィノーポリスで感染症が増加、専門家が症状と予防について助言
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの一地方都市で疥癬・COVID-19・mpoxが同時に増加し、市当局が60日間の公衆衛生緊急事態を宣言するなど行政の関心が高く、学校等での継続的な曝露・流行しやすさが懸念されるためフルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 死亡例や重症例の増加は報告されておらず国際的拡大リスクも低いが、学校を中心とした疥癬の継続的曝露と複数感染症同時発生に対する地域の緊急対応（60日間の公衆衛生緊急事態宣言）があるため、続報を含め注視・確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu: fermeture temporaire de deux structures de santé de Kasindi à cause d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Temporary closure of two health facilities in Kasindi due to Ebola - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in North Kivu, DRC, centered in Kasindi's Mutwanga health zone, prompted temporary closures of Nazareth Medical Center (Mwangaza) and Socidec Hospital (Muvingi). The action follows a local rule suspending care at any facility that has hosted five confirmed EVD cases. The latest tally reports 79 confirmed EVD cases in the Kasindi commune on the Uganda border; there are no figures provided for deaths or recoveries. Uganda has kept the border closed for nearly five months to contain spread; only transit of goods and patients with transport letters is allowed, under strict barrier measures. In bilateral health cooperation, Uganda is supporting the construction of an Ebola Treatment Center in Bulongo, midway between Beni and Kasindi, after an initial center established in Butembo. (As of 27 November 2026).

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：エボラ出血熱により、カシンディの医療施設2施設が一時閉鎖 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州カシンディでエボラ確定症例79例が報告され、ウガンダとの国境閉鎖や医療施設の一時閉鎖など、国際的な公衆衛生対応が継続しているため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは国境閉鎖や治療センター建設支援で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。死亡者数・回復者数は記事中で不明。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا تبدأ اختبار لقاح تجريبي مضاد لفيروس إيبولا من مجموعة "موديرنا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda begins testing an experimental Ebola vaccine from Moderna
article.articleSummary: Uganda has launched a first-in-Africa Phase I trial of an experimental Ebola vaccine based on messenger RNA (mRNA) technology from Moderna to counter the Bundibugyo strain fueling the East Congo outbreak—the second-largest Ebola epidemic on record, with more than 11,000 infections and over 5,700 deaths since May. The Ugandan Virus Research Institute, after regulatory approval, will enroll about 224 healthy volunteers aged 1–65 to assess safety and immunogenicity, with roughly one year of follow-up. This trial expands Moderna’s human testing beyond Canada (adults 18–65). Including children aims to boost community protection. CEPI funds up to $58.5 million for Moderna. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, parallel trials of Moderna and the ChAdOx1 vaccine (Oxford/SII) are planned, and Merck’s Ervebo is being evaluated for cross-protection against Bundibugyo. Uganda ended the outbreak in August with 20 cases and two deaths. Gavi plans to purchase 1.5 million Oxford/SII doses to accelerate distribution if approved.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、モデルナ社製の実験的エボラワクチンの試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で発生中のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行は記録上2番目の規模(感染1万人超、死亡5700人超)であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC東部のエボラ大流行とそれに対抗するワクチン開発・試験（ウガンダで実施中のモデルナ製mRNAワクチン第I相試験を含む）。ウガンダ自体は既に8月に流行終息(症例20、死亡2)しており、対象国リストにも含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。CanadaはModernaの既存試験国であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Belford Roxo realiza Dia D de combate à dengue neste sábado no Bom Pastor - Prefeitura de Belford Roxo - Belford Roxo 24h
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Belford Roxo holds D-Day to combat dengue this Saturday in Bom Pastor - Belford Roxo City Hall - Belford Roxo 24h.
article.articleSummary: Belford Roxo City Hall hosts a Dengue Day on Saturday, 28 November 2026, from 9:00 to 15:00 at Praça do Bom Pastor (Estrada de Belford Roxo, 2005) in Bom Pastor. Organized by the Municipal Health Secretariat via the Vector Control and Zoonoses Coordination, the event combines house-to-house visits to identify and eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites with on-site health services. Activities include multivaccination, medical consultations, dental care via the Odontomóvel, massage therapy, and checks of blood pressure and glucose levels. Animal rabies vaccination is also offered. The campaign emphasizes regular inspection of yards and other water-accumulating areas; residents are advised to keep water tanks covered, store empty bottles upside down, and drain containers after rain to prevent mosquito proliferation and dengue transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ベルフォル・ホッショ市が今週土曜日、ボン・パストールでデング熱対策「Dデー」を開催 - ベルフォル・ホッショ市役所
triage.triage_reason: 通常の地域保健啓発・予防活動（デング対策デーと狂犬病ワクチン接種）の告知記事であり、異常な感染症発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は定例の公衆衛生キャンペーン（デング熱予防と動物狂犬病ワクチン接種）の案内であり、具体的な発生数や異常事態の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ουγκάντα, η πρώτη χώρα στην Αφρική με δοκιμή εμβολίου mRNA κατά του στελέχους Bundibugyo του ιού Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda, the first country in Africa to trial an mRNA vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Uganda launches Africa's first clinical trial of an mRNA vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus. The study began on 27 November at the Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI) in Kampala, in collaboration with Moderna. This marks the second human trial for the candidate vaccine, following a Canadian trial in adults 18–65 that started in August. For the Uganda trial, researchers will assess safety and immunogenicity across age groups and aim to enroll 224 volunteers, including children aged one year and older, a first for this vaccine. The effort addresses a context of the ongoing Bundibugyo-linked Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and emphasizes protection of vulnerable groups. CEPI funds support the project; parallel trials are planned in Congo, while Oxford/Serum Institute and Merck-Ervebo are exploring related or cross-protective options.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、アフリカ初のエボラ・ブンディブギョ株対象mRNAワクチン臨床試験を実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はModerna製mRNAワクチンの臨床試験開始を伝える科学ニュースであり、新規感染症の発生や拡大を示す情報ではない。DRCの進行中アウトブレイクは既知の状況として言及されているのみ。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでのワクチン臨床試験開始であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの進行中のブンディブギョ株エボラアウトブレイクへの言及があるため同国のみ含めた。新規発生情報ではないため社会的関心・緊急性の評価は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Bahia registra queda de 67% nos casos graves de Covid-19 em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bahia records a 67% drop in severe COVID-19 cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Bahia, Brazil, recorded a 67.2% drop in severe COVID-19 cases in 2026 versus 2025, with COVID-19 deaths decreasing by 81.6%, according to Sesab Boletim Epidemiológico No. 46 covering Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) through week 46. The epidemiological picture shows improvement relative to 2025, with fewer hospitalizations for severe COVID-19 and fewer COVID-19 deaths. Across SRAG, total cases declined 21.1% and SRAG-related deaths fell 40.5%; influenza cases decreased 29.4% and influenza deaths by 70%. In 2026, more than half of SRAG cases were caused by other respiratory viruses, chiefly rhinovirus and respiratory syncytial virus. Bahia also records low incidence in Fiocruz’s InfoGripe, with year-to-date notifications representing less than a third of 2025’s total. No details on laboratory confirmation or imported/exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: バイアでは2026年に新型コロナウイルス重症例が67%減少
triage.triage_reason: 記事は重症例・死亡数の減少を報じる好転的内容であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当せず、社会的関心も高まっていない。
triage.notes: 記事は疫学週報に基づく症例・死亡数の減少傾向を報告する内容であり、新たな異常事態や拡大リスクは示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Lobianco cancela apresentações após irmã ser diagnosticada com tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lobianco cancels performances after his sister was diagnosed with tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian actor Luis Lobianco, 44, canceled the final performances of his monologue 'O Tigre' after revealing his sister was diagnosed with tuberculosis, described as a late diagnosis. The force-majeure cancellation affects shows scheduled for November 27–29 and December 4–6, 2026, at Teatro Vanucci in Rio de Janeiro. The announcement was posted on Instagram. Tickets will be fully refunded by Sympla according to its procedures. Lobianco apologized for the disruption and thanked the show's creative team, technicians, supporters, press, and theater management for their dedication. The cancellation underscores a personal tuberculosis case in a Brazilian context, prompting schedule changes and refunds for attendees.

article.articleHeadline: Uganda begins Africa's first mRNA Ebola vaccine trial
article.articleSummary: As of 27 November 2026, Uganda launched Africa's first mRNA Ebola vaccine Phase I trial, testing Moderna's investigational vaccine in 224 healthy volunteers aged 1–65 to assess safety and immune response. The trial targets Bundibugyo ebolavirus, the less common strain driving the DRC outbreak, which WHO reports has more than 11,000 cases and over 5,700 deaths since May; no vaccines or treatments are approved for this strain. Two experimental vaccines are slated to begin in eastern DRC for contacts and high-risk groups. Uganda, sharing a porous border with DRC, had earlier imported cases and was Ebola-free in August after 20 infections and two deaths. Separately, Gavi signed for 1.5 million doses of a second vaccine developed with the University of Oxford; a 500,000-dose Ervebo stockpile will be tested for cross-protection, with potential deployment by early 2027 if trials succeed.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、アフリカ初のmRNA型エボラワクチン試験を開始

triage.notes: 記事の主眼はウガンダでのワクチン治験だが、背景にあるDRCでの大規模エボラ流行（承認済みワクチン・治療薬なし）が本質的な公衆衛生リスクであるため、DRCを発生国として評価。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations からは除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ουγκάντα: Πρώτη δοκιμή εμβολίου mRNA κατά του Έμπολα στην Αφρική
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda: First trial of an mRNA vaccine against Ebola in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Uganda launches Africa’s first phase I trial of Moderna’s mRNA Ebola vaccine in 224 healthy volunteers aged 1–65 to assess safety and immunogenicity against Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The Uganda Ion Research Institute announced the study as the Bundibugyo outbreak in neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has caused over 5,700 deaths and more than 11,000 cases since May, per WHO; no licensed vaccines or therapies exist for this strain. In eastern DRC, two additional experimental vaccines will begin testing on contacts and high-risk individuals. Uganda, declared Ebola-free in August after 20 infections and 2 deaths, hosts the trials. Gavi has signed a deal to procure 1.5 million doses of a separate Oxford-University–developed vaccine via Serum Institute of India, aiming for hundreds of thousands ready if trials succeed, possibly by mid-2027 (optimistic Q1 2027). Gavi also holds 500,000 Ervebo doses to test cross-protection against Bundibugyo.

triage.notes: 記事自体はウガンダでのmRNAワクチン臨床試験（Phase I）開始に関する報道だが、ウガンダは既に8月にエボラフリー宣言済み（対象国リストにも非該当）。一方、背景として言及されているDRCでのBundibugyoエボラウイルス株によるアウトブレイクは5月以降5,700人超の死亡・11,000人超の症例という極めて深刻な状況であり、承認ワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点が異常性として重要。DRC国内の二つの実験的ワクチンの接触者・高リスク者への試験開始も進行中アウトブレイクの深刻さを示す。

Separately, Gavi contracted Serum Institute of India to purchase 1.5 million doses of another experimental vaccine developed with the University of Oxford, aiming for hundreds of thousands ready for distribution if trials succeed and approvals are granted by WHO and the DRC, potentially by early 2027. Gavi also holds 500,000 doses of Ervebo to test against Bundibugyo.

article.articleHeadline: Sorocaba confirma 14º caso de raiva em morcego em 2026; Jundiaí também registra animal infectado | TVS+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sorocaba confirms the 14th rabies case in a bat in 2026; Jundiaí also records an infected animal | TVS+
article.articleSummary: Rabies in bats confirmed in Sorocaba and Jundiaí, São Paulo state, in November 2026. Sorocaba reports the year's 14th bat rabies case, with the animal found on Nov 19 in Jardim Califórnia (Lopes de Oliveira). Jundiaí’s VISAM identified an infected bat on a rural property in Santa Clara; the specimen, Histiotus velatus, was lab-confirmed on Nov 18, with no human or animal contact reported. Sorocaba’s response includes 500-meter outreach by Zoonoses, distribution of information, contact tracing for people and animals connected to bats, vaccination reinforcement for dogs and cats, and referral for post-exposure rabies treatment. VISAM in Jundiaí investigates and coordinates care with the municipal health network, advising residents not to handle bats; reporting of exposure is urged via VISAM hotlines. Rabies is a viral nervous system disease with very high fatality after symptoms appear.

article.articleHeadline: Nueve países refuerzan la vigilancia de zoonosis en Amazonía y Darién | HSB Noticias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nine countries strengthen zoonosis surveillance in the Amazon and Darien
article.articleSummary: Nine Amazon and Darién countries—Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Panama, Peru, Suriname, and Venezuela—agreed to strengthen zoonosis surveillance and response during a regional meeting in Bogotá, November 17–19, 2026, with the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) publishing a progress update on Nov 24. The action plan for 2026–2028 was reviewed by the Amazon-Darién Network for Emerging Zoonoses with Epidemic Potential. Participants endorsed semiannual follow-ups and joint activities for 2027, including a cross-border surveillance workshop, information sharing, laboratory strengthening, and simulation exercises, with a particular focus on yellow fever and hantavirus. PAHO urged integrating human, animal, and environmental health to anticipate and mitigate epidemic risks across the transboundary Amazon and Darién regions. Data reflect ongoing regional collaboration to improve early detection and response.

article.articleHeadline: Cláudio registra 87 casos de escabiose e suspende aulas da rede municipal na segunda-feira - Portal MPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cláudio records 87 cases of scabies and suspends classes in the municipal school system on Monday - Portal MPA.
article.articleSummary: 87 confirmed scabies cases in Cláudio, Minas Gerais, Brazil, reported as of 4:00 p.m. on Friday, November 27, 2026, with majority among municipal schoolchildren. In response, the municipality issued Decree No. 576 and will suspend municipal classes on Monday, November 30, to enable deep cleaning of classrooms, furniture, and shared items, and to enforce a three-day student distancing period to interrupt transmission. State and private schools will set their own schedules. Parents should monitor for intense itching, especially at night, and skin lesions, seeking care at a health unit if suspected. The measures aim to curb spread through sanitation and reduced contact among students. Full decree and notices are available on the city’s official site and social channels.
