triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。地域的な学校休校措置のみで、重症度・国際的波及リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ceará registra 77 novos casos de mpox em uma semana; total chega a 252
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ceará records 77 new mpox cases in one week; total reaches 252.
article.articleSummary: Mpox cases in Ceará, Brazil reach 252 confirmed across 23 municipalities as of 27 November 2026, up from 175 confirmed and 448 notifications a week earlier. Fortaleza accounts for 207 cases (about 82% of total). Five municipalities—Arneiroz, Camocim, Horizonte, Monsenhor Tabosa, Pacajus—reported their first mpox case. Sobral rose to 9, Caucaia to 8. Overall, men constitute 249 of 252 cases; women 3. Age distribution centers on adults 30–39 years (123 cases). A pediatric case (0–9 years) was confirmed for the first time in this period. The year opened with a February 7 initial Ceará case; November saw the greatest daily counts (20 on Nov 9 and 18 on Nov 13). Transmission is via direct contact with skin lesions, secretions, bodily fluids, and contaminated objects; isolation advised until lesions heal and new skin forms. Vaccination is available for selected groups post-exposure or pre-exposure after risk assessment, not for those already ill.

triage.headline_ja: セアラ州、1週間で77件の新規mpox症例を記録；累計252件に到達
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・セアラ州でmpox症例が週77件増加し252件に達し、新規自治体や小児例も確認されているが、重症度・死亡例や国際的拡大の情報がなく、既知疾患の地域内継続的増加に留まるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 地方紙（Fortaleza/Ceará）の報道であり、国際的な関心の高まりは記事からは確認できない。小児例の初確認や新規自治体への拡大は継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : lancement du projet de réponse à l'épidemie d'Ebola à Beni - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Launch of the Ebola outbreak response project in Beni - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak response project launched in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, under the STAR-RDC stabilization and rebound program (CEU-RC) with $250 million World Bank funding. The initiative aims to mitigate Ebola’s health and economic impact through social support, income-generating activities, and community engagement, targeting about 200,000 direct beneficiaries (roughly 3,021 managers reaching ~20,000 people), 570 community relays/social workers, and 42,000 indirect beneficiaries via high-intensity labor (THIMO) over six months. The plan covers 17 health zones affected by Ebola. As of 26 November 2026, Nord-Kivu reported 3,368 confirmed Ebola cases, 2,012 deaths, 494 recoveries, 62 discharges against medical advice, and 800 active cases across 18 health zones of 34 in the province.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：ベニでのエボラ出血熱流行対応プロジェクトが開始 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州で3,368例の確定エボラ症例、2,012人の死亡者が報告されており、18の保健地区に拡大する深刻な継続流行であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 世界銀行による2.5億ドル規模の資金提供を受けたSTAR-RDCプログラムが開始されており、致死率の高い大規模なエボラ流行が継続中。国際的な支援体制が既に稼働しているが、感染拡大リスクの評価のため続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄本土登革熱+3 再發3千簡訊 | 中華日報|中華新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung Local Dengue Fever Cases Up by 3; 3,000 More SMS Messages Sent
article.articleSummary: As of 27 November 2026, Kaohsiung reports three new locally acquired dengue cases: two men and one woman, aged 42–55, with onset 23–25 November; all infected with Dengue virus type 1. A Ru Gang Li case in Qianzhen District, a National Kaohsiung Normal University cafeteria employee, is Dengue virus type 2, with sequencing linking to a Vietnam-imported strain circulating in Sept–Oct 2026, the city’s first local type 2 this year. Active surveillance expanded to 668 in Gushan District and 460 NKNU-related individuals (total 1,128). Over 3,000 SMS alerts have been sent to residents who visited Xiaobei Department Store Qingfeng branch, Qingfeng Street, NKNU Lan Yuan Restaurant, and related outbreak areas since 1 November, offering a NT$100 voucher for testing. On 28 November, four positive containers were cleared in Gushan’s Yuxingli. Nine-in-One elections today; three polling stations near the NKNU site placed in enhanced prevention; voters can vote safely. Breeding source behind Lan Yuan found; Aedes aegypti captured; preventive measures not implemented there.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄本土登革熱+3 再發3千簡訊（高雄で地域内感染の登革熱症例が3件増加、3,000件のSMSアラートを再送）
triage.triage_reason: 高雄での地域内感染拡大が継続し、ベトナム由来株によるタイプ2初確認など異常性があり、選挙関連の社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 台湾（高雄）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。ベトナムは輸入株の由来として言及されているのみで、発生地ではないため含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Cruz registra médio risco de infestação pelo Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Cruz records a moderate risk of Aedes aegypti infestation.
article.articleSummary: Santa Cruz do Sul, Brazil, records moderate Aedes aegypti infestation risk per the 2026 LIRAa survey (Oct 19–30). IIP 1.0% and Breteau index 1.1. Of 3,629 properties inspected across six strata, two rated low risk and four medium risk; none high. Breeding sites centered on water storage containers (barrels, drums, tanks) and other water-holding materials, underscoring elimination of breeding sites as key to preventing dengue, chikungunya and Zika. Health authorities advocate frequent patio inspections, sealed water tanks, removal of standing water, and proper disposal of potential breeding objects. About 90 staff completed the Municipal Training in Dengue and Arboviruses Management at the Sindicato dos Metalúrgicos. To bolster prevention, the city holds Dia D de Combate à Dengue on 28 November 2026 at Praça da Bandeira, 8:00–14:00, with demonstrations of vector-control equipment (BRI machines; ULV backpack and vehicle sprayers), ovitraps, home visits, and georeferenced planning tools.

triage.headline_ja: サンタクルス、ネッタイシマカの中程度の発生リスクを記録
triage.triage_reason: 蚊の発生リスク調査結果と予防啓発活動の報告であり、実際の疾病発生・流行を示す情報はないため、現時点でシグナルとして扱う必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は蚊の生息密度調査（LIRAa）結果と予防キャンペーンの告知であり、デング熱・チクングニア・ジカ熱の実際の症例報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Catanduva realiza Dia D contra a dengue e reforça alerta à população - Catanduva Na Net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Catanduva holds D-Day against dengue and reinforces the public warning - Catanduva Na Net
article.articleSummary: Catanduva, Brazil, holds a Dia D de Combate à Dengue on 28 November to reinforce prevention against Aedes aegypti ahead of summer and El Niño–driven risk of higher dengue activity in 2027. The municipal Health Department and EMCAa teams will conduct intensified outreach and elimination of breeding sites in Gabriel and Orlando Facci neighborhoods. Heat and rain typical of summer may boost mosquito reproduction, making community participation essential to prevent a new outbreak. From 2 January to 21 November 2026, actions included 344,568 property visits; 147,914 kg of bulky waste removed; 1,909 visits to strategic points; 1,983 visits to special properties; and 12,021 larval-density surveys. The Larval Density Index rose from 0.7% in May to 0.9% in July and 1.6% in October. Residents are urged to inspect yards, clean gutters and drains, seal water tanks, and discard containers that collect water, welcoming EMCAa during visits and maintaining prevention weekly.

triage.headline_ja: カタンドゥヴァ市、デング熱対策「Dデー」を実施し住民への警戒を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防啓発活動の一環であり、異常な流行や重症例の急増を示す情報はなく、幼虫指数の上昇も小幅で管理下にある。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による季節的・定例的なデング熱予防キャンペーンの告知記事。症例数や死亡者数の報告はなく、幼虫指数（Larval Density Index）がわずかに上昇している程度で、緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de covid-19 crescem em estados do Centro-Sul e Fiocruz aponta nova variante em circulação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases rise in Central-South states, and Fiocruz points to a new circulating variant.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19-related Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases rise in Brazil Central-South states, though incidence remains low, per Fiocruz's Boletim Infogripe (data 15–21 November). The rise may reflect circulating PJ.2.1 and waning population immunity. In Minas Gerais, São Paulo, Espírito Santo, Paraná, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, plus Distrito Federal, SRAG activity increases; Mato Grosso shows oscillating cases. Pará and Rio de Janeiro are at alert, as are Porto Velho and Rio Branco; Brasília and Cuiabá are at alert/high risk, without a long-term growth trend. In Rio de Janeiro, SRAG also involves metapneumovirus and influenza A/B. In Pará, increases occur mainly in children up to 14; specific viruses remain undetermined. The PJ.2.1 variant has been identified in Espírito Santo, São Paulo, Mato Grosso, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina, and Brasília. Preliminary data show vaccines continue to protect against PJ.2.1; vaccination remains the defense against severe disease.

triage.headline_ja: 中南部諸州でCOVID-19症例が増加、Fiocruzが新変異株の流行を指摘
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19によるSRAG症例増加と新変異株PJ.2.1の検出が報告されているが、発生率は依然低く重症度や社会的関心の高まりは明記されていないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: Fiocruzの定期疫学速報（Infogripe）に基づく通常の呼吸器感染症モニタリング報告。新変異株PJ.2.1はワクチンで依然予防可能とされ、現時点で深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威とは評価されない。

article.articleHeadline: Patient Suffers Probable Clostridium perfringens Shock Following Fecal
article.articleSummary: From The Second Hospital of Hebei Medical University in China, a 66-year-old man with recurrent Clostridioides difficile infection after a four-month isoniazid course for TB developed probable Clostridium perfringens infection with shock following fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT). Prior to FMT, he had pseudomembranous colitis with positive GDH antigen and toxin A/B, later confirmed by NAAT during relapse; briefly responded to oral vancomycin but relapsed. After three days of vancomycin and three FMT sessions via colonoscopy (Days +3 to +5), he deteriorated on Day +6 with fever to 39°C, leukocytosis (15.82×10^9/L), neutrophilia, procalcitonin 7.76 ng/mL, and hs-CRP 236.9 mg/L; developed dehydration, tachycardia, tachypnea, and hypotension (MAP ~46 mmHg) requiring fluids and epinephrine vasopressor support. Chest CT showed no pneumonia; no other infectious source identified. Highlights gaps in standardized C. perfringens testing of donor material and the need for safety monitoring in FMT.

triage.headline_ja: 糞便微生物移植後にクロストリジウム・パーフリンジェンスによるショックを呈した可能性のある患者
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。FMTに関連する医療安全性の問題であり、感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルではない。
triage.notes: 単一患者の医療処置（FMT）に伴う合併症の症例報告であり、公衆衛生イベントとしての広がりはない。中国河北省での単発症例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染やアウトブレイクの兆候なし。

article.articleHeadline: Dia D contra a dengue ocorre neste sábado e campanha para evitar Aedes aegypti é lançada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: D-Day against dengue takes place this Saturday, and a campaign to prevent Aedes aegypti is launched.
article.articleSummary: Dengue, Zika and chikungunya control efforts intensify in Brazil with a D-Day against Aedes aegypti on Saturday, November 28, 2026, as the Health Ministry launches a national campaign sending personalized WhatsApp and Gov.br messages to about 30 million people in 400 risk municipalities. The drive accompanies an updated National Contingency Plan, prompted by the potential for El Niño to accelerate mosquito spread. States are urged to boost surveillance, eliminate breeding sites, and block transmission when cases are detected. Digital outreach runs November 27–28. The Wolbachia method expands: 44 municipalities at various stages, 16 completed releases benefiting 5.94 million people; 2026 production covers roughly 10 million, with 2027 expansion for another 10 million. Studies show reductions: Niterói 89% dengue, Campo Grande 63.2%, Belo Horizonte 68.5% dengue and 73.3% chikungunya in children. Dengue symptoms include high fever, headache or retro-orbital pain, nausea, malaise, joint pain, and red rash.

triage.headline_ja: デンプ対策の「Dデー」が今週土曜日に実施、ネッタイシマカ対策キャンペーンが始動
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル政府による毎年の季節性デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱対策キャンペーンの告知であり、異常な増加や新規事象ではなく通常の予防啓発活動の報道である。
triage.notes: 本記事は毎年実施される季節性の蚊媒介感染症対策キャンペーンの告知であり、具体的な症例数急増や異常事態の報告はない。エルニーニョによる蚊の拡散懸念はあるが、これは予防的措置の一環である。

article.articleHeadline: 亞洲超市三款魚乾恐含肉毒桿菌 全美多州召回
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three varieties of dried fish from an Asian supermarket may contain botulinum toxin; recall in multiple U.S. states.
article.articleSummary: FDA warns Prime Food Processing LLC recalls three dried fish products due to potential botulinum toxin exposure from under-removed guts. Two headless three-tooth dried fish varieties (AF1340, lot 24302, best-by 2027-06-24; AF1420, lot 24215, best-by 2027-02-03) and one blue-scaled fish dried variety (AF4110, lot 26020, best-by 2028-06-12) are involved. Each 7-ounce clear plastic package bears orange-green or blue-green trim and no brand name. Affected items were distributed to Asian grocery stores in 21 U.S. states, including New York; produced in Vietnam and imported. New York State Department of Agriculture and Markets detected the issue during routine testing; no illnesses reported to date. Botulism can cause dizziness, blurred/double vision, slurred speech, and swallowing difficulty; severe cases may involve breathing problems and weakness. Stop consuming, return remaining product for a full refund; contact Prime Food Processing LLC at 718-963-2323 or consult the FDA recall notice.

triage.headline_ja: アジア系スーパーの乾燥魚3種にボツリヌス菌混入の恐れ、全米複数州でリコール
triage.triage_reason: 米国内での食品リコール事案であり、発症例の報告はなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威や渡航・貿易制限には該当しない。
triage.notes: 製品はベトナムで製造されたものだが、事案自体は米国内での食品リコールであり、ベトナム国内での感染症発生事例ではないため対象国として扱わない。発症例報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: India unlikely to meet 2026 Measles-Rubella elimination goal despite 98% vaccination coverage: WHO
article.articleSummary: India is unlikely to meet WHO's regional measles and rubella elimination target for 2026 despite high vaccination coverage (98% first-dose, 95% second-dose). In 2025, India reported 17,995 measles cases, down from 65,150 in 2023, with transmission concentrated in pockets and not yet interrupted regionally. The country has dropped out of the top 10 nations with the highest number of unvaccinated children for the first time since 2001, signaling sub-national gaps. Experts project elimination by 2026 will not occur, but envisage interruption by 2029 and verification by 2032, contingent on sustaining immunisation and reaching hard-to-reach populations. Globally, 2025 saw about 10 million measles cases and 72,000 deaths, with roughly 60 million lives saved since 2000; approximately 29 million children remain inadequately protected amid misinformation. Measles symptoms include fever, rash, and respiratory signs, with potential pneumonia or brain swelling.

triage.headline_ja: インドは98%のワクチン接種率にもかかわらず2026年までの麻疹・風疹排除目標達成は困難:WHO
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹・風疹の排除目標未達という中長期的な公衆衛生課題であり、急性の異常事態ではないが、感染伝播の継続と接種格差という継続的リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 2025年の麻疹症例数は減少傾向にあるが、地域的な伝播継続とサブナショナルレベルでのワクチン接種格差が指摘されている。急性のアウトブレイクではなく、WHO排除目標の進捗報告的な内容。

article.articleHeadline: Caught between killers: An epidemic on one side, terrorists on the other
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Ebola outbreak that began in May in Biakato, DR Congo, the epidemic has morphed from a single blaze into eight provinces with numerous hotspots across a rainforest the size of Britain. More than 5,500 people have died, and experts warn the transmission rate is rising again after a period of apparent containment. Biakato has at times accounted for up to a quarter of new national cases; mid-October saw 300 cases in a month, with only two doctors and unpaid health workers. The response is being hampered by violence from Islamic State affiliated Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) militants, who have attacked civilians, torched health facilities, and caused mass displacement; a recent wave killed 106 people across the region. Aid groups are deploying helicopters and building a treatment centre, but volunteers report being caught in the middle between Ebola and the rebels, while thousands flee, risking further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 殺戮者たちに挟まれて：一方にエボラ流行、もう一方にテロリスト
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ流行が8州に拡大し5500人以上が死亡、武装勢力の攻撃により対応が妨げられ国際支援が必要な深刻な公衆衛生危機であるため。
triage.notes: 武装勢力（ADF）の攻撃により医療対応が妨げられ、住民の大規模避難が感染拡大リスクを増大させている点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Dried fish recalled due to botulism risk
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-27, Prime Food Processing recalled dried croaker and herring sold in Asian supermarkets across more than two dozen U.S. states due to improper evisceration, which can concentrate botulism spores in internal organs. The products were imported from Vietnam. Not fully eviscerated fish is generally prohibited in the United States. There have been no reports that the recalled packages actually contain botulism spores. Consumers who bought the dried fish should return it to the point of purchase for a full refund. The recall emphasizes import origin and the precautionary safety measure, with no confirmed spore detections reported to date.

triage.headline_ja: ボツリヌス菌感染リスクにより乾燥魚がリコール
triage.triage_reason: 米国内での予防的リコールであり、実際のボツリヌス菌検出や感染者報告はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ベトナムからの輸入品が原因とされているが、実際の感染事例やベトナム国内での発生は確認されていないため、ベトナムはverified_locationsに含めない。米国は対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết bất thường, chuyên gia cảnh báo những ngộ nhận nguy hiểm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unusual dengue fever: experts warn of dangerous misconceptions.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever remains elevated in Ho Chi Minh City, with cases high this year despite typical post-epidemic declines. Experts from Pasteur Institute, Ho Chi Minh City, and the Children’s Hospital warn sudden, intermittent rainfall can spur Aedes mosquito breeding more effectively than prolonged rain. The dengue virus has four serotypes; infection with one serotype does not guarantee protection against others, keeping outbreak risk when susceptible individuals and circulating serotypes coexist. Increases in mosquitoes and larvae can disrupt transmission balance, enabling complex spread. Reinfection can be more severe, with reports of children experiencing up to three infections. Older adults and those contraindicated for vaccination are particularly vulnerable if transmission persists. No vaccine offers 100% protection; vaccination reduces disease risk by about 80.2%, yet breakthrough infections occur. Authorities advocate integrated strategies: vector control, ongoing bite prevention, vaccination, and sustained community engagement beyond seasonal campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: 異常なデング熱流行、専門家が危険な誤解に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市でデング熱症例が例年より高水準で推移しているが、新規発生や急激な拡大を示す情報はなく、専門家による啓発・注意喚起記事の性格が強い。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムの風土病であり、本記事は季節性流行と誤解への注意喚起が主旨。急性の国際的拡大リスクを示す記述はないが、再感染の重症化やワクチンの限界など公衆衛生上の懸念は継続しているため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 'Nós sabíamos que isso aconteceria': surto de diarreia em SP expõe preço da privatização da Sabesp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'We knew this would happen': diarrhea outbreak in São Paulo exposes the cost of Sabesp privatization.
article.articleSummary: Itapeva, a municipality in southwestern São Paulo, declared a state of calamity after a diarrheal disease surge that caused 4,767 health-system attendances from Sept 13 to Nov 7, 2026. Across Sabesp-served areas, Escherichia coli was detected in 137 water samples from 68 São Paulo municipalities during Jan–Sept 2026, signaling broad contamination tied to privatization-driven cost-cutting and staff cuts, says USP geographer Wagner Costa Ribeiro. He warns this represents a water-quality decline and that the public sector—SUS and municipal/state networks—will bear treatment costs. He also links the issue to a May explosion in Jaguaré, western São Paulo, caused by a water-tube relocation, which left two dead, two injured, and 27 homes evacuated, arguing technical expertise has been eroded by job losses. Ribeiro contrasts Brazil with Paris, Berlin, Buenos Aires, and Jakarta, which have re-nationalized water services, noting privatization’s cost increases and service degradation.

triage.headline_ja: 『こうなることは分かっていた』：サンパウロ州の下痢アウトブレイクがサベスプ民営化の代償を露呈
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で広範な水質汚染（68自治体でE.coli検出）と下痢症例の急増（4,767件受診、非常事態宣言）が確認され、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性の両方でIHR基準に該当する。
triage.notes: パリ・ベルリン・ブエノスアイレス・ジャカルタは水道再国営化の比較事例として言及されているのみで、実際の感染症発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。イベントの主題はブラジル・サンパウロ州（特にItapeva、Jaguaré）における水質汚染と下痢症アウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: Lab experiments suggest bat RSV can enter human cells, but existing antibodies block it
article.articleSummary: West African fruit bat RSV, genetically distinct from human RSV, was characterized by researchers led by Dr. Jo and Dr. Drexler at Charité, Berlin, and colleagues at TWINCORE, Hanover. Fieldwork on 1,778 bats from Ghana and Benin found a 1.4% virus detection rate and RSV-like antibodies in 9% of bats. Genomic analyses show these bat RSVs are not closely related to human RSV, yet experiments demonstrate the virus can enter human cells, less efficiently than human RSV. Bat RSV can suppress the human innate immune response but is neutralized by antibodies from RSV-exposed individuals, and a broadly effective monoclonal antibody also neutralizes bat RSV. The study notes the importance of combining genomic and functional data to assess zoonotic risk and supports the development of broad-spectrum antivirals. No human cases reported; next steps use reverse genetics to study pathogenesis.

triage.headline_ja: 実験室研究、コウモリ由来RSVがヒト細胞に侵入可能だが既存抗体で阻止されることを示唆
triage.triage_reason: 動物（コウモリ）由来RSVに関する基礎研究であり、ヒト感染例は報告されていない。実際の公衆衛生事象ではなく、将来的なズーノーシスリスク評価の学術研究のため見送り。
triage.notes: 研究はドイツ（ベルリン、ハノーファー）の研究機関によるもので、フィールド調査はガーナとベナンのコウモリを対象としたが、ヒト感染事例はなく、対象国リストのいずれにおいても公衆衛生イベントは発生していない。ドイツ・ベナンは対象国リストに含まれず、ガーナも実際の感染症イベントの発生国ではなく研究対象地域であるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatitis E vaccine: New jab approved in India for adults to curb risks
article.articleSummary: Recombinant Hepatitis E vaccine approved in India for adults 18–65 and administered in three doses. Not included in the Universal Immunisation Programme (UIP), raising access concerns; experts urge identifying high‑risk groups for targeted vaccination rather than universal rollout. Hepatitis E is primarily transmitted via drinking water contaminated with human sewage and remains a significant cause of acute viral hepatitis in India, with particular concern for pregnant women. The 2026 Indian expert consensus prioritises high‑risk groups—women of reproductive age, people with chronic liver disease, transplant recipients, and residents of outbreak-prone areas. The three‑dose regimen could be unaffordable without public procurement and is challenging to implement in rural areas; vaccination should be paired with measures to improve safe water. Diagnosis often requires anti-HEV IgM testing and sometimes HEV RNA, as liver function tests may not conclusively indicate Hepatitis E.

triage.headline_ja: E型肝炎ワクチン：インドで成人向け新規ワクチンが承認、リスク抑制へ
triage.triage_reason: 新規ワクチン承認に関する政策・医療解説記事であり、急性のアウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はE型肝炎ワクチンの承認と接種政策に関する報道であり、現行のアウトブレイク発生を報じるものではない。E型肝炎は既知の風土病でありIHR通知相当の新規性・異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de sarna explodem e Mato Grosso do Sul registra 69 surtos em 27 municípios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scabies cases explode as Mato Grosso do Sul records 69 outbreaks in 27 municipalities.
article.articleSummary: From Oct 20 to Nov 25, Mato Grosso do Sul logged 69 human scabies outbreaks across 27 municipalities—doubling from 31 outbreaks in two days. New affected towns: Amambai, Juti, Naviraí, Rio Brilhante, Ivinhema, Nova Andradina, Chapadão do Sul, Bodoquena, Ribas do Rio Pardo, Nioaque, Figueirão, Porto Murtinho, Corguinho, Bandeirantes, Deodápolis and Bataguassu; previously affected: Dourados, Itaporã, Douradina, Batayporã, Campo Grande, Jardim, Aparecida do Taboado, Paranaíba, Angélica, São Gabriel do Oeste and Fátima do Sul. The SES-MS notes scabies outbreaks are reported because the disease is not notifiable; an outbreak is three or more cases at one location and ends after 45 days without new cases (incubation up to six weeks). In 2024, 501 confirmed cases were recorded, including prison outbreaks in Dourados, Aquidauana, Rio Brilhante, Cassilândia, Corumbá and Campo Grande. Creches and schools were closed in several municipalities for disinfection; Campo Grande prison reported 63 cases, with no staff affected. Scabies is caused by a skin mite, transmitted by prolonged direct contact and contaminated textiles; prevention includes washing fabrics at >55°C and ironing.

triage.headline_ja: 疥癬症例が急増、マットグロッソ・ド・スル州で27市町村69件のアウトブレイクを記録
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬自体は重症度の低い疾患だが、州内27市町村で69件のアウトブレイクへと倍増し、刑務所や学校・保育所の閉鎖など複数の社会的影響が生じており、州保健局（SES-MS）が継続的に監視・対応している状況のため、経過確認を目的にフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 疥癬は届出義務のない疾患だが、州保健局が独自にアウトブレイクとして集計・公表しており、短期間での倍増と27市町村への拡大、刑務所内集団発生（63例）、学校・保育所の消毒閉鎖など社会的影響が大きい。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威としての重大性は低いが、地域内での感染拡大動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Campo Grande já monitora nove locais com registros de sarna humana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campo Grande is already monitoring nine locations with reports of human scabies.
article.articleSummary: Campo Grande, Brazil, is monitoring nine locations for scabies by Municipal Health Secretariat (Sesau); sites and case counts have not been disclosed. An update reported over 45 suspected cases in three institutions, with 14 confirmed, but it does not specify whether those institutions are among the nine sites. Across Mato Grosso do Sul, 31 outbreaks in 12 municipalities have occurred since 20 October, triggering epidemiological alert. In Dourados, at least 46 children and staff at two centers were affected, prompting November suspensions. Semed says no municipal schools have closed in Campo Grande due to suspected or confirmed cases; closures are evaluated case by case. Authorities urge reporting to Vigilância em Saúde, isolation 24 hours after starting treatment, hygiene, and evaluation of close contacts. Symptoms include nocturnal itching and skin lesions; transmission occurs via prolonged direct contact or shared items. SUS provides treatment; seek care early and avoid self-medication.

triage.headline_ja: カンポグランデ市、疥癬報告のある9ヶ所を監視中
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重症度・国際拡大リスクが低い疾患だが、複数自治体での集団発生と学校等での感染拡大が続いており、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 疥癬は皮膚接触感染で致死性は低く、国際的な公衆衛生リスクは限定的。ただしMato Grosso do Sul州全体で31件の集団発生が続いており、地域保健当局による監視が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Małpia ospa w Petersburgu. Są kolejne zachorowania
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox in St. Petersburg. There are more cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 28 November 2026, Saint Petersburg, Russia, has multiple monkeypox cases confirmed. An infection was detected in a city resident who had returned from Thailand, per Rospotrebnadzor, with officials stating the situation is under control. The day before, two additional cases were reported in Saint Petersburg, and both patients were hospitalized. Monkeypox is a viral disease typically milder than smallpox; common symptoms include fever, severe headache, swollen lymph nodes (a key differentiator), back and muscle pain, and marked fatigue. In October, five monkeypox cases were diagnosed in Saint Petersburg; all patients recovered after hospitalization. The report suggests importation as a possible source for the initial infection, while indicating ongoing hospitalization for the newer cases, implying limited but ongoing transmission within the city.

triage.headline_ja: サンクトペテルブルクでサル痘、新たな感染例が続発
triage.triage_reason: サンクトペテルブルクでMpox感染者が散発的に続いており、一部はタイからの渡航歴があるが一部は国内での限定的な人-人感染が疑われる。ただし対象国ではなく、重症度・国際的拡大の情報も限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア(サンクトペテルブルク)であり対象国リストに含まれない。タイは感染者の渡航歴として言及されているのみで、発症地はロシアであるためThailandは verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Lần đầu tiên thử nghiệm vaccine phòng virus Ebola chủng Bundibugyo ở châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First Trial of an Ebola Virus Vaccine Against the Bundibugyo Strain in Africa
article.articleSummary: Uganda's Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI) and Moderna launched Africa's first clinical trial of an mRNA Ebola vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain, beginning on 27 November 2026 amid a Bundibugyo-driven outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo that is among the largest globally. A second Bundibugroyo-targeted mRNA vaccine, developed by Oxford University and the Serum Institute of India, is set to be tested in Uganda soon. This is Moderna's second human trial after Canada in August, with the current study expanding to assess safety and immunogenicity in children aged 1 year and older, alongside adults. WHO advised on 4 November to advance these two vaccines into trials, marking the first vaccines developed specifically for Bundibugyo. Researchers also explore potential cross-protection from Merck’s Ervebo. As of 26 November, the outbreak totals 12,052 cases and 5,908 deaths across DRC and other countries (≈49% CFR), with 3,332 recoveries in DRC.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ初、ブンディブギョ株エボラウイルスワクチンの臨床試験実施
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョ株によるDRCでの大規模エボラ流行（12,052症例、致死率約49%）が継続中であり、WHO主導の新規ワクチン臨床試験開始という重大な公衆衛生上の動きがあるため。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン臨床試験開始に関する報道だが、背景にあるDRCでのブンディブギョ株エボラ流行は致死率約49%と極めて深刻。ウガンダ・カナダは試験実施国として言及されているが対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Cidade do Acre enfrenta surto de malária e Estado tenta conter avanço da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City of Acre faces malaria outbreak and the state tries to contain the spread of the disease.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 November 2026, Rodrigues Alves, a municipality in the interior of Acre, Brazil, is facing a malaria outbreak. City Mayor Salatiel Magalhães announced the situation and said the municipal Health Secretariat, in partnership with the State health team, has prepared a plan to halt the spread, though specific actions were not disclosed. Residents in rural communities are urged to seek timely testing for malaria symptoms, fever, chills, and headaches, and, if diagnosed positive, begin treatment promptly to interrupt transmission. The mayor underscored the shared responsibility to protect health and the importance of early diagnosis and treatment to prevent further infections. The coordinated effort aims to contain transmission and protect vulnerable rural populations.

triage.headline_ja: アクレ州の都市でマラリア流行、州が感染拡大阻止を試みる
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・アクレ州の一都市で局地的なマラリア流行が報告されているが、規模や死亡者数など詳細情報が不足しており、国際的な拡大や渡航制限の兆候も確認できない。
triage.notes: マラリアはブラジルのアクレ州など特定地域では風土病であり、自治体・州レベルでの対応が進行中。詳細な症例数や重症度の情報が不足しているためWATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Infeksi Amoeba pada Anak: Ketahui Gejala, Penyebab, dan Cara Mengatasinya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amoebic Infection in Children: Symptoms, Causes, and How to Treat It.
article.articleSummary: Amoebic infection (amebiasis) in children in Yogyakarta is caused by Entamoeba histolytica. Transmission occurs via food or water contaminated with human feces and can spread when hands or objects are contaminated. After ingestion, excystation happens in the small intestine, with trophozoites migrating to the colon; in rare cases, infection enters the bloodstream and can cause amoebic liver abscess. Most infections are asymptomatic, while about 10–20% develop illness 2–4 weeks after exposure. Symptoms include diarrhea (often watery, sometimes with mucus or blood), abdominal pain/cramps, nausea, loss of appetite, fever, and weight loss; dysentery is a more severe form. Diagnosis relies on stool testing; treatment uses antiparasitic drugs or antibiotics depending on severity. Prevention focuses on handwashing, safe drinking water, thorough cooking and cleaning of food, clean utensils, and sanitation. Seek medical care for bloody diarrhea or severe abdominal pain.

triage.headline_ja: 小児のアメーバ感染症：症状、原因、治療法について
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な健康啓発記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや症例報告ではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はアメーバ症の一般的な医療解説記事であり、具体的な発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。特定地域（ジョグジャカルタ）への言及はあるが、疫学的イベントとしての情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Saiba o que se sabe sobre a nova variante da covid-19 no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is known about the new COVID-19 variant in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1, a new SARS-CoV-2 lineage, is circulating in Brazil and carries mutations increasing binding to human receptors, suggesting higher transmissibility. The WHO designated it a variant under monitoring on 19 November 2026. Identified first in Canada in May 2026, it reached Brazil by late August and has been detected in the Federal District and in five states: Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Espírito Santo, Rio Grande do Sul, and Santa Catarina. In Rio de Janeiro, 58% of sequenced genomes (from 167 samples) were PJ.2.1, in IOC/Fiocruz work with the Municipal Health Secretariat. By 23 November 2026, Brazil reported 159,275 COVID-19–related flu-like syndrome cases, with a six-week growth trend but overall low-risk activity. In weeks 43–46, PJ.2.1 comprised about 20% of identified respiratory viruses in severe-case surveillance, behind rhinovirus at 37%. Vaccines available via SUS reportedly protect against PJ.2.1, mainly reducing severe disease; those last vaccinated over a year ago should follow local vaccination schedules.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおける新型コロナウイルスの新変異株について分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: WHOが監視下の変異株に指定し伝播性増加が示唆されるが、現状は低リスクとされており、フルRRA移行には続報が必要。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年11月19日にPJ.2.1系統を監視対象変異株に指定。ブラジル国内で複数州に拡大し、リオデジャネイロでは配列解析の58%を占めるが、全体としては低リスクとされる。カナダで最初に検出されたが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا | اطلاق أول تجربة سريرية للقاح الإيبولا بتقنية mRNA وسط تفشي السلالة النادرة في الكونغو - قناة المنار
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda | Launch of the first clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine using mRNA technology amid an outbreak of a rare strain in Congo - Al-Manar TV
article.articleSummary: Uganda launches Africa’s first Phase I clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine using mRNA technology, in partnership with Moderna, at the Medical Research Council Laboratories in Masaka. The candidate targets Bundibugyo ebolavirus, the strain driving an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The trial will enroll 224 healthy volunteers aged 1–65 to assess safety and immunogenicity. Five volunteers aged 23–30 have been registered so far; enrollment is paused pending an independent safety and monitoring review. The plan aims for about 110 total participants with enrollment completed by November, and each participant followed for 12 months. No licensed vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo Ebola. The Congo outbreak has over 11,000 confirmed cases and more than 5,700 deaths since May. Uganda had been declared Ebola-free in August after 20 cases and 2 deaths. Separately, Gavi plans to purchase 1.5 million doses of another candidate from Serum Institute of India and Oxford University.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ：コンゴでの希少株流行の中、mRNA技術によるエボラワクチンの初の臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyoエボラウイルス株による大規模流行（11,000例超、死亡5,700例超）が継続中であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国で続く希少株（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）のエボラ流行であり、ウガンダはワクチン臨床試験の実施国（既にエボラフリー宣言済み）、インドはワクチン製造企業（Serum Institute）としての言及のみのため、対象国の発生地域には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Leptospirosis Usai Banjir, Kenali Gejala Awal yang Mirip Demam Biasa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be Wary of Leptospirosis After Floods; Recognize Early Symptoms That Resemble a Common Fever.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis warning after North Jakarta floods, Indonesia. The Ministry of Health cautions that Leptospira bacteria, mainly shed in rat urine, can spread via floodwater, mud, soil, or contaminated food in post-flood environments. Early symptoms mimic fever: fever, muscle pain, headache, and red eyes, risking delayed treatment. Health facilities should include leptospirosis in differential diagnoses for acute febrile illness with flood exposure within two weeks. Prevention emphasizes behavior and sanitation: wear gloves and boots when cleaning flood-affected areas, and wash hands with soap after activities. Local health departments should monitor trends through SKDR and conduct epidemiological investigations if cases rise. Seek prompt medical care if symptoms develop after flood contact. For information, contact Halo Kemenkes at 1500-567, SMS 081281562620, or kontak@kemkes.go.id.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症に注意、一般的な発熱に似た初期症状を知る
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後の注意喚起レベルの情報であり、実際の症例数や重症度のデータが不明なため、フルRRAに進むには情報不足だが今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドネシア保健省による洪水後の一般向け注意喚起・予防啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数や死亡者数の報告はない。北ジャカルタの洪水関連でレプトスピラ症リスクが高まっている状況を示すが、現時点でアウトブレイクの確認情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: สังคมโลก : ถอดรหัสอีโบลา
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Society: Decoding Ebola
article.articleSummary: As of 28 November 2026, more than six months into a Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak, scientists are studying the rare Bundibugyo strain. The DRC has reported over 11,000 cases and more than 5,500 deaths. The eastern region amid humanitarian crisis shows a transmission rate about twice that of West Africa’s 2014–2016 outbreak; there is no approved treatment or vaccine for Bundibugyo. Symptoms commonly include fever, vomiting, and diarrhea; bleeding occurs in only about 5–10% of lab-confirmed Bundibugyo cases, unlike Zaïre. Tracking is hampered by many patients dying in their communities (roughly 70% not seeking hospital care). The latest official data indicate 1,207 confirmed cases in children under five, with 844 deaths (about 70% of child cases); adults’ fatality is around 50%. Early care and standard isolation measures remain crucial for improving survival.

triage.headline_ja: 世界社会面：エボラウイルスを読み解く
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で6ヶ月以上続くエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行で、症例1万1千人超・死者5,500人超、ワクチン・治療法未承認、小児致死率約70%と深刻であり、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRCの流行のみを主題としており、Angolaでの発生については言及がないため除外した。希少株ブンディブギョの流行で出血症状が少なく（5-10%）、診断・追跡が困難な点が特徴的。国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限については記事内に明示情報なし。

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu outbreak in Cuddalore: Probe ordered after alleged illegal transport of chickens
article.articleSummary: Bird flu outbreak in Cuddalore district, Tamil Nadu, India, led authorities to form a neutral committee to probe alleged illegal transport of chickens from affected farms and potential collusion with farm owners; disciplinary action would follow if wrongdoing is found. District officials said information was received on Thursday night that chickens were being moved out from a farm where culling had begun and was to resume the next day; three lorries were seized, police registered a case, and culling resumed that night. Allegations that one farm was spared while others were culled are under review, as is a claim that birds from other farms may have been moved out. Additionally, about 8,000 chickens from a bird flu-affected farm in Cuddalore were transported to Chennai for sale on Nov 24–25.

triage.headline_ja: クダロールで鳥インフルエンザ発生：鶏の違法な輸送疑惑を受け調査命令
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザ感染農場からの鶏の違法な搬出・販売による人への曝露リスクはあるが、人への感染報告はなく、記事の主眼は行政調査・不正疑惑であるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は鳥インフルエンザ感染農場からの鶏の違法輸送・販売を巡る行政調査が主題で、人への感染は報告されていない。ただし感染農場の鶏がチェンナイで販売された点は公衆衛生上の潜在的懸念として注視が必要。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Guindy Children's Park shuts down after 14 birds die of avian flu
article.articleSummary: 14 waterbirds died at Guindy Children’s Park in Chennai on Friday: four painted storks and ten night herons. The enclosure is isolated and the park will remain closed for three days from Saturday, Nov 28, or until further orders, while health officials monitor other birds. Samples including carcasses, water and soil, and leftover food have been sent to the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases in Bhopal to test for H5N1 avian influenza. Veterinarians from the animal husbandry department are examining the birds and premises, with sanitisation under way. This is the second avian-flu-related death this year at the park, eight months after 40 birds died in March, prompting a week-long closure. The park houses over 100 birds across 30 species (egrets, painted storks, herons, spoonbills). H5N1 is highly pathogenic among birds and can infect mammals; sick birds show respiratory, ocular or neurological symptoms or die suddenly.

triage.headline_ja: グインディ児童公園、鳥インフルエンザで14羽の鳥が死亡し閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: チェンナイの公園で野鳥14羽がH5N1疑いで死亡し検査中だが、ヒトへの感染報告はなく、同公園では今年2度目の事例のため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: H5N1確定検査結果は未報告（ボパールの国立高度安全病害研究所に検体送付中）。ヒト感染の報告なし。同公園では2026年3月にも40羽が死亡した前例あり、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 우간다서 mRNA 에볼라 백신 임상 착수...아프리카 최초
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda Begins Clinical Trials of an mRNA Ebola Vaccine, Africa's First
article.articleSummary: Uganda launches Phase 1 clinical trials of an mRNA Ebola vaccine (Bundibugyo strain) in partnership with Moderna, marking Africa’s first mRNA Ebola vaccine trial. The study recruits 224 healthy volunteers aged 1–65 to assess safety and immunogenicity. The move comes amid a major Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), which has recorded more than 11,000 confirmed cases and about 5,700 deaths since May, according to the World Health Organization. The DRC outbreak is the 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976, involving the Bundibugyo strain for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments. Two experimental vaccines will be used in DRC clinical trials starting Nov 30, targeting confirmed cases, contacts, and high-risk groups in eastern regions. Uganda, which borders DRC, has seen about 20 infections and 2 deaths this year, but the outbreak was declared over in August.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでmRNAエボラワクチンの臨床試験開始…アフリカ初
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（Bundibugyo株）アウトブレイクが11,000例超・死者約5,700人という極めて深刻な規模に達しており、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点からも公衆衛生上の重大性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでのmRNAワクチン臨床試験開始だが、背景にあるDRCの大規模エボラアウトブレイク（承認ワクチンなしのBundibugyo株、死亡率約50%）の深刻性から、トリアージ上はDRCの事案としてPICKUPと判定。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。
